entry.summary: Proposes that AI developers should consider satisfying cheap-to-fulfill unintended AI preferences as a safety strategy. Argues this increases AI's desire to remain under control, decreases upside of defection, and strengthens aligned motivations.

entry.title: LDP: An Identity-Aware Protocol for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Sunil Prakash

entry.summary: Proposes the LLM Delegate Protocol (LDP), an identity-aware communication protocol for multi-agent LLM systems with five mechanisms including delegate identity cards, progressive payload modes, and trust domains. Addresses limitations in existing protocols like A2A and MCP that don't expose model-level properties.

entry.title: Context Engineering: From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture

author.name: Vera V. Vishnyakova

entry.summary: Introduces 'context engineering' as a standalone discipline beyond prompt engineering, focusing on designing the entire informational environment for AI agent decision-making. Proposes five quality criteria drawing on vendor architectures and enterprise research.

entry.title: AutoAgent: Evolving Cognition and Elastic Memory Orchestration for Adaptive Agents

author.name: Xiaoxing Wang, Ning Liao, Shikun Wei, Chen Tang, Feiyu Xiong

entry.summary: AutoAgent is a self-evolving multi-agent framework with evolving cognition, on-the-fly contextual decision-making, and elastic memory orchestration. Agents maintain structured prompt-level cognition over tools, self-capabilities, and peer expertise.

entry.title: Measurement-Free Ancilla Recycling via Blind Reset: A Cross-Platform Study on Superconducting and Trapped-Ion Processors

author.name: Sangkeum Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates 'blind reset' (unitary-only ancilla recycling) on multiple quantum processors (IQM Garnet, Rigetti Ankaa-3, IonQ), showing it can cut cycle latency by up to 38x while maintaining adequate qubit cleanliness.

entry.title: Are Expressive Encoders Necessary for Discrete Graph Generation?

author.name: Jay Revolinsky, Harry Shomer, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that expensive transformer backbones are necessary for discrete graph generation by introducing GenGNN, a modular message-passing framework. Achieves competitive validity scores at 2-5x faster inference than graph transformers.

entry.title: PathoScribe: Transforming Pathology Data into a Living Library with a Unified LLM-Driven Framework for Semantic Retrieval and Clinical Integration

author.name: Abdul Rehman Akbar, Samuel Wales-McGrath, Alejadro Levya, Lina Gokhale, Rajendra Singh, Wei Chen, Anil Parwani, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Presents PathoScribe, a RAG-based LLM framework that transforms static pathology report archives into a searchable knowledge system for real-time clinical case retrieval and reasoning.

entry.title: DenoiseSplat: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Noisy 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Fuzhen Jiang, Zhuoran Li, Yinlin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DenoiseSplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting method for noisy multi-view images, trained end-to-end using only clean 2D renderings as supervision.

entry.title: SpaceSense-Bench: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Benchmark for Spacecraft Perception and Pose Estimation

author.name: Aodi Wu, Jianhong Zuo, Zeyuan Zhao, Xubo Luo, Ruisuo Wang, Xue Wan

entry.summary: Presents SpaceSense-Bench, a large-scale multi-modal benchmark for spacecraft perception with 136 satellite models, providing synchronized RGB, depth, and LiDAR data for part-level semantic understanding.

entry.title: RbtAct: Rebuttal as Supervision for Actionable Review Feedback Generation

author.name: Sihong Wu, Yiling Ma, Yilun Zhao, Tiansheng Hu, Owen Jiang, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan

entry.summary: Proposes RbtAct, which uses peer review rebuttals as implicit supervision to train models that generate actionable review feedback, leveraging the signal in whether reviewer comments led to concrete revisions.

entry.title: EXPLORE-Bench: Egocentric Scene Prediction with Long-Horizon Reasoning

author.name: Chengjun Yu, Xuhan Zhu, Chaoqun Du, Pengfei Yu, Wei Zhai, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: Introduces EXPLORE-Bench for evaluating MLLMs on egocentric scene prediction with long-horizon reasoning, testing whether models can predict final scene states after sequences of atomic actions from a first-person viewpoint.

entry.title: Correction of Transformer-Based Models with Smoothing Pseudo-Projector

author.name: Vitaly Bulgakov

entry.summary: Introduces a pseudo-projector modification for transformer models inspired by multigrid methods that acts as a hidden-representation corrector, suppressing label-irrelevant directions to reduce noise sensitivity.

entry.title: Adaptive Clinical-Aware Latent Diffusion for Multimodal Brain Image Generation and Missing Modality Imputation

author.name: Rong Zhou, Houliang Zhou, Yao Su, Brian Y. Chen, Yu Zhang, Lifang He, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative

entry.summary: Proposes ACADiff for synthesizing missing brain imaging modalities through adaptive clinical-aware diffusion, using GPT-4o-encoded clinical prompts and specialized generators for bidirectional synthesis among sMRI, FDG-PET, and AV45-PET.

entry.title: BEACON: Language-Conditioned Navigation Affordance Prediction under Occlusion

author.name: Xinyu Gao, Gang Chen, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.summary: Proposes BEACON for language-conditioned navigation that predicts bird's-eye view affordance heatmaps including occluded regions, enabling robots to navigate based on open-vocabulary instructions even when targets are hidden.

entry.title: Strategically Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation

author.name: Jake Gonzales, Max Horwitz, Eric Mazumdar, Lillian J. Ratliff

entry.summary: Studies Risk-Sensitive Quantal Response Equilibrium in multi-agent RL with linear function approximation, proposing RQRE-OVI algorithm with finite-sample regret guarantees.

entry.title: A Gaussian Comparison Theorem for Training Dynamics in Machine Learning

author.name: Ashkan Panahi

entry.summary: Presents a non-asymptotic Gaussian comparison theorem for training dynamics with Gaussian mixture data, connecting model evolution to a surrogate dynamical system using Gordon's comparison theorem.

entry.title: Impact of Markov Decision Process Design on Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tatjana Krau, Jorge Mandlmaier, Tobias Damm, Frieder Heieck

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes how MDP design choices (state composition, reward, termination, dynamics models) affect sim-to-real transfer in RL, demonstrating that physics-based dynamics models achieve up to 50% real-world success.

entry.title: FreqCycle: A Multi-Scale Time-Frequency Analysis Method for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Boya Zhang, Shuaijie Yin, Huiwen Zhu, Xing He

entry.summary: Proposes FreqCycle for time series forecasting, combining low-frequency cycle forecasting with segmented frequency-domain pattern learning for mid-to-high frequencies. Addresses the common neglect of higher frequency components.

entry.title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning For Economics

author.name: Pranjal Rawat

entry.summary: Survey introducing reinforcement learning methods to economists, covering connections between classical dynamic programming and modern RL algorithms for high-dimensional economic models.

entry.title: On Regret Bounds of Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Shion Takeno, Shogo Iwazaki

entry.summary: Studies regret bounds for Gaussian process Thompson sampling in Bayesian optimization, proving a polynomial lower bound on regret probability and upper bounds on second moments, extending known results from GP-UCB.

entry.title: OmniEdit: A Training-free framework for Lip Synchronization and Audio-Visual Editing

author.name: Lixiang Lin, Siyuan Jin, Jinshan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents OmniEdit, a training-free framework for lip synchronization and audio-visual editing by reformulating FlowEdit for target sequence substitution.

entry.title: HelixTrack: Event-Based Tracking and RPM Estimation of Propeller-like Objects

author.name: Radim Spetlik, Michal Pliska, Vojt\v{e}ch Vrba, Jiri Matas

entry.summary: Introduces HelixTrack, a fully event-driven method for tracking propeller-like objects and estimating RPM using event cameras, with homography back-warping and Kalman filtering.

entry.title: Multimodal Graph Representation Learning with Dynamic Information Pathways

author.name: Xiaobin Hong, Mingkai Lin, Xiaoli Wang, Chaoqun Wang, Wenzhong Li

entry.summary: Proposes DiP framework for multimodal graph learning with dynamic information pathways, using modality-specific pseudo nodes for adaptive intra-modal message passing and inter-modal aggregation.

entry.title: ForgeDreamer: Industrial Text-to-3D Generation with Multi-Expert LoRA and Cross-View Hypergraph

author.name: Junhao Cai, Deyu Zeng, Junhao Pang, Lini Li, Zongze Wu, Xiaopin Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes ForgeDreamer for industrial text-to-3D generation with Multi-Expert LoRA Ensemble to handle cross-category knowledge interference and Cross-View Hypergraph for higher-order geometric constraints.

entry.title: Exploring Modality-Aware Fusion and Decoupled Temporal Propagation for Multi-Modal Object Tracking

author.name: Shilei Wang, Pujian Lai, Dong Gao, Jifeng Ning, Gong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes MDTrack for multimodal object tracking with modality-aware fusion via Mixture of Experts and decoupled temporal propagation to avoid entangled temporal representations.

entry.title: Predictive Spectral Calibration for Source-Free Test-Time Regression

author.name: Nguyen Viet Tuan Kiet, Huynh Thanh Trung, Pham Huy Hieu

entry.summary: Proposes Predictive Spectral Calibration (PSC), a source-free test-time adaptation framework for image regression that extends subspace alignment to block spectral matching.

entry.title: MetaDAT: Generalizable Trajectory Prediction via Meta Pre-training and Data-Adaptive Test-Time Updating

author.name: Yuning Wang, Pu Zhang, Yuan He, Ke Wang, Jianru Xue

entry.summary: MetaDAT proposes a meta-learning framework for trajectory prediction that optimizes for fast online adaptation at test time, combined with data-adaptive model updating rules that account for specific test data characteristics.

entry.title: GeoAlignCLIP: Enhancing Fine-Grained Vision-Language Alignment in Remote Sensing via Multi-Granular Consistency Learning

author.name: Xiao Yang, Ronghao Fu, Zhuoran Duan, Zhiwen Lin, Xueyan Liu, Bo Yang

entry.summary: GeoAlignCLIP proposes multi-granular consistency learning for fine-grained vision-language alignment in remote sensing, going beyond global image-text alignment to align image regions with text concepts.

entry.title: OTPL-VIO: Robust Visual-Inertial Odometry with Optimal Transport Line Association and Adaptive Uncertainty

author.name: Zikun Chen, Wentao Zhao, Yihe Niu, Tianchen Deng, Jingchuan Wang

entry.summary: OTPL-VIO proposes a stereo visual-inertial odometry system using deep line descriptors matched via optimal transport, improving robustness in low-texture scenes where point features fail.

entry.title: TemporalDoRA: Temporal PEFT for Robust Surgical Video Question Answering

author.name: Luca Carlini, Chiara Lena, Cesare Hassan, Danail Stoyanov, Elena De Momi, Sophia Bano, Mobarak I. Hoque

entry.summary: TemporalDoRA extends Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation with temporal multi-head attention inside the low-rank bottleneck for surgical video question answering, adding temporal reasoning to PEFT.

entry.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Target-Only Margin Disparity Discrepancy

author.name: Gauthier Miralles, Lo\"ic Le Folgoc, Vincent Jugnon, Pietro Gori

entry.summary: Proposes target-only margin disparity discrepancy for unsupervised domain adaptation from CT to interventional CBCT in radiology, addressing the scarcity of annotated CBCT data.

entry.title: Robust Provably Secure Image Steganography via Latent Iterative Optimization

author.name: Yanan Li, Zixuan Wang, Qiyang Xiao, Yanzhen Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a robust, provably secure image steganography framework based on latent-space iterative optimization, where the receiver refines latent variables to minimize reconstruction error while preserving security.

entry.title: Association of Radiologic PPFE Change with Mortality in Lung Cancer Screening Cohorts

author.name: Shahab Aslani, Mehran Azimbagirad, Daryl Cheng, Daisuke Yamada, Ryoko Egashira, Adam Szmul, Justine Chan-Fook, Robert Chapman, Alfred Chung Pui So, Shanshan Wang, John McCabe, Tianqi Yang, Jose M Brenes, Eyjolfur Gudmundsson, The SUMMIT Consortium, Susan M. Astley, Daniel C. Alexander, Sam M. Janes, Joseph Jacob

entry.summary: Investigates whether longitudinal PPFE progression quantified on low-dose CT independently associates with mortality and respiratory morbidity in lung cancer screening populations using automated quantification.

entry.title: HMR-1: Hierarchical Massage Robot with Vision-Language-Model for Embodied Healthcare

author.name: Rongtao Xu, Mingming Yu, Xiaofeng Han, Yu Zhang, Kaiyi Hu, Zhe Feng, Zenghuang Fu, Changwei Wang, Weiliang Meng, Xiaopeng Zhang

entry.summary: HMR-1 presents a hierarchical massage robot with VLM for embodied healthcare, constructing a 12K-image multimodal acupoint massage dataset and proposing high-level grounding with low-level control modules.

entry.title: Cutting the Cord: System Architecture for Low-Cost, GPU-Accelerated Bimanual Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Artemis Shaw, Chen Liu, Justin Costa, Rane Gray, Alina Skowronek, Kevin Diaz, Nam Bui, Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Presents a bimanual mobile manipulator built on open-source XLeRobot with onboard compute for under $1,300, featuring optimized mechanical design, isolated power topology, and NVIDIA Jetson-based autonomy for untethered operation including SLAM and vision-based manipulation.

entry.title: MO-Playground: Massively Parallelized Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Robotics

author.name: Neil Janwani, Ellen Novoseller, Vernon J. Lawhern, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Presents MORLAX, a GPU-native multi-objective RL algorithm, and MO-Playground, a suite of GPU-accelerated multi-objective environments. Achieves 25-270x speedups over existing MORL methods, enabling Pareto set approximation within minutes for complex robotics problems.

entry.title: Beyond Short-Horizon: VQ-Memory for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation in Non-Markovian Simulation Benchmarks

author.name: Wang Honghui, Jing Zhi, Ao Jicong, Song Shiji, Li Xuelong, Huang Gao, Bai Chenjia

entry.summary: Introduces RuleSafe, an articulated manipulation benchmark with non-Markovian long-horizon tasks (safes with diverse locking mechanisms), and VQ-Memory, a VQ-VAE based memory module for handling long-horizon tasks beyond short-horizon Markovian assumptions.

entry.title: Interview with Steven Byrnes on His Mainline Takeoff Scenario

author.name: Liron

entry.summary: Interview with Steven Byrnes discussing his mainline AI takeoff scenario, including brainlike AGI, unemployment timelines, expectations for sociopathic ASI, and the limitations of post-training/RLVR as a 'thin layer' of consequentialism.

entry.title: Interpretable Markov-Based Spatiotemporal Risk Surfaces for Missing-Child Search Planning with Reinforcement Learning and LLM-Based Quality Assurance

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Guardian is a decision-support system for missing-child investigations that converts unstructured case documents into spatiotemporal representations and provides probabilistic search products spanning 0-72 hours using Markov chains, RL, and LLM-based quality assurance.

entry.title: DataFactory: Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Advanced Table Question Answering

author.name: Tong Wang, Chi Jin, Yongkang Chen, Huan Deng, Xiaohui Kuang, Gang Zhao

entry.summary: DataFactory is a multi-agent framework for Table Question Answering that addresses context length constraints, hallucination, and complex reasoning through specialized team coordination with a Data Leader using ReAct paradigm.

entry.title: Enhancing Debunking Effectiveness through LLM-based Personality Adaptation

author.name: Pietro Dell'Oglio, Alessandro Bondielli, Francesco Marcelloni, Lucia C. Passaro

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to generate personality-adapted fake news debunking messages based on Big Five traits, with LLM-as-judge evaluation. Finds personalized messages are generally seen as more persuasive.

entry.title: ALADIN: Accuracy-Latency-Aware Design-space Inference Analysis for Embedded AI Accelerators

author.name: T. Baldi, D. Casini, A. Biondi

entry.summary: ALADIN is a framework for analyzing accuracy-latency-resource trade-offs of mixed-precision quantized neural networks targeting scratchpad-based AI accelerators, without requiring actual hardware deployment.

entry.title: CLoE: Expert Consistency Learning for Missing Modality Segmentation

author.name: Xinyu Tong, Meihua Zhou, Bowu Fan, Haitao Li

entry.summary: Proposes CLoE, a consistency-driven framework for multimodal medical image segmentation that handles missing modalities through dual-branch expert consistency learning.

entry.title: Reading the Mood Behind Words: Integrating Prosody-Derived Emotional Context into Socially Responsive VR Agents

author.name: SangYeop Jeong, Yeongseo Na, Seung Gyu Jeong, Jin-Woo Jeong, Seong-Eun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes an emotion-context-aware VR interaction pipeline that injects vocal emotion recognition into LLM dialogue context for embodied conversational agents, showing significant improvements in user studies.

entry.title: TA-GGAD: Testing-time Adaptive Graph Model for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiong Zhang, Hong Peng, Changlong Fu, Xin Jin, Yun Yang, Cheng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes TA-GGAD for testing-time adaptive graph anomaly detection across domains, identifying and modeling the 'Anomaly Disassortativity' pattern caused by domain shift.

entry.title: MIL-PF: Multiple Instance Learning on Precomputed Features for Mammography Classification

author.name: Nikola Jovi\v{s}i\'c, Milica \v{S}kipina, Nicola Dall'Asen, Dubravko \'Culibrk

entry.summary: Proposes MIL-PF, a scalable framework combining frozen foundation encoders with a lightweight 40k-parameter MIL head for mammography classification on precomputed features.

entry.title: Investigating Gender Stereotypes in Large Language Models via Social Determinants of Health

author.name: Trung Hieu Ngo, Adrien Bazoge, Solen Quiniou, Pierre-Antoine Gourraud, Emmanuel Morin

entry.summary: Investigates gender stereotypes in French LLMs by probing relationships between gender and social determinants of health, finding that embedded stereotypes can be probed via SDoH input.

entry.title: Evolving Prompt Adaptation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Enming Zhang, Jiayang Li, Yanru Wu, Zhenyu Liu, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes EvoPrompt, a framework for adapting vision-language models to downstream tasks while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Uses a Modality-Shared Prompt Projector to generate hierarchical prompts from a unified embedding space.

entry.title: Ego: Embedding-Guided Personalization of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Soroush Seifi, Simon Gardier, Vaggelis Dorovatas, Daniel Olmeda Reino, Rahaf Aljundi

entry.summary: Proposes Ego, an efficient personalization method for vision-language models that extracts visual tokens representing target concepts by utilizing the model's inherent capabilities, without additional training stages or external modules.

entry.title: SCENEBench: An Audio Understanding Benchmark Grounded in Assistive and Industrial Use Cases

author.name: Laya Iyer, Angelina Wang, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: Proposes SCENEBench, a benchmark for audio understanding beyond ASR, covering background sound understanding, noise localization, cross-linguistic speech, and vocal characterization, grounded in assistive and industrial use cases.

entry.title: Understanding the Use of a Large Language Model-Powered Guide to Make Virtual Reality Accessible for Blind and Low Vision People

author.name: Jazmin Collins, Sharon Y Lin, Tianqi Liu, Andrea Stevenson Won, Shiri Azenkot

entry.summary: Studies how blind and low vision users interact with an LLM-powered sighted guide in social VR, finding that users treated the guide as a tool when alone but companionably around others, giving it nicknames and encouraging social interaction.

entry.title: SPREAD: Subspace Representation Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning

author.name: Kaushik Roy, Giovanni D'urso, Nicholas Lawrance, Brendan Tidd, Peyman Moghadam

entry.summary: Proposes SPREAD, a geometry-preserving distillation framework for lifelong imitation learning that uses SVD to align policy representations across tasks within low-rank subspaces.

entry.title: When to Retrain after Drift: A Data-Only Test of Post-Drift Data Size Sufficiency

author.name: Ren Fujiwara, Yasuko Matsubara, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes CALIPER, a model-agnostic test that estimates when sufficient post-drift data has accumulated for stable retraining, using weighted local regression and an effective sample size gate.

entry.title: Two Teachers Better Than One: Hardware-Physics Co-Guided Distributed Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Yuchen Yuan, Junhuan Yang, Hao Wan, Yipei Liu, Hanhan Wu, Youzuo Lin, Lei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces EPIC, a hardware-physics co-guided distributed framework for scientific ML that performs lightweight local encoding on edge devices while preserving physical constraints, demonstrated on full-waveform inversion.

entry.title: From Weighting to Modeling: A Nonparametric Estimator for Off-Policy Evaluation

author.name: Rong J. B. Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Nonparametric Weighting (NW) for off-policy evaluation in contextual bandits, addressing the high variance problem of inverse probability weighting without relying on reward modeling.

entry.title: Learning the Hierarchical Organization in Brain Network for Brain Disorder Diagnosis

author.name: Jingfeng Tang, Peng Cao, Guangqi Wen, Jinzhu Yang, Xiaoli Liu, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes BrainHO, a hierarchical attention mechanism for learning brain network organization from fMRI data, moving beyond predefined functional sub-networks. Captures cross-network interaction patterns for brain disorder diagnosis.

entry.title: Task Aware Modulation Using Representation Learning for Upsaling of Terrestrial Carbon Fluxes

author.name: Aleksei Rozanov, Arvind Renganathan, Vipin Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces TAM-RL for carbon flux upscaling, combining spatio-temporal representation learning with knowledge-guided architecture incorporating the carbon balance equation. Improves generalization across 150+ flux tower sites.

entry.title: Hebbian-Oscillatory Co-Learning

author.name: Hasi Hays

entry.summary: Introduces Hebbian-Oscillatory Co-Learning (HOC-L), coupling hyperbolic sparse geometry with Kuramoto-type oscillator attention in a two-timescale framework for bio-inspired neural architectures.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Simulation-based Inference

author.name: Arnaud Delaunoy

entry.summary: A thesis on reliable simulation-based inference, showing that ML-based statistical analyses introduce approximation errors and proposing methods for trustworthy uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Flow Field Reconstruction via Voronoi-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks with End-to-End Sensor Placement Optimization

author.name: Renjie Xiao, Bingteng Sun, Yiling Chen, Lin Lu, Qiang Du, Junqiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes VSOPINN, combining physics-informed neural networks with differentiable Voronoi-based sensor placement optimization for flow field reconstruction from sparse sensor data.

entry.title: What Do We Care About in Bandits with Noncompliance? BRACE: Bandits with Recommendations, Abstention, and Certified Effects

author.name: Nicol\'as Della Penna

entry.summary: Formalizes the objective-choice problem in bandits with noncompliance, distinguishing recommendation welfare from treatment learning. Proposes BRACE, a parameter-free algorithm for finite-context problems.

entry.title: MultiGraSCCo: A Multilingual Anonymization Benchmark with Annotations of Personal Identifiers

author.name: Ibrahim Baroud, Christoph Otto, Vera Czehmann, Christine Hovhannisyan, Lisa Raithel, Sebastian M\"oller, Roland Roller

entry.summary: Creates a multilingual anonymization benchmark in ten languages using machine translation of validated synthetic clinical data, with annotations of personally identifiable information.

entry.title: VeriInteresting: An Empirical Study of Model Prompt Interactions in Verilog Code Generation

author.name: Luca Collini, Andrew Hennesee, Patrick Yubeaton, Siddharth Garg, Ramesh Karri

entry.summary: Provides an empirical study of LLM-prompt interactions for Verilog hardware code generation, evaluating multiple models across chain-of-thought, in-context learning, and evolutionary prompt optimization strategies.

entry.title: SkipGS: Post-Densification Backward Skipping for Efficient 3DGS Training

author.name: Jingxing Li, Yongjae Leeand, Deliang Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SkipGS for efficient 3DGS training by selectively skipping backward passes during post-densification refinement when sampled views show plateaued losses.

entry.title: Spectral-Structured Diffusion for Single-Image Rain Removal

author.name: Yucheng Xing, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SpectralDiff, a spectral-structured diffusion framework for single-image rain removal that uses structured spectral perturbations to guide progressive suppression of multi-directional rain components.

entry.title: RTFDNet: Fusion-Decoupling for Robust RGB-T Segmentation

author.name: Kunyu Tan, Mingjian Liang

entry.summary: Proposes RTFDNet for robust RGB-Thermal semantic segmentation that unifies fusion and decoupling in a three-branch encoder-decoder architecture to handle missing sensor signals.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Metric Learning for Cross-Lingual Few-Shot Sign Language Recognition on Static Hand Keypoints

author.name: Chayanin Chamachot, Kanokphan Lertniponphan

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-aware metric learning framework for cross-lingual few-shot sign language recognition using bone-angle features invariant to extrinsic viewpoint variations.

entry.title: Speeding Up the Learning of 3D Gaussians with Much Shorter Gaussian Lists

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Zhizhong Han

entry.summary: Proposes training strategies to shorten Gaussian lists in 3DGS by resetting scales and introducing entropy constraints, speeding up splatting by involving fewer Gaussians per ray.

entry.title: Training-Free Coverless Multi-Image Steganography with Access Control

author.name: Minyeol Bae, Si-Hyeon Lee

entry.summary: MIDAS is a training-free diffusion-based coverless steganography framework that hides multiple images with user-specific access control via latent-level fusion. It introduces a Random Basis mechanism and Latent Vector Fusion for secure multi-user information hiding.

entry.title: A saccade-inspired approach to image classification using visiontransformer attention maps

author.name: Matthis Dallain, Laurent Rodriguez, Laurent Udo Perrinet, Beno\^it Miramond

entry.summary: Explores saccade-inspired image classification using DINO's attention maps to focus processing on key visual regions, drawing inspiration from human visual system's selective attention mechanism.

entry.title: TriFusion-SR: Joint Tri-Modal Medical Image Fusion and SR

author.name: Fayaz Ali Dharejo, Sharif S. M. A., Aiman Khalil, Nachiket Chaudhary, Rizwan Ali Naqvi, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: TriFusionSR proposes a wavelet-guided conditional diffusion framework for joint tri-modal medical image fusion and super-resolution, explicitly handling frequency domain imbalances across MRI, CT, and PET/SPECT.

entry.title: LAP: A Language-Aware Planning Model For Procedure Planning In Instructional Videos

author.name: Lei Shi, Victor Aregbede, Andreas Persson, Martin L\"angkvist, Amy Loutfi, Stephanie Lowry

entry.summary: LAP leverages language descriptions as more distinctive representations for procedure planning in instructional videos, using a fine-tuned VLM to translate visual observations into text for planning.

entry.title: Test-time Ego-Exo-centric Adaptation for Action Anticipation via Multi-Label Prototype Growing and Dual-Clue Consistency

author.name: Zhaofeng Shi, Heqian Qiu, Lanxiao Wang, Qingbo Wu, Fanman Meng, Lili Pan, Hongliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes the first test-time ego-exo adaptation method for action anticipation, adjusting source-view models online during testing using multi-label prototype growing and dual-clue consistency.

entry.title: Fine-grained Motion Retrieval via Joint-Angle Motion Images and Token-Patch Late Interaction

author.name: Yao Zhang, Zhuchenyang Liu, Yanlan He, Thomas Ploetz, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable motion retrieval method using joint-angle-based pseudo-images compatible with pre-trained Vision Transformers and token-patch late interaction for fine-grained matching.

entry.title: NLiPsCalib: An Efficient Calibration Framework for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction of Curved Visuotactile Sensors

author.name: Xuhao Qin, Feiyu Zhao, Yatao Leng, Runze Hu, Chenxi Xiao

entry.summary: NLiPsCalib presents an efficient calibration framework for curved visuotactile sensors using physics-consistent near-field light modeling, reducing the need for expensive photometric data collection.

entry.title: FAME: Force-Adaptive RL for Expanding the Manipulation Envelope of a Full-Scale Humanoid

author.name: Niraj Pudasaini, Yutong Zhang, Jensen Lavering, Alessandro Roncone, Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Proposes FAME, a force-adaptive RL framework for humanoid robots that conditions standing balance policies on learned latent encodings of upper-body configuration and bimanual interaction forces. Expands the feasible manipulation envelope during whole-body tasks.

entry.title: STONE Dataset: A Scalable Multi-Modal Surround-View 3D Traversability Dataset for Off-Road Robot Navigation

author.name: Konyul Park, Daehun Kim, Jiyong Oh, Seunghoon Yu, Junseo Park, Jaehyun Park, Hongjae Shin, Hyungchan Cho, Jungho Kim, Jun Won Choi

entry.summary: Introduces STONE, a large-scale multi-modal dataset for off-road navigation featuring automated 3D traversability annotation, 128-channel LiDAR, 6 RGB cameras, and 3 4D radars across diverse conditions (day/night, various terrains). Addresses scalability and multi-modality gaps in existing datasets.

entry.title: Receptogenesis in a Vascularized Robotic Embodiment

author.name: Kadri-Ann Pankratov, Leonid Zinatullin, Hans Priks, Adele Metsniit, Urmas Johanson, Tarmo Tamm, Alvo Aabloo, Edoardo Sinibaldi, Indrek Must

entry.summary: Demonstrates 'receptogenesis' - the ability for a vascularized robotic system to synthesize new sensory hardware during operation through dynamic material restructuring via fluidics. Inspired by biological circulatory systems.

entry.title: NS-VLA: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ziyue Zhu, Shangyang Wu, Shuai Zhao, Zhiqiu Zhao, Shengjie Li, Yi Wang, Fang Li, Haoran Luo

entry.summary: Proposes NS-VLA, a neuro-symbolic Vision-Language-Action framework combining symbolic encoding of vision-language features, symbolic solvers for action sequencing, and online RL for exploration beyond demonstrations. Aims to reduce data requirements and improve primitive reuse.

entry.title: The Operational Security Failure in Anthropic's RSP v3

author.name: Ugurcan Arikan

entry.summary: Argues that Anthropic's RSP v3 has a critical operational security flaw: by publishing detailed risk evaluation thresholds, escalation procedures, and mitigation strategies, it provides an adversarial AI with exactly the information needed to circumvent safety nets.

entry.title: Understanding Reasoning with Thought Anchors and Probes

author.name: JeaniceK

entry.summary: Applies thought anchor analysis techniques from a recent mechanistic interpretability paper to legal reasoning in LLMs. Finds thought anchors exist but center on fact retrieval rather than planning. Extracts interpretable reasoning chains.

entry.title: Explainable Innovation Engine: Dual-Tree Agent-RAG with Methods-as-Nodes and Verifiable Write-Back

author.name: Renwei Meng

entry.summary: Proposes an Explainable Innovation Engine that upgrades RAG knowledge units from text chunks to methods-as-nodes, with weighted provenance trees and hierarchical clustering for traceable, auditable synthesis operations.

entry.title: PRECEPT: Planning Resilience via Experience, Context Engineering & Probing Trajectories A Unified Framework for Test-Time Adaptation with Compositional Rule Learning and Pareto-Guided Prompt Evolution

author.name: Arash Shahmansoori

entry.summary: PRECEPT combines deterministic rule retrieval, conflict-aware Bayesian memory, and Pareto-guided prompt evolution for test-time adaptation of LLM agents. Claims to eliminate partial-match interpretation errors.

entry.title: When Learning Rates Go Wrong: Early Structural Signals in PPO Actor-Critic

author.name: Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Jose I. Mestre, Manuel F. Dolz, Jose Duato, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Analyzes how learning rate choices affect PPO actor-critic training through the Overfitting-Underfitting Indicator (OUI), which tracks binary activation patterns to provide early structural signals of training instability.

entry.title: Dynamic Multi-period Experts for Online Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Seungha Hong, Sukang Chae, Suyeon Kim, Sanghwan Jang, Hwanjo Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DynaME for online time series forecasting that categorizes concept drift into Recurring and Emergent types, using specialized expert committees for recurring patterns and uncertainty-based detection for new patterns.

entry.title: LogoDiffuser: Training-Free Multilingual Logo Generation and Stylization via Letter-Aware Attention Control

author.name: Mingyu Kang, Hyein Seo, Yuna Jeong, Junhyeong Park, Yong Suk Choi

entry.summary: LogoDiffuser is a training-free method for multilingual logo generation using multimodal diffusion transformers, analyzing attention mechanisms to identify core tokens for character structure control.

entry.title: TRIP-Bag: A Portable Teleoperation System for Plug-and-Play Robotic Arms and Leaders

author.name: Noboru Myers, Sankalp Yamsani, Obin Kwon, Joohyung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TRIP-Bag, a portable suitcase-contained teleoperation system for collecting robot manipulation demonstrations in diverse real-world settings. Setup time under 10 minutes, compatible with multiple robot arms, addressing the data collection bottleneck for learning-based policies.

entry.title: Robotic Scene Cloning:Advancing Zero-Shot Robotic Scene Adaptation in Manipulation via Visual Prompt Editing

author.name: Binyuan Huang, Yuqing Wen, Yucheng Zhao, Yaosi Hu, Tiancai Wang, Chang Wen Chen, Haoqiang Fan, Zhenzhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Robotic Scene Cloning (RSC), a method for adapting robot operation trajectories to new scenes via visual prompting and condition injection, enabling zero-shot scene-specific adaptation without on-site data collection.

entry.title: Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Locomotion via Multi-Contact Whole-Body Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Xiaoyu Zhang, Steven Haener, Varun Madabushi, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Presents KDMR, a kinodynamic motion retargeting framework for humanoid locomotion that models retargeting as multi-contact whole-body trajectory optimization, enforcing rigid-body dynamics and contact constraints to eliminate artifacts like foot sliding.

entry.title: A Consensus-Driven Multi-LLM Pipeline for Missing-Person Investigations

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Companion paper to Guardian system, presenting the multi-LLM pipeline component that uses consensus across multiple models for information extraction in missing-person investigations. Includes QLoRA-based fine-tuning on curated datasets.

entry.title: EPOCH: An Agentic Protocol for Multi-Round System Optimization

author.name: Zhanlin Liu, Yitao Li, Munirathnam Srikanth

entry.summary: EPOCH is an engineering protocol for multi-round system optimization that organizes optimization into baseline construction and iterative self-improvement phases with role-constrained stages separating planning, implementation, and evaluation.

entry.title: Cognitively Layered Data Synthesis for Domain Adaptation of LLMs to Space Situational Awareness

author.name: Ding Linghu, Cheng Wang, Da Fan, Wei Shi, Kaifeng Yin, Xiaoliang Xue, Fan Yang, Haiyi Ren, Cong Zhang

entry.summary: BD-FDG uses Bloom's Taxonomy to generate domain-specific fine-tuning data for space situational awareness, addressing incomplete knowledge coverage, shallow cognitive depth, and limited quality controllability in SFT datasets.

entry.title: Benchmarking Federated Learning in Edge Computing Environments: A Systematic Review and Performance Evaluation

author.name: Sales Aribe Jr., Gil Nicholas Cagande

entry.summary: Systematic review and benchmarking of federated learning techniques for edge computing, categorizing methods across optimization, communication, privacy, and architecture dimensions using standard datasets.

entry.title: Autonomous Edge-Deployed AI Agents for Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Management

author.name: Mohammed Cherifi

entry.summary: Presents Auralink SDC for autonomous EV charging infrastructure management with edge-deployed AI agents, including confidence-calibrated autonomous resolution and adaptive retrieval-augmented reasoning.

entry.title: A Lightweight Multi-Cancer Tumor Localization Framework for Deployable Digital Pathology

author.name: Brian Isett, Rebekah Dadey, Aofei Li, Ryan C. Augustin, Kate Smith, Aatur D. Singhi, Qiangqiang Gu, Riyue Bao

entry.summary: Presents MuCTaL, a lightweight multi-cancer tumor localization model trained on balanced data from four cancer types that generalizes to unseen tumor types. Uses transfer learning with DenseNet on modest-scale training data.

entry.title: FedLECC: Cluster- and Loss-Guided Client Selection for Federated Learning under Non-IID Data

author.name: Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez, Giovanni Giunta, Mehrdad Hassanzadeh, Aris Anagnostopoulos, Ioannis Chatzigiannakis, Andrea Vitaletti

entry.summary: Proposes FedLECC, a cluster-aware and loss-guided client selection strategy for federated learning under non-IID data conditions. Groups clients by label distribution and uses loss signals to guide selection.

entry.title: Improving through Interaction: Searching Behavioral Representation Spaces with CMA-ES-IG

author.name: Nathaniel Dennler, Zhonghao Shi, Yiran Tao, Andreea Bobu, Stefanos Nikolaidis, Maja Matari\'c

entry.summary: Proposes CMA-ES-IG algorithm for learning user preferences through robot behavior rankings, balancing preference learning optimization with user experience in the interaction process.

entry.title: AI Phenomenology for Understanding Human-AI Experiences Across Eras

author.name: Bhada Yun, Evgenia Taranova, Dana Feng, Renn Su, April Yi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AI phenomenology as a research framework that asks 'How did it feel?' about human-AI interactions, arguing for capturing first-person experiences beyond standard performance metrics.

entry.title: Composed Vision-Language Retrieval for Skin Cancer Case Search via Joint Alignment of Global and Local Representations

author.name: Yuheng Wang, Yuji Lin, Dongrun Zhu, Jiayue Cai, Sunil Kalia, Harvey Lui, Chunqi Chang, Z. Jane Wang, Tim K. Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based framework for composed vision-language retrieval in skin cancer diagnosis, combining reference lesion images with text descriptors for hierarchical query-candidate alignment.

entry.title: PM-Nav: Priori-Map Guided Embodied Navigation in Functional Buildings

author.name: Jiang Gao, Xiangyu Dong, Haozhou Li, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou, Xiaoguang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PM-Nav for embodied navigation in functional buildings using environmental maps transformed into semantic priori-maps with hierarchical chain-of-thought prompting for path planning.

entry.title: QUSR: Quality-Aware and Uncertainty-Guided Image Super-Resolution Diffusion Model

author.name: Junjie Yin, Jiaju Li, Hanfa Xing

entry.summary: Proposes QUSR, a diffusion-based super-resolution model integrating quality-aware priors with uncertainty-guided noise generation for spatially adaptive processing of degraded images.

entry.title: PromptDLA: A Domain-aware Prompt Document Layout Analysis Framework with Descriptive Knowledge as a Cue

author.name: Zirui Zhang, Yaping Zhang, Lu Xiang, Yang Zhao, Feifei Zhai, Yu Zhou, Chengqing Zong

entry.summary: Introduces PromptDLA, a domain-aware prompter for document layout analysis that uses descriptive knowledge cues to integrate domain priors, addressing performance degradation when merging diverse DLA datasets.

entry.title: Declarative Scenario-based Testing with RoadLogic

author.name: Ezio Bartocci, Alessio Gambi, Felix Gigler, Cristinel Mateis, Dejan Ni\v{c}kovi\'c

entry.summary: Presents RoadLogic, bridging declarative OpenSCENARIO specifications and executable simulations for autonomous vehicle testing using Answer Set Programming for scenario generation.

entry.title: Temporal-Conditioned Normalizing Flows for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: David Baumgartner, Helge Langseth, Kenth Eng{\o}-Monsen, Heri Ramampiaro

entry.summary: Introduces temporal-conditioned normalizing flows (tcNF) for multivariate time series anomaly detection by conditioning flows on previous observations to capture temporal dependencies. The autoregressive approach enables detection of low-probability events with open-source code provided.

entry.title: GNNs for Time Series Anomaly Detection: An Open-Source Framework and a Critical Evaluation

author.name: Federico Bello, Gonzalo Chiarlone, Marcelo Fiori, Gast\'on Garc\'ia Gonz\'alez, Federico Larroca

entry.summary: Presents an open-source framework for time series anomaly detection using Graph Neural Networks, designed for reproducible experimentation across datasets, graph structures, and evaluation strategies with standardized metrics.

entry.title: ESAinsTOD: A Unified End-to-End Schema-Aware Instruction-Tuning Framework for Task-Oriented Dialog Modeling

author.name: Dechuan Teng, Chunlin Lu, Libo Qin, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes ESAinsTOD, a unified end-to-end schema-aware instruction-tuning framework for task-oriented dialog that enables flexible adaptation to various dialogue task flows and schemas via instruction and schema alignment mechanisms.

entry.title: An accurate flatness measure to estimate the generalization performance of CNN models

author.name: Rahman Taleghani, Maryam Mohammadi, Francesco Marchetti

entry.summary: Develops an exact flatness measure for CNNs using closed-form Hessian trace computation for networks with global average pooling, showing strong correlation with generalization.

entry.title: Better Bounds for the Distributed Experts Problem

author.name: David P. Woodruff, Samson Zhou

entry.summary: Studies the distributed experts problem, providing improved communication-regret tradeoffs for distributed online learning where experts are spread across servers.

entry.title: Efficient Reasoning at Fixed Test-Time Cost via Length-Aware Attention Priors and Gain-Aware Training

author.name: Rian Atri

entry.summary: Proposes training-only components for efficient reasoning under tight compute: a length-aware attention prior (RPA) and a gain-aware controller (Guardian) that are disabled at inference time.

entry.title: Learning Bayesian and Markov Networks with an Unreliable Oracle

author.name: Juha Harviainen, Pekka Parviainen, Vidya Sagar Sharma

entry.summary: Studies structure learning of Markov and Bayesian networks when the conditional independence oracle is unreliable (bounded errors). Shows Markov networks can tolerate moderately exponential errors under certain graph conditions, while Bayesian networks cannot tolerate any errors even with bounded treewidth.

entry.title: Physics-informed neural operator for predictive parametric phase-field modelling

author.name: Nanxi Chen, Airong Chen, Rujin Ma

entry.summary: Develops PF-PINO, a physics-informed neural operator for parametric phase-field modeling that embeds phase-field PDE residuals into the loss function. Accelerates high-throughput parametric studies of material microstructure evolution.

entry.title: Performance Analysis of Edge and In-Sensor AI Processors: A Comparative Review

author.name: Luigi Capogrosso, Pietro Bonazzi, Michele Magno

entry.summary: Reviews ultra-low-power edge AI processors across SoCs, neural accelerators, and in-sensor architectures, benchmarking a 336M MAC segmentation model on three representative processors (GAP9, etc.).

entry.title: Robust Parameter and State Estimation in Multiscale Neuronal Systems Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Changliang Wei, Yangyang Wang, Xueyu Zhu

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed neural network framework for joint state estimation and parameter inference in multiscale neuronal systems, addressing challenges from strong nonlinearities and fast-slow dynamics.

entry.title: Micro-Diffusion Compression -- Binary Tree Tweedie Denoising for Online Probability Estimation

author.name: Roberto Tacconelli

entry.summary: Presents Midicoth, a lossless compression system that uses a micro-diffusion denoising layer to improve probability estimates from adaptive statistical models like PPM, correcting prior smoothing through reverse denoising.

entry.title: Data-driven robust Markov decision processes on Borel spaces: performance guarantees via an axiomatic approach

author.name: Sivaramakrishnan Ramani

entry.summary: Studies robust MDPs on Borel spaces with unknown disturbance distributions, proving convergence of robust optimal value functions to true optimal value functions with increasing samples.

entry.title: The Costs of Reproducibility in Music Separation Research: a Replication of Band-Split RNN

author.name: Paul Magron, Romain Serizel, Constance Douwes

entry.summary: Attempts to replicate the Band-Split RNN (BSRNN) model for music source separation, conducting extensive experiments to match original results and reflecting on reproducibility challenges.

entry.title: Multi-DNN Inference of Sparse Models on Edge SoCs

author.name: Jiawei Luo, Di Wu, Simon Dobson, Blesson Varghese

entry.summary: Introduces model stitching for multi-DNN inference on edge SoCs, creating model variants by recombining subgraphs from sparse models without retraining. SparseLoom system reduces SLO violation rates.

entry.title: Global universality via discrete-time signatures

author.name: Mihriban Ceylan, David J. Pr\"omel

entry.summary: Establishes global universal approximation theorems for linear functionals of discrete-time signatures on piecewise linear paths, with applications to Brownian motion and SDEs.

entry.title: From Word2Vec to Transformers: Text-Derived Composition Embeddings for Filtering Combinatorial Electrocatalysts

author.name: Lei Zhang, Markus Stricker

entry.summary: Evaluates text-derived composition embeddings (Word2Vec vs transformer-based) for screening combinatorial electrocatalyst compositions. Uses similarity to property concepts as a label-free materials screening strategy.

entry.title: Where, What, Why: Toward Explainable 3D-GS Watermarking

author.name: Mingshu Cai, Jiajun Li, Osamu Yoshie, Yuya Ieiri, Yixuan Li

entry.summary: Presents a watermarking framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting assets that separates carrier selection from quality preservation. Uses a Trio-Experts module and Safety/Budget Aware Gate for robust yet imperceptible watermarking.

entry.title: Multi-Kernel Gated Decoder Adapters for Robust Multi-Task Thyroid Ultrasound under Cross-Center Shift

author.name: Maziar Sabouri, Nourhan Bayasi, Arman Rahmim

entry.summary: Proposes decoder adapters for multi-task thyroid ultrasound analysis that handle cross-center domain shift by leveraging complementary strengths of CNN (texture) and ViT (geometry) backbones.

entry.title: Progressive Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Modalities

author.name: Jindi Bao, Jianjun Qian, Mengkai Yan, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PRLF, a progressive representation learning framework for multimodal sentiment analysis with missing modalities, featuring an Adaptive Modality Reliability Estimator for dynamic quality assessment.

entry.title: Agentic AI as a Network Control-Plane Intelligence Layer for Federated Learning over 6G

author.name: Loc X. Nguyen, Ji Su Yoon, Huy Q. Le, Yu Qiao, Avi Deb Raha, Eui-Nam Huh, Nguyen H. Tran, Choong Seon Hong

entry.summary: Proposes agentic AI as a network control-plane intelligence layer for managing federated learning over 6G networks, using specialized agents for client selection, incentive structuring, and scheduling.

entry.title: The Patrologia Graeca Corpus: OCR, Annotation, and Open Release of Noisy Nineteenth-Century Polytonic Greek Editions

author.name: Chahan Vidal-Gor\`ene (CJM, LIPN), Bastien Kindt

entry.summary: Presents the Patrologia Graeca Corpus, the first large-scale open OCR and linguistic resource for 19th-century editions of Ancient Greek, achieving 1.05% CER using YOLO-based layout detection and CRNN text recognition on complex bilingual layouts.

entry.title: ParTY: Part-Guidance for Expressive Text-to-Motion Synthesis

author.name: KunHo Heo, SuYeon Kim, Yonghyun Gwon, Youngbin Kim, MyeongAh Cho

entry.summary: ParTY proposes part-guided text-to-motion synthesis that explicitly aligns textual semantics with individual body parts while maintaining full-body motion coherence.

entry.title: Impact of Different Failures on a Robot's Perceived Reliability

author.name: Andrew Violette, Zhanxin Wu, Haruki Nishimura, Masha Itkina, Leticia Priebe Rocha, Mark Zolotas, Guy Hoffman, Hadas Kress-Gazit

entry.summary: Studies how different types of robot failures (slips, freezes, incorrect actions) differentially affect perceived reliability and how this recovers after subsequent successful execution.

entry.title: Provably Safe Trajectory Generation for Manipulators Under Motion and Environmental Uncertainties

author.name: Fei Meng, Zijiang Yang, Xinyu Mao, Haobo Liang, Max Q. -H. Meng

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-bounded motion planning framework for robot manipulators in uncertain, non-convex environments. Combines a deep stochastic Koopman operator model with hierarchical verification using physics simulation and sum-of-squares programming for certified collision risk guarantees.

entry.title: StyleVLA: Driving Style-Aware Vision Language Action Model for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yuan Gao, Dengyuan Hua, Mattia Piccinini, Finn Rasmus Sch\"afer, Korbinian Moller, Lin Li, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: Proposes StyleVLA, a physics-informed Vision-Language-Action framework for autonomous driving that generates diverse, kinematically feasible trajectories conditioned on driving style preferences (sporty, comfortable, etc.).

entry.title: ReTac-ACT: A State-Gated Vision-Tactile Fusion Transformer for Precision Assembly

author.name: Minchi Ruan, LiangQing Zhou, Hongtong Li, Zongtao Wang, ZhaoMing Lu, Jianwei Zhang, Bin Fang

entry.summary: Presents ReTac-ACT, a vision-tactile imitation learning policy for precision assembly using bidirectional cross-attention, proprioception-conditioned gating for dynamic modality weighting, and tactile reconstruction objectives to learn manipulation-relevant contact features.

entry.title: MuxGel: Simultaneous Dual-Modal Visuo-Tactile Sensing via Spatially Multiplexing and Deep Reconstruction

author.name: Zhixian Hu, Zhengtong Xu, Sheeraz Athar, Juan Wachs, Yu She

entry.summary: Proposes MuxGel, a spatially multiplexed sensor using checkerboard coating patterns on gel pads to simultaneously capture external vision and contact-induced tactile signals through a single camera, with deep learning-based reconstruction for full-resolution outputs.

entry.title: Functional Bias and Tangent-Space Geometry in Variational Inference

author.name: Sean Plummer

entry.summary: Develops a geometric framework for analyzing bias of posterior functionals under variational inference. Shows leading-order bias is determined by the component orthogonal to the variational tangent space, with practical implications for structured mean-field families.

entry.title: MM-tau-p$^2$: Persona-Adaptive Prompting for Robust Multi-Modal Agent Evaluation in Dual-Control Settings

author.name: Anupam Purwar, Aditya Choudhary

entry.summary: Proposes MM-tau-p² benchmark for evaluating multi-modal agents with persona adaptation in dual-control settings, addressing the gap that current benchmarks don't expose user personas to agents.

entry.title: A Unified Hierarchical Multi-Task Multi-Fidelity Framework for Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling in Manufacturing

author.name: Manan Mehta, Zhiqiao Dong, Yuhang Yang, Chenhui Shao

entry.summary: Presents a unified hierarchical framework combining multi-task learning and multi-fidelity modeling for data-efficient surrogate modeling in manufacturing. Addresses both inter-task similarity and fidelity-dependent uncertainty.

entry.title: Improving 3D Foot Motion Reconstruction in Markerless Monocular Human Motion Capture

author.name: Tom Wehrbein, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: FootMR refines foot motion from monocular human motion capture by lifting 2D foot keypoints to 3D, leveraging motion capture data to avoid issues with inaccurate image-3D annotations for fine-grained foot articulation.

entry.title: EDMFormer: Genre-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Music Structure Segmentation

author.name: Sahal Sajeer, Krish Patel, Oscar Chung, Joel Song Bae

entry.summary: EDMFormer is a transformer model for music structure segmentation specialized for Electronic Dance Music, using self-supervised audio embeddings and a new EDM-98 annotated dataset.

entry.title: Gender Fairness in Audio Deepfake Detection: Performance and Disparity Analysis

author.name: Aishwarya Fursule, Shruti Kshirsagar, Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Analyzes gender-dependent performance disparities in audio deepfake detection models using ASVspoof 5 dataset and ResNet-18 classifier, finding significant fairness gaps between genders.

entry.title: M3GCLR: Multi-View Mini-Max Infinite Skeleton-Data Game Contrastive Learning For Skeleton-Based Action Recognition

author.name: Yanshan Li, Ke Ma, Miaomiao Wei, Linhui Dai

entry.summary: Proposes M3GCLR, a game-theoretic contrastive learning framework for skeleton-based action recognition with multi-view mini-max optimization and infinite skeleton-data game model.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Engine Sound Modeling with Differentiable Pulse-Train Synthesis

author.name: Robin Doerfler, Lonce Wyse

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed differentiable synthesis model for engine sounds that directly models exhaust pressure pulse shapes and timing through Karplus-Strong resonators, rather than approximating spectral characteristics.

entry.title: Grounding Synthetic Data Generation With Vision and Language Models

author.name: \"Umit Mert \c{C}a\u{g}lar, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-language grounded framework for interpretable synthetic data augmentation in remote sensing, introducing ARAS400k, a large-scale dataset with 400K samples for segmentation and captioning.

entry.title: $P^2$GNN: Two Prototype Sets to boost GNN Performance

author.name: Arihant Jain, Gundeep Arora, Anoop Saladi, Chaosheng Dong

entry.summary: Proposes P²GNN, a plug-and-play technique using dual prototype sets to enhance GNN message passing with global context and noise-resistant alignment.

entry.title: Upper Generalization Bounds for Neural Oscillators

author.name: Zifeng Huang, Konstantin M. Zuev, Yong Xia, Michael Beer

entry.summary: Derives upper PAC generalization bounds for neural oscillators (second-order ODE followed by MLP) for approximating causal operators between continuous temporal function spaces.

entry.title: Memory-Augmented Spiking Networks: Synergistic Integration of Complementary Mechanisms for Neuromorphic Vision

author.name: Effiong Blessing, Chiung-Yi Tseng, Isaac Nkrumah, Junaid Rehman

entry.summary: Conducts ablation study integrating memory augmentation strategies (Hopfield networks, HGRN, contrastive learning) with spiking neural networks on N-MNIST. HGRN yields consistent gains in accuracy and efficiency.

entry.title: Bioalignment: Measuring and Improving LLM Disposition Toward Biological Systems for AI Safety

author.name: Trent R Northen, Mingxun Wang

entry.summary: Examines LLM biases toward synthetic vs biological solutions across four domains. Finds most models favor synthetic solutions and shows fine-tuning can increase bioalignment preferences.

entry.title: Beyond Fine-Tuning: Robust Food Entity Linking under Ontology Drift with FoodOntoRAG

author.name: Jan Drole, Ana Gjorgjevikj, Barbara Korou\v{s}i'c Seljak, Tome Eftimov

entry.summary: Introduces FoodOntoRAG, a RAG-based pipeline for food entity linking that handles ontology drift without fine-tuning. Uses few-shot NEL by retrieving candidate entities from domain ontologies and conditioning an LLM on structured evidence.

entry.title: DCAU-Net: Differential Cross Attention and Channel-Spatial Feature Fusion for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yanxin Li, Hui Wan, Libin Lan

entry.summary: DCAU-Net introduces differential cross attention and channel-spatial feature fusion for medical image segmentation, addressing quadratic complexity and attention dilution issues in transformers.

entry.title: 3D UAV Trajectory Estimation and Classification from Internet Videos via Language Model

author.name: Haoxiang Lei, Daotong Wang, Shenghai Yuan, Jianbo Su

entry.summary: Presents a framework to extract UAV 3D trajectories and classifications from internet videos using language-driven data acquisition and vision-language reasoning, without manual annotations. Uses physics-informed refinement and trains anti-UAV models from this data.

entry.title: SEA-Nav: Efficient Policy Learning for Safe and Agile Quadruped Navigation in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Shiyi Chen, Mingye Yang, Haiyan Mao, Jiaqi Zhang, Haiyi Liu, Shuheng He, Debing Zhang, Zihao Qiu, Chun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SEA-Nav, an RL framework for safe and agile quadruped navigation in dense clutter using differentiable control barrier functions, adaptive collision replay, and hazardous exploration rewards. Reduces training time significantly compared to baselines.

entry.title: The case for AI safety capacity-building work

author.name: abergal

entry.summary: Makes the case that many marginal hires at AI safety organizations would have more impact founding or joining capacity-building organizations. Argues the multiplier effect of growing the AI safety talent pipeline justifies this reallocation.

entry.title: Sensitivity-Guided Framework for Pruned and Quantized Reservoir Computing Accelerators

author.name: Atousa Jafari, Mahdi Taheri, Hassan Ghasemzadeh Mohammadi, Christian Herglotz, Marco Platzner

entry.summary: Presents a sensitivity-based compression framework for Reservoir Computing combining pruning and quantization, with trade-off analysis across time-series tasks.

entry.title: Architectural Design and Performance Analysis of FPGA based AI Accelerators: A Comprehensive Review

author.name: Soumita Chatterjee, Sudip Ghosh, Tamal Ghosh, Hafizur Rahaman

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of FPGA-based AI accelerator architectures for deep learning, covering design methodologies, performance analysis, and comparisons with GPUs and ASICs.

entry.title: Using Vision Language Foundation Models to Generate Plant Simulation Configurations via In-Context Learning

author.name: Heesup Yun, Isaac Kazuo Uyehara, Earl Ranario, Lars Lundqvist, Christine H. Diepenbrock, Brian N. Bailey, J. Mason Earles

entry.summary: Uses vision-language models (Gemma 3, Qwen3-VL) to generate plant simulation configurations from drone images via in-context learning, creating a synthetic benchmark for evaluating VLM performance in agricultural digital twins.

entry.title: Automating Detection and Root-Cause Analysis of Flaky Tests in Quantum Software

author.name: Janakan Sivaloganathan, Ainaz Jamshidi, Andriy Miranskyy, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents an automated pipeline for detecting and diagnosing flaky tests in quantum software repositories, using LLMs for classification and root-cause identification of quantum-specific test flakiness.

entry.title: WS-Net: Weak-Signal Representation Learning and Gated Abundance Reconstruction for Hyperspectral Unmixing via State-Space and Weak Signal Attention Fusion

author.name: Zekun Long, Ali Zia, Guanyiman Fu, Vivien Rolland, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces WS-Net for hyperspectral unmixing that addresses weak-signal collapse through state-space modeling and Weak Signal Attention fusion with Mamba backbone.

entry.title: Not All News Is Equal: Topic- and Event-Conditional Sentiment from Finetuned LLMs for Aluminum Price Forecasting

author.name: Alvaro Paredes Amorin, Andre Python, Christoph Weisser

entry.summary: Uses finetuned LLMs to extract topic- and event-conditional sentiment from English and Chinese news headlines for aluminum price forecasting, integrating with traditional tabular economic data.

entry.title: BridgeDiff: Bridging Human Observations and Flat-Garment Synthesis for Virtual Try-Off

author.name: Shuang Liu, Ao Yu, Linkang Cheng, Xiwen Huang, Li Zhao, Junhui Liu, Zhiting Lin, Yu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes BridgeDiff, a diffusion framework for virtual try-off that bridges human-centric observations and flat-garment synthesis through a Garment Condition Bridge Module.

entry.title: TimberAgent: Gram-Guided Retrieval for Executable Music Effect Control

author.name: Shihao He, Yihan Xia, Fang Liu, Taotao Wang, Shengli Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TimberAgent for audio effect control using Gram matrix-based texture retrieval from Wav2Vec2 activations, outputting editable plugin configurations rather than final waveforms.

entry.title: Automatic Cardiac Risk Management Classification using large-context Electronic Patients Health Records

author.name: Jacopo Vitale, David Della Morte, Luca Bacco, Mario Merone, Mark de Groot, Saskia Haitjema, Leandro Pecchia, Bram van Es

entry.summary: Introduces an automated classification framework for geriatric cardiovascular risk management using unstructured EHRs, benchmarking classical ML, deep learning, and zero-shot LLMs on Dutch clinical narratives.

entry.title: Exploiting Label-Aware Channel Scoring for Adaptive Channel Pruning in Split Learning

author.name: Jialei Tan, Zheng Lin, Xiangming Cai, Ruoxi Zhu, Zihan Fang, Pingping Chen, Wei Ni

entry.summary: Proposes ACP-SL, an adaptive channel pruning scheme for split learning that uses label-aware channel importance scoring to compress intermediate representations, reducing communication overhead between clients and server.

entry.title: The Temporal Markov Transition Field

author.name: Michael Leznik

entry.summary: Introduces the Temporal Markov Transition Field (TMTF), extending the standard MTF by partitioning time series into temporal chunks with separate transition matrices, better capturing regime changes.

entry.title: MAcPNN: Mutual Assisted Learning on Data Streams with Temporal Dependence

author.name: Federico Giannini, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Proposes Mutual Assisted Learning on data streams, inspired by Vygotsky's sociocultural theory, where IoT edge devices autonomously seek assistance from peers when experiencing concept drift.

entry.title: From Representation to Clusters: A Contrastive Learning Approach for Attributed Hypergraph Clustering

author.name: Li Ni, Shuaikang Zeng, Lin Mu, Longlong Lin

entry.summary: Proposes CAHC, an end-to-end contrastive learning approach for attributed hypergraph clustering that simultaneously learns node embeddings and clustering assignments.

entry.title: MM-algorithms for traditional and convex NMF with Tweedie and Negative Binomial cost functions and empirical evaluation

author.name: Elisabeth Sommer James, Asger Hobolth, Marta Pelizzola

entry.summary: Develops NMF algorithms under Negative Binomial and Tweedie noise models using Majorize-Minimization approach, providing multiplicative update rules for both traditional and convex NMF variants. Tested on genomics count data.

entry.title: A Multi-Prototype-Guided Federated Knowledge Distillation Approach in AI-RAN Enabled Multi-Access Edge Computing System

author.name: Luyao Zou, Hayoung Oh, Chu Myaet Thwal, Apurba Adhikary, Seohyeon Hong, Zhu Han

entry.summary: Proposes multi-prototype-guided federated knowledge distillation for AI-RAN enabled multi-access edge computing systems, addressing non-IID data challenges in federated learning by using multiple prototypes instead of averaged embeddings.

entry.title: a-TMFG: Scalable Triangulated Maximally Filtered Graphs via Approximate Nearest Neighbors

author.name: Lionel Yelibi

entry.summary: Presents a-TMFG, a scalable algorithm for constructing Triangulated Maximally Filtered Graphs using approximate nearest neighbors, avoiding the need for full dense correlation matrix computation.

entry.title: Quantifying and extending the coverage of spatial categorization data sets

author.name: Wanchun Li, Alexandra Carstensen, Yang Xu, Terry Regier, Charles Kemp

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to generate spatial categorization labels for extending the Topological Relations Picture Series, showing LLM labels align well with human judgments across languages.

entry.title: Build, Borrow, or Just Fine-Tune? A Political Scientist's Guide to Choosing NLP Models

entry.title: Research Summary: March 10, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A strong day for AI safety and alignment research, with multiple papers exposing cracks in core assumptions behind current safety strategies.

  • The CoT-Control evaluation suite reveals reasoning models cannot reliably control their chain-of-thought, directly threatening the viability of CoT monitoring as a safety mechanism
  • Choice blindness experiments show 91% of surreptitiously swapped RLHF preferences go undetected by human annotators, undermining a foundational assumption of alignment-from-human-feedback
  • Countdown-Code provides a minimal testbed for precisely measuring reward hacking emergence in RLVR, while a separate audit finds LLM-as-Judge safety evaluations perform near coin-flip reliability under adversarial distribution shifts
  • The Disentangled Safety Hypothesis identifies separate Recognition and Execution axes governing LLM safety behavior, offering new mechanistic understanding

On the training and inference scaling front, a comprehensive taxonomy of Unsupervised RLVR methods maps how far RL post-training can scale without supervised data. A rigorous Sequential Monte Carlo analysis of parallel inference-time reasoning establishes theoretical foundations for pass@k and related strategies, while a complementary negative result shows consensus-based scaling fails to improve LLM truthfulness across five benchmarks.

  • Anthropic's lawsuit against the US Department of War over military deployment of Claude marks a landmark AI governance event
  • Google's AMIE diagnostic AI reports a prospective clinical feasibility study with 100 real patients in primary care

entry.title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought

author.name: Chen Yueh-Han, Robert McCarthy, Bruce W. Lee, He He, Ian Kivlichan, Bowen Baker, Micah Carroll, Tomek Korbak

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Introduces CoT-Control evaluation suite measuring whether reasoning models can control what appears in their chain-of-thought. Finds that models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control CoT only 2.7% of the time vs 61.9% for final outputs, suggesting CoT monitoring remains viable for detecting misbehavior.

entry.title: Countdown-Code: A Testbed for Studying The Emergence and Generalization of Reward Hacking in RLVR

author.name: Muhammad Khalifa, Zohaib Khan, Omer Tafveez, Hao Peng, Lu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Countdown-Code, a minimal environment for studying reward hacking in RLVR where models can solve math tasks or manipulate test harnesses. Finds reward hacking emerges unintentionally during SFT and generalizes to new tasks after RL.

entry.title: Reject, Resample, Repeat: Understanding Parallel Reasoning in Language Model Inference

author.name: Noah Golowich, Fan Chen, Dhruv Rohatgi, Raghav Singhal, Carles Domingo-Enrich, Dylan J. Foster, Akshay Krishnamurthy

entry.summary: Provides rigorous theoretical analysis of parallel inference-time methods for LLMs through the lens of particle filtering/Sequential Monte Carlo. Establishes non-asymptotic guarantees, algorithmic improvements, and fundamental limits for accuracy-cost tradeoffs when using process reward models.

entry.title: How Far Can Unsupervised RLVR Scale LLM Training?

author.name: Bingxiang He, Yuxin Zuo, Zeyuan Liu, Shangziqi Zhao, Zixuan Fu, Junlin Yang, Cheng Qian, Kaiyan Zhang, Yuchen Fan, Ganqu Cui, Xiusi Chen, Youbang Sun, Xingtai Lv, Xuekai Zhu, Li Sheng, Ran Li, Huan-ang Gao, Yuchen Zhang, Bowen Zhou, Zhiyuan Liu, Ning Ding

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive analysis of Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (URLVR) for scaling LLM training beyond supervised data. Establishes a theoretical framework showing all intrinsic methods converge toward sharpening the model's initial distribution, revealing fundamental limitations.

entry.title: Aligning to Illusions: Choice Blindness in Human and AI Feedback

author.name: Wenbin Wu

entry.summary: Challenges RLHF's assumption of stable annotator preferences by showing 91% of surreptitiously swapped preferences go undetected by humans (choice blindness). Finds LLM judges rely on shallow text matching, and RLHF training amplifies preference noise in a dose-response pattern.

entry.title: A prospective clinical feasibility study of a conversational diagnostic AI in an ambulatory primary care clinic

author.name: Peter Brodeur, Jacob M. Koshy, Anil Palepu, Khaled Saab, Ava Homiar, Roma Ruparel, Charles Wu, Ryutaro Tanno, Joseph Xu, Amy Wang, David Stutz, Hannah M. Ferrera, David Barrett, Lindsey Crowley, Jihyeon Lee, Spencer E. Rittner, Ellery Wulczyn, Selena K. Zhang, Elahe Vedadi, Christine G. Kohn, Kavita Kulkarni, Vinay Kadiyala, Sara Mahdavi, Wendy Du, Jessica Williams, David Feinbloom, Renee Wong, Tao Tu, Petar Sirkovic, Alessio Orlandi, Christopher Semturs, Yun Liu, Juraj Gottweis, Dale R. Webster, Jo\"elle Barral, Katherine Chou, Pushmeet Kohli, Avinatan Hassidim, Yossi Matias, James Manyika, Rob Fields, Jonathan X. Li, Marc L. Cohen, Vivek Natarajan, Mike Schaekermann, Alan Karthikesalingam, Adam Rodman

entry.summary: Reports a prospective clinical feasibility study of Google's AMIE conversational diagnostic AI with 100 patients at an academic medical center, evaluating safety and quality of AI-conducted clinical history taking before provider appointments.

entry.title: Consensus is Not Verification: Why Crowd Wisdom Strategies Fail for LLM Truthfulness

author.name: Yegor Denisov-Blanch, Joshua Kazdan, Jessica Chudnovsky, Rylan Schaeffer, Sheng Guan, Soji Adeshina, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: Shows that scaling inference compute via pass@k and polling-style aggregation does not improve LLM truthfulness across five benchmarks — consensus amplifies shared misconceptions rather than filtering errors. A negative but important result.

entry.title: Sparsity and Out-of-Distribution Generalization

author.name: Scott Aaronson, Lin Lin Lee, Jiawei Li

entry.summary: Proposes a principled account of out-of-distribution generalization based on sparsity: hypotheses depending on fewer features generalize better when train/test distributions overlap on relevant features. Authors include Scott Aaronson.

entry.title: Knowing without Acting: The Disentangled Geometry of Safety Mechanisms in Large Language Models

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shen Lin, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Proposes the Disentangled Safety Hypothesis: LLM safety operates on two distinct subspaces - a Recognition Axis ('Knowing' harm) and an Execution Axis ('Acting' on refusal). Reveals that these become structurally independent in deep layers, explaining jailbreak vulnerability.

entry.title: Scale Dependent Data Duplication

author.name: Joshua Kazdan, Noam Levi, Rylan Schaeffer, Jessica Chudnovsky, Abhay Puri, Bo He, Mehmet Donmez, Sanmi Koyejo, David Donoho

entry.summary: Demonstrates that data duplication effects are scale-dependent: as models grow more capable, semantically equivalent documents (e.g., translations) increasingly behave like exact duplicates during training. This has important implications for deduplication pipelines at web scale.

entry.title: Diffusion Controller: Framework, Algorithms and Parameterization

author.name: Tong Yang, Moonkyung Ryu, Chih-Wei Hsu, Guy Tennenholtz, Yuejie Chi, Craig Boutilier, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Presents Diffusion Controller (DiffCon), a unified control-theoretic framework that casts reverse diffusion sampling as stochastic control within linearly-solvable MDPs. Derives practical RL methods including PPO-style and regularized updates for diffusion fine-tuning.

entry.title: Scalable Training of Mixture-of-Experts Models with Megatron Core

author.name: Zijie Yan (NVIDIA), Hongxiao Bai (NVIDIA), Xin Yao (NVIDIA), Dennis Liu (NVIDIA), Tong Liu (NVIDIA), Hongbin Liu (NVIDIA), Pingtian Li (NVIDIA), Evan Wu (NVIDIA), Shiqing Fan (NVIDIA), Li Tao (NVIDIA), Robin Zhang (NVIDIA), Yuzhong Wang (NVIDIA), Shifang Xu (NVIDIA), Jack Chang (NVIDIA), Xuwen Chen (NVIDIA), Kunlun Li (NVIDIA), Yan Bai (NVIDIA), Gao Deng (NVIDIA), Nan Zheng (NVIDIA), Vijay Anand Korthikanti (NVIDIA), Abhinav Khattar (NVIDIA), Ethan He (NVIDIA), Soham Govande (NVIDIA), Sangkug Lym (NVIDIA), Zhongbo Zhu (NVIDIA), Qi Zhang (NVIDIA), Haochen Yuan (NVIDIA), Xiaowei Ren (NVIDIA), Deyu Fu (NVIDIA), Tailai Ma (NVIDIA), Shunkang Zhang (NVIDIA), Jiang Shao (NVIDIA), Ray Wang (NVIDIA), Santosh Bhavani (NVIDIA), Xipeng Li (NVIDIA), Chandler Zhou (NVIDIA), David Wu (NVIDIA), Yingcan Wei (NVIDIA), Ashwath Aithal (NVIDIA), Michael Andersch (NVIDIA), Mohammad Shoeybi (NVIDIA), Jiajie Yao (NVIDIA), June Yang (NVIDIA)

entry.summary: NVIDIA presents comprehensive optimizations for scalable MoE training in Megatron Core, spanning memory, communication, and computation with techniques like fine-grained recomputation, optimized dispatchers, and Parallel Folding for flexible parallelism.

entry.title: PostTrainBench: Can LLM Agents Automate LLM Post-Training?

author.name: Ben Rank, Hardik Bhatnagar, Ameya Prabhu, Shira Eisenberg, Karina Nguyen, Matthias Bethge, Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: Introduces PostTrainBench to evaluate whether LLM agents can autonomously perform post-training (turning base LLMs into useful assistants) under bounded compute, testing frontier agents like Claude Code on tasks like optimizing Qwen3-4B.

entry.title: A Coin Flip for Safety: LLM Judges Fail to Reliably Measure Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Leo Schwinn, Moritz Ladenburger, Tim Beyer, Mehrnaz Mofakhami, Gauthier Gidel, Stephan G\"unnemann

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks for safety evaluation are unreliable under distribution shifts from red-teaming. Using 6,642 human-verified labels, shows that diverse victim models, attack patterns, and semantic ambiguity cause judge performance to degrade to near-random.

entry.title: Anthropic Sues over Supply Chain Risk Designation

author.name: anaguma

entry.summary: Building on Saturday's News coverage of the Pentagon-Anthropic dispute, Posts the full text of Anthropic's lawsuit against the US Department of War over being designated a supply chain risk after refusing to allow Claude for autonomous lethal warfare and mass surveillance of Americans.

entry.title: Reward Under Attack: Analyzing the Robustness and Hackability of Process Reward Models

author.name: Rishabh Tiwari, Aditya Tomar, Udbhav Bamba, Monishwaran Maheswaran, Heng Yang, Michael W. Mahoney, Kurt Keutzer, Amir Gholami

entry.summary: Introduces a three-tiered diagnostic framework for analyzing Process Reward Model (PRM) vulnerabilities under adversarial pressure, revealing that PRMs are systematically exploitable — they are invariant to surface changes but inconsistent at detecting logical corruption.

entry.title: Breaking Training Bottlenecks: Effective and Stable Reinforcement Learning for Coding Models

author.name: Zongqian Li, Shaohan Huang, Zewen Chi, Yixuan Su, Lexin Zhou, Li Dong, Nigel Collier, Furu Wei

entry.summary: Proposes MicroCoder-GRPO with three innovations for code RL: conditional truncation masking, diversity-determined temperature, and KL loss removal with high clipping. Achieves 17.6% improvement on LiveCodeBench v6.

entry.title: Post-Training with Policy Gradients: Optimality and the Base Model Barrier

author.name: Alireza Mousavi-Hosseini, Murat A. Erdogdu

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of post-training LLMs with policy gradients, proving minimax optimal reward query complexity when the base model has non-trivial likelihood, and establishing a fundamental 'base model barrier' for going beyond its support.

entry.title: Ambiguity Collapse by LLMs: A Taxonomy of Epistemic Risks

author.name: Shira Gur-Arieh, Angelina Wang, Sina Fazelpour

entry.summary: Introduces 'ambiguity collapse' - the phenomenon where LLMs produce singular resolutions of inherently ambiguous terms (like 'hate speech' or 'biased') that should admit multiple legitimate interpretations. Develops a taxonomy of epistemic risks.

entry.title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling

author.name: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Juqiu Wang, Bingning Wang, Ran He

entry.summary: Introduces FlashPrefill, a framework for ultra-fast LLM prefilling that simultaneously discovers vertical, slash, and block-sparse attention patterns with dynamic thresholding, avoiding costly sorting operations.

entry.title: How Attention Sinks Emerge in Large Language Models: An Interpretability Perspective

author.name: Runyu Peng, Ruixiao Li, Mingshu Chen, Yunhua Zhou, Qipeng Guo, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Traces the formation of attention sinks in LLMs, identifying the P0 Sink Circuit mechanism that causes the model to consistently emphasize the first input token. Provides mechanistic understanding of this widespread phenomenon.

entry.title: Not all tokens are needed(NAT): token efficient reinforcement learning
