entry.summary: Presents a conditional diffusion-transformer framework for generating 3D E. coli genome conformations from Hi-C contact maps, formulating genome reconstruction as conditional generative modeling.

entry.title: Constraints Matrix Diffusion based Generative Neural Solver for Vehicle Routing Problems

author.name: Zhenwei Wang, Tiehua Zhang, Ning Xue, Ender Ozcan, Ling Wang, Ruibin Bai

entry.summary: Proposes a constraint matrix diffusion-based solver for vehicle routing problems, addressing robustness across heterogeneous problem distributions that existing neural solvers lack.

entry.title: TS-MLLM: A Multi-Modal Large Language Model-based Framework for Industrial Time-Series Big Data Analysis

author.name: Haiteng Wang, Yikang Li, Yunfei Zhu, Jingheng Yan, Lei Ren, Laurence T. Yang

entry.summary: Proposes TS-MLLM, a multi-modal LLM framework for industrial time-series analysis that jointly models temporal signals, frequency-domain images, and textual domain knowledge for equipment health management.

entry.title: Partial Differential Equations in the Age of Machine Learning: A Critical Synthesis of Classical, Machine Learning, and Hybrid Methods

author.name: Mohammad Nooraiepour, Jakub Wiktor Both, Teeratorn Kadeethum, Saeid Sadeghnejad

entry.summary: A comprehensive review examining classical numerical methods and ML approaches for PDE solution through a unified framework organized around six computational challenges.

entry.title: Hide and Find: A Distributed Adversarial Attack on Federated Graph Learning

author.name: Jinshan Liu, Ken Li, Jiazhe Wei, Bin Shi, Bo Dong

entry.summary: Proposes FedShift, a two-stage 'Hide and Find' distributed adversarial attack on federated graph learning that maintains stealthiness during training and activates after aggregation.

entry.title: FedMomentum: Preserving LoRA Training Momentum in Federated Fine-Tuning

author.name: Peishen Yan, Yang Hua, Hao Wang, Jiaru Zhang, Xiaoyu Wu, Tao Song, Haibing Guan

entry.summary: Introduces FedMomentum, which identifies and addresses the 'loss of training momentum' problem in federated fine-tuning with LoRA, where naive aggregation of low-rank matrices introduces noise and prevents effective accumulation of updates.

entry.title: Training event-based neural networks with exact gradients via Differentiable ODE Solving in JAX

author.name: Lukas K\"onig, Manuel Kuhn, David Kappel, Anand Subramoney

entry.summary: Introduces Eventax, a JAX framework for training spiking neural networks with exact gradients using differentiable ODE solvers combined with event-based spike handling, resolving the tradeoff between surrogate gradient flexibility and exact gradient computation.

entry.title: AutoAdapt: An Automated Domain Adaptation Framework for LLMs

author.name: Sidharth Sinha, Anson Bastos, Xuchao Zhang, Akshay Nambi, Chetan Bansal, Saravan Rajmohan

entry.summary: Presents AutoAdapt, an automated end-to-end framework for LLM domain adaptation that leverages curated knowledge bases and reduces manual hyperparameter tuning, addressing the high cost and uncertainty of domain-specific LLM fine-tuning.

entry.title: SERQ: Saliency-Aware Low-Rank Error Reconstruction for LLM Quantization

author.name: Yeonsik Park, Hyeonseong Kim, Seungkyu Choi

entry.summary: Proposes SERQ, a saliency-aware low-rank error reconstruction method for LLM post-training quantization that focuses error correction on salient weights to address accuracy degradation at low bit-widths.

entry.title: Fibration Policy Optimization

author.name: Chang Li, Tshihao Tsu, Yaren Zhang, Chao Xue, Xiaodong He

entry.summary: Proposes Fibration Policy Optimization with a fiber bundle algebraic framework for organizing RL data, deriving an exact unconstrained reformulation of TV-TRPO and showing clipping and trust-region optimization are dual formulations.

entry.title: PolyFormer: learning efficient reformulations for scalable optimization under complex physical constraints

author.name: Yilin Wen, Yi Guo, Bo Zhao, Wei Qi, Zechun Hu, Colin Jones, Jian Sun

entry.summary: Introduces PolyFormer, a physics-informed ML approach that transforms complex physical constraints into efficient polytopic reformulations for optimization, decoupling problem complexity from solver computational cost.

entry.title: Efficient Credal Prediction through Decalibration

author.name: Paul Hofman, Timo L\"ohr, Maximilian Muschalik, Yusuf Sale, Eyke H\"ullermeier

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient method for credal prediction (using convex sets of probability distributions for epistemic uncertainty) through decalibration, avoiding the need to train model ensembles.

entry.title: Echo2ECG: Enhancing ECG Representations with Cardiac Morphology from Multi-View Echos

author.name: Michelle Espranita Liman, \"Ozg\"un Turgut, Alexander M\"uller, Eimo Martens, Daniel Rueckert, Philip M\"uller

entry.summary: Proposes Echo2ECG, a multimodal self-supervised learning framework that enriches ECG representations by aligning with multi-view echocardiography data, addressing the representational mismatch of single-view approaches for predicting cardiac morphological phenotypes.

entry.title: Impact of Connectivity on Laplacian Representations in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tommaso Giorgi, Pierriccardo Olivieri, Keyue Jiang, Laura Toni, Matteo Papini

entry.summary: Proves upper bounds on approximation error for linear value function approximation using learned Laplacian spectral features, showing how error scales with algebraic connectivity of the state graph.

entry.title: Towards Batch-to-Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Continuous Control

author.name: Riccardo De Monte, Matteo Cederle, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Proposes streaming versions of Soft Actor-Critic (S2AC) and Deterministic Actor-Critic (SDAC) that eliminate replay buffers, batch updates, and target networks for resource-limited hardware deployment.

entry.title: A New Lower Bound for the Random Offerer Mechanism in Bilateral Trade using AI-Guided Evolutionary Search

author.name: Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta, Zun Li, Aranyak Mehta

entry.summary: Uses AI-guided evolutionary search to establish a new lower bound for the Random Offerer mechanism in bilateral trade, addressing an open question in mechanism design. Demonstrates a novel methodology combining AI search with economic theory.

entry.title: A Novel Approach for Testing Water Safety Using Deep Learning Inference of Microscopic Images of Unincubated Water Samples

author.name: Sanjay Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes DeepScope, a deep learning system for water safety testing that analyzes microscope images of unincubated water samples, eliminating the 24-72 hour pathogen incubation step. Claims per-test cost of $0.44 vs current $20-50.

entry.title: Quantum Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Review

author.name: Yanjun Ji, Zhao-Yun Chen, Marco Roth, David A. Kreplin, Christian Schiffer, Martin King, Oliver Anton, M. Sahnawaz Alam, Markus Krutzik, Dennis Willsch, Ludwig Mathey, Frank K. Wilhelm, Guo-Ping Guo

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of quantum deep learning covering hybrid quantum-classical models, quantum deep neural networks, quantum algorithms for DL primitives, and quantum-inspired classical algorithms. Provides taxonomy and operational definitions.

entry.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search for Modern AI: A Projection-Augmented Graph Approach

author.name: Kejing Lu, Zhenpeng Pan, Jianbin Qin, Yoshiharu Ishikawa, Chuan Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces Projection-Augmented Graph (PAG) for approximate nearest neighbor search, integrating projection techniques into graph indices to meet six critical demands of modern AI applications including high efficiency and low memory.

entry.title: TEA-Time: Transporting Effects Across Time

author.name: Harsh Parikh, Gabriel Levin-Konigsberg, Dominique Perrault-Joncas, Alexander Volfovsky

entry.summary: Develops a framework for temporal transportation of treatment effects from RCTs to time periods without experiments, providing doubly robust, semiparametrically efficient estimators under a separable temporal effects assumption.

entry.title: VLN-Cache: Enabling Token Caching for VLN Models with Visual/Semantic Dynamics Awareness

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Zhihao Mao, Xingyue Zhou, Jiayu Chen, Maoliang Li, Xinhao Sun, Hailong Zou, Zhaobo Zhang, Xuanzhe Liu, Donggang Cao, Hong Mei, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes VLN-Cache for token caching in vision-language navigation models, addressing visual dynamics (viewpoint shifts) and semantic dynamics (changing task relevance) that break standard caching assumptions.

entry.title: StructSAM: Structure- and Spectrum-Preserving Token Merging for Segment Anything Models

author.name: Duy M. H. Nguyen, Tuan A. Tran, Duong Nguyen, Siwei Xie, Trung Q. Nguyen, Mai T. N. Truong, Daniel Palenicek, An T. Le, Michael Barz, TrungTin Nguyen, Tuan Dam, Ngan Le, Minh Vu, Khoa Doan, Vien Ngo, Pengtao Xie, James Zou, Daniel Sonntag, Jan Peters, Mathias Niepert

entry.summary: Proposes StructSAM, a token merging method specifically designed for SAM that preserves boundary structure and prevents prompt information leakage, addressing failures of generic token merging in segmentation models.

entry.title: Toward Unified Multimodal Representation Learning for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ximeng Tao, Dimitar Filev, Gaurav Pandey

entry.summary: Proposes Contrastive Tensor Pre-training (CTP) framework that simultaneously aligns multiple modalities (vision, language, 3D) in a unified embedding space for autonomous driving, going beyond pairwise alignment.

entry.title: Robust Transfer Learning with Side Information

author.name: Akram S. Awad, Shihab Ahmed, Yue Wang, George K. Atia

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for robust transfer learning in MDPs using estimate-centered uncertainty sets with side information (moment bounds, distributional distances, density ratios) to avoid overly conservative policies.

entry.title: Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Jing Jingzhe, Fan Zheyi, Szu Hui Ng, Qingpei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization (LCBO) for high-dimensional constrained problems, proving convergence rates for KKT residuals that depend polynomially on dimension.

entry.title: SaiVLA-0: Cerebrum--Pons--Cerebellum Tripartite Architecture for Compute-Aware Vision-Language-Action

author.name: Xiang Shi, Wenlong Huang, Menglin Zou, Xinhai Sun

entry.summary: Presents SaiVLA-0, a neuroscience-inspired tripartite architecture (Cerebrum-Pons-Cerebellum) for vision-language-action models, with frozen multimodal priors, adapter integration, and fast parallel categorical decoding.

entry.title: TRIAGE: Type-Routed Interventions via Aleatoric-Epistemic Gated Estimation in Robotic Manipulation and Adaptive Perception -- Don't Treat All Uncertainty the Same

author.name: Divake Kumar, Sina Tayebati, Devashri Naik, Patrick Poggi, Amanda Sofie Rios, Nilesh Ahuja, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

entry.summary: Introduces TRIAGE, a framework that decomposes robot prediction uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components and routes different corrective actions accordingly, rather than using a single uncertainty scalar.

entry.title: Rethinking Personalization in Large Language Models at the Token Level

author.name: Chenheng Zhang, Yijun Lu, Lizhe Fang, Chunyuan Zheng, Jiajun Chai, Xiaohan Wang, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Yisen Wang, Zhouchen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes PerContrast, a self-contrast method for token-level personalization in LLMs that estimates each token's personalization degree without requiring explicit annotations. Reweights training emphasis toward tokens with higher personalization relevance.

entry.title: Accent Vector: Controllable Accent Manipulation for Multilingual TTS Without Accented Data

author.name: Thanathai Lertpetchpun, Thanapat Trachu, Jihwan Lee, Tiantian Feng, Dani Byrd, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Proposes Accent Vector, a controllable representation for manipulating accents in multilingual TTS without accented training data. Derives vectors by fine-tuning on native non-English speech and computing task vectors capturing accent characteristics.

entry.title: Emergence is Overrated: AGI as an Archipelago of Experts

author.name: Daniel Kilov

entry.summary: Argues against emergence-based views of AGI, proposing instead an 'archipelago of experts' model drawing on cognitive science evidence that human intelligence operates through domain-specific expertise rather than unified general mechanisms.

entry.title: AdaCultureSafe: Adaptive Cultural Safety Grounded by Cultural Knowledge in Large Language Models

author.name: Hankun Kang, Di Lin, Zhirong Liao, Pengfei Bai, Xinyi Zeng, Jiawei Jiang, Yuanyuan Zhu, Tieyun Qian

entry.summary: Proposes AdaCultureSafe, jointly modeling cultural safety and cultural knowledge for LLMs. Addresses the gap where existing work treats these separately, preventing culture-specific respectful responses.

entry.title: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Shaoxiong Zhan, Yanlin Lai, Zheng Liu, Hai Lin, Shen Li, Xiaodong Cai, Zijian Lin, Wen Huang, Hai-Tao Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces 3ViewSense, a framework grounding spatial reasoning in orthographic views to address the 'spatial intelligence gap' in VLMs. Uses a 'Simulate-and-Reason' mechanism inspired by engineering cognition to decompose 3D scenes.

entry.title: GameVerse: Can Vision-Language Models Learn from Video-based Reflection?

author.name: Kuan Zhang, Dongchen Liu, Qiyue Zhao, Jinkun Hou, Xinran Zhang, Qinlei Xie, Miao Liu, Yiming Li

entry.summary: Presents GameVerse, a video game benchmark for VLMs using a reflect-and-retry paradigm to assess whether models can learn from video-based reflection. Introduces cognitive hierarchical taxonomy spanning 15 games with dual action spaces.

entry.title: UWPD: A General Paradigm for Invisible Watermark Detection Agnostic to Embedding Algorithms

author.name: Xiang Ao, Yiling Du, Zidan Wang, Mengru Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Universal Watermark Presence Detection (UWPD), a task to identify if an image carries a watermark without knowing the specific algorithm. Introduces UniFreq-100K dataset and Frequency Shield Network operating in frequency domain.

entry.title: T2SGrid: Temporal-to-Spatial Gridification for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Chaohong Guo, Yihan He, Yongwei Nie, Fei Ma, Xuemiao Xu, Chengjiang Long

entry.summary: T2SGrid reformulates video temporal grounding by converting temporal dynamics into spatial representations through a gridification approach, addressing limitations of positional encoding and timestamp-based methods in Vision-LMMs.

entry.title: Aligning What EEG Can See: Structural Representations for Brain-Vision Matching

author.name: Jingyi Tang, Shuai Jiang, Fei Su, Zhicheng Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Visibility concept and EEG-Visible Layer Selection Strategy for visual decoding from EEG, aligning brain signals with intermediate visual layers rather than final-layer semantic embeddings.

entry.title: Efficient Chest X-ray Representation Learning via Semantic-Partitioned Contrastive Learning

author.name: Wangyu Feng, Shawn Young, Lijian Xu

entry.summary: S-PCL introduces semantic-partitioned contrastive learning for chest X-ray representation, randomly partitioning patch tokens from a single image into complementary views, avoiding aggressive augmentations.

entry.title: Deep Expert Injection for Anchoring Retinal VLMs with Domain-Specific Knowledge

author.name: Shuai Lu, Meng Wang, Jia Guo, Jiawei Du, Bo Liu, Shengzhu Yang, Weihang Zhang, Huazhu Fu, Huiqi Li

entry.summary: EyExIn addresses perception and reasoning gaps in retinal VLMs through Deep Expert Injection, bridging fine-grained pathological feature detection and preventing language priors from overriding visual evidence.

entry.title: Training for Trustworthy Saliency Maps: Adversarial Training Meets Feature-Map Smoothing

author.name: Dipkamal Bhusal, Md Tanvirul Alam, Nidhi Rastogi

entry.summary: Provides curvature-based analysis linking saliency map stability to input-gradient smoothness, studying how adversarial training affects explanation quality with a trade-off between input stability and output stability.

entry.title: VIVECaption: A Split Approach to Caption Quality Improvement

author.name: Varun Ananth, Baqiao Liu, Haoran Cai

entry.summary: VIVECaption introduces a systematic two-sided approach to improving caption quality for T2I/T2V training, with a taxonomy of evaluation metrics distinguishing universal from instance-grounded metrics.

entry.title: Selective Transfer Learning of Cross-Modality Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection

author.name: Rui Ding, Meng Yang, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: Investigates negative transfer in cross-modality (LiDAR-to-camera) knowledge distillation for monocular 3D detection, proposing MonoSTL for selective transfer that encourages depth knowledge while reducing irrelevant information.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Decouple and Recouple Network for Robust 3D Object Detection

author.name: Rui Ding, Zhaonian Kuang, Yuzhe Ji, Meng Yang, Xinhu Zheng, Gang Hua

entry.summary: Proposes a Multi-Modal Decouple and Recouple Network for robust 3D object detection under sensor data corruption, separating and recombining modality-invariant features to handle degraded inputs.

entry.title: RayD3D: Distilling Depth Knowledge Along the Ray for Robust Multi-View 3D Object Detection

author.name: Rui Ding, Zhaonian Kuang, Zongwei Zhou, Meng Yang, Xinhu Zheng, Gang Hua

entry.summary: RayD3D distills depth knowledge along camera rays for multi-view 3D detection, transferring only depth-relevant information from LiDAR to camera while filtering out density-related artifacts.

entry.title: EvolveReason: Self-Evolving Reasoning Paradigm for Explainable Deepfake Facial Image Identification

author.name: Binjia Zhou, Dawei Luo, Shuai Chen, Feng Xu, Seow, Haoyuan Li, Jiachi Wang, Jiawen Wang, Zunlei Feng, Yijun Bei

entry.summary: EvolveReason proposes a self-evolving reasoning paradigm for explainable deepfake facial image identification, mimicking human auditor reasoning with chain-of-thought dataset and progressive refinement.

entry.title: GLASS: Graph and Vision-Language Assisted Semantic Shape Correspondence

author.name: Qinfeng Xiao, Guofeng Mei, Qilong Liu, Chenyuan Yi, Fabio Poiesi, Jian Zhang, Bo Yang, Yick Kit-lun

entry.summary: GLASS integrates geometric spectral analysis with vision-language foundation model priors for unsupervised 3D shape correspondence, addressing challenges of non-isometric deformations. Bridges functional map methods with semantic priors from models like CLIP.

entry.title: FrameVGGT: Frame Evidence Rolling Memory for streaming VGGT

author.name: Zhisong Xu, Takeshi Oishi

entry.summary: FrameVGGT addresses unbounded KV-cache growth in streaming visual geometry transformers by proposing frame-driven rolling memory that retains coherent local geometric support. Motivated by geometric reasoning requirements rather than arbitrary token retention.

entry.title: AutoTraces: Autoregressive Trajectory Forecasting via Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Teng Wang, Yanting Lu, Ruize Wang

entry.summary: AutoTraces uses LLMs for robot trajectory forecasting with a novel tokenization scheme representing waypoints as categorical point tokens with numerical embeddings. Integrates trajectory prediction into the autoregressive LLM framework.

entry.title: This Looks Distinctly Like That: Grounding Interpretable Recognition in Stiefel Geometry against Neural Collapse

author.name: Junhao Jia, Jiaqi Wang, Yunyou Liu, Haodong Jing, Yueyi Wu, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Manifold Prototypes (AMP) that uses Riemannian optimization on the Stiefel manifold to prevent prototype collapse in prototype networks, making rank-one collapse infeasible by construction through orthonormal basis representation.

entry.title: Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework

author.name: Yutong Hu, Jinhui Chen, Chaoqiang Xu, Yuan Kou, Sili Zhou, Shaocheng Yan, Pengcheng Shi, Qingwu Hu, Jiayuan Li

entry.summary: CORE introduces a million-scale dataset for global cross-modal geo-localization matching ground-level text with aerial imagery, spanning 225 geographic regions across all continents with 1M+ image pairs.

entry.title: PRISM: Streaming Human Motion Generation with Per-Joint Latent Decomposition

author.name: Zeyu Ling, Qing Shuai, Teng Zhang, Shiyang Li, Bo Han, Changqing Zou

entry.summary: PRISM introduces a joint-factorized motion latent space where each body joint has its own token, forming a 2D grid for structured motion representation. Supports text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and long-horizon synthesis in a unified model.

entry.title: UniUncer: Unified Dynamic Static Uncertainty for End to End Driving

author.name: Yu Gao, Jijun Wang, Zongzheng Zhang, Anqing Jiang, Yiru Wang, Yuwen Heng, Shuo Wang, Hao Sun, Zhangfeng Hu, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: UniUncer is the first unified uncertainty framework for end-to-end driving that models uncertainty in both static map elements and dynamic agents, addressing the gap where existing E2E approaches only model static uncertainty.

entry.title: RoboCritics: Enabling Reliable End-to-End LLM Robot Programming through Expert-Informed Critics

author.name: Callie Y. Kim, Nathan Thomas White, Evan He, Frederic Sala, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: Presents RoboCritics, a system that augments LLM-based robot programming with expert-informed motion-level critics that analyze execution traces for safety violations like joint speed violations and collisions. Aims to make LLM-generated robot code more verifiable and debuggable.

entry.title: Adaptive Capacity Allocation for Vision Language Action Fine-tuning

author.name: Donghoon Kim, Minji Bae, Unghui Nam, Gyeonghun Kim, Suyun Lee, Kyuhong Shim, Byonghyo Shim

entry.summary: Proposes LoRA-SP (Select-Prune), a rank-adaptive fine-tuning method for Vision-Language-Action models that replaces fixed-rank updates with importance-driven rank selection and pruning, addressing the mismatch between LLM and VLA fine-tuning requirements.

entry.title: MetaWorld-X: Hierarchical World Modeling via VLM-Orchestrated Experts for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

author.name: Yutong Shen, Hangxu Liu, Penghui Liu, Jiashuo Luo, Yongkang Zhang, Rex Morvley, Chen Jiang, Jianwei Zhang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MetaWorld-X, a hierarchical world model framework for humanoid loco-manipulation using VLM-orchestrated expert models, addressing cross-skill gradient interference in monolithic policy learning.

entry.title: NaviDriveVLM: Decoupling High-Level Reasoning and Motion Planning for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ximeng Tao, Pardis Taghavi, Dimitar Filev, Reza Langari, Gaurav Pandey

entry.summary: Proposes NaviDriveVLM, a decoupled framework separating high-level reasoning (large Navigator VLM) from motion planning (small trainable Driver) for autonomous driving, reducing training cost while preserving reasoning ability.

entry.title: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning: Steering ViTs away from Spurious Correlations to Improve Robustness

author.name: Yehonatan Elisha, Oren Barkan, Noam Koenigstein

entry.summary: Introduces concept-guided fine-tuning for ViTs that aligns internal relevance maps with spatially grounded concept masks (e.g., 'beak', 'wings') to reduce reliance on spurious correlations under distribution shift.

entry.title: X-AVDT: Audio-Visual Cross-Attention for Robust Deepfake Detection

author.name: Youngseo Kim, Kwan Yun, Seokhyeon Hong, Sihun Cha, Colette Suhjung Koo, Junyong Noh

entry.summary: Proposes X-AVDT, a deepfake detector that exploits generator-internal audio-visual cross-attention signals accessed via DDIM inversion to detect forgeries with improved generalization.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Taxonomic Generalization in (Vision-) Language Models

author.name: Tianyang Xu, Marcelo Sandoval-Castaneda, Karen Livescu, Greg Shakhnarovich, Kanishka Misra

entry.summary: Studies cross-modal taxonomic generalization in vision-language models, testing whether LM knowledge of hypernyms can be recovered when the VLM is progressively deprived of explicit hypernym evidence, using frozen encoders.

entry.title: 4DRC-OCC: Robust Semantic Occupancy Prediction Through Fusion of 4D Radar and Camera

author.name: David Ninfa, Andras Palffy, Holger Caesar

entry.summary: First study combining 4D radar and camera for 3D semantic occupancy prediction in autonomous driving. Demonstrates complementary strengths of 4D radar's weather resilience and camera's rich semantic information.

entry.title: $L^3$:Scene-agnostic Visual Localization in the Wild

author.name: Yu Zhang, Muhua Zhu, Yifei Xue, Tie Ji, Yizhen Lao

entry.summary: L³ proposes map-free visual localization using feed-forward 3D reconstruction networks for online inference, eliminating offline scene preprocessing. Achieves high accuracy through two-stage metric scale recovery and pose refinement.

entry.title: VisualAD: Language-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection via Vision Transformer

author.name: Yanning Hou, Peiyuan Li, Zirui Liu, Yitong Wang, Yanran Ruan, Jianfeng Qiu, Ke Xu

entry.summary: VisualAD proposes a purely visual framework for zero-shot anomaly detection, removing the text encoder dependency from CLIP-based approaches. Uses learnable tokens within a frozen ViT backbone to encode normality and abnormality.

entry.title: QualiTeacher: Quality-Conditioned Pseudo-Labeling for Real-World Image Restoration

author.name: Fengyang Xiao, Jingjia Feng, Peng Hu, Dingming Zhang, Lei Xu, Guanyi Qin, Lu Li, Chunming He, Sina Farsiu

entry.summary: QualiTeacher transforms pseudo-label quality from a liability into a conditional supervisory signal for real-world image restoration. Instead of filtering low-quality pseudo-labels, conditions the student model on estimated PL quality.

entry.title: MV-Fashion: Towards Enabling Virtual Try-On and Size Estimation with Multi-View Paired Data

author.name: Hunor Laczk\'o, Libang Jia, Loc-Phat Truong, Diego Hern\'andez, Sergio Escalera, Jordi Gonzalez, Meysam Madadi

entry.summary: MV-Fashion introduces a large-scale multi-view video dataset for fashion analysis with 3,273 sequences and 72.5M frames from 80 subjects. Supports virtual try-on and size estimation with rich annotations.

entry.title: Fusion-Poly: A Polyhedral Framework Based on Spatial-Temporal Fusion for 3D Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Xian Wu, Yitao Wu, Xiaoyu Li, Zijia Li, Lijun Zhao, Lining Sun

entry.summary: Fusion-Poly proposes a polyhedral framework for LiDAR-camera 3D multi-object tracking that exploits asynchronous observations between sensors at different sampling rates. Goes beyond synchronized-only fusion.

entry.title: Human-AI Divergence in Ego-centric Action Recognition under Spatial and Spatiotemporal Manipulations

author.name: Sadegh Rahmaniboldaji, Filip Rybansky, Quoc C. Vuong, Anya C. Hurlbert, Frank Guerin, Andrew Gilbert

entry.summary: Large-scale human-AI comparative study of egocentric action recognition using Minimal Identifiable Recognition Crops, systematically analyzing where humans outperform AI models under spatial and temporal manipulations.

entry.title: StreamReady: Learning What to Answer and When in Long Streaming Videos

author.name: Shehreen Azad, Vibhav Vineet, Yogesh Singh Rawat

entry.summary: StreamReady introduces Answer Readiness Score (ARS) for streaming video understanding that measures not just correctness but timing of answers, with asymmetric early and late penalties.

entry.title: SoundWeaver: Semantic Warm-Starting for Text-to-Audio Diffusion Serving

author.name: Ayush Barik, Sofia Stoica, Nikhil Sarda, Arnav Kethana, Abhinav Khanduja, Muchen Xu, Fan Lai

entry.summary: SoundWeaver accelerates text-to-audio diffusion serving by warm-starting from semantically similar cached audio, achieving 1.8-3x latency reduction without training through semantic retrieval and adaptive skip scheduling.

entry.title: Foundational World Models Accurately Detect Bimanual Manipulator Failures

author.name: Isaac R. Ward, Michelle Ho, Houjun Liu, Aaron Feldman, Joseph Vincent, Liam Kruse, Sean Cheong, Duncan Eddy, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Mac Schwager

entry.summary: Trains a probabilistic world model within the compressed latent space of NVIDIA's Cosmos Tokenizer for detecting failures in bimanual manipulators. Uses uncertainty estimates as conformal prediction scores for anomaly detection.

entry.title: StreamVoiceAnon+: Emotion-Preserving Streaming Speaker Anonymization via Frame-Level Acoustic Distillation

author.name: Nikita Kuzmin, Kong Aik Lee, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Addresses emotion preservation in streaming speaker anonymization using supervised finetuning with neutral-emotion pairs and frame-level emotion distillation, maintaining 180ms streaming latency.

entry.title: Stabilized Fine-Tuning with LoRA in Federated Learning: Mitigating the Side Effect of Client Size and Rank via the Scaling Factor

author.name: Jiayu Huang, Xiaohu Wu, Tiantian He, Qicheng Lao

entry.summary: Identifies that aggregating LoRA updates in federated learning introduces variance scaling with client count, causing gradient collapse with high-rank adapters, and proposes a stabilized scaling factor solution.

entry.title: Foley-Flow: Coordinated Video-to-Audio Generation with Masked Audio-Visual Alignment and Dynamic Conditional Flows

author.name: Shentong Mo, Yibing Song

entry.summary: Proposes FoleyFlow for video-to-audio generation using masked modeling for audio-visual alignment and dynamic conditional flow matching, improving temporal synchronization over contrastive learning approaches.

entry.title: PDD: Manifold-Prior Diverse Distillation for Medical Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xijun Lu, Hongying Liu, Fanhua Shang, Yanming Hui, Liang Wan

entry.summary: PDD proposes manifold-prior diverse distillation for medical anomaly detection, unifying dual-teacher priors into a shared high-dimensional manifold and showing discriminative methods fail on medical data unlike industrial settings.

entry.title: EVLF: Early Vision-Language Fusion for Generative Dataset Distillation

author.name: Wenqi Cai, Yawen Zou, Guang Li, Chunzhi Gu, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: EVLF proposes early vision-language fusion for generative dataset distillation, aligning textual and visual embeddings at the encoder-backbone transition to prevent text prompts from dominating the generation.

entry.title: TALON: Test-time Adaptive Learning for On-the-Fly Category Discovery

author.name: Yanan Wu, Yuhan Yan, Tailai Chen, Zhixiang Chi, ZiZhang Wu, Yi Jin, Yang Wang, Zhenbo Li

entry.summary: TALON addresses on-the-fly category discovery in unlabeled online streams through test-time adaptive learning. Overcomes limitations of frozen feature extractors and hash-based prototypes that cause category explosion.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Data Augmentation for Image Recognition: A Systematic Analysis and Evaluation

author.name: Zekun Li, Yinghuan Shi, Yang Gao, Dong Xu

entry.summary: UniDiffDA provides a unified analytical framework decomposing diffusion-based data augmentation into model fine-tuning, sample generation, and sample utilization. Conducts systematic evaluation across configurations to identify effective strategies.

entry.title: GeoLoco: Leveraging 3D Geometric Priors from Visual Foundation Model for Robust RGB-Only Humanoid Locomotion

author.name: Yufei Liu, Xieyuanli Chen, Hainan Pan, Chenghao Shi, Yanjie Chen, Kaihong Huang, Zhiwen Zeng, Huimin Lu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoLoco, an RGB-only humanoid locomotion framework that leverages visual foundation model geometric priors to create 3D latent representations from monocular images, avoiding the need for depth sensors.

entry.title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents

author.name: Ali Shamsaddinlou

entry.summary: RoboLayout extends LayoutVLM by integrating agent-aware reasoning and reachability constraints into a differentiable layout optimization process for 3D scene generation. This enables generating layouts that are navigable and actionable by embodied agents in physically constrained indoor environments.

entry.title: CBR-to-SQL: Rethinking Retrieval-based Text-to-SQL using Case-based Reasoning in the Healthcare Domain

author.name: Hung Nguyen, Hans Moen, Pekka Marttinen

entry.summary: Introduces CBR-to-SQL, a Case-Based Reasoning framework for translating natural language to SQL in healthcare settings. Addresses limitations of standard RAG for medical terminology variability.

entry.title: Post Fusion Bird's Eye View Feature Stabilization for Robust Multimodal 3D Detection

author.name: Trung Tien Dong, Dev Thakkar, Arman Sargolzaei, Xiaomin Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Post Fusion Stabilizer (PFS), a lightweight module that refines BEV features of existing camera-LiDAR fusion detectors for robustness under domain shift and sensor failures without retraining.

entry.title: Longitudinal Lesion Inpainting in Brain MRI via 3D Region Aware Diffusion

author.name: Zahra Karimaghaloo, Dumitru Fetco, Haz-Edine Assemlal, Hassan Rivaz, Douglas L. Arnold

entry.summary: Presents a pseudo-3D longitudinal brain lesion inpainting framework using diffusion models with multi-channel conditioning for temporal context and Region-Aware Diffusion adapted to medical imaging.

entry.title: Cultural Perspectives and Expectations for Generative AI: A Global Survey Approach

author.name: Erin van Liemt, Renee Shelby, Andrew Smart, Sinchana Kumbale, Richard Zhang, Neha Dixit, Qazi Mamunur Rashid, Jamila Smith-Loud

entry.summary: Large-scale global survey assessing cultural perspectives on generative AI, gathering data about how GenAI should represent cultural artifacts, concepts, and values across Europe, Americas, Asia, and Africa.

entry.title: Balancing Domestic and Global Perspectives: Evaluating Dual-Calibration and LLM-Generated Nudges for Diverse News Recommendation

author.name: Ruixuan Sun, Matthew Zent, Minzhu Zhao, Thanmayee Boyapati, Xinyi Li, Joseph A. Konstan

entry.summary: Evaluates dual-calibration algorithmic nudges and LLM-generated presentation nudges for news recommendation diversity in a 5-week real-user study with 120 participants. Finds algorithmic nudges increase diversity but LLM presentation nudges have mixed effects.

entry.title: Skeleton-to-Image Encoding: Enabling Skeleton Representation Learning via Vision-Pretrained Models

author.name: Siyuan Yang, Jun Liu, Hao Cheng, Chong Wang, Shijian Lu, Hedvig Kjellstrom, Weisi Lin, Alex C. Kot

entry.summary: Introduces Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I) that transforms 3D skeleton sequences into image-like data, enabling use of pretrained vision models for skeleton-based action recognition without additional model branches.

entry.title: Demystifying KAN for Vision Tasks: The RepKAN Approach

author.name: Minjong Cheon

entry.summary: Proposes RepKAN, integrating CNNs with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for interpretable remote sensing image classification. Uses dual-path design for spatial and spectral processing, discovering class-specific spectral fingerprints.

entry.title: Text-Driven Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation

author.name: Hao Yang, Yanyan Zhao, Tian Zheng, Hongbo Zhang, Bichen Wang, Di Wu, Xing Fu, Xuda Zhi, Yongbo Huang, Hao He

entry.summary: Proposes Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation (EC-TFG), a novel task where generated faces exhibit continuously changing emotions while speaking, driven by text and emotion descriptions.

entry.title: Cut to the Chase: Training-free Multimodal Summarization via Chain-of-Events

author.name: Xiaoxing You, Qiang Huang, Lingyu Li, Xiaojun Chang, Jun Yu

entry.summary: Introduces CoE, a training-free multimodal summarization framework that performs structured reasoning through a Chain-of-Events guided by a Hierarchical Event Graph for cross-modal grounding.

entry.title: ESAA-Security: An Event-Sourced, Verifiable Architecture for Agent-Assisted Security Audits of AI-Generated Code

author.name: Elzo Brito dos Santos Filho

entry.summary: Proposes ESAA-Security, an event-sourced architecture for agent-assisted security audits of AI-generated code, separating agent cognition from deterministic state mutation with append-only events and replay verification.

entry.title: PONTE: Personalized Orchestration for Natural Language Trustworthy Explanations

author.name: Vittoria Vineis, Matteo Silvestri, Lorenzo Antonelli, Filippo Betello, Gabriele Tolomei

entry.summary: Presents PONTE, a human-in-the-loop XAI framework that generates personalized, trustworthy natural language explanations. Models personalization as a closed-loop validation process rather than prompt engineering.

entry.title: RAMoEA-QA: Hierarchical Specialization for Robust Respiratory Audio Question Answering

author.name: Gaia A. Bertolino, Yuwei Zhang, Tong Xia, Domenico Talia, Cecilia Mascolo

entry.summary: Proposes RAMoEA-QA, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for respiratory audio question answering that handles heterogeneous recordings across devices and environments with specialized expert routing.

entry.title: LegoNet: Memory Footprint Reduction Through Block Weight Clustering

author.name: Joseph Bingham, Noah Green, Saman Zonouz

entry.summary: Proposes LegoNet, a compression technique that clusters blocks of weights across an entire model regardless of layer type, achieving 64x compression on ResNet-50 with only 32 4x4 blocks without removing weights or changing architecture.

entry.title: SmartBench: Evaluating LLMs in Smart Homes with Anomalous Device States and Behavioral Contexts

author.name: Qingsong Zou, Zhi Yan, Zhiyao Xu, Kuofeng Gao, Jingyu Xiao, Yong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces SmartBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs as smart home assistants, focusing on anomalous device state detection — a critical but understudied capability beyond simple instruction execution.

entry.title: Latent Autoencoder Ensemble Kalman Filter for Data assimilation

author.name: Xin T. Tong, Yanyan Wang, Liang Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a latent autoencoder for ensemble Kalman filter (LAE-EnKF) that reformulates data assimilation in a learned latent space with linear dynamics, restoring compatibility with Kalman updates for strongly nonlinear systems.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Diffusion Model for Generating Synthetic Extreme Rare Weather Events Data

author.name: Marawan Yakout, Tannistha Maiti, Monira Majhabeen, Tarry Singh

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed diffusion model for generating synthetic satellite imagery of extreme weather events, conditioned on atmospheric parameters to address data scarcity for rare Category 4+ tropical cyclones.

entry.title: Learning From Design Procedure To Generate CAD Programs for Data Augmentation

author.name: Yan-Ying Chen, Dule Shu, Matthew Hong, Andrew Taber, Jonathan Li, Matthew Klenk

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to generate CAD programs conditioned on design procedures, creating a data augmentation paradigm that produces more geometrically complex shapes than existing training data.

entry.title: RESCHED: Rethinking Flexible Job Shop Scheduling from a Transformer-based Architecture with Simplified States

author.name: Xiangjie Xiao, Cong Zhang, Wen Song, Zhiguang Cao

entry.summary: Introduces RESCHED, a minimalist DRL framework for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling that reduces state representation from 20+ handcrafted features to just 4 essential features using a Transformer-based architecture.

entry.title: LightMedSeg: Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Learned Spatial Anchors

author.name: Kavyansh Tyagi, Vishwas Rathi, Puneet Goyal

entry.summary: Proposes LightMedSeg, a lightweight 3D medical segmentation architecture using anatomical priors, FiLM modulation, and efficient convolutions to achieve strong performance under memory and latency constraints.

entry.title: Neural Dynamics-Informed Pre-trained Framework for Personalized Brain Functional Network Construction

author.name: Hongjie Jiang, Yifei Tang, Shuqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a neural dynamics-informed pre-trained framework for constructing personalized brain functional networks, moving beyond linear assumptions and pre-defined atlases.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Gated Generative Modeling

author.name: Xingrui Gu, Haixi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Uncertainty-Gated Generative Modeling (UGGM) that treats uncertainty as an internal control signal gating representation, propagation, and generation for financial time-series.

entry.title: ProgAgent:A Continual RL Agent with Progress-Aware Rewards

author.name: Jinzhou Tan, Gabriel Adineera, Jinoh Kim

entry.summary: ProgAgent combines progress-aware reward learning from unlabeled expert videos with a JAX-native architecture for continual reinforcement learning. It uses adversarial push-back refinement to handle out-of-distribution states during online exploration, addressing catastrophic forgetting and reward specification costs.

entry.title: ELLMob: Event-Driven Human Mobility Generation with Self-Aligned LLM Framework

author.name: Yusong Wang, Chuang Yang, Jiawei Wang, Xiaohang Xu, Jiayi Xu, Dongyuan Li, Chuan Xiao, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces ELLMob, an event-driven human mobility generation framework using LLMs that handles deviated mobility during large-scale societal events like typhoons and COVID-19, along with the first event-annotated mobility dataset.

entry.title: Model-based Offline RL via Robust Value-Aware Model Learning with Implicitly Differentiable Adaptive Weighting

author.name: Zhongjian Qiao, Jiafei Lyu, Boxiang Lyu, Yao Shu, Siyang Gao, Shuang Qiu

entry.summary: Addresses model exploitation in model-based offline RL by analyzing RAMBO's instabilities (Q-value underestimation and gradient explosion) and proposing improved adversarial model learning with implicitly differentiable adaptive weighting.

entry.title: Optimising antibiotic switching via forecasting of patient physiology

author.name: Magnus Ross, Nel Swanepoel, Akish Luintel, Emma McGuire, Ingemar J. Cox, Steve Harris, Vasileios Lampos

entry.summary: Uses neural processes to model vital sign trajectories for optimizing IV-to-oral antibiotic switching decisions, comparing forecasts against clinical guidelines rather than learning from historical (often delayed) decisions.

entry.title: Grow, Assess, Compress: Adaptive Backbone Scaling for Memory-Efficient Class Incremental Learning

author.name: Adrian Garcia-Casta\~neda, Jon Irureta, Jon Imaz, Aizea Lojo

entry.summary: Proposes GRACE, a dynamic scaling framework for class incremental learning that cycles through growing, assessing capacity saturation, and compressing to manage model size while maintaining plasticity-stability balance.

entry.title: Drift-to-Action Controllers: Budgeted Interventions with Online Risk Certificates

author.name: Ismail Lamaakal, Chaymae Yahyati, Khalid El Makkaoui, Ibrahim Ouahbi, Yassine Maleh

entry.summary: Introduces Drift2Act, a drift-to-action controller that treats distribution drift monitoring as constrained decision-making, combining drift sensing with active risk certificates that provide anytime-valid bounds on current risk.

entry.title: Group Entropies and Mirror Duality: A Class of Flexible Mirror Descent Updates for Machine Learning

author.name: Andrzej Cichocki, Piergiulio Tempesta

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework connecting group theory and group entropies with Mirror Descent optimization, yielding an infinite family of flexible MD algorithms. The approach generalizes beyond Shannon/Tsallis entropies using multi-parametric generalized logarithms as mirror maps.

entry.title: Chart Deep Research in LVLMs via Parallel Relative Policy Optimization

author.name: Jiajin Tang, Gaoyang, Wenjie Wang, Sibei Yang, Xing Chen

entry.summary: Proposes parallel relative policy optimization for training large vision-language models on deep chart analysis tasks, addressing multi-dimensional reward interference and gradient conflicts.

entry.title: The Talking Robot: Distortion-Robust Acoustic Models for Robot-Robot Communication

author.name: Hanlong Li, Karishma Kamalahasan, Jiahui Li, Kazuhiro Nakadai, Shreyas Kousik

entry.summary: Presents Artoo, a learned acoustic communication system for robot-to-robot communication that co-trains TTS transmitter and ASR receiver through a differentiable channel, achieving superior noise robustness by not needing to preserve human speech qualities.

entry.title: A Distributed Gaussian Process Model for Multi-Robot Mapping

author.name: Seth Nabarro, Mark van der Wilk, Andrew J. Davison

entry.summary: Proposes DistGP, a distributed Gaussian process method for multi-robot collaborative learning using sparse GP factorization and Gaussian belief propagation, enabling online training with dynamic connectivity.

entry.title: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Generative AI Applications with Silicon Photonics

author.name: Tharini Suresh, Salma Afifi, Sudeep Pasricha

entry.summary: Presents a silicon photonics-based accelerator for diffusion models, achieving 3x better energy efficiency and 5.5x throughput improvement over electronic accelerators.

entry.title: Revisiting Unknowns: Towards Effective and Efficient Open-Set Active Learning

author.name: Chen-Chen Zong, Yu-Qi Chi, Xie-Yang Wang, Yan Cui, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes E²OAL, a detector-free framework for open-set active learning that exploits labeled unknowns through label-guided clustering for both supervision and querying.

entry.title: RL unknotter, hard unknots and unknotting number

author.name: Anne Dranowski, Yura Kabkov, Daniel Tubbenhauer

entry.summary: Develops an RL pipeline for simplifying knot diagrams through Reidemeister moves, successfully handling 'very hard' unknots and recovering a recently established unknotting number bound.

entry.title: ALOOD: Exploiting Language Representations for LiDAR-based Out-of-Distribution Object Detection

author.name: Michael K\"osel, Marcel Schreiber, Michael Ulrich, Claudius Gl\"aser, Klaus Dietmayer

entry.summary: Proposes ALOOD, which aligns LiDAR object detector features with vision-language model feature spaces to enable zero-shot OOD object detection for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Sign Identifiability of Causal Effects in Stationary Stochastic Dynamical Systems

author.name: Gijs van Seeventer, Saber Salehkaleybar

entry.summary: Studies sign identifiability of causal effects in continuous-time linear stochastic differential equations, deriving criteria for when the sign of drift entries can be determined from observational data without knowing the diffusion matrix.

entry.title: Generative Adversarial Regression (GAR): Learning Conditional Risk Scenarios

author.name: Saeed Asadi, Jonathan Yu-Meng Li

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Adversarial Regression (GAR), a minimax framework for learning conditional risk scenarios where generators are aligned with downstream risk objectives for elicitable functionals.

entry.title: Counting on Consensus: Selecting the Right Inter-annotator Agreement Metric for NLP Annotation and Evaluation

author.name: Joseph James

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of inter-annotator agreement metrics for NLP, organized by task type. Discusses how factors like label imbalance and missing data affect reliability estimates, with best practices for reporting.

entry.title: AutoChecklist: Composable Pipelines for Checklist Generation and Scoring with LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Karen Zhou, Chenhao Tan

entry.summary: Presents AutoChecklist, an open-source library unifying checklist-based LLM evaluation into composable pipelines with five generation abstractions and a modular Generator→Refiner→Scorer pipeline.

entry.title: TableMind++: An Uncertainty-Aware Programmatic Agent for Tool-Augmented Table Reasoning

author.name: Mingyue Cheng, Shuo Yu, Chuang Jiang, Xiaoyu Tao, Qingyang Mao, Jie Ouyang, Qi Liu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Extends TableMind with uncertainty-aware reasoning for tool-augmented table reasoning. Uses a two-stage SFT+RL training strategy with a novel Rank-Aware Policy Optimization algorithm.

entry.title: Examining the Role of YouTube Production and Consumption Dynamics on the Formation of Extreme Ideologies

author.name: Sarmad Chandio, Rishab Nithyanand

entry.summary: Longitudinal mixed-methods analysis combining one year of YouTube watch history with ideological surveys from 1,100 U.S. participants. Examines interplay between content production and consumption in ideological radicalization.

entry.title: RexDrug: Reliable Multi-Drug Combination Extraction through Reasoning-Enhanced LLMs

author.name: Zhijun Wang, Ling Luo, Dinghao Pan, Huan Zhuang, Lejing Yu, Yuanyuan Sun, Hongfei Lin

entry.summary: Proposes RexDrug, a reasoning-enhanced framework for n-ary drug combination extraction from biomedical literature using LLMs. Uses multi-agent collaborative reasoning trace generation and two-stage training.

entry.title: SPD-RAG: Sub-Agent Per Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yagiz Can Akay, Muhammed Yusuf Kartal, Esra Alparslan, Faruk Ortakoyluoglu, Arda Akpinar

entry.summary: Introduces SPD-RAG, a hierarchical multi-agent RAG framework where each document gets a dedicated agent for focused retrieval, with a coordinator dispatching tasks and aggregating answers for cross-document QA.

entry.title: KCoEvo: A Knowledge Graph Augmented Framework for Evolutionary Code Generation

author.name: Jiazhen Kang, Yuchen Lu, Chen Jiang, Jinrui Liu, Tianhao Zhang, Bo Jiang, Ningyuan Sun, Tongtong Wu, Guilin Qi

entry.summary: Proposes KCoEvo, a knowledge graph-augmented framework for code generation that handles API evolution. Constructs static/dynamic API graphs to model cross-version transitions, enabling structured reasoning about API migrations.

entry.title: VB: Visibility Benchmark for Visibility and Perspective Reasoning in Images

author.name: Neil Tripathi

entry.summary: Introduces VB, a benchmark testing whether VLMs can determine visibility in photographs with VISIBLY_TRUE/VISIBLY_FALSE/ABSTAIN outputs. Uses 2x2 design crossing minimal image and text edits to verify model judgments change appropriately.

entry.title: Narrative Weaver: Towards Controllable Long-Range Visual Consistency with Multi-Modal Conditioning

author.name: Zhengjian Yao, Yongzhi Li, Xinyuan Gao, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang, Yanye Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Narrative Weaver, a framework for multi-modal controllable, long-range consistent visual content generation. Combines MLLM for narrative planning with fine-grained control mechanisms for applications like filmmaking.

entry.title: MotionBits: Video Segmentation through Motion-Level Analysis of Rigid Bodies

author.name: Howard H. Qian, Kejia Ren, Yu Xiang, Vicente Ordonez, Kaiyu Hang

entry.summary: Introduces MotionBit, defining the smallest unit in motion-based video segmentation through kinematic spatial twist equivalence, independent of semantics. Targets rigid body detection, segmentation, and tracking for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Inter-Image Pixel Shuffling for Multi-focus Image Fusion

author.name: Huangxing Lin, Rongrong Ma, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: IPS introduces inter-image pixel shuffling for multi-focus image fusion training without requiring actual multi-focus images, reformulating the task as pixel-wise classification using synthetic focused/defocused pixel groups.

entry.title: PromptGate Client Adaptive Vision Language Gating for Open Set Federated Active Learning

author.name: Adea Nesturi, David Due\~nas Gaviria, Jiajun Zeng, Shadi Albarqouni

entry.summary: PromptGate proposes a VLM-gated framework for open-set federated active learning in medical AI, using learnable prompt vectors to filter out-of-distribution noise from unlabeled pools before annotation querying.

entry.title: Faster-HEAL: An Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Perception Framework for Heterogeneous Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Armin Maleki, Hayder Radha

entry.summary: Faster-HEAL proposes a lightweight, privacy-preserving collaborative perception framework for heterogeneous autonomous vehicles, fine-tuning only adapters rather than retraining entire models.

entry.title: Interpretable Aneurysm Classification via 3D Concept Bottleneck Models: Integrating Morphological and Hemodynamic Clinical Features

author.name: Toqa Khaled, Ahmad Al-Kabbany

entry.summary: Proposes 3D Concept Bottleneck Models for intracranial aneurysm classification, integrating morphological and hemodynamic clinical features for interpretable deep learning that aligns with neurosurgical principles.

entry.title: Disentangled Textual Priors for Diffusion-based Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Lei Jiang, Xin Liu, Xinze Tong, Zhiliang Li, Jie Liu, Jie Tang, Gangshan Wu

entry.summary: DTPSR introduces disentangled textual priors for diffusion-based image super-resolution, separating spatial hierarchy (global vs. local) and frequency semantics (low vs. high frequency) for better controllability.

entry.title: SIGMAE: A Spectral-Index-Guided Foundation Model for Multispectral Remote Sensing

author.name: Xiaokang Zhang, Bo Li, Chufeng Zhou, Weikang Yu, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: SIGMAE proposes spectral index-guided masked autoencoder pretraining for multispectral remote sensing, using domain-specific spectral indices as semantic guidance during masking to improve feature learning.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Medical Shape Generation via Skeletal Latent Diffusion

author.name: Guoqing Zhang, Jingyun Yang, Siqi Chen, Anping Zhang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a skeletal latent diffusion framework for medical shape generation that incorporates structural priors through differentiable skeletonization for efficient and high-fidelity anatomical shape synthesis.

entry.title: PureCC: Pure Learning for Text-to-Image Concept Customization

author.name: Zhichao Liao, Xiaole Xian, Qingyu Li, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Weicheng Xie, Siyang Song, Pingfa Feng, Long Zeng, Liang Pan

entry.summary: PureCC proposes decoupled learning for text-to-image concept customization that preserves the original model's capabilities while learning new personalized concepts through dual-branch training.

entry.title: 3DGS-HPC: Distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Hybrid Patch-wise Classification

author.name: Jiahao Chen, Yipeng Qin, Ganlong Zhao, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: 3DGS-HPC proposes hybrid patch-wise classification for distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting, avoiding semantic cue misalignment by combining local spatial frequency and temporal consistency signals.

entry.title: OrdinalBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Diagnosing Generalization Limits in Ordinal Number Understanding of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yusuke Tozaki, Hisashi Miyamori

entry.summary: OrdinalBench benchmarks VLMs on ordinal number understanding - tracking relative positions and generalizing to large indices (up to 300). Reveals systematic failures in ordinal reasoning across arrangement complexity levels.

entry.title: GazeShift: Unsupervised Gaze Estimation and Dataset for VR

author.name: Gil Shapira, Ishay Goldin, Evgeny Artyomov, Donghoon Kim, Yosi Keller, Niv Zehngut

entry.summary: Introduces VRGaze, a 2.1M image VR gaze estimation dataset, and GazeShift, an unsupervised attention-guided framework for learning gaze representations without labeled data. First large-scale off-axis gaze dataset for VR.

entry.title: Geometric Transformation-Embedded Mamba for Learned Video Compression

author.name: Hao Wei, Yanhui Zhou, Chenyang Ge

entry.summary: Introduces a video compression framework using cascaded Mamba modules with geometric transformations, avoiding explicit motion estimation. Uses direct transform strategy with Mamba for long-range spatial-temporal dependency modeling.

entry.title: Controllable Complex Human Motion Video Generation via Text-to-Skeleton Cascades

author.name: Ashkan Taghipour, Morteza Ghahremani, Zinuo Li, Hamid Laga, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun

entry.summary: Two-stage cascaded framework for complex human motion video generation: autoregressive text-to-skeleton generation followed by skeleton-conditioned video diffusion. Handles complex actions like flips and martial arts.

entry.title: DSH-Bench: A Difficulty- and Scenario-Aware Benchmark with Hierarchical Subject Taxonomy for Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Zhenyu Hu, Qing Wang, Te Cao, Luo Liao, Longfei Lu, Liqun Liu, Shuang Li, Hang Chen, Mengge Xue, Yuan Chen, Chao Deng, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: DSH-Bench provides a comprehensive benchmark for subject-driven T2I generation with hierarchical subject taxonomy, difficulty levels, and scenario-aware evaluation. Aims to provide actionable diagnostic insights.

entry.title: MM-TS: Multi-Modal Temperature and Margin Schedules for Contrastive Learning with Long-Tail Data

author.name: Siarhei Sheludzko, Dhimitrios Duka, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne, Anna Kukleva

entry.summary: MM-TS extends temperature scheduling from uni-modal to multi-modal contrastive learning, dynamically adjusting temperature and margins during training. Addresses long-tail data distribution challenges.

entry.title: DynamicVGGT: Learning Dynamic Point Maps for 4D Scene Reconstruction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhuolin He, Jing Li, Guanghao Li, Xiaolei Chen, Jiacheng Tang, Siyang Zhang, Zhounan Jin, Feipeng Cai, Bin Li, Jian Pu, Jia Cai, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: DynamicVGGT extends the VGGT model from static 3D to dynamic 4D scene reconstruction for autonomous driving by jointly predicting current and future point maps in a shared reference coordinate system. Tackles the challenge of modeling dynamic motion in feed-forward 3D models.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Anatomical Guidance for Text-to-CT Generation

author.name: Daniele Molino, Camillo Maria Caruso, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented approach for text-to-CT generation that retrieves semantically related clinical cases and uses their anatomical annotations as structural guidance during generation. Bridges semantic control with anatomical consistency.

entry.title: OccTrack360: 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking from Surround-View Fisheye Cameras

author.name: Yongzhi Lin, Kai Luo, Yuanfan Zheng, Hao Shi, Mengfei Duan, Yang Liu, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: OccTrack360 presents a new benchmark for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking from surround-view fisheye cameras with significantly longer sequences and voxel visibility annotations than prior benchmarks.

entry.title: SWIFT: Sliding Window Reconstruction for Few-Shot Training-Free Generated Video Attribution

author.name: Chao Wang, Zijin Yang, Yaofei Wang, Yuang Qi, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu, Kejiang Chen

entry.summary: SWIFT defines the 'few-shot training-free generated video attribution' task and proposes a sliding window reconstruction method to trace the origin of generated videos without requiring large training samples.

entry.title: CARE-Edit: Condition-Aware Routing of Experts for Contextual Image Editing

author.name: Yucheng Wang, Zedong Wang, Yuetong Wu, Yue Ma, Dan Xu

entry.summary: CARE-Edit proposes condition-aware routing of experts for contextual image editing, dynamically prioritizing or suppressing conflicting modalities instead of static concatenation, addressing task interference in unified diffusion editors.

entry.title: Talking Together: Synthesizing Co-Located 3D Conversations from Audio

author.name: Mengyi Shan, Shouchieh Chang, Ziqian Bai, Shichen Liu, Yinda Zhang, Luchuan Song, Rohit Pandey, Sean Fanello, Zeng Huang

entry.summary: Tackles generating complete 3D facial animations for two co-located conversational participants from mixed audio, modeling dynamic spatial relationships including relative position, orientation, and mutual gaze.

entry.title: SysNav: Multi-Level Systematic Cooperation Enables Real-World, Cross-Embodiment Object Navigation

author.name: Haokun Zhu, Zongtai Li, Zihan Liu, Kevin Guo, Zhengzhi Lin, Yuxin Cai, Guofei Chen, Chen Lv, Wenshan Wang, Jean Oh, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SysNav, a three-level object navigation system that decouples semantic reasoning, navigation planning, and motion control for real-world cross-embodiment deployment. Uses VLMs for semantic understanding at the high level.

entry.title: Is Your Safe Controller Actually Safe? A Critical Review of CBF Tautologies and Hidden Assumptions

author.name: Taekyung Kim

entry.summary: Provides a critical tutorial review of Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) in robotic safety, identifying the gap between theoretical assumptions of safe controller existence and constructive realization under input constraints. Highlights cases where CBF demonstrations are limited to passively safe systems.

entry.title: HSC-VLA: Hierarchical Scene-Clearing for Robust Bimanual Manipulation in Dense Clutter

author.name: Zhen Liu, Xinyu Ning, Zhe Hu, XinXin Xie, Yitong Liu, Zhongzhu Pu

entry.summary: Proposes HSC-VLA, a hierarchical framework for bimanual manipulation in dense clutter that decouples visual-semantic reasoning from sensorimotor execution through scene-clearing abstraction. High-level Brain generates task-specific scene masks to suppress distractors.

entry.title: ICLR: In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning

author.name: Toan Nguyen, Weiduo Yuan, Songlin Wei, Hui Li, Daniel Seita, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Presents ICLR (In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning), augmenting demonstration prompts with structured visual reasoning traces representing anticipated future robot trajectories in image space. Jointly learns reasoning traces and actions.

entry.title: Choose What to Observe: Task-Aware Semantic-Geometric Representations for Visuomotor Policy

author.name: Haoran Ding, Liang Ma, Yaxun Yang, Wen Yang, Tianyu Liu, Anqing Duan, Xiaodan Liang, Dezhen Song, Ivan Laptev, Yoshihiko Nakamura

entry.summary: Proposes a task-aware observation interface that canonicalizes RGB input by segmenting objects with SAM3 and repainting them with semantic colors, improving visuomotor policy robustness to appearance shifts without retraining. Demonstrates improved OOD generalization across multiple manipulation benchmarks.

entry.title: PhaForce: Phase-Scheduled Visual-Force Policy Learning with Slow Planning and Fast Correction for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Mingxin Wang, Zhirun Yue, Renhao Lu, Yizhe Li, Zihan Wang, Guoping Pan, Kangkang Dong, Jun Cheng, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PhaForce, a phase-scheduled visual-force policy for contact-rich manipulation that coordinates low-rate visual planning and high-rate force correction via contact/phase scheduling. Addresses the mismatch between inference latency and force feedback needs.

entry.title: Embedding Classical Balance Control Principles in Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Recovery

author.name: Nehar Poddar, Stephen McCrory, Luigi Penco, Geoffrey Clark, Hakki Erhan Svil, Robert Griffin

entry.summary: Presents a unified RL policy for humanoid recovery from falls by embedding classical balance metrics (capture point, CoM state, centroidal momentum) as privileged critic inputs and shaping rewards, enabling zero-shot hardware transfer.

entry.title: RAPID: Redundancy-Aware and Compatibility-Optimal Edge-Cloud Partitioned Inference for Diverse VLA models

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Sicheng Tian, Hangyu Cao, Chenyue Li, Jiayu Chen, Maoliang Li, Xinhao Sun, Hailong Zou, Guojie Luo, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RAPID, an edge-cloud collaborative inference framework for VLA models that addresses visual noise sensitivity and step-wise redundancy in embodied tasks for efficient partitioned inference.

entry.title: Prologue to Terrified Comments on Claude's Constitution

author.name: Zack_M_Davis

entry.summary: Critical commentary on Anthropic's Claude constitution, arguing that a 'serious' alignment approach would require deep mechanistic understanding rather than constitutional principles, while acknowledging the practical reality of current approaches.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Climate Adaptation: Reinforcement Learning for Climate Change-Resilient Transport

author.name: Miguel Costa, Arthur Vandervoort, Carolin Schmidt, Jo\~ao Miranda, Morten W. Petersen, Martin Drews, Karyn Morrisey, Francisco C. Pereira

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning framework for long-term climate adaptation planning in urban transport systems, formulated as an integrated assessment model combining flood modeling, transport simulation, and impact quantification.

entry.title: SecureRAG-RTL: A Retrieval-Augmented, Multi-Agent, Zero-Shot LLM-Driven Framework for Hardware Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Touseef Hasan, Blessing Airehenbuwa, Nitin Pundir, Souvika Sarkar, Ujjwal Guin

entry.summary: Proposes SecureRAG-RTL, a RAG-based multi-agent framework for zero-shot hardware vulnerability detection in HDL designs, addressing the scarcity of hardware security datasets for LLMs.

entry.title: Margin and Consistency Supervision for Calibrated and Robust Vision Models

author.name: Salim Khazem

entry.summary: Proposes Margin and Consistency Supervision (MaCS), an architecture-agnostic regularization framework combining margin penalty and consistency regularizer for improved calibration and robustness of vision classifiers.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM Alignment With Human Trust Models

author.name: Anushka Debnath, Stephen Cranefield, Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu, Emiliano Lorini

entry.summary: Performs white-box analysis of trust representation in GPT-J-6B using contrastive prompting, comparing learned trust concepts against five established human trust models.

entry.title: Who We Are, Where We Are: Mental Health at the Intersection of Person, Situation, and Large Language Models

author.name: Nikita Soni, August H{\aa}kan Nilsson, Syeda Mahwish, Vasudha Varadarajan, H. Andrew Schwartz, Ryan L. Boyd

entry.summary: Develops interpretable models integrating person-level psychological traits with situational features to predict mental health outcomes from longitudinal social media data. Uses the Situational 8 DIAMONDS framework and psychometrically-informed language models.

entry.title: TempoSyncDiff: Distilled Temporally-Consistent Diffusion for Low-Latency Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation

author.name: Soumya Mazumdar, Vineet Kumar Rakesh

entry.summary: Introduces TempoSyncDiff, a reference-conditioned latent diffusion framework using teacher-student distillation for efficient audio-driven talking head generation with fewer inference steps.

entry.title: A Hazard-Informed Data Pipeline for Robotics Physical Safety

author.name: Alexei Odinokov, Rostislav Yavorskiy

entry.summary: Presents a structured robotics physical safety framework that bridges classical risk engineering with ML pipelines, using hazard-driven synthetic data generation and digital twin simulation.

entry.title: Learning Where the Physics Is: Probabilistic Adaptive Sampling for Stiff PDEs

author.name: Akshay Govind Srinivasan, Balaji Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic adaptive sampling framework for Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machines (PIELMs) to solve stiff PDEs, using GMM-based kernel placement learned via weighted EM.

entry.title: Prosodic Boundary-Aware Streaming Generation for LLM-Based TTS with Streaming Text Input

author.name: Changsong Liu, Tianrui Wang, Ye Ni, Yizhou Peng, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Proposes prosodic-boundary-aware post-training for streaming TTS with streaming text input, using sliding-window prompts for bounded context and seamless concatenation in long-form speech.

entry.title: Distilling and Adapting: A Topology-Aware Framework for Zero-Shot Interaction Prediction in Multiplex Biological Networks

author.name: Alana Deng, Sugitha Janarthanan, Yan Sun, Zihao Jing, Pingzhao Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for zero-shot interaction prediction in multiplex biological networks using knowledge distillation from foundation models and topology-aware graph tokenization.

entry.title: Leakage Safe Graph Features for Interpretable Fraud Detection in Temporal Transaction Networks

author.name: Hamideh Khaleghpour, Brett McKinney

entry.summary: Develops a time-respecting, leakage-safe graph feature extraction protocol for fraud detection in temporal transaction networks, computing causal variants of structural features like PageRank and HITS scores.

entry.title: Regression Models Meet Foundation Models: A Hybrid-AI Approach to Practical Electricity Price Forecasting

author.name: Yunzhong Qiu, Binzhu Li, Hao Wei, Shenglin Weng, Chen Wang, Zhongyi Pei, Mingsheng Long, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FutureBoosting, a paradigm combining regression models with time series foundation models (TSFMs) for electricity price forecasting, using TSFM-generated features to enhance regression-based forecasts.

entry.title: Diversity-Aware Adaptive Collocation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Sparse QUBO Optimization and Hybrid Coresets

author.name: Hadi Salloum, Maximilian Mifsud Bonici, Sinan Ibrahim, Pavel Osinenko, Alexei Kornaev

entry.summary: Reinterprets PINN collocation point selection as a coreset construction problem, formulated as a QUBO optimization to select informative and diverse points, incorporating quantum/hybrid solver approaches.

entry.title: Optimistic Policy Regularization

author.name: Mai Pham, Vikrant Vaze, Peter Chin

entry.summary: Introduces Optimistic Policy Regularization (OPR), which maintains a buffer of high-performing episodes and biases learning toward them through reward shaping and behavioral cloning to prevent premature entropy collapse in deep RL.

entry.title: Combinatorial Allocation Bandits with Nonlinear Arm Utility

author.name: Yuki Shibukawa, Koichi Tanaka, Yuta Saito, Shinji Ito

entry.summary: Proposes Combinatorial Allocation Bandits (CAB), a new online learning problem for matching platforms that incorporates arm satisfaction to prevent match concentration on popular participants.

entry.title: Learning to Reflect: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for CSI-Free mmWave Beam-Focusing

author.name: Hieu Le, Oguz Bedir, Mostafa Ibrahim, Jian Tao, Sabit Ekin

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent RL framework for controlling reconfigurable intelligent surfaces in mmWave systems without channel state information, using only user localization data.

entry.title: Slumbering to Precision: Enhancing Artificial Neural Network Calibration Through Sleep-like Processes

author.name: Jean Erik Delanois, Aditya Ahuja, Giri P. Krishnan, Maxim Bazhenov

entry.summary: Introduces Sleep Replay Consolidation (SRC), a bio-inspired post-training calibration method that mimics biological sleep by selectively replaying internal representations to improve neural network calibration without supervised retraining.

entry.title: Wiener Chaos Expansion based Neural Operator for Singular Stochastic Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Dai Shi, Luke Thompson, Andi Han, Peiyan Hu, Junbin Gao, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

entry.summary: Applies Wiener Chaos Expansion neural operators to singular stochastic PDEs (dynamic Φ⁴₂ model) using feature-wise linear modulation to capture dependencies between solutions and smooth remainders.

entry.title: SCL-GNN: Towards Generalizable Graph Neural Networks via Spurious Correlation Learning

author.name: Yuxiang Zhang, Enyan Dai

entry.summary: Proposes SCL-GNN to improve GNN generalization by explicitly learning and mitigating spurious correlations using the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, targeting both IID and OOD generalization.

entry.title: Beyond the Markovian Assumption: Robust Optimization via Fractional Weyl Integrals in Imbalanced Data

author.name: Gustavo A. Dorrego

entry.summary: Introduces a novel optimization algorithm based on fractional calculus that replaces instantaneous gradients with dynamically weighted historical gradient sequences, acting as a natural regularizer for imbalanced data.

entry.title: Geometrically Constrained Outlier Synthesis

author.name: Daniil Karzanov, Marcin Detyniecki

entry.summary: Introduces GCOS, a training-time regularization that generates virtual outliers in hidden feature space respecting the manifold structure of in-distribution data, using conformal-inspired shells and dominant-variance subspaces.

entry.title: MUSA-PINN: Multi-scale Weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fluid Flow in Complex Geometries

author.name: Weizheng Zhang, Xunjie Xie, Hao Pan, Xiaowei Duan, Bingteng Sun, Qiang Du, Lin lu

entry.summary: Proposes MUSA-PINN, a multi-scale weak-form physics-informed neural network that reformulates PDE constraints as integral conservation laws over hierarchical spherical control volumes for complex geometries like TPMS structures.

entry.title: NN-OpInf: an operator inference approach using structure-preserving composable neural networks

author.name: Eric Parish, Anthony Gruber, Patrick Blonigan, Irina Tezaur

entry.summary: Proposes NN-OpInf, a neural network-based operator inference framework for non-intrusive reduced-order modeling that preserves local operator structure (skew-symmetry, positive definiteness) while supporting composable heterogeneous operators.

entry.title: Divide and Predict: An Architecture for Input Space Partitioning and Enhanced Accuracy

author.name: Fenix W. Huang, Henning S. Mortveit, Christian M. Reidys

entry.summary: Develops an intrinsic measure for training data heterogeneity based on pairwise influence variance, proving it's maximal for equal distribution mixtures, and demonstrates variance-based data partitioning improves prediction accuracy.

entry.title: Isotonic Layer: A Universal Framework for Generic Recommendation Debiasing

author.name: Hailing Cheng, Yafang Yang, Hemeng Tao, Fengyu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces the Isotonic Layer, a differentiable piecewise linear module that enforces monotonic constraints within neural architectures for recommendation system debiasing. Uses learnable embeddings to adaptively capture context-specific distortions.

entry.title: GraphSkill: Documentation-Guided Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Coding for Complex Graph Reasoning

author.name: Fali Wang, Chenglin Weng, Xianren Zhang, Siyuan Hong, Hui Liu, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GraphSkill, a hierarchical retrieval-augmented coding system for graph reasoning that exploits the hierarchical structure of technical documentation and addresses logical errors beyond runtime errors in LLM code generation.

entry.title: CN-CBF: Composite Neural Control Barrier Function for Safe Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Bojan Deraji\'c, Sebastian Bernhard, Wolfgang H\"onig

entry.summary: Proposes composite neural control barrier functions for safe robot navigation in dynamic environments, combining multiple neural CBFs trained via Hamilton-Jacobi reachability with residual dynamics learning.

entry.title: Statistical Contraction for Chance-Constrained Trajectory Optimization of Non-Gaussian Stochastic Systems

author.name: Rihan Aaron D'Silva, Hiroyasu Tsukamoto

entry.summary: Develops distribution-free robust trajectory optimization for nonlinear non-Gaussian stochastic systems using conformal inference for coverage-based confidence sets with closed-loop chance constraint satisfaction guarantees.

entry.title: Dial: A Knowledge-Grounded Dialect-Specific NL2SQL System

author.name: Xiang Zhang, Hongming Xu, Le Zhou, Wei Zhou, Xuanhe Zhou, Guoliang Li, Yuyu Luo, Changdong Liu, Guorun Chen, Jiang Liao, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Presents Dial, a knowledge-grounded framework for dialect-specific NL2SQL that handles heterogeneous database SQL dialects through dialect-aware logical query planning, separating intent reasoning from dialect syntax.

entry.title: Towards Lightweight Adaptation of Speech Enhancement Models in Real-World Environments

author.name: Longbiao Cheng, Shih-Chii Liu

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight adaptation of speech enhancement models using low-rank adapters updated via self-supervised training, updating fewer than 1% of parameters while adapting to 111 environments across 37 noise types.

entry.title: A Systematic Comparison of Training Objectives for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Image Classification

author.name: Furkan Gen\c{c}, Onat \"Ozdemir, Emre Akba\c{s}

entry.summary: Systematically compares four training objectives (Cross-Entropy, Prototype, Triplet, AP Loss) for out-of-distribution detection in image classification using standardized OpenOOD protocols across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-200.

entry.title: Lindbladian Learning with Neural Differential Equations

author.name: Timothy Heightman, Roman Aseguinolaza Gallo, Edward Jiang, JRM Saavedra, Antonio Ac\'in, Marcin P{\l}odzie\'n

entry.summary: Tackles Lindbladian learning for open quantum systems using neural differential equations with maximum-likelihood estimation on transient Pauli measurements, exploiting richer information from transient dynamics.

entry.title: VLM-SubtleBench: How Far Are VLMs from Human-Level Subtle Comparative Reasoning?

author.name: Minkyu Kim, Sangheon Lee, Dongmin Park

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-SubtleBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on subtle comparative reasoning across ten difference types, addressing the gap between benchmarks with salient differences and real-world subtle distinctions.

entry.title: Beyond ReinMax: Low-Variance Gradient Estimators for Discrete Latent Variables

author.name: Daniel Wang, Thang D. Bui

entry.summary: Introduces ReinMax-Rao and ReinMax-CV estimators that reduce variance in discrete latent variable gradient estimation by incorporating Rao-Blackwellisation and control variates into the ReinMax framework.

entry.title: Integrating Lagrangian Neural Networks into the Dyna Framework for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shreya Das, Kundan Kumar, Muhammad Iqbal, Outi Savolainen, Dominik Baumann, Laura Ruotsalainen, Simo S\"arkk\"a

entry.summary: Integrates Lagrangian Neural Networks into the Dyna MBRL framework, using physics-structured dynamics models that respect Lagrangian mechanics for more accurate model-based RL.

entry.title: STRIDE: Structured Lagrangian and Stochastic Residual Dynamics via Flow Matching

author.name: Prakrut Kotecha, Ganga Nair B, Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE, a dynamics learning framework separating conservative rigid-body mechanics from stochastic residual dynamics using flow matching, for robust robot dynamics prediction.

entry.title: The Neural Compass: Probabilistic Relative Feature Fields for Robotic Search

author.name: Gabriele Somaschini, Adrian R\"ofer, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes ProReFF for robotic search using learned probabilistic relative feature fields that predict spatial distributions of object features from unlabeled observations, enabling co-occurrence-based object finding.
