entry.title: Momentum SVGD-EM for Accelerated Maximum Marginal Likelihood Estimation

author.name: Adam Rozzio, Rafael Athanasiades, O. Deniz Akyildiz

entry.summary: Proposes Momentum SVGD-EM, which adds Nesterov acceleration to both parameter updates and probability measure updates in a Stein variational gradient descent framework for maximum marginal likelihood estimation. Demonstrates consistent convergence acceleration.

entry.title: MedInjection-FR: Exploring the Role of Native, Synthetic, and Translated Data in Biomedical Instruction Tuning

author.name: Ikram Belmadani, Oumaima El Khettari, Pac\^ome Constant dit Beaufils, Benoit Favre, Richard Dufour

entry.summary: Introduces MedInjection-FR, a large-scale French biomedical instruction dataset (571K pairs) from native, synthetic, and translated sources. Systematically assesses how data provenance affects instruction tuning for medical French NLP.

entry.title: Emotion Transcription in Conversation: A Benchmark for Capturing Subtle and Complex Emotional States through Natural Language

author.name: Yoshiki Tanaka, Ryuichi Uehara, Koji Inoue, Michimasa Inaba

entry.summary: Proposes Emotion Transcription in Conversation (ETC), a new task generating natural language descriptions of speakers' emotional states rather than categorical labels. Constructs a Japanese dataset with self-reported emotional states.

entry.title: MAWARITH: A Dataset and Benchmark for Legal Inheritance Reasoning with LLMs

author.name: Abdessalam Bouchekif, Shahd Gaben, Samer Rashwani, Somaya Eltanbouly, Mutaz Al-Khatib, Heba Sbahi, Mohammed Ghaly, Emad Mohamed

entry.summary: Introduces MAWARITH, a 12,500-case dataset for Islamic inheritance law reasoning with full reasoning chains including heir identification, blocking rules, and exact share computation. Supports step-by-step evaluation of LLM legal reasoning.

entry.title: StyleBench: Evaluating Speech Language Models on Conversational Speaking Style Control

author.name: Haishu Zhao, Aokai Hao, Yuan Ge, Zhenqiang Hong, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes StyleBench, a multi-turn dialogue benchmark for evaluating speech language models' ability to control speaking style intensity across emotion, speed, volume, and pitch dimensions.

entry.title: Gradually Excavating External Knowledge for Implicit Complex Question Answering

author.name: Chang Liu, Xiaoguang Li, Lifeng Shang, Xin Jiang, Qun Liu, Edmund Y. Lam, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes a gradual knowledge excavation framework for open-domain complex QA where LLMs iteratively acquire external information and reason based on accumulated historical knowledge through action selection.

entry.title: LAMUS: A Large-Scale Corpus for Legal Argument Mining from U.S. Caselaw using LLMs

author.name: Serene Wang, Lavanya Pobbathi, Haihua Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LAMUS, a sentence-level legal argument mining corpus from U.S. Supreme Court and Texas criminal cases, created using LLM-based annotation with human quality refinement. Evaluates multiple models on six-class classification.

entry.title: Learning Multiple Utterance-Level Attribute Representations with a Unified Speech Encoder

author.name: Maryem Bouziane, Salima Mdhaffar, Yannick Est\`eve

entry.summary: Proposes a unified post-training approach for speech foundation models that learns multiple utterance-level attribute representations simultaneously, extending beyond just semantic alignment.

entry.title: The Third Ambition: Artificial Intelligence and the Science of Human Behavior

author.name: W. Russell Neuman, Chad Coleman

entry.summary: Articulates a 'third ambition' for AI beyond productivity and alignment: using LLMs as scientific instruments for studying human behavior, culture, and moral reasoning. Argues LLMs encode large-scale regularities in human symbolic production.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Audiovisual Speech Recognition in Zero-AV-Resource Scenarios with Synthetic Visual Data

author.name: Pol Buitrago, Pol G\`alvez, Oriol Pareras, Javier Hernando

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-AV-resource AVSR framework using synthetic visual streams from lip-syncing static images with real audio. Achieves near state-of-the-art on Catalan, a language with no annotated AV corpora, using 700+ hours of synthesized data.

entry.title: Accelerating Video Generation Inference with Sequential-Parallel 3D Positional Encoding Using a Global Time Index

author.name: Chao Yuan, Pan Li

entry.summary: Implements system-level inference optimizations for causal autoregressive video generation, adapting Self-Forcing to sequence parallel inference with Causal-RoPE SP. Reduces memory consumption and first-frame latency for long videos.

entry.title: SIQA: Toward Reliable Scientific Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Wenzhe Li, Liang Chen, Junying Wang, Yijing Guo, Ye Shen, Farong Wen, Chunyi Li, Zicheng Zhang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces SIQA, a framework for scientific image quality assessment that evaluates not just perceptual fidelity but scientific correctness and logical completeness. Addresses the gap that visually plausible figures may contain conceptual errors.

entry.title: HERO: Hierarchical Embedding-Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos

author.name: Tingting Han, Xinsong Tao, Yufei Yin, Min Tan, Sicheng Zhao, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Introduces HERO for open-vocabulary temporal sentence grounding in videos. Creates the first OV-TSGV benchmarks (Charades-OV, ActivityNet-OV) and proposes hierarchical embedding refinement for generalizing beyond seen training concepts.

entry.title: HIERAMP: Coarse-to-Fine Autoregressive Amplification for Generative Dataset Distillation

author.name: Lin Zhao, Xinru Jiang, Xi Xiao, Qihui Fan, Lei Lu, Yanzhi Wang, Xue Lin, Octavia Camps, Pu Zhao, Jianyang Gu

entry.summary: Proposes HIERAMP for dataset distillation using vision autoregressive models, amplifying hierarchical semantics at different scales. Injects class tokens at each VAR scale to identify salient regions relevant to recognition.

entry.title: Fine-Grained 3D Facial Reconstruction for Micro-Expressions

author.name: Che Sun, Xinjie Zhang, Rui Gao, Xu Chen, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia

entry.summary: First work on 3D facial reconstruction for micro-expressions, proposing methods to capture subtle, transient facial movements by integrating global dynamic features with locally-enriched multi-cue features.

entry.title: Physics-Guided VLM Priors for All-Cloud Removal

author.name: Liying Xu, Huifang Li, Huanfeng Shen

entry.summary: PhyVLM-CR integrates VLM semantic capabilities with physical restoration models for unified cloud removal in remote sensing, transforming VLM cognitive priors into physical scattering parameters.

entry.title: ACD-U: Asymmetric co-teaching with machine unlearning for robust learning with noisy labels

author.name: Reo Fukunaga, Soh Yoshida, Mitsuji Muneyasu

entry.summary: ACD-U proposes asymmetric co-teaching with machine unlearning for robust learning with noisy labels, using different model architectures (CLIP ViT + ResNet) to correct selection errors that standard co-teaching cannot.

entry.title: Class Visualizations and Activation Atlases for Enhancing Interpretability in Deep Learning-Based Computational Pathology

author.name: Marco Gustav, Fabian Wolf, Christina Glasner, Nic G. Reitsam, Stefan Schulz, Kira Aschenbroich, Bruno M\"arkl, Sebastian Foersch, Jakob Nikolas Kather

entry.summary: Evaluates class visualizations and activation atlases for transformer-based computational pathology models, with pathologist annotations to quantify interpretability. Found these feature visualization methods have limitations for tissue classification.

entry.title: PresentBench: A Fine-Grained Rubric-Based Benchmark for Slide Generation

author.name: Xin-Sheng Chen, Jiayu Zhu, Pei-lin Li, Hanzheng Wang, Shuojin Yang, Meng-Hao Guo

entry.summary: PresentBench introduces a fine-grained rubric-based benchmark for evaluating automated slide generation, with verifiable evaluation criteria beyond coarse holistic judgments.

entry.title: FedEU: Evidential Uncertainty-Driven Federated Fine-Tuning of Vision Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation

author.name: Xiaokang Zhang, Xuran Xiong, Jianzhong Huang, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: FedEU applies evidential uncertainty-driven federated fine-tuning for vision foundation models in remote sensing segmentation, using uncertainty estimation to improve reliability of collaborative optimization across heterogeneous clients.

entry.title: RobustSCI: Beyond Reconstruction to Restoration for Snapshot Compressive Imaging under Real-World Degradations

author.name: Hao Wang, Yuanfan Li, Qi Zhou, Zhankuo Xu, Jiong Ni, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: RobustSCI pioneers robust video snapshot compressive imaging restoration, shifting from reconstruction to restoration when captured signals are degraded by motion blur and low light.

entry.title: SketchGraphNet: A Memory-Efficient Hybrid Graph Transformer for Large-Scale Sketch Corpora Recognition

author.name: Shilong Chen, Mingyuan Li, Zhaoyang Wang, Zhonglin Ye, Haixing Zhao

entry.summary: SketchGraphNet proposes a hybrid graph neural architecture for large-scale sketch recognition from graph-structured data, with a 3.44M sketch benchmark across 344 categories.

entry.title: Duala: Dual-Level Alignment of Subjects and Stimuli for Cross-Subject fMRI Decoding

author.name: Shumeng Li, Jintao Guo, Jian Zhang, Yulin Zhou, Luyang Cao, Yinghuan Shi

entry.title: DECADE: A Temporally-Consistent Unsupervised Diffusion Model for Enhanced Rb-82 Dynamic Cardiac PET Image Denoising

author.name: Yinchi Zhou, Liang Guo, Huidong Xie, Yuexi Du, Ashley Wang, Menghua Xia, Tian Yu, Ramesh Fazzone-Chettiar, Christopher Weyman, Bruce Spottiswoode, Vladimir Panin, Kuangyu Shi, Edward J. Miller, Attila Feher, Albert J. Sinusas, Nicha C. Dvornek, Chi Liu

entry.title: SGI: Structured 2D Gaussians for Efficient and Compact Large Image Representation

author.name: Zixuan Pan, Kaiyuan Tang, Jun Xia, Yifan Qin, Lin Gu, Chaoli Wang, Jianxu Chen, Yiyu Shi

entry.summary: SGI proposes Structured Gaussian Image representation that decomposes images into multi-scale local spaces with seed-based structured neural Gaussians. Achieves compact and efficient high-resolution image representation with 2D Gaussian Splatting.

entry.title: Fast Low-light Enhancement and Deblurring for 3D Dark Scenes

author.name: Feng Zhang, Jinglong Wang, Ze Li, Yanghong Zhou, Yang Chen, Lei Chen, Xiatian Zhu

entry.title: SAVE: Speech-Aware Video Representation Learning for Video-Text Retrieval

author.name: Ruixiang Zhao, Zhihao Xu, Bangxiang Lan, Zijie Xin, Jingyu Liu, Xirong Li

entry.summary: SAVE improves video-text retrieval by incorporating speech content through a dedicated speech branch and soft-ALBEF fusion. Addresses the common neglect of audio tracks in CLIP-based video retrieval.

entry.title: SiMO: Single-Modality-Operable Multimodal Collaborative Perception

author.name: Jiageng Wen, Shengjie Zhao, Bing Li, Jiafeng Huang, Kenan Ye, Hao Deng

entry.summary: SiMO introduces Single-Modality-Operable Multimodal Collaborative Perception, addressing the problem of sensor failures in multi-agent collaborative perception. Uses Length-Adaptive Multi-Modal Fusion (LAMMA) to handle missing modalities gracefully.

entry.title: HDR-NSFF: High Dynamic Range Neural Scene Flow Fields

author.name: Shin Dong-Yeon, Kim Jun-Seong, Kwon Byung-Ki, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.title: All Vehicles Can Lie: Efficient Adversarial Defense in Fully Untrusted-Vehicle Collaborative Perception via Pseudo-Random Bayesian Inference

entry.title: SecAgent: Efficient Mobile GUI Agent with Semantic Context

author.name: Yiping Xie, Song Chen, Jingxuan Xing, Wei Jiang, Zekun Zhu, Yingyao Wang, Pi Bu, Jun Song, Yuning Jiang, Bo Zheng

entry.title: RoboPCA: Pose-centered Affordance Learning from Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Zhanqi Xiao, Ruiping Wang, Xilin Chen

entry.title: AffordGrasp: Cross-Modal Diffusion for Affordance-Aware Grasp Synthesis

author.name: Xiaofei Wu, Yi Zhang, Yumeng Liu, Yuexin Ma, Yujiao Shi, Xuming He

entry.title: UniGround: Universal 3D Visual Grounding via Training-Free Scene Parsing

author.name: Jiaxi Zhang, Yunheng Wang, Wei Lu, Taowen Wang, Weisheng Xu, Shuning Zhang, Yixiao Feng, Yuetong Fang, Renjing Xu

entry.title: Stability-Guided Exploration for Diverse Motion Generation

author.name: Eckart Cobo-Briesewitz, Tilman Burghoff, Denis Shcherba, Armand Jordana, Marc Toussaint

entry.title: VSL-Skin: Individually Addressable Phase-Change Voxel Skin for Variable-Stiffness and Virtual Joints Bridging Soft and Rigid Robots

entry.title: SSP: Safety-guaranteed Surgical Policy via Joint Optimization of Behavioral and Spatial Constraints

author.name: Jianshu Hu, ZhiYuan Guan, Lei Song, Kantaphat Leelakunwet, Hesheng Wang, Wei Xiao, Qi Dou, Yutong Ban

entry.title: DexKnot: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning for Dexterous Bag-Knotting Manipulation

author.name: Jiayuan Zhang, Ruihai Wu, Haojun Chen, Yuran Wang, Yifan Zhong, Ceyao Zhang, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen

entry.title: InterReal: A Unified Physics-Based Imitation Framework for Learning Human-Object Interaction Skills

author.name: Dayang Liang, Yuhang Lin, Xinzhe Liu, Jiyuan Shi, Yunlong Liu, Chenjia Bai

entry.title: MoMaStage: Skill-State Graph Guided Planning and Closed-Loop Execution for Long-Horizon Indoor Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Chenxu Li, Zixuan Chen, Yetao Li, Jiapeng Xu, Hongyu Ding, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.title: FoMo: A Multi-Season Dataset for Robot Navigation in For\^et Montmorency

author.name: Mat\v{e}j Boxan, Gabriel Jeanson, Alexander Krawciw, Effie Daum, Xinyuan Qiao, Sven Lilge, Timothy D. Barfoot, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau

entry.title: R2F: Repurposing Ray Frontiers for LLM-free Object Navigation

author.name: Francesco Argenziano, John Mark Alexis Marcelo, Michele Brienza, Abdel Hakim Drid, Emanuele Musumeci, Daniele Nardi, Domenico D. Bloisi, Vincenzo Suriani

entry.title: CRED: Counterfactual Reasoning and Environment Design for Active Preference Learning

author.name: Yi-Shiuan Tung, Gyanig Kumar, Wei Jiang, Bradley Hayes, Alessandro Roncone

entry.title: Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Codex #5

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive summary of agentic coding developments including Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Codex, plus GPT-5.4 reactions. Covers the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-powered coding tools and their implications.

entry.title: Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum

Identifies conditions under which DAG-based scheduling converges to stable equilibria.

entry.title: Sensitivity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Intent Clarification

author.name: Maik Larooij

entry.summary: Addresses sensitivity-aware retrieval-augmented intent clarification for conversational search, particularly in domains with sensitive information like healthcare and legal contexts.

entry.title: A Causal Graph Approach to Oppositional Narrative Analysis

author.name: Diego Revilla, Martin Fernandez-de-Retana, Lingfeng Chen, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana

author.name: Zhengguo Li, Chaobing Zheng, Wei Wang

entry.title: Graph Property Inference in Small Language Models: Effects of Representation and Inference Strategy

author.name: Michal Podstawski

author.name: Chia-Fu Lin, Yi-Ju Tseng

author.name: Kevin Dradjat, Massinissa Hamidi, Blaise Hanczar

author.name: Yunhui Liu, Qizhuo Xie, Yinfeng Chen, Xudong Jin, Tao Zheng, Bin Chong, Tieke He

author.name: Jes\'us S\'anchez Ochoa, Enrique Tom\'as Mart\'inez Beltr\'an, Alberto Huertas Celdr\'an

author.name: Zhehao Yu, Baoquan Zhang, Bingqi Shan, Xinhao Liu, Dongliang Zhou, Guotao Liang, Guangming Ye, Yunming Ye

entry.title: FreeFly-Thinking : Aligning Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Continuous UAV Navigation

author.name: Jiaxu Zhou, Shaobo Wang, Zhiyuan Yang, Zhenjun Yu, Tao Li

entry.summary: FreeFly-Thinking introduces a VLN framework for UAV navigation in outdoor urban settings with chain-of-thought reasoning, converting egocentric images and language instructions into action sequences.

entry.title: LEPA: Learning Geometric Equivariance in Satellite Remote Sensing Data with a Predictive Architecture

author.name: Erik Scheurer, Rocco Sedona, Stefan Kesselheim, Gabriele Cavallaro

entry.summary: LEPA proposes a learned equivariance-predicting architecture for handling geometric mismatches between user-defined areas of interest and fixed precomputed embedding grids in geospatial foundation models.

entry.title: QdaVPR: A novel query-based domain-agnostic model for visual place recognition

author.name: Shanshan Wan, Lai Kang, Yingmei Wei, Tianrui Shen, Haixuan Wang, Chao Zuo

entry.summary: QdaVPR proposes a query-based domain-agnostic visual place recognition model using dual-level adversarial learning for explicit domain supervision, generalizing to unseen domain shifts.

entry.title: Scale-Aware UAV-to-Satellite Cross-View Geo-Localization: A Semantic Geometric Approach

author.name: Yibin Ye, Shuo Chen, Kun Wang, Xiaokai Song, Jisheng Dang, Qifeng Yu, Xichao Teng, Zhang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization that recovers absolute metric scale from monocular UAV images using small vehicles as semantic anchors.

entry.title: Active Inference for Micro-Gesture Recognition: EFE-Guided Temporal Sampling and Adaptive Learning

author.name: Weijia Feng, Jingyu Yang, Ruojia Zhang, Fengtao Sun, Qian Gao, Chenyang Wang, Tongtong Su, Jia Guo, Xiaobai Li, Minglai Shao

entry.summary: Applies active inference with Expected Free Energy-guided temporal sampling for micro-gesture recognition, actively selecting discriminative temporal segments under uncertainty.

entry.title: Efficient RGB-D Scene Understanding via Multi-task Adaptive Learning and Cross-dimensional Feature Guidance

author.name: Guodong Sun, Junjie Liu, Gaoyang Zhang, Bo Wu, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient RGB-D scene understanding model performing semantic/instance/panoptic segmentation, orientation estimation, and classification with adaptive attention and cross-dimensional feature guidance.

entry.title: EmbedTalk: Triplane-Free Talking Head Synthesis using Embedding-Driven Gaussian Deformation

author.name: Arpita Saggar, Jonathan C. Darling, Duygu Sarikaya, David C. Hogg

entry.summary: EmbedTalk replaces tri-plane representations with learnt embeddings for 3D Gaussian Splatting-based talking head synthesis. Shows that direct embeddings can outperform tri-plane encoding for modeling speech-driven facial deformations.

entry.title: Learning Context-Adaptive Motion Priors for Masked Motion Diffusion Models with Efficient Kinematic Attention Aggregation

author.name: Junkun Jiang, Jie Chen, Ho Yin Au, Jingyu Xiang

entry.summary: Introduces Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM) for reconstructing incomplete motion capture data using a diffusion-based framework with Kinematic Attention Aggregation. Handles occlusions and noisy data from both vision-based and wearable motion capture.

entry.title: Training-free Temporal Object Tracking in Surgical Videos

author.name: Subhadeep Koley, Abdolrahim Kadkhodamohammadi, Santiago Barbarisi, Danail Stoyanov, Imanol Luengo

entry.summary: Leverages pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model features for training-free object tracking in laparoscopic surgical videos. Uses cross-frame affinity matrices for temporal continuity without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Structure and Progress Aware Diffusion for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Siyuan Song, Guyue Hu, Chenglong Li, Dengdi Sun, Zhe Jin, Jin Tang

entry.summary: SPAD proposes structure and progress-aware diffusion for medical image segmentation that separates learning of coarse structures from fine boundaries. Uses curriculum-style progressive training to handle boundary ambiguity.

entry.title: RLPR: Radar-to-LiDAR Place Recognition via Two-Stage Asymmetric Cross-Modal Alignment for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhangshuo Qi, Jingyi Xu, Luqi Cheng, Shichen Wen, Guangming Xiong

entry.summary: RLPR addresses radar-to-LiDAR place recognition for autonomous driving, enabling localization of radar scans within existing LiDAR maps. Handles cross-modal alignment challenges and scarcity of paired training data.

entry.title: It's Time to Get It Right: Improving Analog Clock Reading and Clock-Hand Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jaeha Choi, Jin Won Lee, Siwoo You, Jangho Lee

entry.summary: Reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with analog clock reading in real-world environments despite success on complex reasoning tasks. Introduces real-world clock dataset exposing spatial-temporal reasoning failures.

entry.title: Adaptive MLP Pruning for Large Vision Transformers

author.name: Chengchao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive MLP Pruning for large Vision Transformers using Taylor-based importance evaluation with knowledge distillation loss. Targets MLP modules as the largest parameter component.

entry.title: VesselFusion: Diffusion Models for Vessel Centerline Extraction from 3D CT Images

author.name: Soichi Mita, Shumpei Takezaki, Ryoma Bise

entry.summary: VesselFusion uses diffusion models for vessel centerline extraction from 3D CT images with coarse-to-fine representation and voting-based aggregation. Achieves more natural vessel structures than deterministic approaches.

entry.title: Novel Semantic Prompting for Zero-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Salman Iqbal, Waheed Rehman

entry.summary: SP-CLIP introduces structured semantic prompts at multiple abstraction levels (intent, motion, object interaction) for zero-shot action recognition without modifying the visual encoder. Demonstrates that enriched semantic prompting alone can significantly improve performance.

entry.title: Real-Time Drone Detection in Event Cameras via Per-Pixel Frequency Analysis

author.name: Michael Bezick, Majid Sahin

entry.summary: DDHF uses Non-uniform Discrete Fourier Transform for per-pixel frequency analysis of event camera data to detect drones via their rotor frequency signatures. Purely analytical approach without neural networks.

entry.title: Information Maximization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Domain Generalization

author.name: Leo Fillioux, Omprakash Chakraborty, Quentin Gop\'ee, Pierre Marza, Paul-Henry Courn\`ede, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz

entry.summary: IMaX applies the InfoMax principle to semi-supervised domain generalization under long-tailed class distributions, maximizing mutual information between learned features and latent labels to handle class imbalance.

entry.title: Improving Continual Learning for Gaussian Splatting based Environments Reconstruction on Commercial Off-the-Shelf Edge Devices

author.name: Ivan Zaino, Matteo Risso, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Miguel de Prado, Toon Van de Maele, Alessio Burrello

entry.summary: Presents a precision-adaptive optimization framework for running Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting on edge devices, enabling continual 3D scene learning on resource-constrained hardware through mixed-precision and kernel fusion.

entry.title: BioGait-VLM: A Tri-Modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics Framework for Interpretable Clinical Gait Assessment

author.name: Erdong Chen, Yuyang Ji, Jacob K. Greenberg, Benjamin Steel, Faraz Arkam, Abigail Lewis, Pranay Singh, Feng Liu

entry.summary: BioGait-VLM proposes a tri-modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics framework for clinical gait assessment, incorporating temporal evidence distillation and biomechanical tokenization to reason about joint mechanics independent of visual shortcuts.

entry.title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval

author.name: Yanqing Liu, Yingcheng Liu, Fanghong Dong, Budianto Budianto, Cihang Xie, Yan Jiao

entry.summary: CAST formalizes Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) and proposes a plug-and-play adapter that predicts state-conditioned residual updates from visual history for coherent storyline composition from short clips.

entry.title: ProFocus: Proactive Perception and Focused Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Wei Xue, Mingcheng Li, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: ProFocus is a training-free VLN framework combining proactive perception via ego-centric semantic maps with focused reasoning through LLM-VLM collaboration for navigation decision-making.

entry.title: StructBiHOI: Structured Articulation Modeling for Long--Horizon Bimanual Hand--Object Interaction Generation

author.name: Zhi Wang, Liu Liu, Ruonan Liu, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: StructBiHOI proposes structured articulation modeling for long-horizon bimanual hand-object interaction generation, disentangling temporal joint planning from frame-level manipulation refinement.

entry.title: HybridMimic: Hybrid RL-Centroidal Control for Humanoid Motion Mimicking

author.name: Ludwig Chee-Ying Tay, I-Chia Chang, Yan Gu

entry.summary: Introduces HybridMimic, a framework combining reinforcement learning with centroidal model-based control for humanoid motion mimicking. The learned policy dynamically modulates centroidal control without requiring predefined contact timing, improving versatility over existing hybrid approaches.

entry.title: SurgSync: Time-Synchronized Multi-Modal Data Collection Framework and Dataset for Surgical Robotics

author.name: Haoying Zhou, Chang Liu, Yimeng Wu, Junlin Wu, Zijian Wu, Yu Chung Lee, Sara Martuscelli, Spetimiu E. Salcudean, Gregory S. Fischer, Peter Kazanzides

entry.summary: Presents SurgSync, a multi-modal data collection framework with offline and online synchronization for surgical robotics, implemented on the da Vinci Research Kit with modern stereo endoscope and comprehensive data recording.

entry.title: TacDexGrasp: Compliant and Robust Dexterous Grasping with Tactile Feedback

author.name: Yubin Ke, Jiayi Chen, Hang Lv, Xiao Zhou, He Wang

entry.summary: Addresses compliant dexterous grasping with tactile feedback using SOCP-based control without explicit torque modeling or slip detection. Key insight: rotational slip induces detectable translational slip at contact points.

entry.title: RoTri-Diff: A Spatial Robot-Object Triadic Interaction-Guided Diffusion Model for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Nga Teng Chan, Yiwen Hou, Chenrui Tie, Zixuan Liu, Haonan Chen, Junting Chen, Jieqi Shi, Yang Gao, Jing Huo, Lin Shao

entry.summary: Proposes RoTri-Diff, a diffusion model for bimanual manipulation that explicitly models the triadic spatial relationship (Robot-Object Triadic Interaction) between two arms and the manipulated object using relative 6D poses.

entry.title: Approximate Imitation Learning for Event-based Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Nico Messikommer, Jiaxu Xing, Leonard Bauersfeld, Marco Cannici, Elie Aljalbout, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Enables quadrotor flight through cluttered environments using only a single event camera, with an end-to-end neural network mapping event data to control commands. From Davide Scaramuzza's group at UZH.

entry.title: Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on Stairs via Unsafe Stepping Penalty and Sparse LiDAR Elevation Mapping

author.name: Yuzhi Jiang, Yujun Liang, Junhao Li, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a single-stage training framework for omnidirectional humanoid stair locomotion using a dense unsafe stepping penalty and sparse LiDAR elevation mapping for 360° terrain perception. Addresses blind zones from forward-facing cameras.

entry.title: DeReCo: Decoupling Representation and Coordination Learning for Object-Adaptive Decentralized Multi-Robot Cooperative Transport

author.name: Kazuki Shibata, Ryosuke Sota, Shandil Dhiresh Bosch, Yuki Kadokawa, Tsurumine Yoshihisa, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: Introduces DeReCo, which decouples representation learning from coordination learning for decentralized multi-robot cooperative transport across diverse objects. Addresses bidirectional interference between representation and policy learning in MARL.

entry.title: LAR-MoE: Latent-Aligned Routing for Mixture of Experts in Robotic Imitation Learning

author.name: Ariel Rodriguez, Chenpan Li, Lorenzo Mazza, Rayan Younis, Ortrun Hellig, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Martin Wagner, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: Introduces LAR-MoE, a two-stage framework decoupling unsupervised skill discovery from policy learning in imitation learning via Mixture-of-Experts with latent-aligned routing for handling heterogeneous task dynamics.

entry.title: EquiBim: Learning Symmetry-Equivariant Policy for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Aditya Mohan, Seungho Han, Wan Shou, Dongyi Wang, Yu She

entry.summary: Introduces EquiBim, a symmetry-equivariant policy learning framework for bimanual manipulation that enforces bilateral equivariance between observations and actions during training.

entry.title: Bilevel Planning with Learned Symbolic Abstractions from Interaction Data

author.name: Fatih Dogangun, Burcu Kilic, Serdar Bahar, Emre Ugur

entry.summary: Proposes a bilevel neuro-symbolic framework where learned probabilistic symbolic rules generate candidate plans at high level and learned continuous models verify plans and resolve parameter values at low level.

entry.title: Kernel Methods for Some Transport Equations with Application to Learning Kernels for the Approximation of Koopman Eigenfunctions: A Unified Approach via Variational Methods, Green's Functions and the Method of Characteristics

author.name: Boumediene Hamzi, Houman Owhadi, Umesh Vaidya

entry.summary: Presents a unified theoretical framework for constructing reproducing kernels for transport equations and Koopman eigenfunctions, proving equivalence of three construction methods: variational, Green's function, and characteristic flow-based.

entry.title: Sensivity of LLMs' Explanations to the Training Randomness:Context, Class & Task Dependencies

author.name: Romain Loncour, J\'er\'emie Bogaert, Fran\c{c}ois-Xavier Standaert

entry.summary: Investigates how syntactic context, class labels, and task type affect the sensitivity of transformer explanations to training randomness. Shows all factors have statistically significant impact, with tasks having the largest effect.

entry.title: Asymmetric Distillation and Information Retention in Capacity-Constrained Cross-Modal Transfer

author.name: Kabir Thayani

entry.summary: Investigates dimensional collapse when distilling CLIP ViT-B/32 into capacity-constrained CNNs. Finds a capacity-agnostic phase transition where all student models experience severe dimensional collapse regardless of size.

entry.title: Single Image Super-Resolution via Bivariate `A Trous Wavelet Diffusion

author.name: Heidari Maryam, Anantrasirichai Nantheera, Achim Alin

entry.summary: Proposes a wavelet-domain diffusion approach for single image super-resolution using bivariate à trous wavelets, avoiding spatial-domain hallucinations by operating in the frequency domain.

entry.title: Compressed-Domain-Aware Online Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Hai Li, Shujuan Hou, Zhetao Dong, Xiaoyao Yang

entry.summary: CDA-VSR leverages compressed-domain information (motion vectors, residual maps, frame types) for efficient online video super-resolution in bandwidth-limited streaming. Proposes motion-vector-guided deformable alignment to reduce computational overhead.

entry.title: VSDiffusion: Taming Ill-Posed Shadow Generation via Visibility-Constrained Diffusion

author.name: Jing Li, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: VSDiffusion generates realistic cast shadows for composited objects using visibility-constrained diffusion in two stages: coarse shadow mask prediction followed by conditional diffusion guided by lighting and depth cues.

entry.title: From Reactive to Map-Based AI: Tuned Local LLMs for Semantic Zone Inference in Object-Goal Navigation

author.name: Yudai Noda, Kanji Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes transitioning from reactive LLM-based navigation to map-based approach using fine-tuned Llama-2 for semantic zone inference. Integrates LLM reasoning with hybrid topological-grid mapping.

entry.title: CAR: Cross-Vehicle Kinodynamics Adaptation via Mobility Representation

author.name: Tong Xu, Chenhui Pan, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes CAR, a framework for cross-vehicle kinodynamics adaptation using a Transformer encoder with Adaptive Layer Normalization to embed vehicle trajectory transitions into a shared mobility latent space, enabling rapid transfer to new platforms.

entry.title: Towards Scalable Probabilistic Human Motion Prediction with Gaussian Processes for Safe Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Jinger Chong, Xiaotong Zhang, Kamal Youcef-Toumi

entry.summary: Proposes a structured multitask variational Gaussian Process framework for full-body human motion prediction using 6D rotation representation, achieving strong uncertainty calibration and up to 50x better KDE NLL than baselines on Human3.6M.

entry.title: FeasibleCap: Real-Time Embodiment Constraint Guidance for In-the-Wild Robot Demonstration Collection

author.name: Zi Yin, Fanhong Li, Yun Gui, Jia Liu

entry.summary: Presents FeasibleCap, a gripper-in-hand data collection system providing real-time executability feedback during demonstration collection, eliminating the need for separate replay-and-validation stages to verify robot feasibility.

entry.title: Failure Detection in Chemical Processes using Symbolic Machine Learning: A Case Study on Ethylene Oxidation

author.name: Julien Amblard, Niklas Groll, Matthew Tait, Mark Law, G\"urkan Sin, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Investigates symbolic machine learning for failure prediction in chemical processes (ethylene oxidation), using probabilistic rule learning as an explainable alternative to neural approaches in safety-critical industrial settings.

entry.title: FusionRegister: Every Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Deserves Registration

author.name: Congcong Bian, Haolong Ma, Hui Li, Zhongwei Shen, Xiaoqing Luo, Xiaoning Song, Xiao-Jun Wu

entry.summary: FusionRegister proposes a general cross-modality registration method for infrared-visible image fusion guided by visual priors, eliminating need for extensive pre-registration. Learns misregistration representations rather than forcing alignment of all differences.

entry.title: ViSA-Enhanced Aerial VLN: A Visual-Spatial Reasoning Enhanced Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Haoyu Tong, Xiangyu Dong, Xiaoguang Ma, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou, Chenghao Lin

entry.summary: ViSA proposes a visual-spatial reasoning enhanced framework for aerial vision-language navigation using structured visual prompting. Enables VLMs to perform direct spatial reasoning on image planes without additional training.

entry.title: SRNeRV: A Scale-wise Recursive Framework for Neural Video Representation

author.name: Jia Wang, Jun Zhu, Xinfeng Zhang

entry.summary: SRNeRV proposes scale-wise recursive framework for implicit neural video representation, sharing channel mixing modules across scales while keeping spatial mixing scale-specific. Reduces parameter redundancy.

entry.title: Rectified flow-based prediction of post-treatment brain MRI from pre-radiotherapy priors for patients with glioma

author.name: Selena Huisman, Nordin Belkacemi, Vera Keil, Joost Verhoeff, Szabolcs David

entry.summary: Uses rectified flow models conditioned on pre-treatment MRI and radiation dose maps to predict post-radiotherapy brain MRI in glioma patients, enabling treatment optimization through realistic simulation.

entry.title: Learning-Based Robust Control: Unifying Exploration and Distributional Robustness for Reliable Robotics via Free Energy

author.name: Hozefa Jesawada, Giovanni Russo, Abdalla Swikir, Fares Abu-Dakka

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based robust control method inspired by the free energy principle that jointly learns environment dynamics and rewards while ensuring robustness to epistemic uncertainties. Modifies the maximum diffusion learning framework with distributional robustness.

entry.title: Kinematics-Aware Latent World Models for Data-Efficient Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiazhuo Li, Linjiang Cao, Qi Liu, Xi Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes a kinematics-aware latent world model for autonomous driving that incorporates vehicle kinematic information into the RSSM observation encoder and uses geometry-aware supervision for data-efficient learning.

entry.title: DAISS: Phase-Aware Imitation Learning for Dual-Arm Robotic Ultrasound-Guided Interventions

author.name: Feng Li, Pei Liu, Shiting Wang, Ning Wang, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab, Yuan Bi

entry.summary: Presents DAISS, a dual-arm interventional surgical system for ultrasound-guided needle insertion that collects teleoperation demonstrations and learns phase-aware imitation policies for the asymmetric bimanual workflow.

entry.title: The EpisTwin: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Personal AI

author.name: Giovanni Servedio, Potito Aghilar, Alessio Mattiace, Gianni Carmosino, Francesco Musicco, Gabriele Conte, Vito Walter Anelli, Tommaso Di Noia, Francesco Maria Donini

entry.summary: Introduces EpisTwin, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds generative reasoning in a user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph. Uses multimodal language models to convert heterogeneous data into semantic triples for personal AI applications.

entry.title: From Toil to Thought: Designing for Strategic Exploration and Responsible AI in Systematic Literature Reviews

author.name: Runlong Ye, Naaz Sibia, Angela Zavaleta Bernuy, Tingting Zhu, Carolina Nobre, Viktoria Pammer-Schindler, Michael Liut

entry.summary: Investigates friction points in systematic literature reviews through a design study with 20 researchers, then develops ARC, a design probe for AI-assisted literature review with multi-database integration.

entry.title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Jean-Daniel Fekete, Yifan Hu, Dominik Moritz, Arnab Nandi, Senjuti Basu Roy, Eugene Wu, Nikos Bikakis, George Papastefanatos, Panos K. Chrysanthis, Guoliang Li, Lingyun Yu

entry.summary: Position paper examining how AI transforms human-data interaction, data exploration, and visualization, identifying challenges including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, and uncertainty in AI-generated insights.

entry.title: PVminerLLM: Structured Extraction of Patient Voice from Patient-Generated Text using Large Language Models

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah Lowe, Aimee Roundtree

entry.summary: Introduces PVminerLLM, a supervised fine-tuned LLM for structured extraction of patient voice signals from patient-generated text, addressing the gap in capturing lived experience data for health outcomes research.

entry.title: Learning to Solve Orienteering Problem with Time Windows and Variable Profits

author.name: Songqun Gao, Zanxi Ruan, Patrick Floor, Marco Roveri, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based two-stage approach (DeCoST) for the orienteering problem with time windows and variable profits, decoupling discrete routing from continuous service time optimization.

entry.title: Kinetic-based regularization: Learning spatial derivatives and PDE applications

author.name: Abhisek Ganguly, Santosh Ansumali, Sauro Succi

entry.summary: Extends kinetic-based regularization for learning spatial derivatives from discrete noisy data with provable second-order accuracy. Proposes explicit and implicit schemes for derivative estimation.

entry.title: A Reference Architecture of Reinforcement Learning Frameworks

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Proposes a reference architecture for RL frameworks based on grounded theory analysis of 18 state-of-practice frameworks, identifying recurring architectural components and patterns.

entry.title: Khatri-Rao Clustering for Data Summarization

author.name: Martino Ciaperoni, Collin Leiber, Aristides Gionis, Heikki Mannila

entry.summary: Proposes Khatri-Rao clustering, extending centroid-based clustering to produce more compact data summaries by modeling centroids as arising from interactions (Khatri-Rao products). Addresses redundancy in traditional clustering summaries for datasets with many clusters.

entry.title: ERP-RiskBench: Leakage-Safe Ensemble Learning for Financial Risk

author.name: Sanjay Mishra

entry.summary: Presents ERP-RiskBench, a rebuilt experimental framework for financial risk detection in ERP systems, addressing common methodological flaws (leakage, inflated metrics) in prior published studies with proper nested cross-validation.

entry.title: Enhancing SHAP Explainability for Diagnostic and Prognostic ML Models in Alzheimer Disease

author.name: Pablo Guill\'en, Enrique Frias-Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-level SHAP explainability framework for Alzheimer's disease ML models, measuring coherence, stability, and consistency of explanations across disease stages and model architectures.

entry.title: HGT-Scheduler: Deep Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem via Heterogeneous Graph Transformers

author.name: Bulent Soykan

entry.summary: Proposes HGT-Scheduler, a reinforcement learning framework for job shop scheduling that models the problem as a heterogeneous graph, using Heterogeneous Graph Transformers to capture distinct job-precedence and machine-contention relations.

entry.title: IGLU: The Integrated Gaussian Linear Unit Activation Function

author.name: Mingi Kang, Zai Yang, Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto

entry.summary: Introduces IGLU, a parametric activation function derived as a scale mixture of GELU gates under half-normal mixing, offering a principled mathematical derivation connecting various smooth activation functions.

entry.title: A Dual-Graph Spatiotemporal GNN Surrogate for Nonlinear Response Prediction of Reinforced Concrete Beams under Four-Point Bending

author.name: Zhaoyang Ren, Qilin Li

entry.summary: Develops a dual-graph spatiotemporal GNN surrogate for simulating nonlinear response of reinforced concrete beams, replacing costly finite element simulations.

entry.title: Generalizing Linear Autoencoder Recommenders with Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss

author.name: Ruixin Guo, Xinyu Li, Hao Zhou, Yang Zhou, Ruoming Jin

entry.summary: Generalizes the EDLAE recommender system objective into Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss, revealing closed-form solutions in broader hyperparameter ranges.

entry.title: Enhanced Random Subspace Local Projections for High-Dimensional Time Series Analysis

author.name: Eman Khalid, Moimma Ali Khan, Zarmeena Ali, Abdullah Illyas, Muhammad Usman, Saoud Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes an enhanced Random Subspace Local Projection framework for high-dimensional time series with weighted aggregation, category-aware sampling, and adaptive subspace selection.

entry.title: Step-Size Decay and Structural Stagnation in Greedy Sparse Learning

author.name: Pablo M. Bern\'a

entry.summary: Studies failure of greedy algorithms with over-decaying step sizes in sparse approximation, deriving explicit lower bounds showing structural stagnation even in low-dimensional settings.

entry.title: PSTNet: Physically-Structured Turbulence Network

author.name: Boris Kriuk, Fedor Kriuk

entry.summary: Introduces PSTNet, a lightweight neural architecture for atmospheric turbulence estimation that embeds Monin-Obukhov scaling theory directly into its structure, coupling physics-derived components with learned corrections.

entry.title: GCGNet: Graph-Consistent Generative Network for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables

author.name: Zhengyu Li, Xiangfei Qiu, Yuhan Zhu, Xingjian Wu, Jilin Hu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GCGNet for time series forecasting with exogenous variables, using a graph-based approach to jointly model temporal and channel correlations rather than treating them separately.

entry.title: FedPrism: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning under Non-IID Data

author.name: Prakash Kumbhakar, Shrey Srivastava, Haroon R Lone

entry.summary: Proposes FedPrism, a federated learning framework using 'Prism Decomposition' that separates client models into global, group, and private components to handle non-IID data through automatic client grouping.

entry.title: Towards plausibility in time series counterfactual explanations

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Krzysztof Galus, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Presents a method for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classification using gradient-based optimization with soft-DTW alignment to ensure temporal realism.

entry.title: Meta-RL with Shared Representations Enables Fast Adaptation in Energy Systems

author.name: Th\'eo Zangato, Aomar Osmani, Pegah Alizadeh

entry.summary: Introduces a Meta-RL framework with shared state feature extractors jointly optimized across actor and critic networks, featuring bi-level optimization and parameter sharing for improved sample efficiency in energy systems.

entry.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Graph Alignment without Supervision

author.name: Songyang Chen, Youfang Lin, Yu Liu, Shuai Zheng, Lei Zou

entry.summary: Proposes GlobAlign, an unsupervised graph alignment method using a 'global representation and alignment' paradigm with optimal transport, addressing accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs of existing approaches.

entry.title: Split Federated Learning Architectures for High-Accuracy and Low-Delay Model Training

author.name: Yiannis Papageorgiou, Yannis Thomas, Ramin Khalili, Iordanis Koutsopoulos

entry.summary: Investigates how model partitioning in Split Federated Learning architectures affects training accuracy and delay. Proposes optimized Hierarchical SFL architectures that improve both accuracy and communication efficiency.

entry.title: XInsight: Integrative Stage-Consistent Psychological Counseling Support Agents for Digital Well-Being

author.name: Fei Wang, Jiangnan Yang, Junjie Chen, Yuxin Liu, Kun Li, Yanyan Wei, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Presents XInsight, a multi-agent LLM framework for psychological counseling that follows the Exploration-Insight-Action therapeutic paradigm. Orchestrates specialized agents in a structured workflow for digital mental health support.

entry.title: Scaling Strategy, Not Compute: A Stand-Alone, Open-Source StarCraft II Benchmark for Accessible Reinforcement Learning Research

author.name: Sourav Panda, Shreyash Kale, Tanmay Ambadkar, Abhinav Verma, Jonathan Dodge

entry.summary: Introduces the Two-Bridge Map Suite for StarCraft II as an intermediate benchmark between full games and mini-games, designed to be accessible under realistic compute budgets while testing strategic RL capabilities.

entry.title: RECAP: Local Hebbian Prototype Learning as a Self-Organizing Readout for Reservoir Dynamics

author.name: Heng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RECAP, a bio-inspired learning system coupling untrained reservoir dynamics with Hebbian prototype readout for image classification, avoiding backpropagation entirely.

entry.title: EnsAug: Augmentation-Driven Ensembles for Human Motion Sequence Analysis

author.name: Bikram De, Habib Irani, Vangelis Metsis

entry.summary: Proposes EnsAug, a training paradigm that creates diverse ensemble models by training each specialist on a single augmentation type for human motion analysis, rather than mixing all augmentations for one model.

entry.title: Bilateral Trade Under Heavy-Tailed Valuations: Minimax Regret with Infinite Variance

author.name: Hangyi Zhao

entry.summary: Studies contextual bilateral trade under heavy-tailed valuations with infinite variance, proving matching upper and lower bounds for epoch-based algorithms under bounded density.

entry.title: A Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction System

author.name: Moin Amin-Naseri, Hannah Kim, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Proposes DySECT, a dynamic self-evolving extraction system that incrementally populates a self-expanding knowledge base while adapting to shifting terminology across specialized domains.

entry.title: Adaptive Discovery of Interpretable Audio Attributes with Multimodal LLMs for Low-Resource Classification

author.name: Kosuke Yoshimura, Hisashi Kashima

entry.summary: Proposes using multimodal LLMs to adaptively discover interpretable audio attributes for low-resource classification, replacing human-driven attribute discovery in the AdaFlock framework.

entry.title: Deep Generative Spatiotemporal Engression for Probabilistic Forecasting of Epidemics

author.name: Rajdeep Pathak, Tanujit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Presents deep spatiotemporal engression methods for probabilistic epidemic forecasting that generate calibrated prediction intervals, acting as distributional lenses on low-frequency epidemic datasets.

entry.title: AgrI Challenge: A Data-Centric AI Competition for Cross-Team Validation in Agricultural Vision

author.name: Yunmei Chen, Chi Ding, Xiaojing Ye

author.name: Waldyn G Martinez

entry.title: Tau-BNO: Brain Neural Operator for Tau Transport Model

entry.title: RILEC: Detection and Generation of L1 Russian Interference Errors in English Learner Texts

entry.title: Supporting Artifact Evaluation with LLMs: A Study with Published Security Research Papers

entry.title: Geometric Knowledge-Assisted Federated Dual Knowledge Distillation Approach Towards Remote Sensing Satellite Imagery

entry.title: PanoDP: Learning Collision-Free Navigation with Panoramic Depth and Differentiable Physics

author.name: Hao Zhong, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Shenghai Yuan, Xuyang Gao, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Lihua Xie

entry.title: AeroPlace-Flow: Language-Grounded Object Placement for Aerial Manipulators via Visual Foresight and Object Flow

author.name: Sarthak Mishra, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Naveen Nair, Wei Pan, Spandan Roy

entry.title: Reasoning Knowledge-Gap in Drone Planning via LLM-based Active Elicitation

entry.title: Contrastive-to-Self-Supervised: A Two-Stage Framework for Script Similarity Learning

entry.title: OptiRoulette Optimizer: A New Stochastic Meta-Optimizer for up to 5.3x Faster Convergence

entry.title: Metalearning traffic assignment for network disruptions with graph convolutional neural networks

entry.title: Adaptive Double-Booking Strategy for Outpatient Scheduling Using Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ninda Nurseha Amalina, Heungjo An

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive outpatient double-booking framework combining individualized no-show prediction with multi-objective RL for clinic scheduling.

entry.title: Deterministic Fuzzy Triage for Legal Compliance Classification and Evidence Retrieval

author.name: Rian Atri

entry.summary: Studies deterministic dual encoders with fuzzy triage bands for legal compliance classification, emphasizing reproducibility and transparency for regulatory frameworks like HIPAA.

entry.title: Bayesian Transformer for Probabilistic Load Forecasting in Smart Grids

author.name: Sajib Debnath, Md. Uzzal Mia

entry.title: Learning embeddings of non-linear PDEs: the Burgers' equation

entry.title: Sandpiper: Orchestrated AI-Annotation for Educational Discourse at Scale

author.name: Daryl Hedley, Doug Pietrzak, Jorge Dias, Ian Burden, Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Josh Marland, Rachel Slama, Justin Reich, Kenneth Koedinger, Ren\'e Kizilcec

entry.title: Virtual Try-On for Cultural Clothing: A Benchmarking Study

Develops a robot-terrain interaction model predicting anchoring timing, step length, and speed as functions of terrain properties.

entry.title: ACCURATE: Arbitrary-shaped Continuum Reconstruction Under Robust Adaptive Two-view Estimation

entry.title: Visualizing Coalition Formation: From Hedonic Games to Image Segmentation

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Geometric Joint Chance-Constrained Optimization: Neurodynamic Approaches

The model demonstrates efficient compression of input while retaining ability to reconstruct utterances from partial cues, showing emergent structure-sensitive generation.

entry.title: Low-Cost Teleoperation Extension for Mobile Manipulators

entry.title: Aero-Promptness: Drag-Aware Aerodynamic Manipulability for Propeller-driven Vehicles

entry.summary: Introduces Drag-Aware Aerodynamic Manipulability (DAAM), a Riemannian geometry-based framework for control allocation in redundant multirotors that accounts for motor torque limits and aerodynamic drag.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Planning for Fixed-Altitude Sparse Target Search and Sampling

entry.title: Rethinking the semantic classification of indoor places by mobile robots

entry.summary: Proposes relaxing semantic room classification for service robots by allowing 'confusions' between room labels, arguing that functional overlap (e.g., a kitchen table used as a desk) can be beneficial for robot behavior.

entry.title: Directing the Robot: Scaffolding Creative Human-AI-Robot Interaction

entry.title: MRDrive: An Open Source Mixed Reality Driving Simulator for Automotive User Research

entry.title: Unmixing microinfrared spectroscopic images of cross-sections of historical oil paintings

author.name: Shivam Pande, Nicolas Nadisic, Francisco Mederos-Henry, Aleksandra Pizurica

entry.summary: Applies unsupervised CNN autoencoder for blind unmixing of micro-infrared spectroscopic images of historical painting cross-sections, replacing manual reference library comparison.

entry.title: A SISA-based Machine Unlearning Framework for Power Transformer Inter-Turn Short-Circuit Fault Localization

author.name: Nanhong Liu, Jingyi Yan, Mucun Sun, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Applies SISA-based machine unlearning to power transformer fault diagnosis, enabling efficient removal of poisoned sensor data without full retraining.

entry.title: MetaSort: An Accelerated Approach for Non-uniform Compression and Few-shot Classification of Neural Spike Waveforms

author.name: Luca M. Meyer, Majid Zamani

entry.summary: Proposes MetaSort for neural spike sorting combining adaptive level crossing compression with meta-transfer learning for few-shot spike classification from in-vivo neural data.

entry.title: A Lightweight MPC Bidding Framework for Brand Auction Ads

author.name: Yuanlong Chen, Bowen Zhu, Bing Xia, Yichuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight MPC bidding framework for brand advertising campaigns, leveraging stable engagement patterns and fast feedback loops specific to brand ads.

entry.title: Adaptive Entropy-Driven Sensor Selection in a Camera-LiDAR Particle Filter for Single-Vessel Tracking

entry.title: Enhancing Consistency of Werewolf AI through Dialogue Summarization and Persona Information

author.name: Yoshiki Tanaka, Takumasa Kaneko, Hiroki Onozeki, Natsumi Ezure, Ryuichi Uehara, Zhiyang Qi, Tomoya Higuchi, Ryutaro Asahara, Michimasa Inaba

author.name: Mohammadreza Haghighat, Alzayat Saleh, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi

entry.summary: Introduces gRef-CW, the first dataset for generalized visual grounding in agriculture including negative expressions. Benchmarks current models for plant instance localization in field conditions.

entry.title: Text to Automata Diagrams: Comparing TikZ Code Generation with Direct Image Synthesis

author.name: Ethan Young, Zichun Wang, Aiden Taylor, Chance Jewell, Julian Myers, Satya Sri Rajiteswari Nimmagadda, Anthony White, Aniruddha Maiti, Ananya Jana

entry.summary: Introduces a synthetic data generation pipeline using NVIDIA Omniverse Digital Twin of Algiers Airport for training baggage trolley detection models with oriented bounding boxes.

entry.title: QuadAI at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Ensemble Learning of Hybrid RoBERTa and LLMs for Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: A. J. W. de Vink, Filippos Karolos Ventirozos, Natalia Amat-Lefort, Lifeng Han

entry.summary: SemEval-2026 system combining hybrid RoBERTa with LLM ensemble for aspect-based sentiment regression. Uses both regression and discretized classification heads for prediction stability.

entry.summary: SemEval system comparing embedding-based, fine-tuning, and LLM prompting approaches for word sense plausibility rating. Finds structured prompting with narrative decomposition performs best.

entry.title: A prior information informed learning architecture for flying trajectory prediction

author.name: Xianda Huang, Zidong Han, Ruibo Jin, Zhenyu Wang, Wenyu Li, Xiaoyang Li, Yi Gong

entry.summary: Introduces a hardware-efficient trajectory prediction framework for flying objects using a Dual-Transformer-Cascaded architecture with environmental priors. Demonstrated on tennis ball landing prediction using a single camera.

author.name: Suhasnadh Reddy Veluru, Sai Teja Erukude, Viswa Chaitanya Marella

entry.summary: Empirical comparison of ARIMA, LSTM, BiLSTM, and Transformer models for short-term power load forecasting, finding Transformers achieve 3.8% MAPE on PJM energy data.

entry.title: Three-dimensional reconstruction and segmentation of an aggregate stockpile for size and shape analyses

author.name: Erol Tutumluer, Haohang Huang, Jiayi Luo, Issam Qamhia, John M. Hart

entry.summary: Presents an innovative 3D imaging approach for field evaluation of large aggregates using mobile device videos. Combines 3D reconstruction with segmentation for size and shape analysis of aggregate stockpiles.

entry.title: XMACNet: An Explainable Lightweight Attention based CNN with Multi Modal Fusion for Chili Disease Classification

author.name: Tapon Kumer Ray, Rajkumar Y, Shalini R, Srigayathri K, Jayashree S, Lokeswari P

author.name: Natalie Friedman, Kevin Weatherwax, Chengchao Zhu

entry.summary: Argues that robot aesthetics should function as interaction signals rather than decoration, proposing that fashion-inspired material, color, and texture choices can communicate robot capabilities and set appropriate user expectations.

entry.title: Model-based thermal drift compensation for high-precision hexapod robot actuators

author.name: Cl\'ement Robert, Alain Vissiere, Olivier Company, Pierre Noire, Thierry Roux, S\'ebastien Krut

entry.summary: Proposes model-based thermal drift compensation for high-precision hexapod robot actuators by linking actuator expansion state to surface temperature measurements, enabling positioning error correction.

entry.title: Moloch v. Themis

author.name: Stephen Martin

entry.summary: Extends Scott Alexander's Moloch concept by proposing 'Themis' as an alternative coordination mechanism—a rational and fair system that enforces cooperation and is demonstrably better for all participants.

entry.title: Technical Report: Automated Optical Inspection of Surgical Instruments

author.name: Zunaira Shafqat, Atif Aftab Ahmed Jilani, Qurrat Ul Ain

entry.summary: Technical report on automated optical inspection of surgical instruments using AI to detect manufacturing defects like cracks, rust, and structural irregularities.

entry.title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots

author.name: Florentin Dipner, William Talbot, Turcan Tuna, Andrei Cramariuc, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Presents a one-shot badminton shuttlecock detection framework with a dataset of 20,510 annotated frames. Proposes semi-automatic annotation pipeline and achieves F1 0.86 with fine-tuned YOLOv8.

entry.title: A Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Cerebral Palsy Detection

author.name: Karan Kumar Singh, Nikita Gajbhiye, Gouri Sankar Mishra

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid ML model for cerebral palsy detection from brain MRI images using preprocessing and classification techniques.

author.name: James Ashford, Marko Cvjetko, Richard L\"offler, Berfin Sakallioglu, Alessandro Valerio, Marta Tataryn, Benedikt Hartl, L\'eo Pio-Lopez, Stefano Nichele

Discusses implications for artificial life, open-endedness, and collective intelligence.

entry.summary: Creative experiment giving various LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro/Flash-Lite, GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark) freedom to design concept albums, then producing the music videos. Explores LLM creative expression.

entry.summary: Summary and distillation of Nate Soares' 'Replacing Guilt' sequence, framing it as 'effective affectism'—careful analysis of emotions to determine which should be endorsed or dismissed for better motivation.

author.name: Robert Kralisch

entry.summary: Fundraiser announcement for the 12th edition of AI Safety Camp, with 1:1 matching from Survival and Flourishing Fund.

entry.summary: Announcement for UChicago XLab's summer AI safety research fellowship and replication fellowship programs.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 09, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's top research centers on AI safety limitations and efficient inference, with strong contributions in generative modeling and theoretical foundations.

  • The CoT-Control evaluation suite reveals that reasoning models fundamentally struggle to control chain-of-thought verbalization, undermining CoT monitoring as a safety strategy
  • The Disentangled Safety Hypothesis uncovers that LLM safety operates on two separable subspaces—recognition vs. refusal—with direct implications for robustness of alignment
  • A substantive critique highlights that GPT-5.4 Pro was released without adequate safety evaluations for catastrophic-risk-relevant capabilities

Self-Flow from Stability AI and MIT introduces self-supervised flow matching with Dual-Timestep Denoising, unifying representation learning and generation. Omni-Diffusion presents the first fully diffusion-based any-to-any multimodal model, while PSIVG enforces physical consistency in video generation by integrating physics simulators into diffusion loops.

  • FlashPrefill achieves ultra-fast prefilling via instantaneous sparse attention pattern discovery
  • Theoretical work proves weak-to-strong generalization can improve scaling law exponents in random feature ridge regression
  • Scaling PPO to 1M parallel environments resolves training plateaus caused by poor sample-based loss approximations
  • MultiHaystack fills a key evaluation gap with retrieval-and-reasoning benchmarks over 40K heterogeneous multimodal documents

entry.title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought

author.name: Chen Yueh-Han, Robert McCarthy, Bruce W. Lee, He He, Ian Kivlichan, Bowen Baker, Micah Carroll, Tomek Korbak

entry.summary: Introduces CoT-Control evaluation suite showing that reasoning models struggle to control what they verbalize in chain-of-thought much more than they struggle to control final outputs. Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control CoT only 2.7% of the time vs 61.9% for final output, suggesting CoT monitoring may be more reliable than feared.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis

author.name: Hila Chefer, Patrick Esser, Dominik Lorenz, Dustin Podell, Vikash Raja, Vinh Tong, Antonio Torralba, Robin Rombach

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Flow, a self-supervised flow matching paradigm that integrates representation learning within the generative framework via Dual-Timestep Scheduling. This creates information asymmetry across tokens, forcing the model to learn strong semantic representations without external pretrained models like CLIP.

entry.title: Improved Scaling Laws via Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Feature Ridge Regression

author.name: Diyuan Wu, Lehan Chen, Theodor Misiakiewicz, Marco Mondelli

entry.summary: Proves that weak-to-strong generalization in random feature ridge regression can yield substantial improvements that affect the scaling law exponent, not just constant factors. Derives deterministic equivalents for student test error when trained on weak teacher labels.

entry.title: Knowing without Acting: The Disentangled Geometry of Safety Mechanisms in Large Language Models

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shen Lin, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes the Disentangled Safety Hypothesis (DSH) showing that LLM safety computation operates on two distinct subspaces: a Recognition Axis ('Knowing' harmful content) and an Execution Axis ('Acting' to refuse), which transition from entangled to independent across layers.

entry.title: Preventing Learning Stagnation in PPO by Scaling to 1 Million Parallel Environments

author.name: Michael Beukman, Khimya Khetarpal, Zeyu Zheng, Will Dabney, Jakob Foerster, Michael Dennis, Clare Lyle

entry.summary: Shows that PPO training plateaus arise from sample-based loss estimates becoming poor proxies for the true objective, and demonstrates that scaling to 1 million parallel environments prevents this stagnation. Provides theoretical framing as stochastic optimization of the outer loop.

entry.title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling

author.name: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Juqiu Wang, Bingning Wang, Ran He

entry.summary: FlashPrefill proposes a framework for ultra-fast long-context prefilling by using instantaneous pattern discovery to find dynamic vertical, slash, and block-sparse attention patterns, combined with a dynamic thresholding mechanism that avoids expensive sorting. This addresses the quadratic attention bottleneck in LLMs during the compute-intensive prefilling phase.

entry.title: Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation

author.name: Lin Geng Foo, Mark He Huang, Alexandros Lattas, Stylianos Moschoglou, Thabo Beeler, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: Introduces PSIVG, a framework that integrates a physical simulator into the video diffusion process to enforce physical consistency (gravity, inertia, collisions). Reconstructs 4D scenes from template videos, simulates physically plausible trajectories, and uses them to guide diffusion generation.

entry.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Lijiang Li, Zuwei Long, Yunhang Shen, Heting Gao, Haoyu Cao, Xing Sun, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-Diffusion, the first any-to-any multimodal model built entirely on masked discrete diffusion, unifying understanding and generation across text, speech, and images. Challenges the dominance of autoregressive architectures for multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: The current SOTA model was released without safety evals

author.name: Parv Mahajan

entry.summary: Building on yesterday's News coverage of the GPT-5.4 release, Highlights that OpenAI released GPT-5.4 Pro—likely the current most capable model for catastrophic-risk-relevant tasks including bioweapons R&D and cyberoffense—on March 5, 2026 without a system card or any publicly known safety evaluations. The post argues this is a recurring pattern (seen with o3-pro and GPT-5.2 Pro) and provides recommendations for fast independent post-deployment risk assessments.

entry.title: MultiHaystack: Benchmarking Multimodal Retrieval and Reasoning over 40K Images, Videos, and Documents

author.name: Dannong Xu, Zhongyu Yang, Jun Chen, Yingfang Yuan, Ming Hu, Lei Sun, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel, Chun-Mei Feng

entry.summary: Introduces MultiHaystack, the first benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on both retrieval and reasoning over large-scale heterogeneous corpora (46K+ items across documents, images, and videos with 747 verifiable questions). Reveals that current MLLMs struggle with cross-modal retrieval at scale.

entry.title: Proof-of-Guardrail in AI Agents and What (Not) to Trust from It

author.name: Xisen Jin, Michael Duan, Qin Lin, Aaron Chan, Zhenglun Chen, Junyi Du, Xiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes proof-of-guardrail, a system using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to provide cryptographic proof that an AI agent's response was generated after a specific guardrail was applied, enabling verifiable safety claims.

entry.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration

author.name: Ninghao Zhang, Bin Zhu, Shijie Zhou, Jingjing Chen

entry.summary: Reveals a critical 'linguistic blindness' failure mode in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models where policies ignore language instructions and rely on visual priors. Introduces ICBench diagnostic benchmark and a training-free attention recalibration fix.

entry.title: Gradient Flow Polarizes Softmax Outputs towards Low-Entropy Solutions

author.name: Aditya Varre, Mark Rofin and Nicolas Flammarion

entry.summary: Analyzes gradient flow dynamics of the value-softmax model (core building block of self-attention) and proves that gradient flow inherently drives optimization toward low-entropy outputs. Demonstrates this polarization effect across multiple objectives.

entry.title: Penguin-VL: Exploring the Efficiency Limits of VLM with LLM-based Vision Encoders

author.name: Boqiang Zhang, Lei Ke, Ruihan Yang, Qi Gao, Tianyuan Qu, Rossell Chen, Dong Yu, Leoweiliang

entry.summary: Presents Penguin-VL, a compact VLM (2B/8B) that replaces CLIP/SigLIP vision encoders with ones initialized from text-only LLMs. Argues that contrastive pretraining enforces coarse invariances that suppress fine-grained visual cues needed for complex reasoning.

entry.title: When Rubrics Fail: Error Enumeration as Reward in Reference-Free RL Post-Training for Virtual Try-On

author.name: Wisdom Ikezogwo, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Ranjay Krishna, Karim Bouyarmane

entry.summary: Proposes Implicit Error Counting (IEC) as a reward mechanism for RL post-training in reference-free settings like virtual try-on, where multiple valid outputs exist and traditional rubric-based rewards fail. Instead of checking correctness against a reference, IEC enumerates what's wrong with severity-weighted penalties.

entry.title: Revisiting the (Sub)Optimality of Best-of-N for Inference-Time Alignment

author.name: Ved Sriraman, Adam Block

entry.summary: Revisits the theoretical sub-optimality of Best-of-N sampling for LLM alignment, showing that under more realistic assumptions (particularly focusing on worst-case rather than expected reward), BoN is more competitive than prior theory suggests and more robust to reward hacking.

entry.title: Depth Charge: Jailbreak Large Language Models from Deep Safety Attention Heads

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SAHA, an attention-head-level jailbreak framework that exploits deeper, insufficiently aligned safety attention heads in open-source LLMs. Reveals that safety mechanisms are concentrated in specific attention heads that can be targeted.

entry.title: Lyapunov Probes for Hallucination Detection in Large Foundation Models

author.name: Bozhi Luan, Gen Li, Yalan Qin, Jifeng Guo, Yun Zhou, Faguo Wu, Hongwei Zheng, Wenjun Wu, Zhaoxin Fan

entry.summary: Frames LLM hallucination detection through dynamical systems stability theory, proposing Lyapunov Probes that enforce monotonic confidence decay under perturbations to distinguish factual from hallucinated outputs.

entry.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention

author.name: Lin Niu, Xin Luo, Linchuan Xie, Yifu Sun, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, and S Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Stem rethinks causal attention through information flow perspective, proposing position-dependent top-k selection that accounts for the cumulative dependency of tokens in causal architectures. Initial positions attend everywhere, while later positions are more selective.

entry.title: CaTok: Taming Mean Flows for One-Dimensional Causal Image Tokenization

author.name: Yitong Chen, Zuxuan Wu, Xipeng Qiu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Presents CaTok, a 1D causal image tokenizer using a MeanFlow decoder for autoregressive visual generation. Addresses the challenge of extending causal next-token prediction to vision by learning causal 1D representations that support both fast one-step and high-fidelity multi-step generation.

entry.title: NOBLE: Accelerating Transformers with Nonlinear Low-Rank Branches

author.name: Ethan Smith (Canva Research)

entry.summary: Introduces NOBLE, an architectural augmentation adding nonlinear low-rank branches to transformer layers for pretraining from scratch (unlike LoRA which is for fine-tuning). Uses a CosNet activation with learnable frequency/phase, achieving up to 1.47x step speedup to reach baseline perplexity.

entry.title: Why Depth Matters in Parallelizable Sequence Models: A Lie Algebraic View

author.name: Gyuryang Heo, Timothy Ngotiaoco, Kazuki Irie, Samuel J. Gershman, Bernardo Sabatini

entry.summary: Provides a Lie-algebraic analysis of why depth matters in parallelizable sequence models (Transformers, SSMs), showing that error diminishes exponentially with depth through a correspondence with Lie algebra extensions.

entry.title: The Fragility Of Moral Judgment In Large Language Models

author.name: Tom van Nuenen, Pratik S. Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces a perturbation framework testing how stable LLM moral judgments are when surface-level features change while the underlying moral dilemma stays the same. Using ~3K Reddit AITA dilemmas, they show that lexical edits, POV shifts, and persuasion cues can flip model verdicts, revealing fragility in LLM moral reasoning.

entry.title: TumorChain: Interleaved Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Traceable Clinical Tumor Analysis

author.name: Sijing Li, Zhongwei Qiu, Jiang Liu, Wenqiao Zhang, Tianwei Lin, Yihan Xie, Jianxiang An, Boxiang Yun, Chenglin Yang, Jun Xiao, Guangyu Guo, Jiawen Yao, Wei Liu, Yuan Gao, Ke Yan, Weiwei Cao, Zhilin Zheng, Tony C. W. Mok, Kai Cao, Yu Shi, Jiuyu Zhang, Jian Zhou, Beng Chin Ooi, Yingda Xia, Ling Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TumorChain, a multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning system for clinical tumor analysis with TumorCoT, a 1.5M CoT-labeled VQA dataset paired with 3D CT scans. Enables traceable step-by-step interpretation from imaging findings to pathology conclusions.

entry.title: EvoESAP: Non-Uniform Expert Pruning for Sparse MoE

author.name: Zongfang Liu, Shengkun Tang, Boyang Sun, Zhiqiang Shen, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces EvoESAP for non-uniform expert pruning in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models, decoupling within-layer ranking from across-layer budget allocation. Uses a speculative-decoding-inspired metric (ESAP) for pruning decisions.

entry.title: SPOT: Span-level Pause-of-Thought for Efficient and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yunlong Chu, Minglai Shao, Yuhang Liu, Bing Hao, Yumeng Lin, Jialu Wang, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: SPOT proposes span-level pause-of-thought for latent reasoning in LLMs, enabling efficient and interpretable reasoning by operating at span granularity rather than point-to-point token alignment. This captures variable-length reasoning semantics while maintaining interpretability.

entry.title: From Entropy to Calibrated Uncertainty: Training Language Models to Reason About Uncertainty

author.name: Azza Jenane, Nassim Walha, Lukas Kuhn, Florian Buettner

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage pipeline to post-train LLMs for calibrated uncertainty estimation: computing entropy-based uncertainty scores, calibrating via Platt scaling, then using RL to align the model with calibrated signals. Addresses the critical need for reliable uncertainty in high-stakes domains.

entry.title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Divya Chaudhary

entry.summary: SAHOO introduces a framework to monitor and control alignment drift in recursive self-improvement systems through a Goal Drift Index, constraint preservation checks, and regression-risk quantification. Evaluated across 189 tasks showing quality gains while maintaining alignment.

entry.title: Efficient, Property-Aligned Fan-Out Retrieval via RL-Compiled Diffusion

author.name: Pengcheng Jiang, Judith Yue Li, Moonkyung Ryu, R. Lily Hu, Kun Su, Zhong Yi Wan, Liam Hebert, Hao Peng, Jiawei Han, Dima Kuzmin, Craig Boutilier

entry.summary: Proposes a method combining reinforcement learning with diffusion-based generative retrieval for set-valued (fan-out) retrieval problems. RL optimizes set-level objectives like diversity and coverage, while diffusion models enable efficient inference by distilling RL-tuned policies. This addresses the tension between RL's optimization power and its high inference cost.

entry.title: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer

author.name: Jonathan Yang, Chelsea Finn, Dorsa Sadigh

entry.summary: Studies how to best organize heterogeneous robot demonstration data for cross-embodiment transfer. Finds that perceptual shifts benefit from broad diversity while morphology shifts benefit more from structured 'data analogies'—demonstrations specifically crafted to bridge embodiment gaps.

entry.title: Causal Interpretation of Neural Network Computations with Contribution Decomposition

author.name: Joshua Brendan Melander, Zaki Alaoui, Shenghua Liu, Surya Ganguli, Stephen A. Baccus

entry.summary: Introduces CODEC (Contribution Decomposition), using sparse autoencoders to decompose neural network behavior into sparse motifs of hidden-neuron contributions, revealing causal processes beyond what activation analysis alone can show. Finds contributions grow in sparsity and dimensionality across layers.

entry.title: Ambiguity Collapse by LLMs: A Taxonomy of Epistemic Risks

author.name: Shira Gur-Arieh, Angelina Wang, Sina Fazelpour

entry.summary: Introduces 'ambiguity collapse' as a phenomenon where LLMs produce singular resolutions of genuinely ambiguous terms (like 'hate speech' or 'biased'), bypassing the human practices through which meaning is negotiated. Provides a taxonomy of epistemic risks.

entry.title: Confidence Before Answering: A Paradigm Shift for Efficient LLM Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Changcheng Li, Jiancan Wu, Hengheng Zhang, Zhengsu Chen, Guo An, Junxiang Qiu, Xiang Wang, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Proposes CoCA, a confidence-first paradigm where LLMs output confidence scores before generating answers, using GRPO reinforcement learning with segmented credit assignment to jointly optimize confidence calibration and answer accuracy.

entry.title: Improved high-dimensional estimation with Langevin dynamics and stochastic weight averaging

author.name: Stanley Wei, Alex Damian, Jason D. Lee

entry.summary: Shows that Langevin dynamics with stochastic weight averaging can circumvent information exponent barriers in high-dimensional estimation problems like tensor PCA and single-index models, matching or improving upon previous SGD results.

entry.title: Do Foundation Models Know Geometry? Probing Frozen Features for Continuous Physical Measurement

author.name: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov

entry.summary: Demonstrates that vision-language models encode continuous geometry far better than their text output can express: a simple linear probe extracts hand joint angles at 6.1° MAE from frozen features while text output achieves only 20°. LoRA fine-tuning narrows this gap, suggesting a pathway-training deficit rather than representational one.

entry.title: Transducing Language Models
