entry.summary: Proposes SecureRAG-RTL, a RAG-based multi-agent framework for zero-shot hardware vulnerability detection in HDL designs. Addresses the scarcity of public HDL datasets by integrating domain-specific retrieval with generative reasoning for security verification.

entry.title: PVminerLLM: Structured Extraction of Patient Voice from Patient-Generated Text using Large Language Models

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah Lowe, Aimee Roundtree

entry.summary: Introduces PVminerLLM, a fine-tuned LLM for extracting structured patient voice signals from patient-generated text, including lived experiences, social circumstances, and care engagement factors typically unavailable in structured clinical data.

entry.title: Balancing Domestic and Global Perspectives: Evaluating Dual-Calibration and LLM-Generated Nudges for Diverse News Recommendation

author.name: Ruixuan Sun, Matthew Zent, Minzhu Zhao, Thanmayee Boyapati, Xinyi Li, Joseph A. Konstan

entry.summary: Applies personalized diversity nudge framework to news recommendation, designing dual-calibration algorithmic nudges and LLM-based presentation nudges to expand user reading coverage across domestic/world news. Five-week real-user study with 120 participants.

entry.title: Margin and Consistency Supervision for Calibrated and Robust Vision Models

author.name: Salim Khazem

entry.summary: Presents MaCS, an architecture-agnostic regularization combining hinge-squared margin penalty with consistency regularization to improve both calibration and robustness of vision classifiers under distribution shift.

entry.title: OpenHEART: Opening Heterogeneous Articulated Objects with a Legged Manipulator

author.name: Seonghyeon Lim, Hyeonwoo Lee, Seunghyun Lee, I Made Aswin Nahrendra, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: Proposes OpenHEART, a framework for legged manipulators to open heterogeneous articulated objects using Sampling-based Abstracted Feature Extraction (SAFE) for compact geometry encoding and articulation-aware reward shaping.

entry.title: Cog2Gen3D: Sculpturing 3D Semantic-Geometric Cognition for 3D Generation

author.name: Haonan Wang, Hanyu Zhou, Haoyue Liu, Tao Gu, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Introduces Cog2Gen3D, a 3D cognition-guided diffusion framework that integrates semantic information with absolute geometry for controllable 3D generation. Uses cognitive feature embeddings, 3D-aware graph reasoning, and a dual-stream diffusion backbone.

entry.title: Mitigating Bias in Concept Bottleneck Models for Fair and Interpretable Image Classification

author.name: Schrasing Tong, Antoine Salaun, Vincent Yuan, Annabel Adeyeri, Lalana Kagal

entry.summary: Proposes three bias mitigation techniques for Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs): top-k concept filtering, biased concept removal, and adversarial debiasing, to reduce gender bias while maintaining interpretability.

entry.title: Design Experiments to Compare Multi-armed Bandit Algorithms

author.name: Huiling Meng, Ningyuan Chen, Xuefeng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Artificial Replay (AR) as a new experimental design for comparing multi-armed bandit algorithms, reusing recorded rewards when policies agree to reduce the number of required samples.

entry.title: FTSplat: Feed-forward Triangle Splatting Network

author.name: Xiong Jinlin, Li Can, Shen Jiawei, Qi Zhigang, Sun Lei, Zhao Dongyang

entry.summary: Proposes FTSplat, a feed-forward framework that directly predicts continuous triangle surfaces from multi-view images in a single pass, producing simulation-ready 3D models without per-scene optimization.

entry.title: XAI for Coding Agent Failures: Transforming Raw Execution Traces into Actionable Insights

author.name: Arun Joshi

entry.summary: Presents an XAI approach for debugging LLM-based coding agent failures, transforming raw execution traces into structured explanations with a domain-specific failure taxonomy and visual execution flow diagrams.

entry.title: RePer-360: Releasing Perspective Priors for 360$^\circ$ Depth Estimation via Self-Modulation

author.name: Cheng Guan, Chunyu Lin, Zhijie Shen, Junsong Zhang, Jiyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RePer-360, a distortion-aware self-modulation framework that adapts perspective depth foundation models to 360° panoramic images while preserving pretrained priors. Uses a lightweight geometry-aligned guidance module.

entry.title: Occlusion-Aware SORT: Observing Occlusion for Robust Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Chunjiang Li, Jianbo Ma, Li Shen, Yanru Chen, Liangyin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes OA-SORT, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for multi-object tracking that addresses positional cost confusion from partial occlusion through occlusion-aware modules and bias-aware momentum.

entry.title: Transforming Omnidirectional RGB-LiDAR data into 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Semin Bae, Hansol Lim, Jongseong Brad Choi

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline to transform archived omnidirectional RGB-LiDAR logs into 3D Gaussian Splatting initialization assets, addressing distortion and tracking challenges in converting raw sensor data.

entry.title: StreamVoiceAnon+: Emotion-Preserving Streaming Speaker Anonymization via Frame-Level Acoustic Distillation

author.name: Nikita Kuzmin, Kong Aik Lee, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Proposes StreamVoiceAnon+, a streaming speaker anonymization method that preserves emotional content through supervised finetuning with neutral-emotion pairs and frame-level emotion distillation, maintaining 180ms latency.

entry.title: DeepSight: Bridging Depth Maps and Language with a Depth-Driven Multimodal Model

author.name: Hao Yang, Hongbo Zhang, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Introduces DeepSight, the first dedicated depth MLLM designed for 3D scene understanding by leveraging depth-specific characteristics (single-channel grayscale with direct depth cues) rather than standard RGB alignment.

entry.title: A Semi-Supervised Framework for Breast Ultrasound Segmentation with Training-Free Pseudo-Label Generation and Label Refinement

author.name: Ruili Li, Jiayi Ding, Ruiyu Li, Yilun Jin, Shiwen Ge, Yuwen Zeng, Xiaoyong Zhang, Eichi Takaya, Jan Vrba and Noriyasu Homma

entry.summary: Proposes a semi-supervised framework for breast ultrasound segmentation using VLM-generated pseudo labels from simple appearance descriptions, enabling cross-domain transfer between natural and medical images.

entry.title: VG3S: Visual Geometry Grounded Gaussian Splatting for Semantic Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Xiaoyang Yan, Muleilan Pei, Shaojie Shen

entry.summary: VG3S introduces a framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction in autonomous driving that injects geometric grounding from Vision Foundation Models into Gaussian splatting-based occupancy prediction, addressing the limitation of purely vision-centric approaches.

entry.title: Few-Shot Neural Differentiable Simulator: Real-to-Sim Rigid-Contact Modeling

author.name: Zhenhao Huang, Siyuan Luo, Bingyang Zhou, Ziqiu Zeng, Jason Pho, Fan Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a few-shot real-to-sim approach combining analytical physics simulators with GNN-based models for rigid-contact dynamics. Uses small amounts of real-world data to calibrate simulators, then trains a mesh-based GNN with differentiable collision detection.

entry.title: FlowMotion: Training-Free Flow Guidance for Video Motion Transfer

author.name: Zhen Wang, Youcan Xu, Jun Xiao, Long Chen

entry.summary: FlowMotion proposes a training-free framework for video motion transfer that directly leverages predicted outputs of flow-based text-to-video models, using the insight that early latent predictions encode rich temporal information for motion guidance.

entry.title: Abductive Reasoning with Syllogistic Forms in Large Language Models

author.name: Hirohiko Abe, Risako Ando, Takanobu Morishita Kentaro Ozeki, Koji Mineshima, Mitsuhiro Okada

entry.summary: Explores LLM accuracy in abductive reasoning by converting syllogistic datasets into abductive tasks. Examines whether LLMs share human-like biases in drawing tentative conclusions from limited information, connecting formal deduction with abduction.

entry.title: Prosodic Boundary-Aware Streaming Generation for LLM-Based TTS with Streaming Text Input

author.name: Changsong Liu, Tianrui Wang, Ye Ni, Yizhou Peng, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Proposes a prosodic-boundary-aware post-training strategy for streaming TTS with streaming text input, addressing unnatural prosody from missing lookahead and collapse in long-form synthesis. Uses sliding-window prompts with bounded context for seamless concatenation.

entry.title: Predicting Atomistic Transitions with Transformers

author.name: Henry Tischler, Wenting Li, Qi Tang, Danny Perez, and Thomas Vogel

entry.summary: Demonstrates how transformers can predict atomistic transitions in nano-clusters as a fast surrogate for computationally intensive simulation techniques. Evaluates physical validity of predictions and shows multiple validation approaches.

entry.title: SCOPE: Scene-Contextualized Incremental Few-Shot 3D Segmentation

author.name: Vishal Thengane, Zhaochong An, Tianjin Huang, Son Lam Phung, Abdesselam Bouzerdoum, Lu Yin, Na Zhao, Xiatian Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces SCOPE, a plug-and-play framework for incremental few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation that uses background-guided prototype enrichment. Extracts pseudo-instances from unlabeled background regions to build prototype pools for learning new categories from few examples.

entry.title: GenCLIP: Generalizing CLIP Prompts for Zero-shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Donghyeong Kim, Chaewon Park, Suhwan Cho, Hyeonjeong Lim, Minseok Kang, Jungho Lee, Sangyoun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes GenCLIP for zero-shot anomaly detection using CLIP, with multi-layer prompting and dual-branch inference to balance generalizability and category specificity in prompt learning.

entry.title: CoEditor++: Instruction-based Visual Editing via Cognitive Reasoning

author.name: Minheng Ni, Yutao Fan, Zhengyuan Yang, Yeli Shen, Yuxiang Wei, Yaowen Zhang, Lijuan Wang, Lei Zhang, and Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes CoEditor++, a training-free framework for instruction-based image editing that decomposes editing into 'what to edit' and 'how to edit' through cognitive reasoning stages with self-selection.

entry.title: Towards Efficient and Stable Ocean State Forecasting: A Continuous-Time Koopman Approach

author.name: Rares Grozavescu, Pengyu Zhang, Mark Girolami, Etienne Meunier

entry.summary: Investigates Continuous-Time Koopman Autoencoders for long-horizon ocean state forecasting, showing bounded error growth and stable statistics compared to Transformer baselines that exhibit error amplification.

entry.title: From Decoupled to Coupled: Robustness Verification for Learning-based Keypoint Detection with Joint Specifications

author.name: Xusheng Luo, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes the first coupled robustness verification framework for heatmap-based keypoint detectors, bounding joint deviation across all keypoints to capture interdependencies and downstream task requirements.

entry.title: Relational Semantic Reasoning on 3D Scene Graphs for Open World Interactive Object Search

author.name: Imen Mahdi, Matteo Cassinelli, Fabien Despinoy, Tim Welschehold, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Introduces SCOUT for open-world interactive object search using 3D scene graphs with learned utility scoring for rooms, frontiers, and objects, avoiding slow LLM inference during real-time deployment.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Power-Flow Network Analysis

author.name: Alperen Ergur, Julia Lindberg, Vinny Miller

entry.summary: Applies reinforcement learning to find power flow network parameters with many equilibrium points, designing a probabilistic reward function and state-space that mimics power flow equations. Derives an average root count baseline for a Gaussian model to benchmark RL agents.

entry.title: Towards Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation Based on Knowledge Graph: A Comparative Analysis

author.name: Hazem Amamou, St\'ephane Gagnon, Alan Davoust, and Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Compares standard RAG with GraphRAG using the RGB benchmark across noise robustness, information integration, negative rejection, and counterfactual robustness scenarios. Evaluates whether knowledge graph-based retrieval improves LLM robustness to problematic retrieved information.

entry.title: Spectral Probing of Feature Upsamplers in 2D-to-3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Ling Xiao, Yuliang Xiu, Yue Chen, Guoming Wang, and Toshihiko Yamasaki

entry.summary: Introduces a spectral diagnostic framework with six metrics for analyzing feature upsamplers in 2D-to-3D reconstruction pipelines, characterizing how upsampling affects 3D geometric consistency across classical and learnable methods.

entry.title: Architectural Unification for Polarimetric Imaging Across Multiple Degradations

author.name: Chu Zhou, Yufei Han, Junda Liao, Linrui Dai, Wangze Xu, Art Subpa-Asa, Heng Guo, Boxin Shi, and Imari Sato

entry.summary: Proposes a unified architecture for polarimetric imaging restoration across multiple degradation types (low-light noise, motion blur, mosaicing), ensuring physically consistent recovery of polarimetric parameters.

entry.title: VS3R: Robust Full-frame Video Stabilization via Deep 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Muhua Zhu, Xinhao Jin, Yu Zhang, Yifei Xue, Tie Ji, Yizhen Lao

entry.summary: Proposes VS3R for video stabilization, combining feed-forward 3D reconstruction with generative video diffusion. Uses a Hybrid Stabilized Rendering module and Dual-Stream Video Diffusion Model to handle extreme motions while maintaining full-frame consistency.

entry.title: CylinderSplat: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Cylindrical Triplanes for Panoramic Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Qiwei Wang, Xianghui Ze, Jingyi Yu, Yujiao Shi

entry.summary: Introduces CylinderSplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for panoramic novel view synthesis using cylindrical triplane representations that better align with 360° scene geometry than Cartesian alternatives.

entry.title: Computational Pathology in the Era of Emerging Foundation and Agentic AI -- International Expert Perspectives on Clinical Integration and Translational Readiness

author.name: Qian Da, Yijiang Chen, Min Ju, Zheyi Ji, Albert Zhou, Wenwen Wang, Matthew A Abikenari, Philip Chikontwe, Guillaume Larghero, Bowen Chen, Peter Neiglinger, Dingrong Zhong, Shuhao Wang, Wei Xu, Drew Williamson, German Corredor, Sen Yang, Le Lu, Xiao Han, Kun-Hsing Yu, Jun-zhou Huang, Laura Barisoni, Geert Litjens, Anant Madabhushi, Lifeng Zhu, Chaofu Wang, Junhan Zhao, Weiguo Hu

entry.summary: A comprehensive review of computational pathology in the era of foundation models and agentic AI, discussing clinical integration challenges including economic, technical, and administrative barriers to real-world adoption.

entry.title: Addressing the Ecological Fallacy in Larger LMs with Human Context

author.name: Nikita Soni, Dhruv Vijay Kunjadiya, Pratham Piyush Shah, Dikshya Mohanty, H. Andrew Schwartz, Niranjan Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Studies the ecological fallacy in LLMs by modeling author context in an 8B Llama model, exploring whether HuLM (author-context modeling) benefits scale up from 124M to 8B parameter models.

entry.title: SLER-IR: Spherical Layer-wise Expert Routing for All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Peng Shurui, Xin Lin, Shi Luo, Jincen Ou, Dizhe Zhang, Lu Qi, Truong Nguyen, Chao Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SLER-IR, a spherical layer-wise expert routing framework for all-in-one image restoration with contrastive learning-based degradation embeddings on a hypersphere and global-local granularity fusion.

entry.title: LucidNFT: LR-Anchored Multi-Reward Preference Optimization for Generative Real-World Super-Resolution

author.name: Song Fei, Tian Ye, Sixiang Chen, Zhaohu Xing, Jianyu Lai and Lei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes LucidNFT for generative real-world super-resolution with LR-anchored multi-reward preference optimization, addressing semantic and structural hallucination while maintaining perceptual quality.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Model Merging across Disconnected Modes

author.name: Junming Liu, Yusen Zhang, Rongchao Zhang, Wenkai Zhu, Tian Wu

entry.summary: Presents DMM, a data-free model merging framework for handling highly divergent domain-specific models through similarity-based grouping, standard merging, and knowledge distillation with synthesized pseudo-data.

entry.title: Demystifying KAN for Vision Tasks: The RepKAN Approach

author.name: Minjong Cheon

entry.summary: Proposes RepKAN, integrating CNN structural efficiency with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) non-linear representational power for interpretable remote sensing image classification. Uses a dual-path spatial linear and spectral non-linear design.

entry.title: EffectMaker: Unifying Reasoning and Generation for Customized Visual Effect Creation

author.name: Shiyuan Yang, Ruihuang Li, Jiale Tao, Shuai Shao, Qinglin Lu, Jing Liao

entry.summary: Presents EffectMaker, a unified reasoning-generation framework for reference-based visual effects (VFX) customization in videos. Uses an MLLM to interpret effect semantics and reason about adaptation to target scenes.

entry.title: Text-Driven Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation

author.name: Hao Yang, Yanyan Zhao, Tian Zheng, Hongbo Zhang, Bichen Wang, Di Wu, Xing Fu, Xuda Zhi, Yongbo Huang, Hao He

entry.summary: Proposes Emotionally Continuous Talking Face Generation (EC-TFG), generating videos where facial expressions continuously change according to emotion descriptions, rather than maintaining a fixed target emotion.

entry.title: Enhancing Neural Video Compression of Static Scenes with Positive-Incentive Noise

author.name: Cheng Yuan, Zhenyu Jia, Jiawei Shao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes using positive-incentive noise for neural video compression of static scenes, reinterpreting short-term temporal changes as beneficial noise for model finetuning rather than artifacts to compress away.

entry.title: A Causal Graph Approach to Oppositional Narrative Analysis

author.name: Diego Revilla, Martin Fernandez-de-Retana, Lingfeng Chen, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-based framework for detecting and classifying oppositional narratives by representing them as entity-interaction graphs with causal estimation for interpretable classification.

entry.title: JOPP-3D: Joint Open Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation on Point Clouds and Panoramas

author.name: Sandeep Inuganti, Hideaki Kanayama, Kanta Shimizu, Mahdi Chamseddine, Soichiro Yokota, Didier Stricker, Jason Rambach

entry.summary: Presents JOPP-3D, an open-vocabulary semantic segmentation framework jointly leveraging panoramic and point cloud data for language-driven scene understanding.

entry.title: Cut to the Chase: Training-free Multimodal Summarization via Chain-of-Events

author.name: Xiaoxing You, Qiang Huang, Lingyu Li, Xiaojun Chang, Jun Yu

entry.summary: CoE introduces a training-free multimodal summarization framework that uses a Chain-of-Events approach with a Hierarchical Event Graph to perform structured reasoning across videos, transcripts, and images without domain-specific supervision.

entry.title: Spectral and Trajectory Regularization for Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution

author.name: Jingkai Wang, Yixin Tang, Jue Gong, Jiatong Li, Shu Li, Libo Liu, Jianliang Lan, Yutong Liu, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: StrSR proposes a one-step adversarial distillation framework for diffusion transformer super-resolution with spectral and trajectory regularization to address trajectory mismatch and periodic artifacts in DiT-based image super-resolution.

entry.title: SuperSuit: An Isomorphic Bimodal Interface for Scalable Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Tongqing Chen, Hang Wu, Jiasen Wang, Xiaotao Li, Zhu Jin, Lu Fang

entry.summary: SuperSuit presents a bimodal data acquisition framework for mobile manipulation that supports both teleoperation and active demonstration under a shared kinematic interface, enabling structurally identical trajectories from both modalities.

entry.title: The EpisTwin: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Personal AI

author.name: Giovanni Servedio, Potito Aghilar, Alessio Mattiace, Gianni Carmosino, Francesco Musicco, Gabriele Conte, Vito Walter Anelli, Tommaso Di Noia, Francesco Maria Donini

entry.summary: EpisTwin introduces a neuro-symbolic framework for personal AI that grounds generative reasoning in a user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph, using multimodal language models to convert heterogeneous user data into semantic triples for structured reasoning.

entry.title: Continual Adaptation for Pacific Indigenous Speech Recognition

author.name: Yang Xiao, Aso Mahmudi, Nick Thieberger, Eliathamby Ambikairajah, Eun-Jung Holden, Ting Dang

entry.summary: Studies continual adaptation of speech models for Pacific Indigenous languages, finding that adaptation causes severe internal representational drift and a strict plasticity-stability dilemma. LoRA initially works well but suffers catastrophic forgetting across languages.

entry.title: Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Network for Multi-Timescale Dynamics

author.name: Yaojun Li, Yulong Yang, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Proposes Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Networks that decompose Hamiltonian functions into frequency-separated components to capture multi-timescale dynamics, addressing the spectral bias of standard Hamiltonian Neural Networks.

entry.title: History-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Qitong Wang, Yijun Liang, Ming Li, Tianyi Zhou, Christopher Rasmussen

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free spatio-temporal vision token pruning framework for Vision-Language Navigation that reduces computational cost while maintaining navigation performance. Uses attention-based importance scoring and query-guided filtering for efficient long-horizon inference.

entry.title: PONTE: Personalized Orchestration for Natural Language Trustworthy Explanations

author.name: Vittoria Vineis, Matteo Silvestri, Lorenzo Antonelli, Filippo Betello and Gabriele Tolomei

entry.summary: Introduces PONTE, a human-in-the-loop framework for personalized and trustworthy XAI explanations in natural language. Models personalization as a closed-loop validation process rather than prompt engineering, combining preference models with LLM-generated narratives.

entry.title: Quantum Diffusion Models: Score Reversal Is Not Free in Gaussian Dynamics

author.name: Ammar Fayad

entry.summary: Analyzes quantum diffusion models and proves that score reversal in Gaussian dynamics is not free—complete positivity constraints force additional diffusion injection. Establishes conditions under which the Wigner-score reverse drift violates complete positivity for quantum-limited attenuators.

entry.title: Speak in Context: Multilingual ASR with Speech Context Alignment via Contrastive Learning

author.name: Yuchen Zhang, Haralambos Mouratidis, Ravi Shekhar

entry.summary: Introduces a context-aware multilingual ASR framework that combines frozen speech encoders with decoder-only language models via lightweight projection, using contrastive learning to align speech and contextual representations across languages.

entry.title: Unified Learning of Temporal Task Structure and Action Timing for Bimanual Robot Manipulation

author.name: Christian Dreher, Patrick Dormanns, Andre Meixner, Tamim Asfour

entry.summary: Presents an approach for learning both symbolic temporal relations and concrete timing parameters from human demonstrations for bimanual robot manipulation. Bridges the gap between high-level task planning and low-level movement synchronization.

entry.title: FeatureGS: Eigenvalue-Feature Optimization in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate and Artifact-Reduced Reconstruction

author.name: Miriam J\"ager, Markus Hillemann, Boris Jutzi

entry.summary: Introduces FeatureGS, which adds eigenvalue-based geometric loss terms to 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization to improve geometric accuracy and reduce floater artifacts in 3D reconstruction.

entry.title: ZK-HybridFL: Zero-Knowledge Proof-Enhanced Hybrid Ledger for Federated Learning

author.name: Amirhossein Taherpour, and Xiaodong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ZK-HybridFL, a federated learning framework combining DAG ledgers, sidechains, and zero-knowledge proofs for privacy-preserving model validation with adversarial behavior detection.

entry.title: ProFocus: Proactive Perception and Focused Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Wei Xue, Mingcheng Li, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ProFocus, a training-free framework for Vision-and-Language Navigation using LLM/VLM collaboration with proactive perception via ego-centric semantic maps and focused reasoning over navigation history.

entry.title: Prediction-Powered Conditional Inference

author.name: Yang Sui, Jin Zhou, Hua Zhou, and Xiaowu Dai

entry.summary: Studies prediction-powered inference for conditional functionals using kernel-based localization and ML predictions for variance reduction, providing confidence intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantees.

entry.title: NOTAI.AI: Explainable Detection of Machine-Generated Text via Curvature and Feature Attribution

author.name: Oleksandr Marchenko Breneur, Adelaide Danilov, Aria Nourbakhsh, Salima Lamsiyah

entry.summary: Presents NOTAI.AI, an explainable framework for AI-generated text detection combining curvature-based signals, neural features, and stylometrics with SHAP explanations and natural language rationales.

entry.title: Post Fusion Bird's Eye View Feature Stabilization for Robust Multimodal 3D Detection

author.name: Trung Tien Dong, Dev Thakkar, Arman Sargolzaei, Xiaomin Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Post Fusion Stabilizer, a lightweight module for improving robustness of camera-LiDAR BEV fusion detectors under domain shift and sensor failures without modifying the existing architecture.

entry.title: Identifying Adversary Characteristics from an Observed Attack

author.name: Soyon Choi, Scott Alfeld, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: Presents a framework for identifying adversary characteristics from observed data manipulation attacks, proving non-identifiability without prior knowledge and proposing a domain-agnostic approach to find the most probable attacker.

entry.title: OWL: A Novel Approach to Machine Perception During Motion

author.name: Daniel Raviv and Juan D. Yepes

entry.summary: Introduces OWL, an analytical perception function for 3D understanding during motion that derives values from two fundamental visual motion cues (local visual looming and perceived rotation) relative to a fixation point. Provides a unified mathematical framework without requiring explicit range or translation measurements.

entry.title: Let's Talk, Not Type: An Oral-First Multi-Agent Architecture for Guaran\'i

author.name: Samantha Adorno, Akshata Kishore Moharir, Ratna Kandala

entry.summary: Position paper proposing an oral-first multi-agent architecture for Guaraní language AI, arguing that standard text-first NLP pipelines are insufficient for primarily oral indigenous languages. Proposes decoupling understanding from conversation state and community governance.

entry.title: Multi-Robot Trajectory Planning via Constrained Bayesian Optimization and Local Cost Map Learning with STL-Based Conflict Resolution

author.name: Sourav Raxit, Abdullah Al Redwan Newaz, Jose Fuentes, Paulo Padrao, Ana Cavalcanti, Leonardo Bobadilla

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage multi-robot motion planning framework combining constrained Bayesian optimization-based tree search with STL-enhanced conflict-based search for trajectory planning under temporal logic specifications.

entry.title: Task-Level Decisions to Gait Level Control: A Hierarchical Policy Approach for Quadruped Navigation

author.name: Sijia Li, Haoyu Wang, Shenghai Yuan, Yizhuo Yang, Thien-Minh Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical policy architecture (TDGC) for quadruped navigation with gait-conditioned low-level locomotion trained via RL and high-level task-centric decisions from sparse semantic/geometric inputs.

entry.title: EventGeM: Global-to-Local Feature Matching for Event-Based Visual Place Recognition

author.name: Adam D. Hines, Gokul B. Nair, Nicol\'as Marticorena, Michael Milford, Tobias Fischer

entry.summary: Presents EventGeM, a global-to-local feature matching pipeline for event camera-based visual place recognition using pretrained ViT and MaxViT backbones with RANSAC-based re-ranking.

entry.title: Lexara: A User-Centered Toolkit for Evaluating Large Language Models for Conversational Visual Analytics

author.name: Srishti Palani and Vidya Setlur

entry.summary: Presents Lexara, a user-centered evaluation toolkit for Conversational Visual Analytics developed through interviews with 22 developers and 16 end-users, providing interpretable metrics for multi-format outputs.

entry.title: DexEMG: Towards Dexterous Teleoperation System via EMG2Pose Generalization

author.name: Qianyou Zhao, Wenqiao Li, Chiyu Wang, Kaifeng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents DexEMG, a lightweight teleoperation system using surface EMG signals to control dexterous robotic hands. Trains EMG2Pose neural network from synchronized sEMG and hand pose data to predict hand kinematics from muscle activity.

entry.title: Beyond Geometry: Artistic Disparity Synthesis for Immersive 2D-to-3D

author.name: Ping Chen, Zezhou Chen, Xingpeng Zhang, Yanlin Qian, Huan Hu, Xiang Liu, Zipeng Wang, Xin Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: Proposes Art3D for 'Artistic Disparity Synthesis' in 2D-to-3D conversion, arguing that the goal should shift from physically accurate to artistically coherent disparity estimation, learning from professional 3D cinema.

entry.title: Pano3DComposer: Feed-Forward Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Single Panoramic Image

author.name: Zidian Qiu and Ancong Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Pano3DComposer, a feed-forward framework for compositional 3D scene generation from panoramic images using an Object-World Transformation Predictor that decouples object generation from layout estimation.

entry.title: Swooper: Learning High-Speed Aerial Grasping With a Simple Gripper

author.name: Ziken Huang, Xinze Niu, Bowen Chai, Renbiao Jin, Danping Zou

entry.summary: Proposes Swooper, a DRL-based approach for high-speed aerial grasping using a single lightweight neural network policy for both flight control and gripper manipulation, with training completing in under 60 minutes.

entry.title: Who We Are, Where We Are: Mental Health at the Intersection of Person, Situation, and Large Language Models

author.name: Nikita Soni, August H{\aa}kan Nilsson, Syeda Mahwish, Vasudha Varadarajan, H. Andrew Schwartz, Ryan L. Boyd

entry.summary: Develops interpretable models for mental health prediction from social media by integrating person-level psychological traits with situational features from the DIAMONDS framework, comparing against psychometrically-informed LM embeddings.

entry.title: Skeleton-to-Image Encoding: Enabling Skeleton Representation Learning via Vision-Pretrained Models

author.name: Siyuan Yang, Jun Liu, Hao Cheng, Chong Wang, Shijian Lu, Hedvig Kjellstrom, Weisi Lin, Alex C. Kot

entry.summary: Introduces Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I) that transforms skeleton sequences into image-like data, enabling use of pretrained vision models for skeleton-based action recognition without additional model branches.

entry.title: CR-QAT: Curriculum Relational Quantization-Aware Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Jinyeong Park, Donghwa Kim, Brent ByungHoon Kang, Hyeongboo Baek, Jibum Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CR-QAT for quantizing open-vocabulary object detectors to extreme low-bit (4-bit), combining curriculum stage-by-stage quantization with text-centric relational knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Imagine How To Change: Explicit Procedure Modeling for Change Captioning

author.name: Jiayang Sun, Zixin Guo, Min Cao, Guibo Zhu, Jorma Laaksonen

entry.summary: Introduces ProCap, a framework that reformulates change captioning from static image comparison to dynamic procedure modeling, learning change procedures from automatically generated intermediate frames.

entry.title: FontUse: A Data-Centric Approach to Style- and Use-Case-Conditioned In-Image Typography

author.name: Xia Xin, Yuki Endo, Yoshihiro Kanamori

entry.summary: Presents FontUse, a data-centric approach to controllable typography in text-to-image generation, constructing a 70K-image dataset with structured annotations for font styles and use cases.

entry.title: TempoSyncDiff: Distilled Temporally-Consistent Diffusion for Low-Latency Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation

author.name: Soumya Mazumdar and Vineet Kumar Rakesh

entry.summary: Introduces TempoSyncDiff, a distilled latent diffusion framework for low-latency audio-driven talking head generation using teacher-student distillation for fewer inference steps while maintaining temporal stability.

entry.title: Making Implicit Premises Explicit in Logical Understanding of Enthymemes

author.name: Xuyao Feng and Anthony Hunter

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline integrating LLMs with logic-based approaches to decode enthymemes (arguments with implicit premises), generating logical formulae needed to show logical entailment from textual arguments.

entry.title: Sticky-Glance: Robust Intent Recognition for Human Robot Collaboration via Single-Glance

author.name: Yuzhi Lai, Shenghai Yuan, Peizheng Li and Andreas Zell

entry.summary: Proposes a gaze-based intent recognition framework for human-robot collaboration that stabilizes intent through a sticky-glance algorithm, achieving high tracking rates with minimal gaze samples.

entry.title: FedARKS: Federated Aggregation via Robust and Discriminative Knowledge Selection and Integration for Person Re-identification

author.name: Xin Xu, Binchang Ma, Zhixi Yu, Wei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FedARKS for federated domain generalization in person re-identification, using discriminative knowledge selection to avoid diluting high-quality client contributions and capturing domain-invariant local details.

entry.title: EntON: Eigenentropy-Optimized Neighborhood Densification in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Miriam J\"ager, Boris Jutzi

entry.summary: EntON introduces an eigenentropy-optimized densification strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses geometry-aware splitting and pruning based on local structural analysis of Gaussian neighborhoods, improving both geometric accuracy and photometric quality.

entry.title: Conversational Demand Response: Bidirectional Aggregator-Prosumer Coordination through Agentic AI

author.name: Reda El Makroum, Sebastian Zwickl-Bernhard, Lukas Kranzl, Hans Auer

entry.summary: Proposes Conversational Demand Response (CDR), a mechanism where energy aggregators and prosumers coordinate through bidirectional natural language using agentic AI. A two-tier multi-agent architecture handles flexibility requests and cost-benefit optimization for home energy management.

entry.title: TaPD: Temporal-adaptive Progressive Distillation for Observation-Adaptive Trajectory Forecasting in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Mingyu Fan, Yi Liu, Hao Zhou, Deheng Qian, Mohammad Haziq Khan, Matthias Raetsch

entry.summary: TaPD proposes a temporal-adaptive progressive distillation framework for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving that handles variable-length observation histories. Uses observation-adaptive forecasting and temporal backfilling for robust prediction under partial observations.

entry.title: ESAA-Security: An Event-Sourced, Verifiable Architecture for Agent-Assisted Security Audits of AI-Generated Code

author.name: Elzo Brito dos Santos Filho

entry.summary: ESAA-Security proposes an event-sourced architecture for agent-assisted security auditing of AI-generated code, using append-only events and replay-based verification to provide immutable audit trails for security reviews.

entry.title: DiffInf: Influence-Guided Diffusion for Supervision Alignment in Facial Attribute Learning

author.name: Basudha Pal, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Introduces DiffInf, a framework that uses self-influence scores and diffusion models to fix annotation inconsistencies in facial attribute classification datasets. The method identifies mislabeled samples and generates corrected training signals, improving robustness of downstream classifiers.

entry.title: Match4Annotate: Propagating Sparse Video Annotations via Implicit Neural Feature Matching

author.name: Zhuorui Zhang, Roger Pallar\`es-L\'opez, Praneeth Namburi, Brian W. Anthony

entry.summary: Proposes Match4Annotate, a framework for propagating sparse video annotations using implicit neural feature matching. Supports both point and mask annotations across videos with spatiotemporal smoothness, addressing the annotation bottleneck in specialized domains.

entry.title: Control Barrier Corridors: From Safety Functions to Safe Sets

author.name: \"Om\"ur Arslan and Nikolay Atanasov

entry.summary: Introduces control barrier corridors, a unifying concept that bridges control barrier functions (functional safety) with safe motion corridors (geometric safety) for robot navigation. Converts control barrier functions into local safe goal regions for reference goal optimization.

entry.title: RAMoEA-QA: Hierarchical Specialization for Robust Respiratory Audio Question Answering

author.name: Gaia A. Bertolino, Yuwei Zhang, Tong Xia, Domenico Talia, Cecilia Mascolo

entry.summary: Introduces RAMoEA-QA, a hierarchical mixture-of-experts approach for respiratory audio question answering that handles heterogeneous recordings across devices, environments, and query types. Addresses specialization challenges in biomedical audio-language QA systems.

entry.title: Hierarchical Industrial Demand Forecasting with Temporal and Uncertainty Explanations

author.name: Harshavardhan Kamarthi, Shangqing Xu, Xinjie Tong, Xingyu Zhou, James Peters, Joseph Czyzyk, B. Aditya Prakash

entry.summary: Introduces an interpretability method for hierarchical probabilistic time-series forecasting that adapts generic interpretability techniques to handle hierarchical structures and uncertainty. Provides explanations for industrial supply chain demand prediction.

entry.title: Hierarchical Collaborative Fusion for 3D Instance-aware Referring Expression Segmentation

author.name: Keshen Zhou, Runnan Chen, Mingming Gong, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: HCF-RES proposes a multi-modal framework for 3D referring expression segmentation using hierarchical visual semantic decomposition and progressive multi-level fusion, combining SAM instance masks with CLIP encoding at dual granularities.

entry.title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents

author.name: Ali Shamsaddinlou

entry.summary: Introduces RoboLayout, extending LayoutVLM with agent-aware reasoning and reachability constraints for generating 3D scene layouts that are navigable and actionable by embodied agents.

entry.title: Clinical-Injection Transformer with Domain-Adapted MAE for Lupus Nephritis Prognosis Prediction

author.name: Yuewen Huang, Zhitao Ye, Guangnan Feng, Fudan Zheng, Xia Gao, and Yutong Lu

entry.summary: Proposes the first multimodal computational pathology framework for pediatric lupus nephritis prognosis using PAS-stained biopsies and clinical data, with domain-adapted MAE and clinical data injection.

entry.title: TEGA: A Tactile-Enhanced Grasping Assistant for Assistive Robotics via Sensor Fusion and Closed-Loop Haptic Feedback

author.name: Hengxu You, Tianyu Zhou, Fang Xu, Kaleb Smith and Eric Jing Du

entry.summary: Presents TEGA, a closed-loop assistive teleoperation framework combining EMG-based intent-to-force inference with visuotactile sensing for grasp force modulation, designed for users with upper limb disabilities.

entry.title: IntSeqBERT: Learning Arithmetic Structure in OEIS via Modulo-Spectrum Embeddings

author.name: Kazuhisa Nakasho

entry.summary: Presents IntSeqBERT, a dual-stream Transformer for OEIS integer sequence modeling using log-scale magnitude embeddings and modulo-spectrum embeddings, achieving 95.85% magnitude accuracy on masked prediction.

entry.title: Aligning the True Semantics: Constrained Decoupling and Distribution Sampling for Cross-Modal Alignment

author.name: Xiang Ma, Lexin Fang, Litian Xu, Caiming Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes constrained decoupling of embeddings into semantic and modality components for cross-modal alignment, with distribution sampling to address the modality gap problem in vision-language learning.

entry.title: PRISM: Personalized Refinement of Imitation Skills for Manipulation via Human Instructions

author.name: Arnau Boix-Granell, Alberto San-Miguel-Tello, Mag\'i Dalmau-Moreno, N\'estor Garc\'ia

entry.summary: Presents PRISM, combining imitation learning with reinforcement learning for robot manipulation refinement via natural language instructions, using Eureka-style iterative reward generation.

entry.title: Task Parameter Extrapolation via Learning Inverse Tasks from Forward Demonstrations

author.name: Serdar Bahar, Fatih Dogangun, Matteo Saveriano, Yukie Nagai, Emre Ugur

entry.summary: Proposes joint learning of forward and inverse tasks for robot skill extrapolation, constructing common representations to achieve accurate zero-shot generalization to novel task conditions outside the training region.

entry.title: Koopman Regularized Deep Speech Disentanglement for Speaker Verification

author.name: Nikos Chazaridis, Mohammad Belal, Rafael Mestre, Timothy J. Norman, Christine Evers

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Koopman Speech Disentanglement Autoencoder for speaker verification that disentangles speaker and content dynamics using multi-step Koopman operator learning with instance normalization, without requiring labels.

entry.title: Behavior-dLDS: A decomposed linear dynamical systems model for neural activity partially constrained by behavior

author.name: Eva Yezerets, En Yang, Misha B. Ahrens, Adam S. Charles

entry.summary: Proposes Behavior-dLDS, a decomposed linear dynamical systems model that separates brain activity into behavior-related and internal computation components, with behavior represented by lower-dimensional latent dynamics.

entry.title: Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum

author.name: Lauri Lov\'en, Alaa Saleh, Reza Farahani, Ilir Murturi, Miguel Bordallo L\'opez, Praveen Kumar Donta, Schahram Dustdar

entry.summary: Presents a framework for real-time AI service economies across device-edge-cloud continuum, analyzing when decentralized price-based resource allocation works based on service dependency graph structure.

entry.title: Adversarial Batch Representation Augmentation for Batch Correction in High-Content Cellular Screening

author.name: Lei Tong, Xujing Yao, Adam Corrigan, Long Chen, Navin Rathna Kumar, Kerry Hallbrook, Jonathan Orme, Yinhai Wang, Huiyu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ABRA for mitigating batch effects in high-content cell screening by framing it as domain generalization, using adversarial augmentation of batch-wise feature statistics.

entry.title: Introducing the transitional autonomous vehicle lane-changing dataset: Empirical Experiments

author.name: Abhinav Sharma, Zijun He, Danjue Chen

entry.summary: Introduces the NC-tALC Dataset capturing high-fidelity trajectory data of transitional autonomous vehicles during lane-changing maneuvers, including controlled experiments with both AV-initiated and human-initiated interactions.

entry.title: Unsupervised domain adaptation for radioisotope identification in gamma spectroscopy

author.name: Peter Lalor, Ayush Panigrahy, Alex Hagen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that unsupervised domain adaptation can improve radioisotope identification models trained on synthetic gamma spectroscopy data when deployed to new operational environments, using unlabeled target domain data.

entry.title: From Phase Grounding to Intelligent Surgical Narratives

author.name: Ethan Peterson, Huixin Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes a CLIP-based multi-modal framework for automatically creating surgical timelines and narratives from surgical videos by aligning video frames with textual gesture descriptions.

entry.title: NERdME: a Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Indexing Research Artifacts in Code Repositories

author.name: Genet Asefa Gesese, Zongxiong Chen, Shufan Jiang, Mary Ann Tan, Zhaotai Liu, Sonja Schimmler, Harald Sack

entry.summary: Introduces NERdME, a named entity recognition dataset of 200 annotated README files with 10K+ labeled spans across 10 entity types, designed to extract implementation-level research artifacts from code repositories.

entry.title: First-Order Softmax Weighted Switching Gradient Method for Distributed Stochastic Minimax Optimization with Stochastic Constraints

author.name: Zhankun Luo, Antesh Upadhyay, Sang Bin Moon, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Proposes a first-order Softmax-Weighted Switching Gradient method for distributed stochastic minimax optimization with stochastic constraints, achieving standard oracle complexity bounds under full and partial client participation in federated learning.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM Alignment With Human Trust Models

author.name: Anushka Debnath, Stephen Cranefield, Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu, Emiliano Lorini

entry.summary: Performs white-box analysis of trust representation in GPT-J-6B using contrastive prompting and activation space analysis. Maps trust concepts from five human trust models to LLM internal representations via cosine similarity of embeddings.

entry.title: Towards Driver Behavior Understanding: Weakly-Supervised Risk Perception in Driving Scenes

author.name: Nakul Agarwal, Yi-Ting Chen, Behzad Dariush

entry.summary: Introduces RAID, a large-scale dataset for driver risk perception with 4,691 annotated video clips covering diverse traffic scenarios with labels for maneuvers, risk situations, driver responses, and pedestrian attentiveness.

entry.title: Beyond Static Frames: Temporal Aggregate-and-Restore Vision Transformer for Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Hongwei Fang, Jiahang Cai, Xun Wang, Wenwu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes TAR-ViTPose, a temporal aggregate-and-restore Vision Transformer for video-based 2D human pose estimation that aggregates temporal cues across frames in a plug-and-play manner for more robust predictions.

entry.title: Implicit Style Conditioning: A Structured Style-Rewrite Framework for Low-Resource Character Modeling

author.name: Chanhui Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a structured style-rewrite framework for character modeling in small LMs, disentangling style into lexical signatures, syntactic patterns, and pragmatic style, with implicit style conditioning via CoT distillation.

entry.title: PROBE: Probabilistic Occupancy BEV Encoding with Analytical Translation Robustness for 3D Place Recognition

author.name: Jinseop Lee, Byoungho Lee, Gichul Yoo

entry.summary: Presents PROBE, a learning-free LiDAR place recognition descriptor using Bernoulli occupancy modeling in BEV with analytical translation robustness via polar Jacobian, enabling cross-sensor generalization.

entry.title: Breaking Smooth-Motion Assumptions: A UAV Benchmark for Multi-Object Tracking in Complex and Adverse Conditions

author.name: Jingtao Ye, Kexin Zhang, Xunchi Ma, Yuehan Li, Guangming Zhu, Peiyi Shen, Linhua Jiang, Xiangdong Zhang, Liang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DynUAV, a benchmark for dynamic UAV-perspective multi-object tracking with 42 video sequences and 1.7M bounding box annotations, featuring intense ego-motion and complex apparent trajectories.

entry.title: MagRobot:An Open Simulator for Magnetically Navigated Robots

author.name: Heng Wang (1), Haoyu Song (1), Jiatao Zheng (1), Yuxiang Han (1), Kunli Wang (1) ((1) South China University of Technology)

entry.summary: Proposes MagRobot, the first universal open-source simulation platform for magnetically navigated robots, supporting both magnetic tracking and actuation systems for minimally invasive medicine applications.

entry.title: Sensitivity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Intent Clarification

author.name: Maik Larooij

entry.summary: Explores sensitivity-aware retrieval-augmented intent clarification for conversational search, addressing the challenge of protecting sensitive information in retrieval databases during the clarification process.

entry.title: A Hazard-Informed Data Pipeline for Robotics Physical Safety

author.name: Alexei Odinokov and Rostislav Yavorskiy

entry.summary: Presents a hazard-informed data pipeline for robotics physical safety, bridging classical risk engineering with ML through explicit asset declaration, vulnerability enumeration, and hazard-driven synthetic data generation.

entry.title: Dual-Agent Multiple-Model Reinforcement Learning for Event-Triggered Human-Robot Co-Adaptation in Decoupled Task Spaces

author.name: Yaqi Li, Zhengqi Han, Huifang Liu and Steven W.Su

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-agent RL framework for shared-control rehabilitation robotics that decomposes reaching tasks into decoupled spatial axes with event-driven progression to avoid trajectory oscillations.

entry.title: Contrastive-to-Self-Supervised: A Two-Stage Framework for Script Similarity Learning

author.name: Claire Roman and Philippe Meyer

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage contrastive-to-self-supervised framework for learning script similarity, training on labeled invented alphabets then distilling to historical scripts through teacher-student transfer.

entry.title: Point-Supervised Skeleton-Based Human Action Segmentation

author.name: Hongsong Wang, Yiqin Shen, Pengbo Yan, Jie Gui

entry.summary: Introduces a point-supervised framework for skeleton-based action segmentation where only a single frame per action segment is labeled. Uses multimodal skeleton data and proposes a prototype similarity method for generating pseudo-labels.

entry.title: KISS-IMU: Self-supervised Inertial Odometry with Motion-balanced Learning and Uncertainty-aware Inference

author.name: Jiwon Choi, Hogyun Kim, Geonmo Yang, Juhui Lee, Younggun Cho

entry.summary: KISS-IMU proposes a self-supervised inertial odometry framework that eliminates ground truth dependency by using LiDAR-based ICP registration as a supervisory signal. Features motion-aware balanced training and uncertainty-driven inference for robust performance.

entry.title: Word-Anchored Temporal Forgery Localization

author.name: Tianyi Wang and Xi Shao and Harry Cheng and Yinglong Wang and Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: WAFL proposes a novel paradigm for temporal forgery localization that shifts from temporal regression to discrete word-level binary classification, aligning detection with natural linguistic boundaries of speech to reduce computational cost and improve accuracy.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Climate Adaptation: Reinforcement Learning for Climate Change-Resilient Transport

author.name: Miguel Costa, Arthur Vandervoort, Carolin Schmidt, Jo\~ao Miranda, Morten W. Petersen, Martin Drews, Karyn Morrisey, Francisco C. Pereira

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based decision-support framework for long-term flood adaptation planning in urban transportation, formulated as an integrated assessment model combining rainfall projection, flood modeling, and transport simulation.

entry.title: Learning Where the Physics Is: Probabilistic Adaptive Sampling for Stiff PDEs

author.name: Akshay Govind Srinivasan, Balaji Srinivasan

entry.summary: GMM-PIELM introduces a probabilistic framework that learns the location of important physics features for adaptively sampling kernel centers of Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machines, using EM to concentrate basis functions in high-error regions.

entry.title: Adaptive Lipschitz-Free Conditional Gradient Methods for Stochastic Composite Nonconvex Optimization

author.name: Ganzhao Yuan

entry.summary: ALFCG proposes the first adaptive projection-free framework for stochastic composite nonconvex optimization that requires neither global smoothness constants nor line search, using self-normalized accumulators for local smoothness estimation.

entry.title: MoEMambaMIL: Structure-Aware Selective State Space Modeling for Whole-Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Dongqing Xie, Yonghuang Wu

entry.summary: MoEMambaMIL combines state space models with mixture-of-experts for whole-slide image analysis, using region-nested selective scanning to exploit the spatial hierarchy of multi-resolution WSI data.

entry.title: Prompt Group-Aware Training for Robust Text-Guided Nuclei Segmentation

author.name: Yonghuang Wu, Zhenyang Liang, Wenwen Zeng, Xuan Xie, Jinhua Yu

entry.summary: Proposes prompt group-aware training for robust text-guided nuclei segmentation using SAM3, addressing sensitivity to prompt formulation through group-wise consistency constraints and quality-guided regularization.

entry.title: From Prompting to Preference Optimization: A Comparative Study of LLM-based Automated Essay Scoring

author.name: Minh Hoang Nguyen, Vu Hoang Pham, Xuan Thanh Huynh, Phuc Hong Mai, Vinh The Nguyen, Quang Nhut Huynh, Huy Tien Nguyen, Tung Le

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive comparison of LLM-based approaches for Automated Essay Scoring on IELTS Writing Task 2, evaluating encoder-based fine-tuning, prompting, instruction tuning with RAG, and SFT+DPO+RAG. Finds clear accuracy-cost-robustness trade-offs across methods.

entry.title: Toward Generative Quantum Utility via Correlation-Complexity Map

author.name: Chen-Yu Liu, Leonardo Placidi, Eric Brunner, Enrico Rinaldi

entry.summary: Proposes a Correlation-Complexity Map as a diagnostic tool to determine when real-world data is structurally suited for IQP-type quantum generative models. Introduces two indicators (QCLI and CCI) to characterize data-model alignment for quantum machine learning.

entry.title: A Unified Low-Dimensional Design Embedding for Joint Optimization of Shape, Material, and Actuation in Soft Robots

author.name: Vittorio Candiello, Manuel Mekkattu, Mike Y. Michelis, Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Introduces a unified low-dimensional design embedding for soft robot optimization that jointly handles shape, material, and actuation in a single parameter space. Uses continuous deformation maps and spatial fields to enable gradient-free optimization of complex soft robot designs.

entry.title: SCAN: Visual Explanations with Self-Confidence and Analysis Networks

author.name: Gwanghee Lee, Sungyoon Jeong, Kyoungson Jhang

entry.summary: Introduces SCAN, a universal visual explanation framework using AutoEncoder-based feature reconstruction for both CNNs and Transformers. Aims to bridge the gap between high-fidelity architecture-specific XAI methods and broadly applicable universal ones.

entry.title: Modeling and Measuring Redundancy in Multisource Multimodal Data for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yuhan Zhou, Mehri Sattari, Haihua Chen, Kewei Sha

entry.summary: Models and measures data redundancy in autonomous driving datasets across multiple sensors and modalities. Shows that selectively removing redundant labels can improve YOLOv8 detection performance, highlighting data quality over quantity.

entry.title: Bayesian Additive Distribution Regression

author.name: Antonio R. Linero and Soumyabrata Bose and Jared Murray

entry.summary: Introduces DistBART, a Bayesian nonparametric approach to distribution regression using BART priors. Models regression from distribution-valued predictors to scalar responses, showing that shallow tree ensembles encode appropriate inductive biases for such problems.

entry.title: On The Independence Axiom

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: A lengthy essay drawing parallels between the Independence Axiom in decision theory and Euclid's parallel postulate in geometry, arguing that the Independence Axiom may similarly be a non-necessary assumption that opens interesting alternatives when relaxed.

entry.title: Edges Are All You Need: Robust Gait Recognition via Label-Free Structure

author.name: Chao Zhang, Zhuang Zheng, Ruixin Li, Zhanyong Mei

entry.summary: Proposes using edge-based representations for gait recognition that capture structural details without requiring semantic parsing labels, offering a label-free alternative between sparse silhouettes and parser-dependent methods.

entry.title: Vision-Language System using Open-Source LLMs for Gestures in Medical Interpreter Robots

author.name: Thanh-Tung Ngo, Emma Murphy, Robert J. Ross

entry.summary: Presents a privacy-preserving vision-language framework for medical interpreter robots that detects speech acts (consent, instruction) and generates corresponding robotic gestures using locally deployed open-source LLMs.

entry.title: Unify the Views: View-Consistent Prototype Learning for Few-Shot Segmentation

author.name: Hongli Liu, Yu Wang, Shengjie Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces VINE for few-shot segmentation with view-consistent prototype learning using spatial-view graphs that connect features from different perspectives and propagate view-invariant structural semantics.

entry.title: Towards High-resolution and Disentangled Reference-based Sketch Colorization

author.name: Dingkun Yan, Xinrui Wang, Ru Wang, Zhuoru Li, Jinze Yu, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Jiaxian Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-branch framework for reference-based sketch colorization that explicitly models distribution shift between training and inference by handling semantic-aligned and semantic-misaligned branches separately.

entry.title: WMoE-CLIP: Wavelet-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Prompt Learning for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Peng Chen, Chao Huang

entry.summary: WMoE-CLIP proposes wavelet-enhanced mixture-of-experts prompt learning for zero-shot anomaly detection, using wavelet decomposition for multi-frequency features and variational autoencoder for global semantic representations in prompts.

entry.title: REACT++: Efficient Cross-Attention for Real-Time Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Ma\"elic Neau and Zoe Falomir

entry.summary: REACT++ proposes efficient cross-attention for real-time scene graph generation, balancing relation prediction accuracy, object detection accuracy, and inference speed simultaneously.

entry.title: From Toil to Thought: Designing for Strategic Exploration and Responsible AI in Systematic Literature Reviews

author.name: Runlong Ye, Naaz Sibia, Angela Zavaleta Bernuy, Tingting Zhu, Carolina Nobre, Viktoria Pammer-Schindler, Michael Liut

entry.summary: Conducts a design study with 20 researchers to identify pain points in systematic literature reviews, then develops ARC, a design probe with multi-database integration, transparent iterative search, and verifiable AI assistance.

entry.title: Control Lyapunov Functions for Underactuated Soft Robots

author.name: Huy Pham, Zach J. Patterson

entry.summary: Presents a control Lyapunov function framework for task-space regulation and tracking of underactuated soft robots under bounded inputs, validated on multiple platforms with increasing underactuation.

entry.title: Interpretable Motion Artificat Detection in structural Brain MRI

author.name: Naveetha Nithianandam, Prabhjot Kaur, Anil Kumar Sao

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight framework for detecting motion artifacts in brain MRI using 3D Discriminative Histogram of Gradient Magnitude features with a parallel 2D/3D decision strategy, avoiding deep learning's generalization issues.

entry.title: Tutor Move Taxonomy: A Theory-Aligned Framework for Analyzing Instructional Moves in Tutoring

author.name: Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Tamisha Thompson, Jennifer St John, Rene Kizilcec

entry.summary: Presents a theory-aligned tutor move taxonomy for large-scale analysis of tutoring dialogue, developed through hybrid deductive-inductive process synthesizing cognitive science, learning sciences, and intelligent tutoring systems research.

entry.title: InnoAds-Composer: Efficient Condition Composition for E-Commerce Poster Generation

author.name: Yuxin Qin, Ke Cao, Haowei Liu, Ao Ma, Fengheng Li, Honghe Zhu, Zheng Zhang, Run Ling, Wei Feng, Xuanhua He, Zhanjie Zhang, Zhen Guo, Haoyi Bian, Jingjing Lv, Junjie Shen, Ching Law

entry.summary: Proposes InnoAds-Composer, a single-stage framework for e-commerce poster generation with simultaneous control over subject, text, and style using tri-conditional control tokens, addressing issues with multi-stage pipeline approaches.

entry.title: Weak-SIGReg: Covariance Regularization for Stable Deep Learning

author.name: Habibullah Akbar

entry.summary: Proposes Weak-SIGReg, a covariance regularization method repurposed from self-supervised learning to stabilize supervised training, particularly for low-bias architectures like ViTs in low-data regimes.

entry.title: Evaluating Austrian A-Level German Essays with Large Language Models for Automated Essay Scoring

author.name: Jonas Kubesch, Lena Huber, Clemens Havas

entry.summary: Evaluates open-weight LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, Mixtral, Llama3.3) for automated essay scoring on Austrian A-level German texts, finding moderate inter-rater reliability with human graders.

entry.title: Ensemble Graph Neural Networks for Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting via Input Perturbations

author.name: Alejandro J. Gonz\'alez-Santana and Giovanny A. Cuervo-Londo\~no and Javier S\'anchez

entry.summary: Investigates ensemble GNN strategies for sea surface temperature forecasting, using inference-time input perturbations (Gaussian, Perlin, fractal noise) for uncertainty quantification without retraining.

entry.title: 3D CBCT Artefact Removal Using Perpendicular Score-Based Diffusion Models

author.name: Susanne Schaub, Florentin Bieder, Matheus L. Oliveira, Yulan Wang, Dorothea Dagassan-Berndt, Michael M. Bornstein, Philippe C. Cattin

entry.summary: Proposes perpendicular score-based diffusion models for 3D CBCT artifact removal that model correlations across projections, rather than treating each 2D projection independently. Addresses dental implant artifacts in cone-beam CT imaging.

entry.title: P-SLCR: Unsupervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation via Prototypes Structure Learning and Consistent Reasoning

author.name: Lixin Zhan, Jie Jiang, Tianjian Zhou, Yukun Du, Yan Zheng, Xuehu Duan

entry.summary: P-SLCR proposes prototype library-driven unsupervised point cloud semantic segmentation using structure learning and consistent reasoning. Addresses the challenge of unsupervised segmentation without annotation or pre-training.

entry.title: KCLarity at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Encoder and Zero-Shot Approaches to Political Evasion Detection

author.name: Archie Sage, Salvatore Greco

entry.summary: Describes the KCLarity team's SemEval-2026 submission for detecting political evasion and ambiguity, comparing encoder-based models and zero-shot GPT-5.2. Finds RoBERTa-large wins on public test but GPT-5.2 generalizes better on hidden evaluation data.

entry.title: Fly360: Omnidirectional Obstacle Avoidance within Drone View

author.name: Xiangkai Zhang and Dizhe Zhang and WenZhuo Cao and Zhaoliang Wan and Yingjie Niu and Lu Qi and Xu Yang and Zhiyong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Fly360, a two-stage framework for omnidirectional obstacle avoidance in panoramic drones. Addresses the limitation that most UAV obstacle avoidance methods only handle limited field-of-view, constructing a benchmark with three flight tasks.

entry.title: SORS: A Modular, High-Fidelity Simulator for Soft Robots

author.name: Manuel Mekkattu, Mike Y. Michelis and Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Presents SORS, a high-fidelity simulator for soft robots built on finite element methods, handling large nonlinear deformations, material incompressibility, and contact interactions in a modular framework.

entry.title: VDCook:DIY video data cook your MLLMs

author.name: Chengwei Wu

entry.summary: Introduces VDCook, a self-evolving video data construction platform where users specify needs via natural language and the system automatically retrieves and synthesizes in-domain video data with provenance tracking.

entry.title: Digital-Twin Losses for Lane-Compliant Trajectory Prediction at Urban Intersections

author.name: Kuo-Yi Chao, Erik Leo Ha{\ss}, Melina Gegg, Jiajie Zhang, Ralph Ra{\ss}hofer, Alois Christian Knoll

entry.summary: Creates a digital twin-driven V2X trajectory prediction pipeline using Bi-LSTM with a novel twin loss encoding infrastructure constraints, collision avoidance, and diversity for multi-agent motion forecasting.

entry.title: Learning Optimal Distributionally Robust Individualized Treatment Rules Integrating Multi-Source Data

author.name: Wenhai Cui, Wen Su and Xingqiu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes PDRO-ITR for learning distributionally robust individualized treatment rules from multi-source data, addressing posterior shift with covariate-dependent uncertainty sets and deriving closed-form solutions.

entry.title: RFM-HRI : A Multimodal Dataset of Medical Robot Failure, User Reaction and Recovery Preferences for Item Retrieval Tasks

author.name: Yashika Batra, Giuliano Pioldi, Promise Ekpo, Arman Sayatqyzy, Purnjay Maruur, Shalom Otieno, Kevin Ching, Angelique Taylor

entry.summary: Presents RFM-HRI, a multimodal dataset capturing human responses to robot communication failures in healthcare-inspired item retrieval tasks, with 41 participants across lab and hospital settings.

entry.title: Environment-Aware Path Generation for Robotic Additive Manufacturing of Structures

author.name: Mahsa Rabiei, Reza Moini

entry.summary: Proposes an environment-aware path generation framework for robotic additive manufacturing that generates toolpaths online using search-based and sampling-based planning algorithms, adapting to obstacles in dynamic construction environments.

entry.title: The Coordination Gap: Alternation Metrics for Temporal Dynamics in Multi-Agent Battle of the Exes

author.name: Nikolaos Al. Papadopoulos, Konstantinos Psannis

entry.summary: Introduces alternation metrics for multi-agent coordination in Battle of the Exes games, showing that conventional outcome-based metrics are temporally blind and proposing Perfect Alternation as a reference coordination regime.

entry.title: Expert Knowledge-driven Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Racing via Trajectory Guidance and Dynamics Constraints

author.name: Bo Leng, Weiqi Zhang, Zhuoren Li, Lu Xiong, Guizhe Jin, Ran Yu, Chen Lv

entry.summary: Proposes TraD-RL for autonomous racing, combining trajectory guidance from expert racing lines with dynamics constraints via control barrier functions to stabilize RL training. Addresses training instability in high-dynamics racing environments.

entry.title: Iterative Convex Optimization with Control Barrier Functions for Obstacle Avoidance among Polytopes

author.name: Shuo Liu and Zhe Huang and Calin A. Belta

entry.summary: Proposes a novel iterative convex MPC-DCBF framework for obstacle avoidance between polytopic robots and obstacles, using supporting hyperplanes from exact closest-point computations rather than smooth geometric approximations.

entry.title: OD-RASE: Ontology-Driven Risk Assessment and Safety Enhancement for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kota Shimomura, Masaki Nambata, Atsuya Ishikawa, Ryota Mimura, Takayuki Kawabuchi, Takayoshi Yamashita, Koki Inoue

entry.summary: Proposes OD-RASE, a framework combining ontology-based road knowledge with LLM-generated infrastructure improvement proposals to proactively enhance autonomous driving safety by identifying accident-prone road structures.

entry.title: RODEO: RObotic DEcentralized Organization

author.name: Milan Groshev, Eduardo Castell\'o Ferrer

entry.summary: Proposes RODEO, a blockchain-based framework for robot accountability using Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs), including a ROS-ETH bridge and proof-verification mechanisms for auditable robot actions.

entry.title: Aggregative Semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks

author.name: Yann Munro, Isabelle Bloch, Marie-Jeanne Lesot

entry.summary: Introduces aggregative semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks, proposing separate aggregation of attackers and supporters through a three-stage computation process.

entry.title: Adaptive Language-Aware Image Reflection Removal Network

author.name: Siyan Fang, Yuntao Wang, Jinpu Zhang, Ziwen Li and Yuehuan Wang

entry.summary: ALANet proposes an adaptive language-aware network for image reflection removal that handles inaccurate machine-generated language descriptions by integrating filtering and optimization strategies. This addresses a practical gap where language guidance helps but noisy descriptions from VLMs can harm performance.

entry.title: GazeMoE: Perception of Gaze Target with Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Zhuangzhuang Dai, Zhongxi Lu, Vincent G. Zakka, Luis J. Manso, Jose M Alcaraz Calero, Chen Li

entry.summary: GazeMoE proposes a Mixture-of-Experts framework for gaze target estimation that selectively leverages gaze-related cues from a frozen vision foundation model, addressing multi-modal cue integration for understanding human attention.

entry.title: Learning to Solve Orienteering Problem with Time Windows and Variable Profits

author.name: Songqun Gao, Zanxi Ruan, Patrick Floor, Marco Roveri, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli

entry.summary: DeCoST proposes a learning-based two-stage approach for the orienteering problem with time windows and variable profits, decoupling discrete and continuous optimization with parallel decoding and linear programming refinement.

entry.title: Attribute Distribution Modeling and Semantic-Visual Alignment for Generative Zero-shot Learning

author.name: Haojie Pu, Zhuoming Li, Yongbiao Gao, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: ADiVA proposes attribute distribution modeling and semantic-visual alignment for generative zero-shot learning, addressing the class-instance gap and semantic-visual domain gap through attribute distribution modeling and explicit alignment.

entry.title: Tiny, Hardware-Independent, Compression-based Classification

author.name: Charles Meyers, Aaron MacSween, Erik Elmroth, Tommy L\"ofstedt

entry.summary: Proposes compression-based classification as a privacy-preserving, hardware-independent alternative to deep learning for client-side data analysis, addressing privacy concerns in machine learning.

entry.title: Kinetic-based regularization: Learning spatial derivatives and PDE applications

author.name: Abhisek Ganguly, Santosh Ansumali, Sauro Succi

entry.summary: Extends kinetic-based regularization for learning spatial derivatives from noisy discrete data with provable second-order accuracy. Proposes explicit and implicit schemes showing quadratic convergence matching finite difference for clean data with superior noise robustness.

entry.title: A Reference Architecture of Reinforcement Learning Frameworks

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Proposes a reference architecture for reinforcement learning frameworks by analyzing 18 state-of-the-practice RL frameworks using grounded theory. Identifies recurring components and relationships, codifying them into a unified architectural reference.

entry.title: Semantics-Aware Caching for Concept Learning

author.name: Louis Mozart Kamdem Teyou, Caglar Demir, Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo

entry.summary: Presents a semantics-aware caching approach for concept learning in description logics that uses subsumption-aware maps to cache instance retrieval results. Dramatically reduces runtime for symbolic concept learners through crisp set operations on cached results.

entry.title: LiveSense: A Real-Time Wi-Fi Sensing Platform for Range-Doppler on COTS Laptop

author.name: Jessica Sanson, Rahul C. Shah, Maximilian Pinaroc, Cagri Tanriover and Valerio Frascolla

entry.summary: Presents LiveSense, a platform that transforms commercial Wi-Fi NICs on laptops into centimeter-level range-Doppler sensors while preserving communication capability. Demonstrates real-time sensing of distance, velocity, and micro-motion using Intel Wi-Fi 6E/7 hardware.

entry.title: Verify as You Go: An LLM-Powered Browser Extension for Fake News Detection

author.name: Dorsaf Sallami, Esma A\"imeur

entry.summary: Introduces Aletheia, a browser extension using RAG and LLMs for fake news detection with evidence-based explanations, including a Discussion Hub and fact-check surfacing features.

entry.title: Full Dynamic Range Sky-Modelling For Image Based Lighting

author.name: Ian J. Maquignaz

entry.summary: Addresses full dynamic range sky modeling for image-based lighting, tackling the challenge of accurately representing the 14EV+ solar region that DNN models struggle with at higher resolutions.

entry.title: CollabOD: Collaborative Multi-Backbone with Cross-scale Vision for UAV Small Object Detection

author.name: Xuecheng Bai, Yuxiang Wang, Chuanzhi Xu, Boyu Hu, Kang Han, Ruijie Pan, Xiaowei Niu, Xiaotian Guan, Liqiang Fu, Pengfei Ye

entry.summary: Proposes CollabOD, a lightweight collaborative detection framework for UAV small object detection that preserves structural details and aligns heterogeneous feature streams before multi-scale fusion.

entry.title: Proprioceptive Shape Estimation of Tensegrity Manipulators Using Energy Minimisation

author.name: Tufail Ahmad Bhat and Shuhei Ikemoto

entry.summary: Demonstrates shape estimation for tensegrity manipulators using only strut inclination angles relative to gravity via energy minimization, requiring only simple IMU sensors.

entry.title: An Interactive Multi-Agent System for Evaluation of New Product Concepts

author.name: Bin Xuan, Ruo Ai, Hakyeon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based multi-agent system for product concept evaluation with eight specialized virtual agents using RAG and real-time search, evaluating technical and market feasibility.

entry.title: Ensemble Learning with Sparse Hypercolumns

author.name: Julia Dietlmeier, Vayangi Ganepola, Oluwabukola G. Adegboro, Mayug Maniparambil, Claudia Mazo and Noel E. O'Connor

entry.summary: Investigates ensemble learning on sparse hypercolumns from CNNs for image segmentation, applying stratified subsampling to reduce computational complexity while maintaining performance on brain tumor segmentation.

entry.title: FedSCS-XGB -- Federated Server-centric surrogate XGBoost for continual health monitoring

author.name: Felix Walger, Mehdi Ejtehadi, Anke Schmeink, Diego Paez-Granados

entry.summary: FedSCS-XGB presents a federated XGBoost protocol for human activity recognition from wearable sensors, designed for spinal cord injury monitoring. Preserves key XGBoost properties while enabling distributed learning across devices.

entry.title: ODD-SEC: Onboard Drone Detection with a Spinning Event Camera

author.name: Kuan Dai, Hongxin Zhang, Sheng Zhong, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: ODD-SEC proposes onboard drone detection using a spinning event camera, leveraging event cameras' high dynamic range and microsecond responsiveness for detecting fast-moving drones in challenging illumination conditions.

entry.title: Enhanced Protein Intrinsic Disorder Prediction Through Dual-View Multiscale Features and Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm

author.name: Shaokuan Wang, Pengshan Cui, Yining Qian, An-Yang Lu, Xianpeng Wang

entry.summary: D2MOE proposes a dual-view multiscale approach for protein intrinsic disorder prediction, combining evolutionary and deep semantic views with multi-objective evolutionary optimization for feature fusion.

entry.title: Safe Consensus of Cooperative Manipulation with Hierarchical Event-Triggered Control Barrier Functions

author.name: Simiao Zhuang and Bingkun Huang and Zewen Yang

entry.summary: Presents a distributed control framework for cooperative multi-manipulator transport using hierarchical event-triggered control barrier functions, enabling safe consensus coordination with limited communication.

entry.title: Computer vision-based estimation of invertebrate biomass

author.name: Mikko Impi\"o, Philipp M. Rehsen, Jarrett Blair, Cecilie Mielec, Arne J. Beermann, Florian Leese, Toke T. H{\o}ye, Jenni Raitoharju

entry.summary: Proposes computer vision approaches for estimating invertebrate biomass from images, including linear models with novel predictors and end-to-end deep networks with multi-view architectures, to replace destructive dry weighing.

entry.title: Solving Jigsaw Puzzles in the Wild: Human-Guided Reconstruction of Cultural Heritage Fragments

author.name: Omidreza Safaei, Sinem Aslan, Sebastiano Vascon, Luca Palmieri, Marina Khoroshiltseva, Marcello Pelillo

entry.summary: Proposes a human-in-the-loop jigsaw puzzle solving framework for archaeological artifact reconstruction, integrating automatic relaxation-labeling with interactive human guidance for the large-scale RePAIR benchmark.
