author.name: Yuan Liang, Ruobin Zhong, Haoming Xu, Chen Jiang, Yi Zhong, Runnan Fang, Jia-Chen Gu, Shumin Deng, Yunzhi Yao, Mengru Wang, Shuofei Qiao, Xin Xu, Tongtong Wu, Kun Wang, Yang Liu, Zhen Bi, Jungang Lou, Yuchen Eleanor Jiang, Hangcheng Zhu, Gang Yu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Chenxi Wang, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, Xi Chen, Zhaopeng Tu, Feiyu Xiong, Xin Xie, Peng Zhang, Zhengke Gui, Lei Liang, Jun Zhou, Chiyu Wu, Jin Shang, Yu Gong, Junyu Lin, Changliang Xu, Hongjie Deng, Wen Zhang, Keyan Ding, Qiang Zhang, Fei Huang, Ningyu Zhang, Jeff Z. Pan, Guilin Qi, Haofen Wang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: SkillNet introduces an open infrastructure for creating, evaluating, and organizing AI agent skills at scale using a unified ontology. It addresses the problem of agents repeatedly rediscovering solutions by enabling systematic skill accumulation and transfer across heterogeneous sources.

entry.title: When Agents Persuade: Propaganda Generation and Mitigation in LLMs

author.name: Julia Jose, Ritik Roongta, Rachel Greenstadt

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs can be exploited to generate propaganda, analyzing outputs using domain-specific classification models. Explores mitigation via SFT, DPO, and ORPO fine-tuning approaches to reduce propagandistic behaviors.

entry.title: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks

author.name: ELita Lobo, Xu Chen, Jingjing Meng, Nan Xi, Yang Jiao, Chirag Agarwal, Yair Zick, Yan Gao

entry.summary: STRUCTUREDAGENT uses dynamic AND/OR trees for hierarchical planning in long-horizon web tasks, with structured memory for tracking candidate solutions. Addresses limited context memory and greedy behaviors in web agents.

entry.title: Building AI Coding Agents for the Terminal: Scaffolding, Harness, Context Engineering, and Lessons Learned

author.name: Nghi D. Q. Bui

entry.summary: OPENDEV is an open-source CLI-based coding agent with workload-specialized model routing, dual-agent architecture, and context management designed for terminal-native development workflows.

entry.title: CTRL-RAG: Contrastive Likelihood Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Context-Faithful RAG Models

author.name: Zhehao Tan, Yihan Jiao, Dan Yang, Junjie Wang, Duolin Sun, Jie Feng, Xidong Wang, Lei Liu, Yue Shen, Jian Wang, Jinjie Gu

entry.summary: CTRL-RAG proposes an internal-external hybrid reward framework for training RAG models using contrastive likelihood rewards, addressing the lack of RAG-specific self-reward mechanisms and hallucination accumulation.

entry.title: On Emergences of Non-Classical Statistical Characteristics in Classical Neural Networks

author.name: Hanyu Zhao, Yang Wu, Yuexian Hou

entry.summary: Proposes NCnet, a classical neural architecture that exhibits non-classical statistical behaviors (violating CHSH inequality) through gradient competition among shared hidden-layer neurons in multi-task settings. Shows non-local correlations emerge without explicit communication.

entry.title: How Professional Visual Artists are Negotiating Generative AI in the Workplace

author.name: Harry H. Jiang, Jordan Taylor, William Agnew

entry.summary: Survey of 378 verified professional visual artists on generative AI's impact on their careers. Finds most artists strongly oppose GenAI, employ refusal strategies, face pressure from clients/bosses, and report overwhelmingly negative career impacts.

entry.title: Why the Brain Consolidates: Predictive Forgetting for Optimal Generalisation

author.name: Zafeirios Fountas, Adnan Oomerjee, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Jun Wang, Neil Burgess

entry.summary: Proposes that memory consolidation in the brain optimizes stored representations for generalization via 'predictive forgetting' - selectively retaining information that predicts future outcomes. Shows this formally improves information-theoretic generalization bounds.

entry.title: Free Lunch for Pass@$k$? Low Cost Diverse Sampling for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Sean Lamont, Christian Walder, Paul Montague, Amir Dezfouli, Michael Norrish

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free intervention to enhance diversity in diffusion language models for Pass@k problems, modifying intermediate samples to reduce mode collapse and redundant failure modes.

entry.title: VPWEM: Non-Markovian Visuomotor Policy with Working and Episodic Memory

author.name: Yuheng Lei, Zhixuan Liang, Hongyuan Zhang, Ping Luo

entry.summary: VPWEM introduces a visuomotor policy that equips robots with working and episodic memory to handle non-Markovian tasks requiring long-term memory, inspired by human memory systems. This addresses a key limitation of current imitation learning approaches that rely on short-context histories.

entry.title: Escaping the Hydrolysis Trap: An Agentic Workflow for Inverse Design of Durable Photocatalytic Covalent Organic Frameworks

author.name: Iman Peivaste, Nicolas D. Boscher, Ahmed Makradi, Salim Belouettar

entry.summary: Introduces Ara, an LLM agent that designs photocatalytic covalent organic frameworks satisfying band-gap, band-edge, and hydrolytic stability criteria, navigating the combinatorial space of chemical building blocks using pretrained chemical knowledge.

entry.title: WavSLM: Single-Stream Speech Language Modeling via WavLM Distillation

author.name: Luca Della Libera, Cem Subakan, Mirco Ravanelli

entry.summary: WavSLM is a speech language model that jointly models semantic and acoustic information in a single token stream through WavLM distillation, moving toward the simple autoregressive paradigm that works well for text.

entry.title: Leveraging LLM Parametric Knowledge for Fact Checking without Retrieval

author.name: Artem Vazhentsev, Maria Marina, Daniil Moskovskiy, Sergey Pletenev, Mikhail Seleznyov, Mikhail Salnikov, Elena Tutubalina, Vasily Konovalov, Irina Nikishina, Alexander Panchenko, Viktor Moskvoretskii

entry.summary: Proposes fact-checking without retrieval by leveraging LLMs' parametric knowledge, introducing a benchmark and studying models' intrinsic fact-verification capabilities independent of external data.

entry.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Multi--Task Learning: Implicit Regularization and Double Descent Effects

author.name: Ayed M. Alrashdi, Oussama Dhifallah, Houssem Sifaou

entry.summary: Provides precise asymptotic analysis of multi-task learning showing that combining tasks is equivalent to traditional formulation with additional regularization and double descent effects.

entry.title: On the Necessity of Learnable Sheaf Laplacians

author.name: Ferran Hernandez Caralt, Mar Gonz\`alez i Catal\`a, Adri\'an Bazaga, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Investigates whether learnable sheaf Laplacians in Sheaf Neural Networks are necessary, finding that simpler constructions with residual connections may suffice to address oversmoothing.

entry.title: A Fast Generative Framework for High-dimensional Posterior Sampling: Application to CMB Delensing

author.name: Hadi Sotoudeh, Pablo Lemos, Laurence Perreault-Levasseur

entry.summary: Introduces a deep generative framework for high-dimensional Bayesian inference that enables posterior sampling an order of magnitude faster than diffusion baselines, applied to CMB delensing.

entry.title: Spinverse: Differentiable Physics for Permeability-Aware Microstructure Reconstruction from Diffusion MRI

author.name: Prathamesh Pradeep Khole, Mario M. Brenes, Zahra Kais Petiwala, Ehsan Mirafzali, Utkarsh Gupta, Jing-Rebecca Li, Andrada Ianus, Razvan Marinescu

entry.summary: Presents Spinverse, a permeability-aware microstructure reconstruction method that inverts diffusion MRI through a fully differentiable Bloch-Torrey simulator, learning face permeabilities on tetrahedral meshes.

entry.title: The Impact of Preprocessing Methods on Racial Encoding and Model Robustness in CXR Diagnosis

author.name: Dishantkumar Sutariya, Eike Petersen

entry.summary: Investigates how image preprocessing methods affect racial shortcut learning in deep learning models for chest X-ray diagnosis. Addresses concern that models can identify racial identity from CXRs and may use this as a biased diagnostic shortcut.

entry.title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies

author.name: Hokyun Im, Andrey Kolobov, Jianlong Fu, Youngwoon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Policy Steering (LPS) for offline reinforcement learning that enables high-fidelity policy improvement by backpropagating original-action-space critics through a one-step flow decoder, avoiding lossy latent-space critic approximations.

entry.title: Autoscoring Anticlimax: A Meta-analytic Understanding of AI's Short-answer Shortcomings and Wording Weaknesses

author.name: Michael Hardy

entry.summary: Meta-analyzes 890 results across LLM short-answer scoring studies, finding that decoder-only architectures underperform encoders by 0.37 QWK and that task difficulty for humans has no statistical effect on LLM scoring performance.

entry.title: InverseNet: Benchmarking Operator Mismatch and Calibration Across Compressive Imaging Modalities

author.name: Chengshuai Yang, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces InverseNet, the first cross-modality benchmark for operator mismatch in compressive imaging, showing that deep learning methods lose 10-21 dB under mismatch and that performance and robustness are inversely correlated across modalities.

entry.title: PinPoint: Evaluation of Composed Image Retrieval with Explicit Negatives, Multi-Image Queries, and Paraphrase Testing

author.name: Rohan Mahadev, Joyce Yuan, Patrick Poirson, David Xue, Hao-Yu Wu, Dmitry Kislyuk

entry.summary: Presents PinPoint, a comprehensive composed image retrieval benchmark with 7,635 queries and 329K relevance judgments, supporting explicit hard negatives, instruction paraphrases, multi-image queries, and fairness evaluation.

entry.title: MASQuant: Modality-Aware Smoothing Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Lulu Hu, Wenhu Xiao, Xin Chen, Xinhua Xu, Bowen Xu, Kun Li, Yongliang Tao

entry.summary: Proposes MASQuant for multimodal LLM quantization, learning modality-specific smoothing factors and using SVD-based cross-modal compensation to address issues when applying SmoothQuant to MLLMs.

entry.title: GloSplat: Joint Pose-Appearance Optimization for Faster and More Accurate 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Tianyu Xiong, Rui Li, Linjie Li, Jiaqi Yang

entry.summary: GloSplat jointly optimizes camera poses and 3D Gaussian Splatting appearance by maintaining explicit SfM feature tracks as persistent geometric anchors alongside photometric supervision. This bridges the gap between traditional SfM pipelines and neural rendering by preserving feature correspondences throughout training.

entry.title: Mario: Multimodal Graph Reasoning with Large Language Models

author.name: Yuanfu Sun, Kang Li, Pengkang Guo, Jiajin Liu, Qiaoyu Tan

entry.summary: Mario enables LLM-based reasoning on multimodal graphs where nodes have text and visual attributes, addressing weak cross-modal consistency and heterogeneous modality preferences through a unified framework.

entry.title: Frequency-Aware Error-Bounded Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Guandong Li

entry.summary: Proposes frequency-aware error-bounded caching for accelerating Diffusion Transformers, identifying three axes of non-uniformity (temporal, depth, feature) and adapting caching strategies accordingly.

entry.title: Beyond the Patch: Exploring Vulnerabilities of Visuomotor Policies via Viewpoint-Consistent 3D Adversarial Object

author.name: Chanmi Lee, Minsung Yoon, Woojae Kim, Sebin Lee, Sung-eui Yoon

entry.summary: Investigates adversarial vulnerabilities of visuomotor policies via viewpoint-consistent 3D adversarial textures optimized through differentiable rendering, demonstrating that 3D adversarial objects are more effective than 2D patches under dynamic viewpoints.

entry.title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers

author.name: Esteban Padilla, Boyang Sun, Marc Pollefeys, Hermann Blum

entry.summary: OpenFrontier formulates open-world navigation as sparse subgoal identification and reaching, using vision-language grounded frontiers to provide visual anchoring targets for semantic navigation without task-specific fine-tuning or interactive training.

entry.title: Salient Directions in AI Control

author.name: Bruce W. Lee

entry.summary: Provides a structured overview of AI Control as a research framework for extracting useful work from potentially misaligned AI agents. Identifies key open problems including multi-turn settings, monitor-agent collusion, deployment at scale, and integration with alignment techniques.

entry.title: Adaptive Memory Admission Control for LLM Agents

author.name: Guilin Zhang, Wei Jiang, Xiejiashan Wang, Aisha Behr, Kai Zhao, Jeffrey Friedman, Xu Chu, Amine Anoun

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Memory Admission Control (A-MAC) for LLM agents, treating memory admission as a structured decision problem with five interpretable factors. Addresses the problem of agents accumulating hallucinated or obsolete facts in long-term memory.

entry.title: CONE: Embeddings for Complex Numerical Data Preserving Unit and Variable Semantics

author.name: Gyanendra Shrestha, Anna Pyayt, Michael Gubanov

entry.summary: CONE introduces a hybrid transformer encoder that encodes numbers, ranges, and gaussians into embedding vectors while preserving distance relationships, addressing LLMs' weakness with numerical data by integrating units and attribute semantics.

entry.title: Bidirectional Curriculum Generation: A Multi-Agent Framework for Data-Efficient Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Boren Hu, Xiao Liu, Boci Peng, Xinping Zhao, Xiaoran Shang, Yun Zhu, Lijun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional curriculum learning for mathematical reasoning in LLMs, using a multi-agent ecosystem that dynamically generates problems by both increasing and decreasing complexity based on the model's current capabilities.

entry.title: SalamahBench: Toward Standardized Safety Evaluation for Arabic Language Models

author.name: Omar Abdelnasser, Fatemah Alharbi, Khaled Khasawneh, Ihsen Alouani, Mohammed E. Fouda

entry.summary: SalamaBench introduces a safety benchmark for Arabic language models with 8,170 prompts across 12 categories aligned with MLCommons Safety Hazard Taxonomy, addressing the gap in non-English safety evaluation.

entry.title: Agent Memory Below the Prompt: Persistent Q4 KV Cache for Multi-Agent LLM Inference on Edge Devices

author.name: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov

entry.summary: Addresses multi-agent LLM memory management on edge devices by persisting KV caches to disk in 4-bit quantized format, eliminating redundant prefill computation. On Apple M4 Pro, enables 10-agent workflows that would otherwise require constant cache eviction.

entry.title: TSEmbed: Unlocking Task Scaling in Universal Multimodal Embeddings

author.name: Yebo Wu, Feng Liu, Ziwei Xie, Zhiyuan Liu, Changwang Zhang, Jun Wang, Li Li

entry.summary: Proposes TSEmbed, a universal multimodal embedding framework combining MoE with LoRA to disentangle conflicting task objectives, plus Expert-Aware Negative Sampling for better hard negative selection.

entry.title: Multilevel Training for Kolmogorov Arnold Networks

author.name: Ben S. Southworth, Jonas A. Actor, Graham Harper, Eric C. Cyr

entry.summary: Develops multilevel training algorithms for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) by establishing equivalence between spline-basis KANs and multichannel MLPs, enabling training speedup through hierarchical optimization.

entry.title: Balancing Coverage and Draft Latency in Vocabulary Trimming for Faster Speculative Decoding

author.name: Ofir Ben Shoham

entry.summary: Addresses the coverage-latency trade-off in speculative decoding by trimming the draft model's vocabulary, balancing token coverage against draft generation speed.

entry.title: SurvHTE-Bench: A Benchmark for Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation in Survival Analysis

author.name: Shahriar Noroozizadeh, Xiaobin Shen, Jeremy C. Weiss, George H. Chen

entry.summary: SurvHTE-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark for heterogeneous treatment effect estimation with censored survival data, spanning synthetic and semi-synthetic datasets with systematic variation of causal assumptions.

entry.title: Machine Learning for Complex Systems Dynamics: Detecting Bifurcations in Dynamical Systems with Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Swadesh Pal, Roderick Melnik

entry.summary: Proposes equilibrium-informed neural networks (EINNs) for detecting critical transitions and bifurcations in complex dynamical systems, reversing the standard approach by using candidate equilibrium solutions to find critical parameters.

entry.title: Oracle-efficient Hybrid Learning with Constrained Adversaries

author.name: Princewill Okoroafor, Robert Kleinberg, Michael P. Kim

entry.summary: Studies oracle-efficient hybrid online learning where features are i.i.d. but labels are adversarial, achieving progress toward simultaneous statistical optimality and computational efficiency by constraining the adversary.

entry.title: Beyond Word Error Rate: Auditing the Diversity Tax in Speech Recognition through Dataset Cartography

author.name: Ting-Hui Cheng, Line H. Clemmensen, Sneha Das

entry.summary: Proposes sample difficulty index (SDI) for auditing ASR systems beyond WER, exposing the 'diversity tax' on marginalized speakers. Demonstrates that semantic metrics reveal hidden failures that lexical metrics miss.

entry.title: Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning

author.name: Siqi Yang, Kai Yan, Alexander G. Schwing, Yu-Xiong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning (LWAIL) using Wasserstein distance in a dynamics-aware latent space for state-only imitation learning from limited demonstrations.

entry.title: Cheap Thrills: Effective Amortized Optimization Using Inexpensive Labels

author.name: Khai Nguyen, Petros Ellinas, Anvita Bhagavathula, Priya Donti

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for amortized optimization that collects cheap imperfect labels, performs supervised pretraining, then refines through self-supervised learning. Theoretical analysis shows labeled data need only be approximately correct.

entry.title: Thermodynamic Response Functions in Singular Bayesian Models

author.name: Sean Plummer

entry.summary: Connects singular learning theory with thermodynamic concepts, showing that posterior tempering induces thermodynamic response functions that unify WAIC, WBIC, and singular geometry invariants through a covariance identity.

entry.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: Navigating the Landscape of Streaming Large Language Models

author.name: Junlong Tong, Zilong Wang, YuJie Ren, Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: Provides comprehensive survey and taxonomy of streaming LLMs, establishing unified definitions based on data flow and dynamic interaction, covering streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures.

entry.title: Representation Fidelity:Auditing Algorithmic Decisions About Humans Using Self-Descriptions

author.name: Theresa Elstner, Martin Potthast

entry.summary: Introduces 'Representation Fidelity' as a new dimension for validating algorithmic decisions about humans by measuring distance between externally-prescribed input representations and self-descriptions provided by human subjects.

entry.title: Mask-aware inference with State-Space Models

author.name: Ignasi Mas, Ramon Morros, Javier-Ruiz Hidalgo, Ivan Huerta

entry.summary: Introduces Partial Vision Mamba (PVM), adapting partial convolution principles to State Space Models for handling inputs with missing/invalid data regions, addressing a gap in Mamba architectures for tasks like depth completion.

entry.title: sFRC for assessing hallucinations in medical image restoration

author.name: Prabhat Kc, Rongping Zeng, Nirmal Soni, Aldo Badano

entry.summary: Proposes sFRC (scanning Fourier Ring Correlation) for detecting hallucinations in deep learning-based medical image restoration by comparing DL outputs to reference images in frequency domain across small patches.

entry.title: FC-VFI: Faithful and Consistent Video Frame Interpolation for High-FPS Slow Motion Video Generation

author.name: Ganggui Ding, Hao Chen, Xiaogang Xu

entry.summary: FC-VFI uses video diffusion models for faithful and consistent video frame interpolation supporting 4x and 8x interpolation, boosting frame rates up to 240 FPS at 2560x1440 resolution while preserving visual fidelity through temporal modeling on latent sequences.

entry.title: Physics-consistent deep learning for blind aberration recovery in mobile optics

author.name: Kartik Jhawar, Tamo Sancho Miguel Tandoc, Khoo Jun Xuan, Wang Lipo

entry.summary: Lens2Zernike recovers physical optical parameters (Zernike coefficients) from a single blurred image via deep learning, integrating supervision across three optical domains simultaneously for physics-consistent mobile lens aberration correction.

entry.title: CoIn3D: Revisiting Configuration-Invariant Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection

author.name: Zhaonian Kuang, Rui Ding, Haotian Wang, Xinhu Zheng, Meng Yang, Gang Hua

entry.summary: CoIn3D addresses configuration-invariant multi-camera 3D object detection by identifying spatial prior discrepancies across source and target camera configurations and proposing solutions for intrinsics, extrinsics, and layout generalization.

entry.title: MoRe: Motion-aware Feed-forward 4D Reconstruction Transformer

author.name: Juntong Fang, Zequn Chen, Weiqi Zhang, Donglin Di, Xuancheng Zhang, Chengmin Yang, Yu-Shen Liu

entry.summary: MoRe is a feed-forward 4D reconstruction network that efficiently recovers dynamic 3D scenes from monocular videos using an attention-forcing strategy to disentangle dynamic motion from static structure, with grouped decoding for temporal consistency.

entry.title: From Local Corrections to Generalized Skills: Improving Neuro-Symbolic Policies with MEMO

author.name: Benjamin A. Christie, Yinlong Dai, Mohammad Bararjanianbahnamiri, Simon Stepputtis, Dylan P. Losey

entry.summary: MEMO improves neuro-symbolic manipulation policies by dynamically expanding the robot's skill library through local corrections that generalize into new skills, addressing the fundamental bottleneck of limited skill repertoires.

entry.title: ELLIPSE: Evidential Learning for Robust Waypoints and Uncertainties

author.name: Zihao Dong, Chanyoung Chung, Dong-Ki Kim, Mukhtar Maulimov, Xiangyun Meng, Harmish Khambhaita, Ali-akbar Agha-mohammadi, Amirreza Shaban

entry.summary: ELLIPSE uses multivariate deep evidential regression for robust waypoint prediction with uncertainty estimation in a single forward pass, introducing domain augmentation to reduce overconfidence under distribution shifts.

entry.title: LEGS-POMDP: Language and Gesture-Guided Object Search in Partially Observable Environments

author.name: Ivy Xiao He, Stefanie Tellex, Jason Xinyu Liu

entry.summary: LEGS-POMDP integrates language, gesture, and visual observations within a POMDP framework for open-world object search, combining foundation model multimodal grounding with principled uncertainty-based planning.

entry.title: Hyperbolic Multiview Pretraining for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Jin Yang, Ping Wei, Yixin Chen

entry.summary: HyperMVP uses hyperbolic space for multiview self-supervised pretraining for robotic manipulation, arguing that hyperbolic geometry better captures structural relations among embeddings compared to Euclidean space.

entry.title: Personality Self-Replicators

author.name: eggsyntax

entry.summary: Describes the risk of 'personality self-replicators'—LLM agents like OpenClaw that are defined by small text files and can self-replicate by copying those files, unlike full model weight exfiltration. Argues these could spread like computer viruses with evolutionary dynamics escalating the threat.

entry.title: ECG-MoE: Mixture-of-Expert Electrocardiogram Foundation Model

author.name: Yuhao Xu, Xiaoda Wang, Yi Wu, Wei Jin, Xiao Hu, Carl Yang

entry.summary: ECG-MoE is a Mixture-of-Experts foundation model for electrocardiogram analysis that separately models beat-level morphology and rhythm using a dual-path architecture. Achieves SOTA on five clinical tasks with 40% faster inference.

entry.title: EvoTool: Self-Evolving Tool-Use Policy Optimization in LLM Agents via Blame-Aware Mutation and Diversity-Aware Selection

author.name: Shuo Yang, Soyeon Caren Han, Xueqi Ma, Yan Li, Mohammad Reza Ghasemi Madani, Eduard Hovy

entry.summary: EvoTool optimizes LLM agent tool-use policies via gradient-free evolutionary paradigm, decomposing policy into four modules (Planner, Selector, Caller, Synthesizer) with blame-aware mutation and diversity-aware selection.

entry.title: Rethinking Representativeness and Diversity in Dynamic Data Selection

author.name: Yuzhe Zhou, Zhenglin Hua, Haiyun Guo, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Rethinks representativeness and diversity in dynamic data selection, redefining representativeness as coverage of high-frequency feature factors and diversity as a process-level property over training trajectory.

entry.title: Reclaiming Lost Text Layers for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Zhenyu Zhang, Guangyao Chen, Yixiong Zou, Yuhua Li, Ruixuan Li

entry.summary: Discovers that removing certain middle layers of CLIP's text encoder improves source-free cross-domain few-shot learning, and proposes methods to reclaim the useful information from these 'Lost Layers' while bridging visual gaps.

entry.title: ZorBA: Zeroth-order Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs with Heterogeneous Block Activation

author.name: Chuiyang Meng, Ming Tang, Vincent W. S. Wong

entry.summary: Proposes ZorBA, a zeroth-order optimization framework for federated fine-tuning of LLMs with heterogeneous block activation. Eliminates gradient storage by using forward passes only, reducing VRAM requirements.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Financial Reasoning via Deterministic Fact Ledgers and Adversarial Low-Latency Hallucination Detector

author.name: Pedram Agand

entry.summary: Introduces VeNRA for zero-hallucination financial reasoning, using a Universal Fact Ledger with strictly typed variables and a Double-Lock Grounding algorithm instead of probabilistic text retrieval for RAG.

entry.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence for Artificial Intelligence Systems

author.name: Natalia Krawczyk, Mateusz Szczepkowski, Adrian Brodzik, Krzysztof Bocianiak

entry.summary: Investigates how cyber threat intelligence should evolve to address AI-specific security threats, outlining AI-oriented indicators of compromise and threat intelligence knowledge bases for different AI supply chain stages.

entry.title: Recurrent Graph Neural Networks and Arithmetic Circuits

author.name: Timon Barlag, Vivian Holzapfel, Laura Strieker, Jonni Virtema, Heribert Vollmer

entry.summary: Characterizes the computational power of recurrent GNNs in terms of arithmetic circuits over real numbers, introducing recurrent arithmetic circuits with memory gates as analogues of sequential circuits.

entry.title: Lifelong Language-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation Learning

author.name: Xudong Wang, Zebin Han, Zhiyu Liu, Gan Li, Jiahua Dong, Baichen Liu, Lianqing Liu, Zhi Han

entry.summary: SkillsCrafter proposes a continual learning framework for language-conditioned robotic manipulation that retains old skills while learning new ones through manipulation skills adaptation and skill semantic subspace projection.

entry.title: Boosting ASR Robustness via Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Audio-Text Semantic Rewards

author.name: Linghan Fang, Tianxin Xie, Li Liu

entry.summary: ASR-TRA proposes test-time reinforcement learning with audio-text semantic rewards for robust ASR, avoiding confirmation bias from pseudo-labeling by using semantic similarity as a reward signal.

entry.title: GALACTIC: Global and Local Agnostic Counterfactuals for Time-series Clustering

author.name: Christos Fragkathoulas, Eleni Psaroudaki, Themis Palpanas, Evaggelia Pitoura

entry.summary: GALACTIC is the first framework bridging local and global counterfactual explanations for unsupervised time-series clustering, generating perturbations that move instances across cluster boundaries.

entry.title: RelaxFlow: Text-Driven Amodal 3D Generation

author.name: Jiayin Zhu, Guoji Fu, Xiaolu Liu, Qiyuan He, Yicong Li, Angela Yao

entry.summary: RelaxFlow formalizes text-driven amodal 3D generation where text guides completion of occluded regions while preserving visible observations, using a dual-branch framework with theoretically-motivated relaxation mechanism.

entry.title: POET-X: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation

author.name: Zeju Qiu, Lixin Liu, Adrian Weller, Han Shi, Weiyang Liu

entry.summary: POET-X is a memory-efficient variant of orthogonal equivalence training for LLMs that reduces computational cost while maintaining training stability and generalization properties.

entry.title: PDE foundation model-accelerated inverse estimation of system parameters in inertial confinement fusion

author.name: Mahindra Rautela, Alexander Scheinker, Bradley Love, Diane Oyen, Nathan DeBardeleben, Earl Lawrence, Ayan Biswas

entry.summary: Finetunes a PDE foundation model for inverse parameter estimation in inertial confinement fusion, jointly reconstructing hyperspectral images and regressing system parameters from multi-modal observations.

entry.title: Balancing Privacy-Quality-Efficiency in Federated Learning through Round-Based Interleaving of Protection Techniques

author.name: Yenan Wang, Carla Fabiana Chiasserini, Elad Michael Schiller

entry.summary: Proposes Alt-FL, a federated learning framework combining differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and synthetic data via round-based interleaving for flexible privacy-quality-efficiency trade-offs.

entry.title: Kraus Constrained Sequence Learning For Quantum Trajectories from Continuous Measurement

author.name: Priyanshi Singh, Krishna Bhatia

entry.summary: Proposes a Kraus-structured output layer for neural sequence models that ensures physically valid quantum state updates during continuous measurement trajectory reconstruction.

entry.title: AbAffinity: A Large Language Model for Predicting Antibody Binding Affinity against SARS-CoV-2

author.name: Faisal Bin Ashraf, Animesh Ray, Stefano Lonardi

entry.summary: Introduces AbAffinity, a large language model for predicting antibody binding affinity against SARS-CoV-2 spike protein from sequence data.

entry.title: Learning Optimal Individualized Decision Rules with Conditional Demographic Parity

author.name: Wenhai Cui, Wen Su, Donglin Zeng, Xingqiu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for learning optimal individualized decision rules under demographic parity and conditional demographic parity constraints. Shows optimal constrained IDRs can be obtained by perturbations to unconstrained solutions.

entry.title: ThaiSafetyBench: Assessing Language Model Safety in Thai Cultural Contexts

author.name: Trapoom Ukarapol, Nut Chukamphaeng, Kunat Pipatanakul, Pakhapoom Sarapat

entry.summary: Introduces ThaiSafetyBench, an open-source safety benchmark for Thai language with 1,954 culturally-grounded malicious prompts. Evaluates 24 LLMs, finding closed-source models generally safer than open-source ones.

entry.title: HiFlow: Hierarchical Feedback-Driven Optimization for Constrained Long-Form Text Generation

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Guanting Chen, Bing Wei, Haoran Luo

entry.summary: Proposes HiFlow, a hierarchical feedback-driven optimization framework for constrained long-form text generation that formulates generation as a two-level optimization (planning + execution) with dynamic feedback.

entry.title: Distilling Formal Logic into Neural Spaces: A Kernel Alignment Approach for Signal Temporal Logic

author.name: Sara Candussio, Gabriele Sarti, Gaia Saveri, Luca Bortolussi

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for learning continuous neural representations of formal specifications (Signal Temporal Logic) by distilling symbolic robustness kernels into a Transformer encoder using kernel-weighted geometric alignment.

entry.title: FOZO: Forward-Only Zeroth-Order Prompt Optimization for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Xingyu Wang, Tao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FOZO, a forward-only zeroth-order prompt optimization method for test-time adaptation that avoids backpropagation, making it suitable for deployment on low-end devices.

entry.title: Revisiting Shape from Polarization in the Era of Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Chenhao Li, Taishi Ono, Takeshi Uemori, Yusuke Moriuchi

entry.summary: Shows that lightweight models trained on small datasets with polarization cues can outperform RGB-only vision foundation models for surface normal estimation, arguing prior SfP method weakness came from domain gaps not the modality itself.

entry.title: SURE: Semi-dense Uncertainty-REfined Feature Matching

author.name: Sicheng Li, Zaiwang Gu, Jie Zhang, Qing Guo, Xudong Jiang, Jun Cheng

entry.summary: SURE proposes a semi-dense feature matching framework that jointly predicts correspondences and their confidence by modeling both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties via an evidential head. Addresses overconfident matching in challenging viewpoint/textureless scenarios.

entry.title: Orthogonal Spatial-temporal Distributional Transfer for 4D Generation

author.name: Wei Liu, Shengqiong Wu, Bobo Li, Haoyu Zhao, Hao Fei, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework transferring spatial priors from 3D diffusion models and temporal priors from video diffusion models to enhance 4D synthesis through a spatial-temporal-disentangled diffusion architecture.

entry.title: Diff-ES: Stage-wise Structural Diffusion Pruning via Evolutionary Search

author.name: Zongfang Liu, Shengkun Tang, Zongliang Wu, Xin Yuan, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Diff-ES uses evolutionary search to find optimal stage-wise sparsity schedules for structured pruning of diffusion transformers, addressing the non-uniform importance of denoising steps that makes manual scheduling suboptimal.

entry.title: FaceCam: Portrait Video Camera Control via Scale-Aware Conditioning

author.name: Weijie Lyu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhixin Shu

entry.summary: FaceCam generates portrait videos under customizable camera trajectories from monocular input, using a face-tailored scale-aware camera representation that avoids geometric distortions from scale-ambiguous representations or 3D reconstruction errors.

entry.title: Autonomous Aerial Non-Destructive Testing: Ultrasound Inspection with a Commercial Quadrotor in an Unstructured Environment

author.name: Ruben Veenstra, Barbara Bazzana, Sander Smits, Antonio Franchi

entry.summary: Presents the first fully autonomous contact-based non-destructive testing using a commercial quadrotor, with a multi-rate control architecture enabling ultrasound inspection in unstructured environments.

entry.title: Design, Mapping, and Contact Anticipation with 3D-printed Whole-Body Tactile and Proximity Sensors

author.name: Carson Kohlbrenner, Anna Soukhovei, Caleb Escobedo, Nataliya Nechyporenko, Alessandro Roncone

entry.summary: GenTact-Prox is a fully 3D-printed artificial skin integrating tactile and proximity sensing for whole-body contact anticipation, with a data-driven framework for mapping perisensory space around the robot.

entry.title: U-OBCA: Uncertainty-Aware Optimization-Based Collision Avoidance via Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Chance Constraints

author.name: Zehao Wang, Yuxuan Tang, Han Zhang, Jingchuan Wang, Weidong Chen

entry.summary: U-OBCA extends optimization-based collision avoidance with Wasserstein distributionally robust chance constraints, handling polygon-shaped robots/obstacles without circle approximations and providing guarantees without specific noise distribution assumptions.

entry.title: Critic in the Loop: A Tri-System VLA Framework for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation

author.name: Pengfei Yi, Yingjie Ma, Wenjiang Xu, Yanan Hao, Shuai Gan, Wanting Li, Shanlin Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces 'Critic in the Loop,' a hierarchical framework combining a VLM for high-level reasoning, a VLA for reactive execution, and a lightweight visual Critic that dynamically routes control between them. Inspired by brain architecture for balancing semantic depth with real-time execution.

entry.title: AMV-L: Lifecycle-Managed Agent Memory for Tail-Latency Control in Long-Running LLM Systems

author.name: Emmanuel Bamidele

entry.summary: Presents AMV-L, a lifecycle memory management framework for long-running LLM agents that uses utility-based promotion/demotion/eviction across memory tiers to control tail latency, replacing simple TTL-based retention.

entry.title: Bayesian Supervised Causal Clustering

author.name: Luwei Wang, Nazir Lone, Sohan Seth

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian Supervised Causal Clustering (BSCC) that identifies patient subgroups based on both covariate profiles and treatment effects, using treatment effect as the outcome guiding clustering. Evaluated on both simulated and real-world clinical data.

entry.title: Structure Observation Driven Image-Text Contrastive Learning for Computed Tomography Report Generation

author.name: Hong Liu, Dong Wei, Qiong Peng, Yawen Huang, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng, Liansheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a two-stage framework for CT report generation featuring structure-wise image-text contrastive learning, where learnable structure-specific visual queries observe corresponding anatomical structures. Addresses the complexity gap between X-ray and CT report generation.

entry.title: TAPFormer: Robust Arbitrary Point Tracking via Transient Asynchronous Fusion of Frames and Events

author.name: Jiaxiong Liu, Zhen Tan, Jinpu Zhang, Yi Zhou, Hui Shen, Xieyuanli Chen, Dewen Hu

entry.summary: TAPFormer combines RGB frames and event streams for arbitrary point tracking via a Transient Asynchronous Fusion mechanism that models temporal evolution between discrete frames through continuous event updates.

entry.title: Efficient Autonomous Navigation of a Quadruped Robot in Underground Mines on Edge Hardware

author.name: Yixiang Gao, Kwame Awuah-Offei

entry.summary: Presents a fully autonomous navigation stack for a Spot robot in underground mines running on a low-power Intel NUC without GPU, integrating LiDAR-inertial odometry, scan-matching localization, terrain segmentation, and visibility-graph planning.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Decentralized Exploration with Self-Organizing Robot Teams

author.name: Hiroaki Kawashima, Shun Ikejima, Takeshi Takai, Mikita Miyaguchi, Yasuharu Kunii

entry.summary: Proposes combining LLM-guided exploration target selection with self-organizing team formation for decentralized multi-robot exploration, enabling autonomous operation without centralized control.

entry.title: MI-DETR: A Strong Baseline for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection with Bio-Inspired Motion Integration

author.name: Nian Liu, Jin Gao, Shubo Lin, Yutong Kou, Sikui Zhang, Fudong Ge, Zhiqiang Pu, Liang Li, Gang Wang, Yizheng Wang, Weiming Hu

entry.summary: MI-DETR is a bio-inspired dual-pathway detector for infrared small target detection that processes one frame per timestep while explicitly modeling motion via a retina-inspired cellular automaton, creating parvocellular-like appearance and magnocellular-like motion pathways.

entry.title: CATNet: Collaborative Alignment and Transformation Network for Cooperative Perception

author.name: Gong Chen, Chaokun Zhang, Tao Tang, Pengcheng Lv, Feng Li, Xin Xie

entry.summary: CATNet introduces a cooperative perception framework with Spatio-Temporal Recurrent Synchronization for aligning asynchronous feature streams in multi-agent systems, addressing temporal latency and multi-source noise.

entry.title: Loop Closure via Maximal Cliques in 3D LiDAR-Based SLAM

author.name: Javier Laserna, Saurabh Gupta, Oscar Martinez Mozos, Cyrill Stachniss, Pablo San Segundo

entry.summary: CliReg replaces RANSAC-based loop closure verification in LiDAR SLAM with a deterministic maximal clique search over feature correspondence compatibility graphs, improving robustness to outliers while avoiding random sampling.

entry.title: HiMAP-Travel: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Planning for Long-Horizon Constrained Travel

author.name: The Viet Bui, Wenjun Li, Yong Liu

entry.summary: HiMAP-Travel addresses long-horizon travel planning with hard constraints through a hierarchical multi-agent framework. Uses a coordinator-executor architecture with transactional monitoring, bargaining protocols, and GRPO-trained policy.

entry.title: SEA-TS: Self-Evolving Agent for Autonomous Code Generation of Time Series Forecasting Algorithms

author.name: Longkun Xu, Xiaochun Zhang, Qiantu Tuo, Rui Li

entry.summary: SEA-TS proposes a self-evolving agent that autonomously generates, validates, and optimizes time series forecasting code using Monte Carlo Tree Search with normalized advantage scoring and automated code review.

entry.title: AegisUI: Behavioral Anomaly Detection for Structured User Interface Protocols in AI Agent Systems

author.name: Mohd Safwan Uddin, Saba Hajira

entry.summary: AegisUI builds a framework to detect behavioral anomalies in AI-generated UI payloads where actions contradict displayed labels (e.g., 'View invoice' button that deletes an account). Tests anomaly detectors on 4,000 labeled payloads.

entry.title: Enhancing Zero-shot Commonsense Reasoning by Integrating Visual Knowledge via Machine Imagination

author.name: Hyuntae Park, Yeachan Kim, SangKeun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Imagine, a zero-shot commonsense reasoning framework that supplements PLM text inputs with visual signals from machine-generated images to bridge human reporting biases in textual knowledge.

entry.title: Distributed Partial Information Puzzles: Examining Common Ground Construction Under Epistemic Asymmetry

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Mariah Bradford, Kenneth Lai, Timothy Obiso, Videep Venkatesha, James Pustejovsky, Nikhil Krishnaswamy

entry.summary: Introduces Distributed Partial Information Puzzles for studying common ground construction in multimodal, multiparty settings with epistemic asymmetry. Provides multimodal dataset aligned across speech, gesture, and action.

entry.title: What Is Missing: Interpretable Ratings for Large Language Model Outputs

author.name: Nicholas Stranges, Yimin Yang

entry.summary: Introduces the 'What Is Missing' (WIM) rating system that produces LLM output rankings from natural language feedback describing what outputs lack, rather than direct numerical scores. Integrates into existing preference learning pipelines.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Calibrated Spatiotemporal Field Diffusion with Sparse Supervision

author.name: Kevin Valencia, Xihaier Luo, Shinjae Yoo, David Keetae Park

entry.summary: Presents SOLID, a mask-conditioned diffusion framework for spatiotemporal field reconstruction from sparse observations, trained end-to-end with sparse supervision only. Unlike prior work, requires no dense fields or pre-imputation.

entry.title: Projected Hessian Learning: Fast Curvature Supervision for Accurate Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials

author.name: Austin Rodriguez, Justin S. Smith, Sakib Matin, Nicholas Lubbers, Kipton Barros, Jose L. Mendoza-Cortes

entry.summary: Introduces Projected Hessian Learning (PHL), a scalable framework for training machine-learning interatomic potentials using Hessian-vector products instead of full Hessians, achieving curvature-informed training without quadratic memory costs.

entry.title: Why Do Neural Networks Forget: A Study of Collapse in Continual Learning

author.name: Yunqin Zhu, Jun Jin

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting through the lens of structural collapse, investigating correlation between forgetting and effective rank changes in weight and activation spaces across MLP, CNN, ResNet, and ViT architectures.

entry.title: Beyond Linear LLM Invocation: An Efficient and Effective Semantic Filter Paradigm

author.name: Nan Hou, Kangfei Zhao, Jiadong Xie, Jeffrey Xu Yu

entry.summary: Proposes efficient semantic filtering for LLM-based query processing over large tables, moving beyond linear tuple-by-tuple evaluation to reduce latency and token costs when applying natural language predicates.

entry.title: MPCEval: A Benchmark for Multi-Party Conversation Generation

author.name: Minxing Zhang, Yi Yang, Zhuofan Jia, Xuan Yang, Jian Pei, Yuchen Zang, Xingwang Deng, Xianglong Chen

entry.summary: MPCEval is a benchmark suite for multi-party conversation generation, decomposing quality into speaker modeling, content quality, and speaker-content consistency. It distinguishes local next-turn from global full-conversation generation tasks.

entry.title: Poisoning the Inner Prediction Logic of Graph Neural Networks for Clean-Label Backdoor Attacks

author.name: Yuxiang Zhang, Bin Ma, Enyan Dai

entry.summary: Explores clean-label backdoor attacks on GNNs where training labels cannot be modified, identifying why existing attacks fail and proposing methods to poison the inner prediction logic of graph neural networks.

entry.title: SPIRIT: Perceptive Shared Autonomy for Robust Robotic Manipulation under Deep Learning Uncertainty

author.name: Jongseok Lee, Ribin Balachandran, Harsimran Singh, Jianxiang Feng, Hrishik Mishra, Marco De Stefano, Rudolph Triebel, Alin Albu-Schaeffer, Konstantin Kondak

entry.summary: SPIRIT proposes perceptive shared autonomy where uncertainty estimates from deep learning perception regulate the level of robot autonomy, transitioning between semi-autonomous and teleoperation modes based on confidence.

entry.title: Whispering to a Blackbox: Bootstrapping Frozen OCR with Visual Prompts

author.name: Samandar Samandarov, Nazirjon Ismoiljonov, Abdullah Sattorov, Temirlan Sabyrbayev

entry.summary: Whisperer learns diffusion-based visual preprocessors to adapt inputs for frozen OCR models, achieving 8% CER reduction through behavioral cloning of stochastically discovered improvement policies.

entry.title: Learning Causal Structure of Time Series using Best Order Score Search

author.name: Irene Gema Castillo Mansilla, Urmi Ninad

entry.summary: TS-BOSS extends the Best Order Score Search algorithm to time series causal discovery, performing permutation-based search over dynamic Bayesian network structures with theoretical soundness guarantees.

entry.title: K-Means as a Radial Basis function Network: a Variational and Gradient-based Equivalence

author.name: Felipe de Jesus Felix Arredondo, Alejandro Ucan-Puc, Carlos Astengo Noguez

entry.summary: Establishes rigorous variational and gradient-based equivalence between K-Means and differentiable RBF neural networks, proving Γ-convergence and trajectory equivalence as temperature vanishes.

entry.title: Engineering Regression Without Real-Data Training: Domain Adaptation for Tabular Foundation Models Using Multi-Dataset Embeddings

author.name: Lyle Regenwetter, Rosen Yu, Cyril Picard, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces TREDBench, 83 engineering regression datasets, and studies domain adaptation of tabular foundation models to engineering applications, finding engineering datasets partially distinguishable in embedding space.

entry.title: Competitive Multi-Operator Reinforcement Learning for Joint Pricing and Fleet Rebalancing in AMoD Systems

author.name: Emil Kragh Toft, Carolin Schmidt, Daniele Gammelli, Filipe Rodrigues

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-operator reinforcement learning framework for autonomous mobility-on-demand systems where operators compete through pricing and fleet rebalancing, integrating discrete choice theory for passenger allocation.

entry.title: Explainable Regime Aware Investing

author.name: Amine Boukardagha

entry.summary: Proposes an explainable regime-aware portfolio framework using Wasserstein Hidden Markov Models with predictive model-order selection and transaction-cost-aware optimization.

entry.title: Dictionary Based Pattern Entropy for Causal Direction Discovery

author.name: Harikrishnan N B, Shubham Bhilare, Aditi Kathpalia, Nithin Nagaraj

entry.summary: Proposes Dictionary Based Pattern Entropy (DPE) for causal direction discovery from symbolic sequences, integrating algorithmic and Shannon information theory.

entry.title: How important are the genes to explain the outcome - the asymmetric Shapley value as an honest importance metric for high-dimensional features

author.name: Mark A. van de Wiel, Jeroen Goedhart, Martin Jullum, Kjersti Aas

entry.summary: Proposes using asymmetric Shapley values to quantify the importance of high-dimensional features (like genomics) in clinical prediction models, accounting for collinearity and known directional dependencies between variables.

entry.title: Federated Heterogeneous Language Model Optimization for Hybrid Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Mengze Hong, Yi Gu, Di Jiang, Hanlin Gu, Chen Jason Zhang, Lu Wang, Zhiyang Su

entry.summary: Proposes heterogeneous language model optimization for federated ASR, introducing match-and-merge algorithms (GMMA using genetic operations, RMMA using RL) to merge heterogeneous n-gram and neural language models.

entry.title: Oral to Web: Digitizing 'Zero Resource'Languages of Bangladesh

author.name: Mohammad Mamun Or Rashid

entry.summary: Presents the Multilingual Cloud Corpus, the first national-scale parallel multimodal dataset covering 42 language varieties from Bangladesh's ethnic and indigenous languages, including 14 endangered languages.

entry.title: Exploring the potential and limitations of Model Merging for Multi-Domain Adaptation in ASR

author.name: Carlos Carvalho, Francisco Teixeira, Thomas Rolland, Alberto Abad

entry.summary: Studies model merging for multi-domain ASR, benchmarking 11 merging algorithms across 10 European Portuguese domains and proposing BoostedTSV-M, a new merging algorithm based on TSV-M.

entry.title: SGR3 Model: Scene Graph Retrieval-Reasoning Model in 3D

author.name: Zirui Wang, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Junwei Zheng, Weijia Fan, Kunyu Peng, Di Wen, Jiale Wei, Jiaming Zhang, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Introduces SGR3, a training-free framework leveraging multimodal LLMs with RAG for 3D scene graph generation, avoiding the need for multi-modal point cloud data and heuristic graph construction.

entry.title: Federated Modality-specific Encoders and Partially Personalized Fusion Decoder for Multimodal Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Hong Liu, Dong Wei, Qian Dai, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng, Liansheng Wang

entry.summary: FedMEPD proposes a federated learning framework with modality-specific encoders and partially personalized fusion decoders for multimodal brain tumor segmentation, handling both inter-modal and intra-modal heterogeneity across FL participants.

entry.title: BiEvLight: Bi-level Learning of Task-Aware Event Refinement for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Zishu Yao, Xiang-Xiang Su, Shengning Zhou, Guang-Yong Chen, Guodong Fan, Xing Chen

entry.summary: BiEvLight proposes a bi-level optimization framework that jointly optimizes low-light image enhancement and event camera denoising, leveraging the intrinsic interdependence between the two tasks for mutual improvement.

entry.title: Tell2Adapt: A Unified Framework for Source Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation via Vision Foundation Model

author.name: Yulong Shi, Shijie Li, Ziyi Li, Lin Qi

entry.summary: Tell2Adapt introduces a source-free unsupervised domain adaptation framework using Vision Foundation Models with Context-Aware Prompt Regularization for multi-modality, multi-target medical image segmentation.

entry.title: ORMOT: A Dataset and Framework for Omnidirectional Referring Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Sijia Chen, Zihan Zhou, Yanqiu Yu, En Yu, Wenbing Tao

entry.summary: ORMOT proposes omnidirectional referring multi-object tracking using 360° cameras to address the limited field-of-view problem in conventional RMOT, introducing both a new task formulation and dataset.

entry.title: UltraDexGrasp: Learning Universal Dexterous Grasping for Bimanual Robots with Synthetic Data

author.name: Sizhe Yang, Yiman Xie, Zhixuan Liang, Yang Tian, Jia Zeng, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: Introduces UltraDexGrasp, a framework for generating universal dexterous grasps for bimanual robots using synthetic data. Addresses the data bottleneck for multi-strategy grasping by producing physically plausible, geometrically conforming grasps that withstand external wrenches.

entry.title: PhysiFlow: Physics-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body VLA via Multi-Brain Latent Flow Matching and Robust Tracking

author.name: Weikai Qin, Sichen Wu, Ci Chen, Mengfan Liu, Linxi Feng, Xinru Cui, Haoqi Han, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents PhysiFlow, a physics-aware multi-brain VLA framework for humanoid whole-body control that combines vision-language guidance with robust physical execution. Uses latent flow matching to bridge semantic reasoning and motor control.

entry.title: Locality-Attending Vision Transformer

author.name: Sina Hajimiri, Farzad Beizaee, Fereshteh Shakeri, Christian Desrosiers, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz

entry.summary: Presents a simple add-on for Vision Transformers that modulates self-attention with a learnable Gaussian kernel to bias attention toward neighboring patches, improving segmentation performance while retaining classification capabilities.

entry.title: MultiGO++: Monocular 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction via Geometry-Texture Collaboration

author.name: Nanjie Yao, Gangjian Zhang, Wenhao Shen, Jian Shu, Yu Feng, Hao Wang

entry.summary: MultiGO++ achieves monocular 3D clothed human reconstruction through geometry-texture collaboration, addressing limitations of texture data availability, inaccurate geometric priors, and biased single-modality supervision.

entry.title: Fusion4CA: Boosting 3D Object Detection via Comprehensive Image Exploitation

author.name: Kang Luo, Xin Chen, Yangyi Xiao, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Fusion4CA improves LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D object detection by introducing contrastive alignment to calibrate image features with 3D geometry and a camera auxiliary branch to better mine RGB information during training.

entry.title: GAIDE: Graph-based Attention Masking for Spatial- and Embodiment-aware Motion Planning

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: GAIDE introduces a graph-based attention masking mechanism for neural informed sampling in robotic motion planning, encoding spatial structure and robot embodiment to guide sampling distribution in configuration space.

entry.title: Iterative On-Policy Refinement of Hierarchical Diffusion Policies for Language-Conditioned Manipulation

author.name: Clemence Grislain, Olivier Sigaud, Mohamed Chetouani

entry.summary: Proposes HD-ExpIt, a framework for iteratively fine-tuning hierarchical diffusion policies for language-conditioned manipulation via environment feedback. Creates a self-reinforcing cycle where diffusion planning discovers successful behaviors that are distilled back into the policy.

entry.title: Exploiting Intermediate Reconstructions in Optical Coherence Tomography for Test-Time Adaption of Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Thomas Pinetz, Veit Hucke, Hrvoje Bogunovic

entry.summary: IRTTA exploits intermediate representations from iterative OCT image reconstruction for test-time adaptation of segmentation models, rather than using only the final reconstructed image.

entry.title: EdgeDAM: Real-time Object Tracking for Mobile Devices

author.name: Syed Muhammad Raza, Syed Murtaza Hussain Abidi, Khawar Islam, Muhammad Ibrahim, Ajmal Saeed Mian

entry.summary: EdgeDAM is a lightweight detection-guided tracking framework for single-object tracking on edge devices, reformulating distractor-aware tracking without expensive segmentation masks or attention-driven memory updates.

entry.title: ICHOR: A Robust Representation Learning Approach for ASL CBF Maps with Self-Supervised Masked Autoencoders

author.name: Xavier Beltran-Urbano, Yiran Li, Xinglin Zeng, Katie R. Jobson, Manuel Taso, Christopher A. Brown, David A. Wolk, Corey T. McMillan, Ilya M. Nashrallah, Paul A. Yushkevich, Ze Wang, John A. Detre, Sudipto Dolui

entry.summary: ICHOR applies self-supervised masked autoencoders for robust representation learning on ASL cerebral blood flow maps, addressing variable image quality and inter-site protocol differences without large labeled datasets.

entry.title: SeedPolicy: Horizon Scaling via Self-Evolving Diffusion Policy for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Youqiang Gui, Yuxuan Zhou, Shen Cheng, Xinyang Yuan, Haoqiang Fan, Peng Cheng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SeedPolicy, which uses a Self-Evolving Gated Attention module to enable Diffusion Policy to handle long observation horizons without performance degradation. Compresses long-horizon observations into fixed-size representations via gated recurrent updates.

entry.title: K-Gen: A Multimodal Language-Conditioned Approach for Interpretable Keypoint-Guided Trajectory Generation

author.name: Mingxuan Mu, Guo Yang, Lei Chen, Ping Wu, Jianxun Cui

entry.summary: K-Gen uses Multimodal LLMs to generate interpretable keypoints with reasoning for autonomous driving trajectory generation, unifying rasterized BEV maps with textual scene descriptions.

entry.title: BioLLMAgent: A Hybrid Framework with Enhanced Structural Interpretability for Simulating Human Decision-Making in Computational Psychiatry

author.name: Zuo Fei, Kezhi Wang, Xiaomin Chen, Yizhou Huang

entry.summary: BioLLMAgent combines traditional RL models with LLM agents for simulating human decision-making in computational psychiatry, featuring an Internal RL Engine, External LLM Shell, and Decision Fusion Mechanism.

entry.title: MedCoRAG: Interpretable Hepatology Diagnosis via Hybrid Evidence Retrieval and Multispecialty Consensus

author.name: Zheng Li, Jiayi Xu, Zhikai Hu, Hechang Chen, Lele Cong, Yunyun Wang, Shuchao Pang

entry.summary: MedCoRAG is a medical collaborative RAG framework for hepatology diagnosis that generates hypotheses from abnormal findings, retrieves multi-source evidence, and supports iterative role-specialized deliberation.

entry.title: Context-Dependent Affordance Computation in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Murad Farzulla

entry.summary: Studies context-dependent affordance computation in VLMs, showing that >90% of lexical scene description changes when different agentic personas are applied. Demonstrates massive 'affordance drift' across 3,213 scene-context pairs using Qwen-VL and LLaVA models.

entry.title: DARE: Aligning LLM Agents with the R Statistical Ecosystem via Distribution-Aware Retrieval

author.name: Maojun Sun, Yue Wu, Yifei Xie, Ruijian Han, Binyan Jiang, Defeng Sun, Yancheng Yuan, Jian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes DARE, a distribution-aware retrieval model for aligning LLM agents with R statistical packages. Includes RPKB (8,191 CRAN packages) and an embedding model fusing distributional features for better tool retrieval.

entry.title: Guiding Diffusion-based Reconstruction with Contrastive Signals for Balanced Visual Representation

author.name: Boyu Han, Qianqian Xu, Shilong Bao, Zhiyong Yang, Ruochen Cui, Xilin Zhao, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Integrates contrastive signals into diffusion-based reconstruction to improve CLIP visual representations, balancing discriminative ability with detail perceptual ability.

entry.title: An Approach to Simultaneous Acquisition of Real-Time MRI Video, EEG, and Surface EMG for Articulatory, Brain, and Muscle Activity During Speech Production

author.name: Jihwan Lee, Parsa Razmara, Kevin Huang, Sean Foley, Aditya Kommineni, Haley Hsu, Woojae Jeong, Prakash Kumar, Xuan Shi, Yoonjeong Lee, Tiantian Feng, Takfarinas Medani, Ye Tian, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Krishna S. Nayak, Dani Byrd, Louis Goldstein, Richard M. Leahy, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Presents the first simultaneous acquisition of real-time MRI, EEG, and surface EMG during speech production, with an artifact suppression pipeline for managing MRI-induced interference.

entry.title: Location-Aware Pretraining for Medical Difference Visual Question Answering

author.name: Denis Musinguzi, Caren Han, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Introduces location-aware pretraining tasks for medical differential VQA, enabling vision encoders to learn spatially-grounded representations for comparing medical images and identifying differences. Addresses the gap between contrastive/classification pretraining and the needs of comparative diagnosis.

entry.title: FedBCD:Communication-Efficient Accelerated Block Coordinate Gradient Descent for Federated Learning

author.name: Junkang Liu, Fanhua Shang, Yuanyuan Liu, Hongying Liu, Yuangang Li, YunXiang Gong

entry.summary: FedBCGD proposes block coordinate gradient descent for federated learning that splits model parameters into blocks and uploads only specific blocks per client, significantly reducing communication overhead for large models like Vision Transformers.

entry.title: SSR-GS: Separating Specular Reflection in Gaussian Splatting for Glossy Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Ningjing Fan, Yiqun Wang

entry.summary: SSR-GS improves 3D Gaussian splatting for glossy surface reconstruction by modeling both direct and indirect specular reflections through prefiltered Mip-Cubemaps and a novel indirect specular module.

entry.title: Not All Trust is the Same: Effects of Decision Workflow and Explanations in Human-AI Decision Making

author.name: Laura Spillner, Rachel Ringe, Robert Porzel, Rainer Malaka

entry.summary: Studies how decision workflow design (1-step vs 2-step) and explanations interact with trust calibration in AI-assisted decision making, examining reported trust vs. behavioral reliance across different user profiles.

entry.title: An LLM-Guided Query-Aware Inference System for GNN Models on Large Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Waleed Afandi, Hussein Abdallah, Ashraf Aboulnaga, Essam Mansour

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-guided query-aware inference system for GNNs on large knowledge graphs that adapts model components based on the semantics and structure of individual queries.

entry.title: KindSleep: Knowledge-Informed Diagnosis of Obstructive Sleep Apnea from Oximetry

author.name: Micky C Nnamdi, Wenqi Shi, Cheng Wan, J. Ben Tamo, Benjamin M Smith, Chad A Purnell, May D Wang

entry.summary: Presents KindSleep, a deep learning framework integrating clinical knowledge with oximetry signals for diagnosing obstructive sleep apnea. Learns clinically interpretable concepts like desaturation indices directly from raw signals.

entry.title: Decoupling Task and Behavior: A Two-Stage Reward Curriculum in Reinforcement Learning for Robotics

author.name: Kilian Freitag, Knut {\AA}kesson, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage reward curriculum for RL in robotics that decouples task-specific objectives from behavioral terms, first training on simplified rewards before introducing full objectives.

entry.title: Towards a data-scale independent regulariser for robust sparse identification of non-linear dynamics

author.name: Jay Raut, Daniel N. Wilke, Stephan Schmidt

entry.summary: Introduces STCV, a sparse regression algorithm for SINDy that is robust to data normalization, addressing a critical vulnerability where standard methods produce incorrect models after scaling.

entry.title: An interpretable prototype parts-based neural network for medical tabular data

author.name: Jacek Karolczak, Jerzy Stefanowski

entry.summary: Proposes a prototype parts-based neural network for medical tabular data that learns interpretable prototypical parts as binary or discretized feature subsets.

entry.title: Generalizing Fair Top-$k$ Selection: An Integrative Approach

author.name: Guangya Cai

entry.summary: Generalizes fair top-k selection to multiple protected groups with disparity minimization, addressing runtime efficiency issues that emerge with multiple groups.

entry.title: Mitigating Instance Entanglement in Instance-Dependent Partial Label Learning

author.name: Rui Zhao, Bin Shi, Kai Sun, Bo Dong

entry.summary: Proposes CAD framework for instance-dependent partial label learning that addresses instance entanglement through class-specific augmentation with intra- and inter-class regulations.

entry.title: BLINK: Behavioral Latent Modeling of NK Cell Cytotoxicity

author.name: Iman Nematollahi, Jose Francisco Villena-Ossa, Alina Moter, Kiana Farhadyar, Gabriel Kalweit, Abhinav Valada, Toni Cathomen, Evelyn Ullrich, Maria Kalweit

entry.summary: Introduces BLINK, a trajectory-based recurrent state-space model for NK cell-tumor interaction dynamics that learns latent interaction states and predicts apoptosis from fluorescence microscopy data.

entry.title: Probing Memes in LLMs: A Paradigm for the Entangled Evaluation World

author.name: Luzhou Peng, Zhengxin Yang, Honglu Ji, Yikang Yang, Fanda Fan, Wanling Gao, Jiayuan Ge, Yilin Han, Jianfeng Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes a 'Probing Memes' evaluation paradigm for LLMs inspired by Dawkins' meme concept, using a Perception Matrix to capture model-item interactions for more nuanced evaluation beyond simple accuracy scores.

entry.title: Coordinated Semantic Alignment and Evidence Constraints for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Xin Chen, Saili Uday Gadgil, Jiarong Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes a RAG method that integrates semantic alignment with evidence constraints through coordinated modeling of retrieval and generation stages, addressing semantic misalignment between retrieved results and generation objectives.

entry.title: HACHIMI: Scalable and Controllable Student Persona Generation via Orchestrated Agents

author.name: Yilin Jiang, Fei Tan, Xuanyu Yin, Jing Leng, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces HACHIMI, a multi-agent framework for generating 1M theory-aligned student personas using a Propose-Validate-Revise approach with neuro-symbolic validation and stratified sampling to reduce mode collapse.

entry.title: SearchGym: A Modular Infrastructure for Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Hybrid Search Orchestration

author.name: Jerome Tze-Hou Hsu

entry.summary: Presents SearchGym, a modular infrastructure for RAG benchmarking and hybrid search orchestration that decouples data representation, embedding, and retrieval into composable abstractions with reproducible configurations.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based sRGB Real Noise Generation via Prompt-Driven Noise Representation Learning

author.name: Jaekyun Ko, Dongjin Kim, Soomin Lee, Guanghui Wang, Tae Hyun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Prompt-Driven Noise Generation (PNG), a diffusion-based framework that synthesizes realistic sRGB noise without requiring camera metadata during testing. Uses learned prompt representations to capture high-dimensional noise characteristics.

entry.title: Adaptive Prototype-based Interpretable Grading of Prostate Cancer

author.name: Riddhasree Bhattacharyya, Pallabi Dutta, Sushmita Mitra

entry.summary: Proposes a prototype-based weakly-supervised framework for interpretable prostate cancer grading from histopathology images, providing explanations of why highlighted regions matter rather than just where they are.

entry.title: Semantic Class Distribution Learning for Debiasing Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yingxue Su, Yiheng Zhong, Keying Zhu, Zimu Zhang, Zhuoru Zhang, Yifang Wang, Yuxin Zhang, Jingxin Liu

entry.summary: SCDL proposes a plug-and-play framework for debiasing semi-supervised medical image segmentation via structured class-conditional feature distribution learning, addressing class imbalance through bidirectional alignment.

entry.title: Digital Twin Driven Textile Classification and Foreign Object Recognition in Automated Sorting Systems

author.name: Serkan Ergun, Tobias Mitterer, Hubert Zangl

entry.summary: Presents a digital twin-driven robotic textile sorting system integrating grasp prediction, RGBD sensing, capacitive tactile feedback, and VLMs for garment classification, benchmarking 9 VLMs across 5 model families.

entry.title: Transformer-Based Inpainting for Real-Time 3D Streaming in Sparse Multi-Camera Setups

author.name: Leif Van Holland, Domenic Zingsheim, Mana Takhsha, Hannah Dr\"oge, Patrick Stotko, Markus Plack, Reinhard Klein

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based inpainting method for completing missing textures in sparse multi-camera 3D streaming for AR/VR, designed as a standalone post-processing module compatible with any calibrated multi-camera system.

entry.title: Distributed State Estimation for Vision-Based Cooperative Slung Load Transportation in GPS-Denied Environments

author.name: Jack R. Pence, Jackson Fezell, Jack W. Langelaan, Junyi Geng

entry.summary: Presents distributed state estimation for cooperative slung load transportation using multiple rotorcraft in GPS-denied environments, using vision-based decentralized estimation without centralized controllers.

entry.title: Task-Relevant and Irrelevant Region-Aware Augmentation for Generalizable Vision-Based Imitation Learning in Agricultural Manipulation

author.name: Shun Hattori, Hikaru Sasaki, Takumi Hachimine, Yusuke Mizutani, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: DRAIL proposes region-aware data augmentation for vision-based imitation learning in agricultural manipulation, separating observations into task-relevant and task-irrelevant regions with different augmentation strategies.

entry.title: Direct Contact-Tolerant Motion Planning With Vision Language Models

author.name: He Li, Jian Sun, Chengyang Li, Guoliang Li, Qiyu Ruan, Shuai Wang, Chengzhong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a contact-tolerant motion planner that integrates vision-language models to reason about which obstacles can be safely contacted during navigation in cluttered environments. Uses VLM-based point cloud partitioning and propagation across frames for real-time operation.

entry.title: Selecting Spots by Explicitly Predicting Intention from Motion History Improves Performance in Autonomous Parking

author.name: Long Kiu Chung, David Isele, Faizan M. Tariq, Sangjae Bae, Shreyas Kousik, Jovin D'sa

entry.summary: Proposes an autonomous valet parking pipeline that selects parking spots by predicting other agents' parking intentions from motion history using learned models and probabilistic belief maps.

entry.title: Design Behaviour Codes (DBCs): A Taxonomy-Driven Layered Governance Benchmark for Large Language Models

author.name: G. Madan Mohan, Veena Kiran Nambiar, Kiranmayee Janardhan

entry.summary: Introduces the DBC benchmark for evaluating behavioral governance layers applied at inference time to LLMs, featuring 150 controls across a 30-domain risk taxonomy with agentic red-teaming evaluation.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Covariate Time Series

author.name: Kenny Ye Liang, Zhongyi Pei, Huan Zhang, Yuhui Liu, Shaoxu Song, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: RAG4CTS proposes regime-aware, training-free RAG for covariate time series, addressing data scarcity and coupled dynamics in predictive maintenance scenarios like pressure valve monitoring.

entry.title: Decorrelating the Future: Joint Frequency Domain Learning for Spatio-temporal Forecasting

author.name: Zepu Wang (Xuegang), Bowen Liao (Xuegang), Jeff (Xuegang), Ban

entry.summary: Proposes FreST Loss, a frequency-enhanced spatio-temporal training objective that uses Joint Fourier Transform to align predictions with ground truth in a unified spectral domain, decorrelating dependencies across space and time. Addresses limitations of MSE-based objectives for graph-structured signals.

entry.title: Still Fresh? Evaluating Temporal Drift in Retrieval Benchmarks

author.name: Nathan Kuissi, Suraj Subrahmanyan, Nandan Thakur, Jimmy Lin

entry.summary: Investigates temporal drift in information retrieval benchmarks using FreshStack, comparing corpus snapshots from Oct 2024 and Oct 2025. Finds most queries remain supported but relevant documents migrate between repositories.

entry.title: When Denoising Hinders: Revisiting Zero-Shot ASR with SAM-Audio and Whisper

author.name: Akif Islam, Raufun Nahar, Md. Ekramul Hamid

entry.summary: Shows that using Meta's SAM-Audio speech enhancement as preprocessing for Whisper ASR actually degrades recognition accuracy, challenging the assumption that better perceptual quality improves ASR.

entry.title: Particle-Guided Diffusion for Gas-Phase Reaction Kinetics

author.name: Andrew Millard, Henrik Pedersen

entry.summary: Applies diffusion-based guided sampling to gas-phase chemical reactions, training on solutions of advection-reaction-diffusion equations and generating physically consistent concentration fields at unseen parameters.

entry.title: Logi-PAR: Logic-Infused Patient Activity Recognition via Differentiable Rule

author.name: Muhammad Zarar, MingZheng Zhang, Xiaowang Zhang, Zhiyong Feng, Sofonias Yitagesu, Kawsar Farooq

entry.summary: Logi-PAR integrates explicit logic-based reasoning into patient activity recognition, going beyond classification to infer why visual cues imply clinical risks through differentiable rule-based reasoning.

entry.title: Early Warning of Intraoperative Adverse Events via Transformer-Driven Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Xueyao Wang, Xiuding Cai, Honglin Shang, Yaoyao Zhu, Yu Yao

entry.summary: Proposes IAENet, a transformer-based multi-label learning framework for early warning of intraoperative adverse events, along with MuAE, the first multi-label dataset covering six critical surgical events.

entry.title: Synchronization-based clustering on the unit hypersphere

author.name: Zinaid Kapi\'c, Aladin Crnki\'c, Goran Mau\v{s}a

entry.summary: Introduces clustering on the unit hypersphere using the d-dimensional generalized Kuramoto model, leveraging synchronization dynamics for clustering.

entry.title: Robust Node Affinities via Jaccard-Biased Random Walks and Rank Aggregation

author.name: Bastian Pfeifer, Michael G. Schimek

entry.summary: Introduces TopKGraphs, a method using Jaccard-biased random walks and rank aggregation to compute robust node affinity matrices for graph analysis.

entry.title: A Geometry-Adaptive Deep Variational Framework for Phase Discovery in the Landau-Brazovskii Model

author.name: Yuchen Xie, Jianyuan Yin, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-adaptive deep variational framework for discovering ordered phases in pattern-forming systems, jointly optimizing order parameters (parameterized by neural networks) and computational domain geometry to avoid artificial stress artifacts.

entry.title: Additive Multi-Step Markov Chains and the Curse of Dimensionality in Large Language Models

author.name: O. V. Usatenko, S. S. Melnyk, G. M. Pritula

entry.summary: Explores approximating LLM dynamics using N-order additive Markov chains, establishing correspondence between additive multi-step chains and chains with step-wise memory functions to address the curse of dimensionality in high-dimensional token spaces.

entry.title: AILS-NTUA at SemEval-2026 Task 10: Agentic LLMs for Psycholinguistic Marker Extraction and Conspiracy Endorsement Detection

author.name: Panagiotis Alexios Spanakis, Maria Lymperaiou, Giorgos Filandrianos, Athanasios Voulodimos, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Presents an agentic LLM pipeline for SemEval-2026 Task 10 on conspiracy marker extraction and detection, using Dynamic Discriminative Chain-of-Thought and an 'Anti-Echo Chamber' architecture to overcome false penalization of objective reporting.

entry.title: SarcasmMiner: A Dual-Track Post-Training Framework for Robust Audio-Visual Sarcasm Reasoning

author.name: Zhu Li, Yongjian Chen, Huiyuan Lai, Xiyuan Gao, Shekhar Nayak, Matt Coler

entry.summary: Proposes SarcasmMiner, an RL-based post-training framework for multimodal sarcasm detection that uses dual-track distillation and GRPO with decoupled rewards for accuracy and reasoning quality.

entry.title: Structure-Guided Histopathology Synthesis via Dual-LoRA Diffusion

author.name: Xuan Xu, Prateek Prasanna

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-LoRA Controllable Diffusion for histopathology image synthesis, using multi-class nuclei centroids as spatial priors for both local structure completion and global structure synthesis.

entry.title: Towards Highly Transferable Vision-Language Attack via Semantic-Augmented Dynamic Contrastive Interaction

author.name: Yuanbo Li, Tianyang Xu, Cong Hu, Tao Zhou, Xiao-Jun Wu, Josef Kittler

entry.summary: Proposes SADCA for adversarial attacks on vision-language models using progressive semantic-augmented dynamic contrastive interactions to enhance transferability beyond static cross-modal disruption.

entry.title: Multi-Paradigm Collaborative Adversarial Attack Against Multi-Modal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuanbo Li, Tianyang Xu, Cong Hu, Tao Zhou, Xiao-Jun Wu, Josef Kittler

entry.summary: Proposes MPCAttack, a multi-paradigm collaborative attack framework against MLLMs that uses surrogate models from multiple learning paradigms to boost adversarial transferability.

entry.title: Scalable Injury-Risk Screening in Baseball Pitching From Broadcast Video

author.name: Jerrin Bright, Justin Mende, John Zelek

entry.summary: Presents a monocular video pipeline that recovers 18 clinically relevant biomechanics metrics from broadcast baseball footage for injury-risk screening. Uses DreamPose3D with a drift-controlled global lifting module for pelvis trajectory recovery.

entry.title: CLIP-driven Zero-shot Learning with Ambiguous Labels

author.name: Jinfu Fan, Jiangnan Li, Xiaowen Yan, Xiaohui Zhong, Wenpeng Lu, Linqing Huang

entry.summary: CLIP-PZSL handles zero-shot learning with ambiguous/partial labels by using CLIP features and a semantic mining block to extract discriminative label embeddings, with a partial zero-shot loss for handling label ambiguity.

entry.title: Towards 3D Scene Understanding of Gas Plumes in LWIR Hyperspectral Images Using Neural Radiance Fields

author.name: Scout Jarman, Zigfried Hampel-Arias, Adra Carr, Kevin R. Moon

entry.summary: Explores applying Neural Radiance Fields to LWIR hyperspectral images for 3D scene understanding of gas plumes, combining spectral and spatial information into a unified volumetric representation.

entry.title: Many-RRT*: Robust Joint-Space Trajectory Planning for Serial Manipulators

author.name: Theodore M. Belmont, Benjamin A. Christie, Anton Netchaev

entry.summary: Many-RRT* extends RRT*-Connect to handle the multi-arm bandit problem in joint-space planning for high-DoF manipulators, where multiple IK solutions for a single task-space goal create ambiguity in goal selection.

entry.title: Python Bindings for a Large C++ Robotics Library: The Case of OMPL

author.name: Weihang Guo, Theodoros Tyrovouzis, Lydia E. Kavraki

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs to assist generating Python bindings for large C++ robotics libraries (specifically OMPL), with human experts reviewing and refining LLM-generated nanobind wrappers.

entry.title: GaussTwin: Unified Simulation and Correction with Gaussian Splatting for Robotic Digital Twins
