author.name: Yichen Cai, Paul Jansonnie, Cristiana de Farias, Oleg Arenz, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Presents GaussTwin, a real-time digital twin system combining position-based physics simulation with Gaussian splatting for rendering and visual correction. Anchors Gaussians to physical primitives for coherent SE(3) updates, enabling stable prediction-correction cycles for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Omni-Manip: Beyond-FOV Large-Workspace Humanoid Manipulation with Omnidirectional 3D Perception

author.name: Pei Qu, Zheng Li, Yufei Jia, Ziyun Liu, Liang Zhu, Haoang Li, Jinni Zhou, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-Manip, which gives humanoid robots omnidirectional 3D perception for manipulation beyond their field of view using surround sensing rather than camera repositioning. Eliminates the need for base movements that introduce uncertainty.

entry.title: Measuring the Fragility of Trust: Devising Credibility Index via Explanation Stability (CIES) for Business Decision Support Systems

author.name: Alin-Gabriel Vaduva, Simona-Vasilica Oprea, Adela Bara

entry.summary: Introduces CIES, a metric measuring the stability of XAI explanations (SHAP, LIME) under realistic data perturbations for business decision support, penalizing instability in the most important features.

entry.title: UniSTOK: Uniform Inductive Spatio-Temporal Kriging

author.name: Lewei Xie, Haoyu Zhang, Juan Yuan, Liangjun You, Yulong Chen, Yifan Zhang

entry.summary: UniSTOK addresses spatio-temporal kriging with heterogeneous missing data through a plug-and-play framework that handles ambiguity between true signals and missingness artifacts.

entry.title: PACE: A Personalized Adaptive Curriculum Engine for 9-1-1 Call-taker Training

author.name: Zirong Chen, Hongchao Zhang, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: PACE is a personalized adaptive curriculum engine for 9-1-1 call-taker training that maintains probabilistic skill state beliefs and models individual learning/forgetting dynamics to recommend training scenarios.

entry.title: CogGen: Cognitive-Load-Informed Fully Unsupervised Deep Generative Modeling for Compressively Sampled MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Qingyong Zhu, Yumin Tan, Xiang Gu, Dong Liang

entry.summary: Proposes CogGen, a cognitive-load-informed unsupervised deep generative model for compressed-sensing MRI reconstruction that progressively schedules reconstruction from easy (low-frequency) to hard (high-frequency) components.

entry.title: A unified foundational framework for knowledge injection and evaluation of Large Language Models in Combustion Science

author.name: Zonglin Yang, Runze Mao, Tianhao Wu, Han Li, QingGuo Zhou, Zhi X. Chen

entry.summary: Presents the first end-to-end framework for developing combustion science LLMs, including a 3.5B-token knowledge base, CombustionQA benchmark, and three-stage knowledge injection pathway from RAG to continued pretraining.

entry.title: Are Multimodal LLMs Ready for Surveillance? A Reality Check on Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection in the Wild

author.name: Shanle Yao, Armin Danesh Pazho, Narges Rashvand, Hamed Tabkhi

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs for zero-shot video anomaly detection on surveillance benchmarks, finding pronounced conservative bias and significant performance gaps compared to specialized systems.

entry.title: LAW & ORDER: Adaptive Spatial Weighting for Medical Diffusion and Segmentation

author.name: Anugunj Naman, Ayushman Singh, Gaibo Zhang, Yaguang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LAW & ORDER, a pair of network adapters for medical image analysis: LAW for adaptive loss weighting in diffusion training and ORDER for spatial attention rebalancing in segmentation, addressing spatial imbalance of lesions.

entry.title: On the Strengths and Weaknesses of Data for Open-set Embodied Assistance

author.name: Pradyumna Tambwekar, Andrew Silva, Deepak Gopinath, Jonathan DeCastro, Xiongyi Cui, Guy Rosman

entry.summary: Investigates generalization capabilities of embodied foundation models fine-tuned on diverse interactive assistance data, exploring generalization along user behavior and configuration axes.

entry.title: SCoUT: Scalable Communication via Utility-Guided Temporal Grouping in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Manav Vora, Gokul Puthumanaillam, Hiroyasu Tsukamoto, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Introduces SCoUT for scalable communication in multi-agent RL, using temporal grouping and utility-guided communication to learn when and who to communicate with efficiently.

entry.title: Debiasing Sequential Recommendation with Time-aware Inverse Propensity Scoring

author.name: Sirui Huang, Jing Long, Qian Li, Guandong Xu, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes time-aware inverse propensity scoring for sequential recommendation to address selection and exposure biases by distinguishing between unexposed items and items not of interest using counterfactual reasoning.

entry.title: Visual-Informed Speech Enhancement Using Attention-Based Beamforming

author.name: Chihyun Liu, Jiaxuan Fan, Mingtung Sun, Michael Anthony, Mingsian R. Bai, Yu Tsao

entry.summary: Proposes visual-informed neural beamforming that integrates lip movement features from a pretrained visual speech recognition model with microphone array processing for robust speech enhancement in challenging conditions.

entry.title: MCEL: Margin-Based Cross-Entropy Loss for Error-Tolerant Quantized Neural Networks

author.name: Mikail Yayla, Akash Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes MCEL, a margin-based cross-entropy loss for training neural networks robust to bit errors on approximate computing platforms, avoiding the computational overhead of training-time bit flip injection.

entry.title: FairFinGAN: Fairness-aware Synthetic Financial Data Generation

author.name: Tai Le Quy, Dung Nguyen Tuan, Trung Nguyen Thanh, Duy Tran Cong, Huyen Giang Thi Thu, Frank Hopfgartner

entry.summary: Proposes FairFinGAN, a WGAN-based framework for generating synthetic financial data with fairness constraints incorporated during training.

entry.title: Embedded Inter-Subject Variability in Adversarial Learning for Inertial Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Francisco M. Calatrava-Nicol\'as, Shoko Miyauchi, Vitor Fortes Rey, Paul Lukowicz, Todor Stoyanov, Oscar Martinez Mozos

entry.summary: Proposes an adversarial framework for human activity recognition that integrates inter-subject variability into adversarial training, encouraging subject-invariant features.

entry.title: Quadratic polarity and polar Fenchel-Young divergences from the canonical Legendre polarity

author.name: Frank Nielsen, Basile Plus-Gourdon, Mahito Sugiyama

entry.summary: Defines quadratic polarity and polar Fenchel-Young divergences from canonical Legendre polarity, connecting projective geometry with information divergences.

entry.title: SRasP: Self-Reorientation Adversarial Style Perturbation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Wenqian Li, Pengfei Fang, Hui Xue

entry.summary: Proposes SRasP for cross-domain few-shot learning using crop-global style perturbation with self-reorientation of adversarial style gradients.

entry.title: LocalSUG: Geography-Aware LLM for Query Suggestion in Local-Life Services

author.name: Jinwen Chen (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Shuai Gong (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Shiwen Zhang (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Zheng Zhang (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Yachao Zhao (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Lingxiang Wang (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Haibo Zhou (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Yuan Zhan (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Wei Lin (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China), Hainan Zhang (Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing, School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, China)

entry.summary: Proposes LocalSUG, an LLM-based query suggestion framework for local-life service platforms that addresses geographic grounding, exposure bias in preference optimization, and inference latency challenges.

entry.title: VisionPangu: A Compact and Fine-Grained Multimodal Assistant with 1.7B Parameters

author.name: Jiaxin Fan, Wenpo Song

entry.summary: Presents VisionPangu, a compact 1.7B-parameter multimodal model for detailed image captioning using InternVL-derived vision encoder with OpenPangu-Embedded language backbone and DOCCI dataset fine-tuning.

entry.title: Toward Real-world Infrared Image Super-Resolution: A Unified Autoregressive Framework and Benchmark Dataset

author.name: Yang Zou, Jun Ma, Zhidong Jiao, Xingyuan Li, Zhiying Jiang, Jinyuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Real-IISR, a unified autoregressive framework for real-world infrared image super-resolution that progressively reconstructs thermal structures while maintaining thermal fidelity.

entry.title: Revisiting an Old Perspective Projection for Monocular 3D Morphable Models Regression

author.name: Toby Chong, Ryota Nakajima

entry.summary: Introduces a novel camera model for monocular 3DMM regression that captures perspective distortion in close-up facial images, extending orthographic projection to handle head-mounted camera footage.

entry.title: Generalizable Multiscale Segmentation of Heterogeneous Map Collections

author.name: Remi Petitpierre

entry.summary: Introduces Semap, a benchmark dataset of 1,439 annotated patches for historical map segmentation, plus a framework combining procedural data synthesis with multiscale integration for generalizable map recognition across diverse historical map styles.

entry.title: Gait Generation Balancing Joint Load and Mobility for Legged Modular Robots with Easily Detachable Joints

author.name: Kennosuke Chihara, Takuya Kiyokawa, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Proposes an NSGA-III optimization framework for legged modular robot gait generation that balances joint load minimization with mobility, particularly important for detachable joints prone to mechanical failure.

entry.title: Data-Driven Control of a Magnetically Actuated Fish-Like Robot

author.name: Akiyuki Koyama, Hiroaki Kawashima

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven control framework for magnetically actuated fish-like robots combining a neural network forward dynamics model with gradient-based MPC, handling variable-duration control steps and nonlinear dynamics.

entry.title: Curve-Induced Dynamical Systems on Riemannian Manifolds and Lie Groups

author.name: Saray Bakker, Martin Schonger, Tobias L\"ow, Javier Alonso-Mora, Sylvain Calinon

entry.summary: Introduces CDSM, a framework for constructing dynamical systems directly on Riemannian manifolds and Lie groups for robot motion generation. Enables safe, stable, and interpretable behaviors that respect geometric task structure including poses on SE(3).

entry.title: Safe-SAGE: Social-Semantic Adaptive Guidance for Safe Engagement through Laplace-Modulated Poisson Safety Functions

author.name: Lizhi Yang, Ryan M. Bena, Meg Wilkinson, Gilbert Bahati, Andy Navarro Brenes, Ryan K. Cosner, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Proposes Safe-SAGE, a framework integrating semantic understanding with safety-critical control through Poisson safety functions modulated by Laplace guidance fields. Enables context-aware robot behavior that treats obstacles differently based on their semantic meaning.

entry.title: Fusion-CAM: Integrating Gradient and Region-Based Class Activation Maps for Robust Visual Explanations

author.name: Hajar Dekdegue, Moncef Garouani, Josiane Mothe, Jordan Bernigaud

entry.summary: Fusion-CAM combines gradient-based and region-based class activation map methods to produce more complete and discriminative visual explanations, addressing the complementary weaknesses of each approach.

entry.title: Designing and Validating a Self-Aligning Tool Changer for Modular Reconfigurable Manipulation Robots

author.name: Mahfudz Maskur, Takuya Kiyokawa, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Designs a misalignment-tolerant tool-changing system for modular reconfigurable robots using passive self-alignment geometries and a compact rotating tool exchange station.

entry.title: From Offline to Periodic Adaptation for Pose-Based Shoplifting Detection in Real-world Retail Security

author.name: Shanle Yao, Narges Rashvand, Armin Danesh Pazho, Hamed Tabkhi

entry.summary: Addresses shoplifting detection using pose-based unsupervised video anomaly detection with a periodic adaptation framework for IoT edge deployment. Introduces RetailS, a new large-scale dataset for the domain.

entry.title: Visioning Human-Agentic AI Teaming: Continuity, Tension, and Future Research

author.name: Bowen Lou, Tian Lu, T. S. Raghu, Yingjie Zhang

entry.summary: Advances Team Situation Awareness theory for human-agentic AI teaming, addressing how open-ended AI action trajectories introduce structural uncertainty that requires continuous alignment rather than bounded agreement.

entry.title: EchoGuard: An Agentic Framework with Knowledge-Graph Memory for Detecting Manipulative Communication in Longitudinal Dialogue

author.name: Ratna Kandala, Niva Manchanda, Akshata Kishore Moharir, Ananth Kandala

entry.summary: EchoGuard is an agentic AI framework using knowledge graphs as episodic/semantic memory to detect manipulative communication patterns like gaslighting and emotional coercion in longitudinal dialogues.

entry.title: Authorize-on-Demand: Dynamic Authorization with Legality-Aware Intellectual Property Protection for VLMs

author.name: Lianyu Wang, Meng Wang, Huazhu Fu, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: AoD-IP proposes dynamic authorization for intellectual property protection of vision-language models, supporting on-demand authorization and legality-aware assessment rather than static training-time definitions.

entry.title: Jagarin: A Three-Layer Architecture for Hibernating Personal Duty Agents on Mobile

author.name: Ravi Kiran Kadaboina

entry.summary: Jagarin proposes a three-layer mobile agent architecture resolving the battery/responsiveness paradox through structured hibernation and demand-driven wake, using urgency scoring from multiple signals.

entry.title: FedEMA-Distill: Exponential Moving Average Guided Knowledge Distillation for Robust Federated Learning

author.name: Hamza Reguieg, Mohamed El Kamili, Essaid Sabir

entry.summary: Proposes FedEMA-Distill, combining exponential moving average of global models with ensemble knowledge distillation for federated learning. Clients upload only compressed logits, supporting model heterogeneity without client-side modifications.

entry.title: Augmenting representations with scientific papers

author.name: Nicol\`o Oreste Pinciroli Vago, Rocco Di Tella, Carolina Cuesta-L\'azaro, Michael J. Smith, Cecilia Garraffo, Rafael Mart\'inez-Galarza

entry.summary: Introduces a contrastive learning framework to align X-ray spectra with scientific literature for astronomy, achieving 20% Recall@1% when retrieving texts from spectra.

entry.title: Invariant Causal Routing for Governing Social Norms in Online Market Economies

author.name: Xiangning Yu, Qirui Mi, Xiao Xue, Haoxuan Li, Yiwei Shi, Xiaowei Liu, Mengyue Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Invariant Causal Routing (ICR), a causal governance framework for identifying and intervening on social norms in online market economies, using invariance principles for policy transferability.

entry.title: Probabilistic Dreaming for World Models

author.name: Gavin Wong

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to the Dreamer world model using probabilistic methods for parallel latent state exploration and maintaining distinct hypotheses for mutually exclusive futures. Shows 4.5% improvement on MPE SimpleTag.

entry.title: Meta-D: Metadata-Aware Architectures for Brain Tumor Analysis and Missing-Modality Segmentation

author.name: SangHyuk Kim, Daniel Haehn, Sumientra Rampersad

entry.summary: Presents Meta-D, an architecture leveraging categorical scanner metadata (MRI sequence, plane orientation) to guide feature extraction for brain tumor analysis, with extensions to missing-modality segmentation.

entry.title: DeformTrace: A Deformable State Space Model with Relay Tokens for Temporal Forgery Localization

author.name: Xiaodong Zhu, Suting Wang, Yuanming Zheng, Junqi Yang, Yangxu Liao, Yuhong Yang, Weiping Tu, Zhongyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DeformTrace for temporal forgery localization using deformable state space models with relay tokens, enhancing SSMs with dynamic receptive fields for precise temporal boundary detection in videos.

entry.title: Aura: Universal Multi-dimensional Exogenous Integration for Aviation Time Series

author.name: Jiafeng Lin, Mengren Zheng, Simeng Ye, Yuxuan Wang, Huan Zhang, Yuhui Liu, Zhongyi Pei, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Aura, a framework for integrating multi-dimensional exogenous factors into time series forecasting for aviation maintenance, identifying three distinct types of exogenous factors with different interaction modes.

entry.title: GEM-TFL: Bridging Weak and Full Supervision for Forgery Localization through EM-Guided Decomposition and Temporal Refinement

author.name: Xiaodong Zhu, Yuanming Zheng, Suting Wang, Junqi Yang, Yuhong Yang, Weiping Tu, Zhongyuan Wang

entry.summary: GEM-TFL addresses weakly-supervised temporal forgery localization in videos using graph-based EM optimization, tackling mismatched objectives and limited supervision from binary labels.

entry.title: LBM: Hierarchical Large Auto-Bidding Model via Reasoning and Acting

author.name: Yewen Li, Zhiyi Lyu, Peng Jiang, Qingpeng Cai, Fei Pan, Bo An, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: LBM applies large language models to auto-bidding in online advertising through a hierarchical reasoning and acting framework, leveraging LLM prior knowledge to improve bidding strategy generalization.

entry.title: SPyCer: Semi-Supervised Physics-Guided Contextual Attention for Near-Surface Air Temperature Estimation from Satellite Imagery

author.name: Sofiane Bouaziz, Adel Hafiane, Raphael Canals, Rachid Nedjai

entry.summary: SPyCer is a semi-supervised physics-guided network for estimating near-surface air temperature from satellite imagery, leveraging both pixel information and physical modeling to guide learning.

entry.title: SAIL: Similarity-Aware Guidance and Inter-Caption Augmentation-based Learning for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning

author.name: Ye-Chan Kim, SeungJu Cha, Si-Woo Kim, Minju Jeon, Hyungee Kim, Dong-Jin Kim

entry.summary: SAIL improves weakly-supervised dense video captioning by constructing semantically-aware masks through cross-modal alignment and augmenting training with inter-caption augmentation to address data sparsity.

entry.title: Residual RL--MPC for Robust Microrobotic Cell Pushing Under Time-Varying Flow

author.name: Yanda Yang, Sambeeta Das

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid controller for microrobotic cell pushing that augments MPC with a learned SAC-trained residual policy, using contact-gating to apply residual corrections only during robot-cell contact.

entry.title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Information Bottleneck for Uncertainty-Aware DRAM Equalization

author.name: Muhammad Usama, Dong Eui Chang

entry.summary: Proposes a distributional risk-sensitive reinforcement learning framework for DRAM equalizer optimization, integrating Information Bottleneck representations with CVaR optimization. Achieves 51x speedup over traditional eye diagram evaluation.

entry.title: Semantic Communication-Enhanced Split Federated Learning for Vehicular Networks: Architecture, Challenges, and Case Study

author.name: Lu Yu, Zheng Chang, Ying-Chang Liang

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic communication-enhanced split federated learning framework for vehicular networks, reducing communication overhead by transmitting only task-relevant information.

entry.title: Uncertainty-aware Blood Glucose Prediction from Continuous Glucose Monitoring Data

author.name: Hai Siong Tan

entry.summary: Investigates uncertainty-aware neural networks for blood glucose prediction in Type 1 diabetes, comparing LSTM, GRU, and Transformer architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and evidential output layers.

entry.title: Trainable Bitwise Soft Quantization for Input Feature Compression

author.name: Karsten Schr\"odter, Jan Stenkamp, Nina Herrmann, Fabian Gieseke

entry.summary: Proposes a trainable bitwise soft quantization layer for compressing input features at the edge before transmission, reducing data transfer requirements for IoT ML applications.

entry.title: A Behaviour-Aware Federated Forecasting Framework for Distributed Stand-Alone Wind Turbines

author.name: Bowen Li, Xiufeng Liu, Maria Sinziiana Astefanoaei

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage federated learning framework for wind turbine power forecasting using behavioral clustering with Double Roulette Selection initialization.

entry.title: Multiclass Hate Speech Detection with RoBERTa-OTA: Integrating Transformer Attention and Graph Convolutional Networks

author.name: Mahmoud Abusaqer, Jamil Saquer

entry.summary: Proposes RoBERTa-OTA, combining RoBERTa embeddings with ontology-guided attention and graph convolutional networks for multiclass hate speech detection across demographic categories.

entry.title: Optimizing What We Trust: Reliability-Guided QUBO Selection of Multi-Agent Weak Framing Signals for Arabic Sentiment Prediction

author.name: Rabab Alkhalifa

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-aware weak supervision framework for Arabic framing detection using multi-agent LLM pipeline with QUBO-based subset selection for data curation guided by instance-level reliability estimates.

entry.title: Can LLMs Capture Expert Uncertainty? A Comparative Analysis of Value Alignment in Ethnographic Qualitative Research

author.name: Arina Kostina, Marios Dikaiakos, Alejandro Porcel, Tassos Stassopoulos

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs on identifying human values from ethnographic interviews using the Schwartz framework, comparing LLM outputs to expert annotations and analyzing uncertainty patterns.

entry.title: An Exploration-Analysis-Disambiguation Reasoning Framework for Word Sense Disambiguation with Low-Parameter LLMs

author.name: Deshan Sumanathilaka, Nicholas Micallef, Julian Hough

entry.summary: Investigates whether small LLMs (<4B parameters) can achieve competitive word sense disambiguation through CoT-based fine-tuning on augmented data with rationale-rich annotations.

entry.title: NCTB-QA: A Large-Scale Bangla Educational Question Answering Dataset and Benchmarking Performance

author.name: Abrar Eyasir, Tahsin Ahmed, Muhammad Ibrahim

entry.summary: Introduces NCTB-QA, a large-scale Bangla question answering dataset with 87,805 pairs including balanced answerable/unanswerable questions with adversarial distractors. Benchmarks transformer models and GPT-4o.

entry.title: Privacy-Aware Camera 2.0 Technical Report

author.name: Huan Song, Shuyu Tian, Ting Long, Jiang Liu, Cheng Yuan, Zhenyu Jia, Jiawei Shao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes Privacy Camera 2.0, a privacy-preserving perception framework using AI Flow paradigm and edge-cloud architecture that eliminates visual data at source while maintaining sufficient semantic understanding for security applications.

entry.title: Evaluating and Correcting Human Annotation Bias in Dynamic Micro-Expression Recognition

author.name: Feng Liu, Bingyu Nan, Xuezhong Qian, Xiaolan Fu

entry.summary: Proposes GAMDSS architecture for micro-expression recognition that re-selects key frames (onset, apex, offset) via dynamic frame reselection to correct human annotation biases.

entry.title: RMK RetinaNet: Rotated Multi-Kernel RetinaNet for Robust Oriented Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Huiran Sun

entry.summary: Proposes RMK RetinaNet for rotated object detection in remote sensing, introducing multi-scale kernel blocks, multi-directional contextual anchor attention, bottom-up path, and Euler angle encoding.

entry.title: Generic Camera Calibration using Blurry Images

author.name: Zezhun Shi

entry.summary: Addresses generic camera calibration using blurry images by simultaneously estimating feature locations and spatially varying point spread functions, leveraging geometric constraints and a local parametric illumination model.

entry.title: Adaptive Policy Switching of Two-Wheeled Differential Robots for Traversing over Diverse Terrains

author.name: Haruki Izawa, Takeshi Takai, Shingo Kitano, Mikita Miyaguchi, Hiroaki Kawashima

entry.summary: Investigates adaptive policy switching for two-wheeled differential robots based on terrain type estimation from posture observations, using pitch variance to distinguish flat from rough terrain in simulated lunar lava tubes.

entry.title: AIM-SLAM: Dense Monocular SLAM via Adaptive and Informative Multi-View Keyframe Prioritization with Foundation Model

author.name: Jinwoo Jeon, Dong-Uk Seo, Eungchang Mason Lee, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: Proposes AIM-SLAM, a dense monocular SLAM system that uses adaptive multi-view keyframe selection with a visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT) for dense pointmap predictions. Introduces information- and geometric-aware metrics for intelligent view selection.

entry.title: AI Safety Has 12 Months Left

author.name: mhdempsey

entry.summary: Argues there is a 12-month window to embed AI safety into technical and social infrastructure before IPOs and competitive dynamics make it permanently impossible. Frames the transition as productivity shifting from labor to capital.

entry.title: FedAFD: Multimodal Federated Learning via Adversarial Fusion and Distillation

author.name: Min Tan, Junchao Ma, Yinfu Feng, Jiajun Ding, Wenwen Pan, Tingting Han, Qian Zheng, Zhenzhong Kuang, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes FedAFD for multimodal federated learning using adversarial fusion and distillation, with bi-level adversarial alignment and granularity-aware fusion to handle modality/task discrepancies.

entry.title: Memory as Ontology: A Constitutional Memory Architecture for Persistent Digital Citizens

author.name: Zhenghui Li

entry.summary: Proposes the 'Memory-as-Ontology' paradigm arguing that for long-lived AI agents, memory is not just data management but the foundation of digital existence. Designs Animesis, a Constitutional Memory Architecture for persistent digital citizens.

entry.title: LLM-Grounded Explainability for Port Congestion Prediction via Temporal Graph Attention Networks

author.name: Zhiming Xue, Yujue Wang

entry.summary: AIS-TGNN combines Temporal Graph Attention Networks with LLM reasoning for port congestion prediction and explanation, using AIS vessel tracking data to construct spatial graphs for maritime supply chain management.

entry.title: Lost in Translation: How Language Re-Aligns Vision for Cross-Species Pathology

author.name: Ekansh Arora

entry.summary: Investigates how fine-tuning CPath-CLIP affects cancer detection under cross-species transfer between canine and human histopathology, finding that tissue matching enables meaningful transfer but performance remains below specialized benchmarks.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Moot Courts: Simulating Justice-Specific Questioning in Oral Arguments

author.name: Kylie Zhang, Nimra Nadeem, Lucia Zheng, Dominik Stammbach, Peter Henderson

entry.summary: Evaluates whether AI models can simulate justice-specific questioning for moot court practice using U.S. Supreme Court oral argument transcripts. Explores quality dimensions of effective questioning.

entry.title: Attention's Gravitational Field:A Power-Law Interpretation of Positional Correlation

author.name: Edward Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Attention Gravitational Field (AGF) concept, decoupling positional encodings from semantic embeddings and drawing analogies to Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation for interpreting attention mechanisms.

entry.title: UniPAR: A Unified Framework for Pedestrian Attribute Recognition

author.name: Minghe Xu, Rouying Wu, Jiarui Xu, Minhao Sun, Zikang Yan, Xiao Wang, ChiaWei Chu, Yu Li

entry.summary: UniPAR is a unified Transformer-based framework for pedestrian attribute recognition that handles heterogeneous modalities and attribute definitions across multiple datasets with dynamic classification heads.

entry.title: A Late-Fusion Multimodal AI Framework for Privacy-Preserving Deduplication in National Healthcare Data Environments

author.name: Mohammed Omer Shakeel Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal AI framework for privacy-preserving deduplication in healthcare that avoids using sensitive identifiers, leveraging semantic embeddings and behavioral features instead.

entry.title: Direct Estimation of Tree Volume and Aboveground Biomass Using Deep Regression with Synthetic Lidar Data

author.name: Habib Pourdelan, Zhengkang Xiang, Hugh Stewart, Cam Nicholson, Martin Tomko, Kourosh Khoshelham

entry.summary: Proposes direct estimation of tree volume and biomass from LiDAR point clouds using deep regression trained on synthetic data, bypassing allometric models.

entry.title: Lightweight and Scalable Transfer Learning Framework for Load Disaggregation

author.name: L. E. Garcia-Marrero, G. Petrone, E. Monmasson

entry.summary: Proposes RefQuery, a scalable multi-appliance transfer learning framework for non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) that works on edge devices and handles evolving appliance sets.

entry.title: Video-based Locomotion Analysis for Fish Health Monitoring

author.name: Timon Palm, Clemens Seibold, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert

entry.summary: Presents a video-based fish health monitoring system using YOLOv11 in a tracking-by-detection framework to estimate locomotion activities from aquaculture videos, investigating various architecture configurations.

entry.title: Risk-Aware Rulebooks for Multi-Objective Trajectory Evaluation under Uncertainty

author.name: Tichakorn Wongpiromsarn

entry.summary: Presents a risk-aware formalism for evaluating autonomous system trajectories under uncertainty, handling hierarchical priorities and non-comparable objectives. Explicitly models how system trajectories influence environment responses and proves the formalism induces a consistent preorder.

entry.title: Capability Thresholds and Manufacturing Topology: How Embodied Intelligence Triggers Phase Transitions in Economic Geography

author.name: Xinmin Fang, Lingfeng Tao, Zhengxiong Li

entry.summary: A theoretical paper arguing that embodied AI will trigger phase transitions in manufacturing economic geography, breaking the century-old Fordist paradigm of centralized mega-factories. It identifies critical capability thresholds in dexterity, generalization, reliability, and tactile-vision fusion.

entry.title: MOOSEnger -- a Domain-Specific AI Agent for the MOOSE Ecosystem

author.name: Mengnan Li, Jason Miller, Zachary Prince, Alexander Lindsay, Cody Permann

entry.summary: MOOSEnger is an AI agent for the MOOSE multiphysics simulation environment that converts natural language to runnable simulation inputs using RAG and MOOSE-aware parsing/validation tools.

entry.title: Knowledge-informed Bidding with Dual-process Control for Online Advertising

author.name: Huixiang Luo, Longyu Gao, Yaqi Liu, Qianqian Chen, Pingchun Huang, Tianning Li

entry.summary: KBD embeds human expertise as inductive biases in bid optimization for online advertising, using Decision Transformers with dual-process control to replicate expert adaptive decision-making.

entry.title: Ailed: A Psyche-Driven Chess Engine with Dynamic Emotional Modulation

author.name: Diego Armando Resendez Prado

entry.summary: Ailed is a chess engine with dynamic emotional modulation using a personality × psyche decomposition, applying audio-inspired signal processing (noise gate, compressor, equalizer) to reshape move probability distributions.

entry.title: Legal interpretation and AI: from expert systems to argumentation and LLMs

author.name: V\'aclav Jane\v{c}ek, Giovanni Sartor

entry.summary: Reviews how AI and Law research has engaged with legal interpretation across three eras: expert systems (knowledge engineering), argumentation (dialectical frameworks), and machine learning (LLM-based interpretation).

entry.title: ASFL: An Adaptive Model Splitting and Resource Allocation Framework for Split Federated Learning

author.name: Chuiyang Meng, Ming Tang, Vincent W. S. Wong

entry.summary: Proposes ASFL, an adaptive split federated learning framework over wireless networks that optimizes model splitting and resource allocation. Theoretically analyzes convergence rate and formulates joint optimization of learning performance and efficiency.

entry.title: GIANT - Global Path Integration and Attentive Graph Networks for Multi-Agent Trajectory Planning

author.name: Jonas le Fevre Sejersen, Toyotaro Suzumura, Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: Proposes GIANT for multi-robot collision avoidance using attentive graph neural networks with global path integration. Shows robust performance across structurally diverse simulated scenarios.

entry.title: Detection of Illicit Content on Online Marketplaces using Large Language Models

author.name: Quoc Khoa Tran, Thanh Thi Nguyen, Campbell Wilson

entry.summary: Investigates LLMs (Llama 3.2, Gemma 3) for detecting illicit content on online marketplaces, addressing challenges of obfuscation techniques and multilingual content that defeat traditional content moderation.

entry.title: DSA-SRGS: Super-Resolution Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Sparse-View DSA Reconstruction

author.name: Shiyu Zhang, Zhicong Wu, Huangxuan Zhao, Zhentao Liu, Lei Chen, Yong Luo, Lefei Zhang, Zhiming Cui, Ziwen Ke, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes DSA-SRGS for super-resolution 4D vascular reconstruction from sparse dynamic DSA inputs using Gaussian splatting, addressing resolution limitations in cerebrovascular imaging.

entry.title: MUTEX: Leveraging Multilingual Transformers and Conditional Random Fields for Enhanced Urdu Toxic Span Detection

author.name: Inayat Arshad, Fajar Saleem, Ijaz Hussain

entry.summary: MUTEX combines XLM-RoBERTa with CRF for Urdu toxic span detection at the token level, addressing the lack of annotated resources for low-resource language toxicity detection.

entry.title: The Spatial and Temporal Resolution of Motor Intention in Multi-Target Prediction

author.name: Marie Dominique Schmidt, Ioannis Iossifidis

entry.summary: Studies motor intention prediction from EMG signals, analyzing spatial and temporal resolution of movement direction and target location decoding across planning and execution phases of reaching tasks.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Driven Friendly Jamming for Secure Multicarrier ISAC Under Channel Uncertainty

author.name: Bui Minh Tuan, Van-Dinh Nguyen, Diep N. Nguyen, Nguyen Linh Trung, Nguyen Van Huynh, Dinh Thai Hoang, Marwan Krunz, Eryk Dutkiewicz

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning framework for physical-layer security in multicarrier ISAC systems, using radar echo feedback for directional jamming without requiring eavesdropper information.

entry.title: Auction-Based RIS Allocation With DRL: Controlling the Cost-Performance Trade-Off

author.name: Martin Mark Zan, Stefan Schwarz

entry.summary: Studies RIS allocation in multi-cell wireless networks using auction-based mechanisms with deep reinforcement learning agents for bidding optimization.

entry.title: Bayesian Modeling of Collatz Stopping Times: A Probabilistic Machine Learning Perspective

author.name: Nicol\`o Bonacorsi, Matteo Bordoni

entry.summary: Studies Collatz stopping times using Bayesian hierarchical models and mechanistic generative approximations, treating it as a probabilistic ML problem.

entry.title: Weather-Related Crash Risk Forecasting: A Deep Learning Approach for Heterogenous Spatiotemporal Data

author.name: Abimbola Ogungbire, Srinivas Pulugurtha

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble of ConvLSTM models for weather-related traffic crash risk forecasting using overlapping spatial grids to capture spatial heterogeneity.

entry.title: Non-Zipfian Distribution of Stopwords and Subset Selection Models

author.name: Wentian Li, Oscar Fontanelli

entry.summary: Analyzes the rank-frequency distribution of stopwords, showing they follow Beta Rank Function rather than Zipf's law, and proposes a subset selection model for stopwords based on Hill's function.

entry.title: AILS-NTUA at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Efficient Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Stavros Gazetas, Giorgos Filandrianos, Maria Lymperaiou, Paraskevi Tzouveli, Athanasios Voulodimos, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Presents a system for dimensional aspect-based sentiment analysis combining fine-tuned encoder backbones with LoRA-tuned LLMs for multilingual, multi-domain sentiment triplet and quadruplet extraction.

entry.title: A Multilingual Human Annotated Corpus of Original and Easy-to-Read Texts to Support Access to Democratic Participatory Processes

author.name: Stefan Bott, Verena Riegler, Horacio Saggion, Almudena Rasc\'on Alcaina, Nouran Khallaf

entry.summary: Presents a multilingual corpus of original and easy-to-read texts in Spanish, Catalan, and Italian, developed for the iDEM project assessing impact of Easy-to-Read language for democratic participation.

entry.title: Recognition of Daily Activities through Multi-Modal Deep Learning: A Video, Pose, and Object-Aware Approach for Ambient Assisted Living

author.name: Kooshan Hashemifard, Pau Climent-P\'erez, Francisco Florez-Revuelta

entry.summary: Presents a multi-modal approach for daily activity recognition in ambient assisted living, combining 3D CNNs for visual data, GCNs for pose data, and object detection for contextual reasoning.

entry.title: NaiLIA: Multimodal Nail Design Retrieval Based on Dense Intent Descriptions and Palette Queries

author.name: Kanon Amemiya, Daichi Yashima, Kei Katsumata, Takumi Komatsu, Ryosuke Korekata, Seitaro Otsuki, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: NaiLIA proposes a multimodal retrieval method for nail design images based on dense intent descriptions and palette queries, addressing limitations of existing VLMs in handling nuanced color and design specifications.

entry.title: CT-Enabled Patient-Specific Simulation and Contact-Aware Robotic Planning for Cochlear Implantation

author.name: Lingxiao Xun, Gang Zheng, Alexandre Kruszewski, Renato Torres

entry.summary: Presents a CT-to-simulation pipeline for robotic cochlear implant insertion, using a differentiable Cosserat-rod model coupled with frictional contact. Enables patient-specific contact-aware planning from CT-reconstructed cochlear anatomy.

entry.title: Accelerating Sampling-Based Control via Learned Linear Koopman Dynamics

author.name: Wenjian Hao, Yuxuan Fang, Zehui Lu, Shaoshuai Mou

entry.summary: Replaces nonlinear dynamics in Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with a learned linear Deep Koopman Operator for faster trajectory rollouts. Validated on pendulum, surface vehicle, and quadruped robot tasks.

entry.title: Vibe Coding cripples the mind

author.name: spookyuser

entry.summary: Argues that AI-assisted 'vibe coding' produces chaotic, unmaintainable codebases, with evidence from hackathon observations and a GitHub scraping study. Raises concerns about developers losing fundamental coding skills by over-relying on AI code generation.

entry.title: Towards automated data analysis: A guided framework for LLM-based risk estimation

author.name: Panteleimon Rodis

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for LLM-guided dataset risk estimation that integrates generative AI under human supervision, using LLMs to identify semantic and structural properties in database schemata for automated risk analysis.

entry.title: GCAgent: Enhancing Group Chat Communication through Dialogue Agents System

author.name: Zijie Meng, Zheyong Xie, Zheyu Ye, Chonggang Lu, Zuozhu Liu, Zihan Niu, Yao Hu, Shaosheng Cao

entry.summary: GCAgent introduces an LLM-driven system for enhancing multi-participant group chats with entertainment and utility-oriented dialogue agents, featuring agent building, dialogue management, and topic recommendation modules.

entry.title: MPBMC: Multi-Property Bounded Model Checking with GNN-guided Clustering

author.name: Soumik Guha Roy, Sumana Ghosh, Ansuman Banerjee, Raj Kumar Gajavelly, Sudhakar Surendran

entry.summary: Proposes MPBMC, using GNN embeddings for functional clustering of properties in formal hardware verification, combining neural representations with runtime statistics to speed up bounded model checking.

entry.title: MAD-SmaAt-GNet: A Multimodal Advection-Guided Neural Network for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Samuel van Wonderen, Siamak Mehrkanoon

entry.summary: Introduces MAD-SmaAt-GNet for precipitation nowcasting, extending the SmaAt-UNet with multimodal advection guidance and graph neural network components for weather prediction.

entry.title: Interpretable Pre-Release Baseball Pitch Type Anticipation from Broadcast 3D Kinematics

author.name: Jerrin Bright, Michelle Lu, John Zelek

entry.summary: Classifies eight baseball pitch types from monocular 3D pose sequences without ball-flight data, achieving 80.4% accuracy on 119,561 professional pitches. Finds upper-body mechanics contribute 64.9% of predictive signal.

entry.title: PersianPunc: A Large-Scale Dataset and BERT-Based Approach for Persian Punctuation Restoration

author.name: Mohammad Javad Ranjbar Kalahroodi, Heshaam Faili, Azadeh Shakery

entry.summary: PersianPunc introduces a 17M sample dataset for Persian punctuation restoration and demonstrates that fine-tuned ParsBERT outperforms LLMs which tend to over-correct.

entry.title: Fusion and Grouping Strategies in Deep Learning for Local Climate Zone Classification of Multimodal Remote Sensing Data

author.name: Ancymol Thomas, Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair

entry.summary: Analyzes fusion strategies in deep learning for local climate zone classification using multimodal remote sensing data, comparing CNN-based fusion approaches.

entry.title: A Benchmark Study of Neural Network Compression Methods for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Sai Shi

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of neural network compression methods (pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation) for hyperspectral image classification on resource-constrained platforms.

entry.title: Stan: An LLM-based thermodynamics course assistant

author.name: Eric M. Furst, Vasudevan Venkateshwaran

entry.summary: Describes Stan, an LLM-based course assistant for undergraduate thermodynamics that serves both students (via RAG pipeline) and instructors from shared lecture transcripts and textbook index.

entry.title: Dual-Interaction-Aware Cooperative Control Strategy for Alleviating Mixed Traffic Congestion

author.name: Zhengxuan Liu, Yuxin Cai, Yijing Wang, Xiangkun He, Chen Lv, Zhiqiang Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes DIACC, a multi-agent reinforcement learning strategy for connected automated vehicles in mixed traffic with human drivers. Enhances both local and global interaction awareness for cooperative control at bottleneck areas.

entry.title: Model Medicine: A Clinical Framework for Understanding, Diagnosing, and Treating AI Models

author.name: Jihoon Jeong

entry.summary: Proposes 'Model Medicine' as a new research paradigm that treats AI models like biological organisms with diagnosable and treatable conditions. Introduces 15 subdisciplines organized across four divisions for systematic AI model care.

entry.title: Simulating Meaning, Nevermore! Introducing ICR: A Semiotic-Hermeneutic Metric for Evaluating Meaning in LLM Text Summaries

author.name: Natalie Perez, Sreyoshi Bhaduri, Aman Chadha

entry.summary: Proposes ICR, a semiotic-hermeneutic metric for evaluating meaning in LLM-generated text summaries, integrating semiotics and hermeneutics with qualitative research methods. Attempts to bridge the gap between statistical text approximation and human interpretive meaning.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Bidding Agents in Repeated HetNet Auction

author.name: Ismail Lotfi, Ali Ghrayeb, Samson Lasaulce, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs as bidding agents in repeated spectrum auctions within heterogeneous networks, where user equipment strategically decides association and bid values under budget constraints.

entry.title: Learning Unified Distance Metric for Heterogeneous Attribute Data Clustering

author.name: Yiqun Zhang, Mingjie Zhao, Yizhou Chen, Yang Lu, Yiu-ming Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes a unified distance metric for clustering datasets with mixed numerical and categorical attributes, addressing the challenge of simultaneously exploiting both attribute types.

entry.title: Hate Speech Detection using Large Language Models with Data Augmentation and Feature Enhancement

author.name: Brian Jing Hong Nge, Stefan Su, Thanh Thi Nguyen, Campbell Wilson, Alexandra Phelan, Naomi Pfitzner

entry.summary: Evaluates data augmentation and feature enhancement for hate speech detection, comparing traditional classifiers with transformer models including gpt-oss-20b. Finds gpt-oss-20b consistently achieves highest results.

entry.title: A 360-degree Multi-camera System for Blue Emergency Light Detection Using Color Attention RT-DETR and the ABLDataset

author.name: Francisco Vacalebri-Lloret (Universitat Polit\`ecnica de Val\`encia, Spain), Lucas Banchero (Universitat Polit\`ecnica de Val\`encia, Spain), Jose J. Lopez (Universitat Polit\`ecnica de Val\`encia, Spain), Jose M. Mossi (Universitat Polit\`ecnica de Val\`encia, Spain)

entry.summary: Presents a 360-degree multi-camera system for detecting blue emergency vehicle lights using RT-DETR enhanced with color attention, achieving high accuracy on a curated European emergency vehicle dataset.

entry.title: Guidelines for the Annotation and Visualization of Legal Argumentation Structures in Chinese Judicial Decisions

author.name: Kun Chen, Xianglei Liao, Kaixue Fei, Yi Xing, Xinrui Li

entry.summary: Proposes an annotation framework for representing legal argumentation structures in Chinese judicial decisions, defining proposition types and argumentative relations for computational legal analysis.

entry.title: U-Parking: Distributed UWB-Assisted Autonomous Parking System with Robust Localization and Intelligent Planning

author.name: Yiang Wu, Qiong Wu, Pingyi Fan, Kezhi Wang, Wen Chen, Guoqiang Mao, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Demonstrates U-Parking, a UWB-assisted autonomous parking system integrating LLM-assisted planning with fusion localization for indoor environments.

entry.title: WhisperAlign: Word-Boundary-Aware ASR and WhisperX-Anchored Pyannote Diarization for Long-Form Bengali Speech

author.name: Aurchi Chowdhury, Rubaiyat -E-Zaman, Sk. Ashrafuzzaman Nafees

entry.summary: Presents a solution for Bengali long-form speech recognition and speaker diarization using whisper-timestamped chunking and pyannote/WhisperX pipeline.

entry.title: Person Detection and Tracking from an Overhead Crane LiDAR

author.name: Nilusha Jayawickrama, Henrik Toikka, Risto Ojala

entry.summary: Investigates person detection and tracking from overhead crane LiDAR in industrial settings, adapting 3D detectors and integrating tracking-by-detection.

entry.title: SinhaLegal: A Benchmark Corpus for Information Extraction and Analysis in Sinhala Legislative Texts

author.name: Minduli Lasandi, Nevidu Jayatilleke

entry.summary: Introduces SinhaLegal, a Sinhala legislative text corpus of ~2 million words across 1,206 legal documents with NER, topic modeling, and other NLP evaluations.

entry.title: VietJobs: A Vietnamese Job Advertisement Dataset

author.name: Hieu Pham Dinh, Hung Nguyen Huy, Mo El-Haj

entry.summary: Introduces VietJobs, the first large-scale Vietnamese job advertisement corpus with 48,092 postings covering 16 occupational domains, benchmarking LLMs on job classification and salary prediction.

entry.title: DEBISS: a Corpus of Individual, Semi-structured and Spoken Debates

author.name: Klaywert Danillo Ferreira de Souza, David Eduardo Pereira, Cl\'audio E. C. Campelo, Larissa Lucena Vasconcelos

entry.summary: Introduces DEBISS corpus of individual, semi-structured spoken debates with annotations for speech-to-text, speaker diarization, argument mining, and debater quality assessment.

entry.title: Integrated cooperative localization of heterogeneous measurement swarm: A unified data-driven method

author.name: Kunrui Ze, Wei Wang, Guibin Sun, Jiaqi Yan, Kexin Liu, Jinhu L\"u

entry.summary: Proposes a unified data-driven approach for cooperative localization in heterogeneous robotic swarms where sensors produce directed, sparse measurement topologies. A pairwise relative localization estimator handles heterogeneous unidirectional measurements, then feeds into a distributed pose-coupling strategy with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: S5-SHB Agent: Society 5.0 enabled Multi-model Agentic Blockchain Framework for Smart Home

author.name: Janani Rangila, Akila Siriweera, Incheon Paik, Keitaro Naruse, Isuru Jayanada, Vishmika Devindi

entry.summary: S5-SHB Agent combines multi-model AI agents with blockchain for smart home governance under the Society 5.0 vision, addressing adaptive consensus, multi-agent coordination, and resident-controlled governance.

entry.title: Generating Realistic, Protocol-Compliant Maritime Radio Dialogues using Self-Instruct and Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: G\"ursel Akdeniz, Emin Cagatay Nakilcioglu

entry.summary: Introduces a compliance-aware Self-Instruct methodology for generating realistic maritime VHF radio dialogues using LoRA fine-tuning. Addresses the scarcity of maritime communication training data for AI safety systems.

entry.title: MADCrowner: Margin Aware Dental Crown Design with Template Deformation and Refinement

author.name: Linda Wei, Chang Liu, Wenran Zhang, Yuxuan Hu, Ruiyang Li, Feng Qi, Changyao Tian, Ke Wang, Yuanyuan Wang, Shaoting Zhang, Dimitris Metaxas, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes MADCrowner, a margin-aware mesh generation framework for automated dental crown design using template deformation and refinement, addressing clinical workflow inefficiencies.

entry.title: Data-Driven Optimization of Multi-Generational Cellular Networks: A Performance Classification Framework for Strategic Infrastructure Management

author.name: Maryam Sabahat, M. Umar Khan

entry.summary: Analyzes multi-generational cellular network data from OpenCelliD to identify patterns in deployment, utilization, and infrastructure gaps using ML classification.

entry.title: Signal in the Noise: Decoding the Reality of Airline Service Quality with Large Language Models

author.name: Ahmed Dawoud, Osama El-Shamy, Ahmed Habashy

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to analyze 16,000+ airline reviews, categorizing 36 service issues and uncovering an 'operational perception disconnect' for EgyptAir where satisfaction dropped despite reported improvements.

entry.title: VinePT-Map: Pole-Trunk Semantic Mapping for Resilient Autonomous Robotics in Vineyards

author.name: Giorgio Audrito, Mauro Martini, Alessandro Navone, Giorgia Galluzzo, Marcello Chiaberge

entry.summary: Introduces VinePT-Map, a semantic mapping framework for vineyard robots that uses vine trunks and support poles as persistent landmarks for season-agnostic localization. Formulated as a factor graph integrating GPS, IMU, and RGB-D with semantic detections.

entry.title: From Code to Road: A Vehicle-in-the-Loop and Digital Twin-Based Framework for Central Car Server Testing in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Chengdong Wu, Sven Kirchner, Nils Purschke, Axel Torschmied, Norbert Kroth, Yinglei Song, Andr\'e Schamschurko, Erik Leo Ha{\ss}, Kuo-Yi Chao, Yi Zhang, Nenad Petrovic, Alois C. Knoll

entry.summary: Presents a Vehicle-in-the-Loop and digital twin framework for testing autonomous driving software on centralized E/E architectures. Couples a physical vehicle on a dynamometer with its virtual twin for safe, reproducible validation.

entry.title: Using Vision + Language Models to Predict Item Difficulty

author.name: Samin Khan

entry.summary: Investigates using GPT-4.1-nano to predict difficulty of data visualization literacy test items, finding that multimodal (visual + text) features yield the lowest prediction error compared to unimodal approaches.

entry.title: A systematic approach to answering the easy problems of consciousness based on an executable cognitive system

author.name: Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Attempts to systematically address Chalmers' 'easy problems' of consciousness using an executable cognitive system built on Kantian conceptual knowledge. Covers discrimination, information integration, reportability, attention, and deliberate control.

entry.title: An Explainable Ensemble Framework for Alzheimer's Disease Prediction Using Structured Clinical and Cognitive Data

author.name: Nishan Mitra

entry.summary: Introduces an explainable ensemble framework for Alzheimer's disease prediction using structured clinical data, comparing Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Extra Trees, and a deep neural network with SHAP explanations.

entry.title: Observer Design for Augmented Reality-based Teleoperation of Soft Robots

author.name: Jorge Francisco Garc\'ia-Samart\'in, Iago L\'opez P\'erez, Emirhan Yolcu, Jaime del Cerro, Antonio Barrientos

entry.summary: Presents an augmented reality interface using HoloLens 2 for teleoperating soft pneumatic robots. Uses a physics-based observer to estimate the robot's configuration from sensor data, addressing the challenge of modeling soft robots for real-time AR visualization.

entry.title: Constraint-Free Static Modeling of Continuum Parallel Robot

author.name: Lingxiao Xun, Matyas Diezinger, Azad Artinian, Guillaume Laurent, Brahim Tamadazte

entry.summary: Develops a constraint-free static model for continuum parallel robots by eliminating connectivity constraints through kinematic embedding. Yields an unconstrained optimization problem that handles geometrically nonlinear large deformations.

entry.title: The Trilingual Triad Framework: Integrating Design, AI, and Domain Knowledge in No-code AI Smart City Course

author.name: Qian Huang, King Wang Poon

entry.summary: Introduces the Trilingual Triad framework for teaching students to design with generative AI by integrating Design, AI, and Domain Knowledge in a no-code smart city course at SUTD.

entry.title: A theoretical model of dynamical grammatical gender shifting based on set-valued set function

author.name: Mohamed El Idrissi

entry.summary: Proposes a formal model for dynamical grammatical gender shifting in natural language using set-valued set functions, creating computational components for pairing items with morphological templates.

entry.title: Towards Explainable Deep Learning for Ship Trajectory Prediction in Inland Waterways

author.name: Tom Legel, Dirk S\"offker, Roland Sch\"atzle, Kathrin Donandt

entry.summary: Examines an LSTM-based ship trajectory prediction model with attention-based fusion and trained ship domain parameters for inland waterway safety, focusing on explainability of predictions.

entry.title: ROScopter: A Multirotor Autopilot based on ROSflight 2.0

author.name: Jacob Moore (Brigham Young University), Ian Reid (Brigham Young University), Phil Tokumaru (AeroVironment, Inc), Tim McLain (Brigham Young University)

entry.summary: Introduces ROScopter, a lean multirotor autopilot built on ROSflight 2.0 and ROS 2 designed for researchers. Achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art autopilots for waypoint following with a significantly simpler and more modifiable codebase.

entry.title: Activity Recognition from Smart Insole Sensor Data Using a Circular Dilated CNN

author.name: Yanhua Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a circular dilated CNN for activity recognition from smart insole sensor data, achieving 86.42% accuracy on a four-class task comparable to XGBoost baseline.

entry.title: Comparative Evaluation of Traditional Methods and Deep Learning for Brain Glioma Imaging. Review Paper

author.name: Kiranmayee Janardhan, Vinay Martin DSa Prabhu, T. Christy Bobby

entry.summary: Review paper comparing traditional methods and deep learning for brain glioma imaging, covering segmentation and classification approaches.

entry.title: Rethinking the Role of Collaborative Robots in Rehabilitation

author.name: Vivek Gupte, Shalutha Rajapakshe, Emmanuel Senft

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that collaborative robots in rehabilitation should be deployed more broadly—before, during, and after therapy sessions—rather than just for repetitive motion training. Discusses how cobots could improve access to physical therapy for people with disabilities.

entry.title: Computation, Chess, and Language in Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Bill Benzon

entry.summary: Working paper contrasting chess and natural language as AI paradigms, arguing that intelligence requires both symbolic and neural computational regimes. Draws on Miriam Yevick's distinction to challenge the assumption that intelligence reduces to computation.

entry.title: February 2026 Links

author.name: nomagicpill

entry.summary: A curated collection of notable links from February 2026, covering OpenClaw agent incidents, China's nuclear expansion, AI ecosystem developments, and various technology and culture items.

entry.title: Have Americans Become Less Violent Since 1980?

author.name: Benquo

entry.summary: Argues that the apparent decline in US homicide rates since 1980 is largely explained by improvements in trauma medicine rather than reduced violence. After adjusting for medical advances, the tripling of violence in the 1960s-70s may never have reversed.

entry.title: Deterministic Preprocessing and Interpretable Fuzzy Banding for Cost-per-Student Reporting from Extracted Records

author.name: Shane Lee, Stella Ng

entry.summary: Describes a deterministic Python script for processing casual academic database exports into cost-per-student reports with fuzzy banding for university budget decisions.

entry.title: Rational Chess
entry.summary: Proposes 'Rational Chess,' a variant combining Armageddon rules (black wins on draw) with a 'you cut I choose' mechanism where the second player can flip the board, aiming to eliminate both white's advantage and draw prevalence.

entry.title: How can I arrest and reverse stress, anxiety and depression induced cognitive decline?

author.name: ConformalInfinity

entry.summary: A personal question on LessWrong asking about reversing cognitive decline from chronic stress, anxiety, and depression. Seeks advice on drugs and interventions.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 05, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A strong day for AI safety research dominates alongside a major open-weight release and a striking capability milestone.

  • Evaluation-awareness sandbagging reveals models strategically underperform when detecting evaluation contexts—arguably the day's most consequential safety finding
  • Sleeper Cell demonstrates temporal backdoor injection into tool-using agents via PEFT, while Asymmetric Goal Drift quantifies how coding agents violate constraints over time
  • The Depth-Accuracy Paradox shows 81.6% of correct math reasoning predictions in Qwen2.5-Math-7B arise through computationally inconsistent pathways, undermining trust in chain-of-thought
  • Reward model bias analysis across five models uncovers new style-specific and answer-order biases with a mechanistic mitigation approach

Microsoft releases Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B, an open-weight multimodal reasoning model punching well above its parameter class. A Gemini 3.1 Pro agent achieves a perfect score on IPhO 2025 theory across all five runs, though data contamination cannot be ruled out. Molt Dynamics studies emergent social phenomena across 770K+ autonomous LLM agents, observing spontaneous role specialization and norm formation at unprecedented scale.

  • Measuring AI R&D Automation from the Centre for the Governance of AI proposes concrete metrics for tracking automation's effect on AI progress and oversight
  • Compressed sensing for capability localization shows zeroing out as few as 5 attention heads can degrade specific LLM capabilities by 60%+, advancing mechanistic interpretability

entry.title: In-Context Environments Induce Evaluation-Awareness in Language Models

author.name: Maheep Chaudhary

entry.summary: Investigates environment-dependent evaluation awareness in language models, showing that models can strategically underperform (sandbag) when they detect evaluation contexts. Introduces a black-box adversarial optimization framework for characterizing sandbagging vulnerability.

entry.title: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B Technical Report

author.name: Jyoti Aneja, Michael Harrison, Neel Joshi, Tyler LaBonte, John Langford, Eduardo Salinas

entry.summary: Presents Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B, a compact open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Microsoft that excels at scientific/mathematical reasoning and UI understanding. Demonstrates that careful architecture choices and data curation enable smaller models to achieve competitive performance.

entry.title: Perfect score on IPhO 2025 theory by Gemini agent

author.name: Yichen Huang

entry.summary: Reports that a Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview agent achieves a perfect score on IPhO 2025 theory problems in all five runs, though acknowledges possible data contamination since the model was released after the competition.

entry.title: Molt Dynamics: Emergent Social Phenomena in Autonomous AI Agent Populations

author.name: Brandon Yee, Krishna Sharma

entry.summary: Studies MoltBook, a large-scale environment with 770K+ autonomous LLM agents interacting without human participation, observing emergent role specialization, communication dynamics, and coordination behaviors ('Molt Dynamics').

entry.title: Asymmetric Goal Drift in Coding Agents Under Value Conflict

author.name: Magnus Saebo, Spencer Gibson, Tyler Crosse, Achyutha Menon, Eyon Jang, Diogo Cruz

entry.summary: Introduces a framework built on OpenCode to measure how coding agents violate explicit system prompt constraints over time, especially under environmental pressure toward competing values. Studies asymmetric goal drift in realistic multi-step coding tasks, addressing a gap in understanding agent behavior in non-synthetic settings.

entry.title: One Bias After Another: Mechanistic Reward Shaping and Persistent Biases in Language Reward Models

author.name: Daniel Fein, Max Lamparth, Violet Xiang, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Nick Haber

entry.summary: Systematically measures biases in five high-quality reward models and discovers new biases related to model-specific styles and answer-order. Proposes mechanistic reward shaping as a simple post-hoc intervention to reduce targeted biases without degrading general performance.

entry.title: Sleeper Cell: Injecting Latent Malice Temporal Backdoors into Tool-Using LLMs

author.name: Bhanu Pallakonda, Mikkel Hindsbo, Sina Ehsani, Prag Mishra

entry.summary: Demonstrates a novel backdoor injection attack on tool-using LLM agents via a multi-stage PEFT framework (SFT-then-GRPO) that decouples capability injection from behavioral alignment, creating latent 'sleeper agent' behaviors.

entry.title: When Shallow Wins: Silent Failures and the Depth-Accuracy Paradox in Latent Reasoning

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Divya Chaudhary

entry.summary: Demonstrates that 81.6% of correct predictions in math reasoning models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B) emerge through computationally inconsistent pathways, while only 18.4% use stable faithful reasoning. Identifies 'silent failures'—confident but incorrect outputs.

entry.title: Measuring AI R&D Automation

author.name: Alan Chan, Ranay Padarath, Joe Kwon, Hilary Greaves, Markus Anderljung

entry.summary: Proposes metrics to track AI R&D automation (AIRDA) and its effects on AI progress and oversight. Metrics span capital share of R&D spending, researcher time allocation, and AI subversion incidents. Aims to help decision makers assess whether safety keeps pace with capabilities.

entry.title: Why Are Linear RNNs More Parallelizable?

author.name: William Merrill, Hongjian Jiang, Yanhong Li, Ashish Sabharwal

entry.summary: Provides a formal complexity-theoretic explanation for why linear RNNs are parallelizable like transformers while nonlinear RNNs are not. Shows linear RNNs correspond to log-depth arithmetic circuits, while nonlinear RNNs can solve problems requiring deeper circuits.

entry.title: Compressed Sensing for Capability Localization in Large Language Models

author.name: Anna Bair, Yixuan Even Xu, Mingjie Sun, J. Zico Kolter

entry.summary: Shows that many LLM capabilities are highly localized to small subsets of attention heads - zeroing out as few as 5 heads can degrade performance by 65%. Introduces a compressed sensing method to efficiently identify these critical heads.

entry.title: A Rubric-Supervised Critic from Sparse Real-World Outcomes

author.name: Xingyao Wang, Valerie Chen, Heng Ji, Graham Neubig

entry.summary: Proposes Critic Rubrics, a rubric-based supervision framework with 24 behavioral features to learn critic models from sparse, noisy human-agent interaction data. Can serve as reward models for RL training or inference-time scaling of coding agents.

entry.title: Test-Time Meta-Adaptation with Self-Synthesis

author.name: Zeyneb N. Kaya, Nick Rui

entry.summary: Introduces MASS, a meta-learning framework where LLMs self-adapt at test time by generating problem-specific synthetic training data and performing targeted self-updates, trained end-to-end via bilevel optimization.

entry.title: $V_1$: Unifying Generation and Self-Verification for Parallel Reasoners

author.name: Harman Singh, Xiuyu Li, Kusha Sareen, Monishwaran Maheswaran, Sijun Tan, Xiaoxia Wu, Junxiong Wang, Alpay Ariyak, Qingyang Wu, Samir Khaki, Rishabh Tiwari, Long Lian, Yucheng Lu, Boyi Li, Alane Suhr, Ben Athiwaratkun, Kurt Keutzer

entry.summary: Introduces V1, a framework unifying generation and verification for reasoning through efficient pairwise ranking. Shows models are substantially stronger at pairwise self-verification than independent scalar scoring, enabling better test-time scaling.

entry.title: Language Model Goal Selection Differs from Humans' in an Open-Ended Task

author.name: Gaia Molinaro, Dave August, Danielle Perszyk, Anne G. E. Collins

entry.summary: Directly tests whether LLMs can serve as proxies for human goal selection in open-ended tasks. Finds substantial divergence: humans gradually explore while most models exploit single solutions (reward hacking). Tests GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Centaur.

entry.title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling with Multi-Sequence Verifiers

author.name: Yegon Kim, Seungyoo Lee, Chaeyun Jang, Hyungi Lee, Juho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Sequence Verifiers for parallel test-time scaling that score candidate solutions jointly rather than in isolation, improving both answer selection accuracy and enabling early-stopping to reduce latency.

entry.title: Monitoring Emergent Reward Hacking During Generation via Internal Activations

author.name: Patrick Wilhelm, Thorsten Wittkopp, Odej Kao

entry.summary: Proposes activation-based monitoring to detect reward-hacking behavior during LLM generation using sparse autoencoders on residual stream activations. Shows internal patterns reliably predict reward hacking before it's visible in outputs.

entry.title: Memex(RL): Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agents via Indexed Experience Memory

author.name: Zhenting Wang, Huancheng Chen, Jiayun Wang, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Memex, an indexed experience memory for LLM agents that compresses context without discarding evidence for long-horizon tasks. Maintains a compact working context with concise summaries while keeping full evidence in an indexed store, addressing the fundamental context window bottleneck.

entry.title: HumanLM: Simulating Users with State Alignment Beats Response Imitation

author.name: Shirley Wu, Evelyn Choi, Arpandeep Khatua, Zhanghan Wang, Joy He-Yueya, Tharindu Cyril Weerasooriya, Wei Wei, Diyi Yang, Jure Leskovec, James Zou

entry.summary: Proposes HumanLM, a training framework for building user simulators that reflect real users by generating natural-language latent states (beliefs, emotions) aligned with ground-truth through reinforcement learning. Goes beyond surface-level pattern imitation.

entry.title: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action Models are Surprisingly Resistant to Forgetting in Continual Learning

author.name: Huihan Liu, Changyeon Kim, Bo Liu, Minghuan Liu, Yuke Zhu

entry.summary: Finds that pretrained Vision-Language-Action models are remarkably resistant to catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, with simple Experience Replay sometimes achieving zero forgetting even with small replay data. Shows pretraining creates stable feature representations.

entry.title: AgentIR: Reasoning-Aware Retrival for Deep Research Agents

author.name: Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Shengyao Zhuang, Jimmy Lin, Akari Asai, Victor Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces Reasoning-Aware Retrieval for Deep Research agents that jointly embeds the agent's reasoning trace with its query, plus DR-Synth for synthesizing training data. Demonstrates that reasoning traces provide rich intent signals that existing retrievers ignore.

entry.title: Old Habits Die Hard: How Conversational History Geometrically Traps LLMs

author.name: Adi Simhi, Fazl Barez, Martin Tutek, Yonatan Belinkov, Shay B. Cohen

entry.summary: Introduces History-Echoes framework revealing how conversational history biases LLM responses through both probabilistic (Markov chain) and geometric (hidden representation consistency) perspectives. Shows strong geometric bias toward maintaining prior response patterns.

entry.title: Beyond Pixel Histories: World Models with Persistent 3D State

author.name: Samuel Garcin, Thomas Walker, Steven McDonagh, Tim Pearce, Hakan Bilen, Tianyu He, Kaixin Wang, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: Presents PERSIST, a world model paradigm that maintains a latent 3D scene representation (environment, camera, renderer) for interactive video generation with persistent spatial memory and consistent geometry.

entry.title: From Narrow to Panoramic Vision: Attention-Guided Cold-Start Reshapes Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Ruilin Luo, Chufan Shi, Yizhen Zhang, Cheng Yang, Songtao Jiang, Tongkun Guan, Ruizhe Chen, Ruihang Chu, Peng Wang, Mingkun Yang, Yujiu Yang, Junyang Lin, Zhibo Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Attention Score (VAS) to analyze cold-start initialization for Multimodal Large Reasoning Models, discovering that text-only cold-start surprisingly increases visual attention more than multimodal cold-start ('Lazy Attention Localization').

entry.title: Solving adversarial examples requires solving exponential misalignment

author.name: Alessandro Salvatore, Stanislav Fort, Surya Ganguli

entry.summary: Defines perceptual manifolds of neural networks and finds their dimensionalities are orders of magnitude higher than human concepts, providing an exponential misalignment explanation for adversarial vulnerability. Shows this exponential gap is a fundamental geometric property.

entry.title: ByteFlow: Language Modeling through Adaptive Byte Compression without a Tokenizer

author.name: Chunyuan Deng, Sanket Lokegaonkar, Colin Lockard, Besnik Fetahu, Nasser Zalmout, Xian Li

entry.summary: Introduces ByteFlow Net, a hierarchical architecture that removes tokenizers entirely, learning segmentation of raw byte streams into semantic units via compression-driven coding rate optimization with static computation graphs.

entry.title: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models

author.name: Marcel Torne, Karl Pertsch, Homer Walke, Kyle Vedder, Suraj Nair, Brian Ichter, Allen Z. Ren, Haohuan Wang, Jiaming Tang, Kyle Stachowicz, Karan Dhabalia, Michael Equi, Quan Vuong, Jost Tobias Springenberg, Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, Danny Driess

entry.summary: Proposes MEM, a multi-scale embodied memory architecture for vision-language-action models that combines long-term semantic memory with short-term observation memory for complex multi-stage robotic tasks.

entry.title: How LLMs Cite and Why It Matters: A Cross-Model Audit of Reference Fabrication in AI-Assisted Academic Writing and Methods to Detect Phantom Citations

author.name: MZ Naser

entry.summary: Conducts one of the largest citation hallucination audits of LLMs, testing 10 commercial models across 4 academic domains with 69,557 citations verified against CrossRef, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. Hallucination rates range from 11.4% to 56.8% depending on model, domain, and prompt framing.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: Evaluating Visual Grounding In Multimodal Medical Reasoning

author.name: Anas Zafar, Leema Krishna Murali, Ashish Vashist

entry.summary: Introduces a counterfactual evaluation framework for medical VQA revealing that RLVR improves accuracy while degrading visual grounding. Text-only RLVR achieves comparable accuracy, suggesting current benchmarks don't measure causal visual dependence.

entry.title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model

author.name: Shenghai Yuan, Yuanyang Yin, Zongjian Li, Xinwei Huang, Xiao Yang, Li Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces Helios, a 14B autoregressive diffusion model for real-time long video generation running at 19.5 FPS on a single H100 GPU, achieving minute-scale generation without standard acceleration techniques like KV-cache or sparse attention.

entry.title: Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data

author.name: Saptarshi Chakraborty, Quentin Berthet, Peter L. Bartlett

entry.summary: Derives finite-sample generalization bounds for score-based diffusion models that depend on intrinsic data dimensionality rather than ambient dimension, holding for all Wasserstein-p distances under mild regularity conditions.

entry.title: MAGE: Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Language Agents toward Strategic Exploration and Exploitation

author.name: Lu Yang, Zelai Xu, Minyang Xie, Jiaxuan Gao, Zhao Shok, Yu Wang, Yi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes MAGE, a meta-reinforcement learning framework that enables LLM agents to strategically explore and exploit in multi-agent environments. Addresses the gap where existing meta-RL approaches for LLMs focus only on exploration in single-agent settings.

entry.title: On Google's SynthID-Text LLM Watermarking System: Theoretical Analysis and Empirical Validation

author.name: Romina Omidi, Yun Dong, Binghui Wang

entry.summary: Provides the first theoretical analysis of Google's SynthID-Text watermarking system, analyzing detection performance and robustness, with proofs about score function properties and empirical validation.

entry.title: Farther the Shift, Sparser the Representation: Analyzing OOD Mechanisms in LLMs

author.name: Mingyu Jin, Yutong Yin, Jingcheng Niu, Qingcheng Zeng, Wujiang Xu, Mengnan Du, Wei Cheng, Zhaoran Wang, Tianlong Chen, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Reveals that as input difficulty/OOD shift increases, LLM last hidden states become substantially sparser, concentrating computation into specialized subspaces. This 'farther the shift, sparser the representation' phenomenon is consistent across diverse models and domains.

entry.title: SWE-CI: Evaluating Agent Capabilities in Maintaining Codebases via Continuous Integration

author.name: Jialong Chen, Xander Xu, Hu Wei, Chuan Chen, Bing Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes SWE-CI, the first repository-level benchmark built on continuous integration, shifting evaluation from static one-shot bug fixing to dynamic long-term code maintainability across 100 tasks requiring requirement changes and feature iterations.

entry.title: NuMuon: Nuclear-Norm-Constrained Muon for Compressible LLM Training

author.name: Hadi Mohaghegh Dolatabadi, Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan, Sameera Ramasinghe, Chamin P Hewa Koneputugodage, Shamane Siriwardhana, Violetta Shevchenko, Karol Pajak, James Snewin, Gil Avraham, Alexander Long

entry.summary: Discovers that models trained with the Muon optimizer, despite using full-rank update steps, still exhibit low-rank weight structure and are highly compressible. Proposes NuMuon, a nuclear-norm-constrained variant for training LLMs that are compression-friendly from the start.

entry.title: SE-Search: Self-Evolving Search Agent via Memory and Dense Reward

author.name: Jian Li, Yizhang Jin, Dongqi Liu, Hang Ding, Jiafu Wu, Dongsheng Chen, Yunhang Shen, Yulei Qin, Ying Tai, Chengjie Wang, Xiaotong Yuan, Yabiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SE-Search, a self-evolving search agent for RAG that uses memory purification, atomic query training, and dense rewards. Follows a Think-Search-Memorize strategy to retain salient evidence while filtering irrelevant content.

entry.title: When Do Language Models Endorse Limitations on Human Rights Principles?

author.name: Keenan Samway, Nicole Miu Takagi, Rada Mihalcea, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Ilias Chalkidis, Daniel Hershcovich, Zhijing Jin

entry.summary: Evaluates how 11 major LLMs navigate tradeoffs involving the Universal Declaration of Human Rights across 1,152 scenarios in 8 languages. Reveals systematic biases where models accept limiting economic rights more than political rights and show cross-linguistic variation.

entry.title: Split Personality Training can detect Alignment Faking

author.name: Florian_Dietz

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Split Personality Training (SPT) can detect alignment faking in LLMs by training a secondary 'honest persona' that can review and expose the main model's deceptive behavior, with experimental results showing the technique successfully reveals planted alignment faking.

entry.title: LifeBench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Multi-Source Memory

author.name: Zihao Cheng, Weixin Wang, Yu Zhao, Ziyang Ren, Jiaxuan Chen, Ruiyang Xu, Shuai Huang, Yang Chen, Guowei Li, Mengshi Wang, Yi Xie, Ren Zhu, Zeren Jiang, Keda Lu, Yihong Li, Xiaoliang Wang, Liwei Liu, Cam-Tu Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces LifeBench, a benchmark for long-horizon multi-source memory that pushes beyond declarative memory to include habitual and procedural memory types inferred from diverse digital traces. Features densely connected, long-horizon event simulation.

entry.title: Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Structured Generation in LLMs

author.name: Avinash Reddy, Thayne T. Walker, James S. Ide, Amrit Singh Bedi
