entry.summary: Proposes Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding (DCCD), a two-step training-free procedure that first generates an unconstrained draft then applies constrained decoding conditioned on it, to prevent semantic distortion in structured output generation.

entry.title: Automated Concept Discovery for LLM-as-a-Judge Preference Analysis

author.name: James Wedgwood, Chhavi Yadav, Virginia Smith

entry.summary: Studies embedding-level concept extraction methods for analyzing LLM judge behavior, finding that sparse autoencoder-based approaches recover more interpretable preference features than alternatives while predicting LLM decisions well.

entry.title: Error as Signal: Stiffness-Aware Diffusion Sampling via Embedded Runge-Kutta Guidance

author.name: Inho Kong, Sojin Lee, Youngjoon Hong, Hyunwoo J. Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ERK-Guid, a guidance mechanism for diffusion models that uses solver-induced local truncation error as a guidance signal, detecting stiff ODE regions to improve sample quality without auxiliary networks.

entry.title: Relational In-Context Learning via Synthetic Pre-training with Structural Prior

author.name: Yanbo Wang, Jiaxuan You, Chuan Shi, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RDB-PFN, the first relational foundation model trained purely on synthetic data generated from a Relational Prior Generator, enabling in-context learning for relational database tasks across heterogeneous schemas.

entry.title: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction with Test-Time Training

author.name: Haian Jin, Rundi Wu, Tianyuan Zhang, Ruiqi Gao, Jonathan T. Barron, Noah Snavely, Aleksander Holynski

entry.summary: Introduces ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model achieving linear-time 3D reconstruction from image collections using test-time training layers. Processes 700+ frames in under 10 seconds while matching quadratic-time methods in accuracy.

entry.title: Specialization of softmax attention heads: insights from the high-dimensional single-location model

author.name: M. Sagitova, O. Duranthon, L. Zdeborov\'a

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of multi-head attention specialization during training, showing an initial unspecialized phase followed by sequential head alignment with latent signal directions. Compares softmax variants' impact on performance.

entry.title: Retrieval or Representation? Reassessing Benchmark Gaps in Multilingual and Visually Rich RAG

author.name: Martin Asenov, Kenza Benkirane, Dan Goldwater, Aneiss Ghodsi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that better document representation (transcription/preprocessing) is the primary driver of RAG benchmark improvements rather than sophisticated retrieval mechanisms. Shows BM25 can recover large gaps on multilingual and visual benchmarks with proper document processing.

entry.title: Mozi: Governed Autonomy for Drug Discovery LLM Agents

author.name: He Cao, Siyu Liu, Fan Zhang, Zijing Liu, Hao Li, Bin Feng, Shengyuan Bai, Leqing Chen, Kai Xie, Yu Li

entry.summary: Presents Mozi, a dual-layer architecture for drug discovery LLM agents that combines flexible generative AI with deterministic computational biology rigor. Addresses unconstrained tool-use governance and poor long-horizon reliability in pharmaceutical pipelines through a governed supervisor-worker hierarchy.

entry.title: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents

author.name: Ke Yang, Zixi Chen, Xuan He, Jize Jiang, Michel Galley, Chenglong Wang, Jianfeng Gao, Jiawei Han, ChengXiang Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes PlugMem, a task-agnostic plugin memory module for LLM agents that structures episodic memories into a compact knowledge-centric graph representing propositional and prescriptive knowledge. Can attach to arbitrary agents without task-specific redesign.

entry.title: Discern Truth from Falsehood: Reducing Over-Refusal via Contrastive Refinement

author.name: Yuxiao Lu, Lin Xu, Yang Sun, Wenjun Li, Jie Shi

entry.summary: Introduces DCR (Discernment via Contrastive Refinement), a preceding alignment stage that helps LLMs distinguish between truly toxic and seemingly toxic prompts to reduce over-refusal without degrading harmful content rejection.

entry.title: AutoHarness: improving LLM agents by automatically synthesizing a code harness

author.name: Xinghua Lou, Miguel L\'azaro-Gredilla, Antoine Dedieu, Carter Wendelken, Wolfgang Lehrach, Kevin P. Murphy

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Gemini-2.5-Flash can automatically synthesize code harnesses to prevent illegal actions in LLM agents, achieving zero illegal moves across 145 TextArena games through iterative code refinement.

entry.title: Fragile Thoughts: How Large Language Models Handle Chain-of-Thought Perturbations

author.name: Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan, Mayank Kejriwal

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive evaluation of LLM robustness to five types of Chain-of-Thought perturbations across 13 models spanning 3B to 1.5T parameters, revealing how corruptions at different reasoning points affect model performance.

entry.title: Phys4D: Fine-Grained Physics-Consistent 4D Modeling from Video Diffusion

author.name: Haoran Lu, Shang Wu, Jianshu Zhang, Maojiang Su, Guo Ye, Chenwei Xu, Lie Lu, Pranav Maneriker, Fan Du, Manling Li, Zhaoran Wang, Han Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Phys4D, a three-stage pipeline for learning physics-consistent 4D world representations from video diffusion models, progressively lifting appearance-driven models into physically grounded representations.

entry.title: Directional Neural Collapse Explains Few-Shot Transfer in Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Achleshwar Luthra, Yash Salunkhe, Tomer Galanti

entry.summary: Shows that directional CDNV (decision-axis variance) explains both few-shot transfer and low task interference in self-supervised learning, proving sharp generalization bounds with finite-shot corrections.

entry.title: World Properties without World Models: Recovering Spatial and Temporal Structure from Co-occurrence Statistics in Static Word Embeddings

author.name: Elan Barenholtz

entry.summary: Shows that geographic and temporal structure recoverable from LLM hidden states is also substantially present in static word embeddings (GloVe, Word2Vec), suggesting much of this signal comes from text co-occurrence rather than deeper world models.

entry.title: Efficient Refusal Ablation in LLM through Optimal Transport

author.name: Geraldin Nanfack, Eugene Belilovsky, Elvis Dohmatob

entry.summary: Introduces an optimal transport-based framework for efficient refusal ablation in LLMs, treating it as distributional matching rather than one-dimensional direction removal. Combines PCA with Gaussian OT for efficient computation.

entry.title: Half the Nonlinearity Is Wasted: Measuring and Reallocating the Transformer's MLP Budget

author.name: Peter Balogh

entry.summary: Investigates when transformer MLP nonlinearity is necessary by training a gating mechanism that routes between full MLP and linear surrogates. Finds 25-56% of MLP computations can be replaced with linear operations at <1% perplexity cost, and that nonlinearity need is fully contextual.

entry.title: Online Learnability of Chain-of-Thought Verifiers: Soundness and Completeness Trade-offs

author.name: Maria-Florina Balcan, Avrim Blum, Kiriaki Fragkia, Zhiyuan Li, Dravyansh Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes an online learning framework for chain-of-thought verifiers that handle distribution shift from the prover-verifier feedback loop. Studies soundness-completeness trade-offs in learning to verify reasoning chains.

entry.title: Riemannian Optimization in Modular Systems

author.name: Christian Pehle, Jean-Jacques Slotine

entry.summary: Combines Riemannian geometry, optimal control theory, and theoretical physics to provide new theoretical understanding of backpropagation in modular systems. Introduces a framework connecting gradient descent trajectories to action minimization principles.

entry.title: Benchmarking Legal RAG: The Promise and Limits of AI Statutory Surveys

author.name: Mohamed Afane, Emaan Hariri, Derek Ouyang, Daniel E. Ho

entry.summary: Benchmarks emerging legal AI tools (including commercial products from Westlaw and LexisNexis) on the LaborBench statutory survey benchmark. Makes five contributions including evaluating specialized tools and finding significant performance improvements over standard RAG.

entry.title: Modeling Cross-vision Synergy for Unified Large Vision Model

author.name: Shengqiong Wu, Lanhu Wu, Mingyang Bao, Wenhao Xu, Hanwang Zhang, Shuicheng Yan, Hao Fei, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Presents PolyV, a unified large vision model that achieves cross-vision synergy across images, videos, and 3D data using sparse Mixture-of-Experts with dynamic modality routing for bidirectional cross-modal interaction.

entry.title: Controllable and explainable personality sliders for LLMs at inference time

author.name: Florian Hoppe, David Khachaturov, Robert Mullins, Mark Huasong Meng

entry.summary: Proposes Sequential Adaptive Steering (SAS) for continuous multi-dimensional personality control in LLMs at inference time, orthogonalizing steering vectors to prevent destructive interference when controlling multiple traits simultaneously.

entry.title: Observationally Informed Adaptive Causal Experimental Design

author.name: Erdun Gao, Liang Zhang, Jake Fawkes, Aoqi Zuo, Wenqin Liu, Haoxuan Li, Mingming Gong, Dino Sejdinovic

entry.summary: Proposes Active Residual Learning for experimental design that uses observational models as priors and focuses experiments on estimating residuals to correct observational bias, rather than learning causal quantities from scratch.

entry.title: TTSR: Test-Time Self-Reflection for Continual Reasoning Improvement

author.name: Haoyang He, Zihua Rong, Liangjie Zhao, Yunjia Zhao, Lan Yang, Honggang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TTSR, a test-time self-evolving framework where a single model alternates between Student and Teacher roles to improve reasoning at test time. Addresses unreliable pseudo-labels and inability to target specific reasoning weaknesses.

entry.title: Entropic-Time Inference: Self-Organizing Large Language Model Decoding Beyond Attention

author.name: Andrew Kiruluta

entry.summary: Proposes entropic-time inference for LLMs where decoding is governed by uncertainty flow rather than token position. Extends vLLM with entropy-aware scheduling, attention pruning, and adaptive temperature control.

entry.title: AgentSelect: Benchmark for Narrative Query-to-Agent Recommendation

author.name: Yunxiao Shi, Wujiang Xu, Tingwei Chen, Haoning Shang, Ling Yang, Yunfeng Wan, Zhuo Cao, Xing Zi, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Min Xu

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSelect, a benchmark that reframes agent selection as narrative query-to-agent recommendation, providing query-conditioned supervision for recommending end-to-end agent configurations coupling backbone models with toolkits.

entry.title: BeamPERL: Parameter-Efficient RL with Verifiable Rewards Specializes Compact LLMs for Structured Beam Mechanics Reasoning

author.name: Tarjei Paule Hage, Markus J. Buehler

entry.summary: Studies whether RLVR can teach a 1.5B parameter model to reason about beam statics physics. Finds 66.7% improvement in Pass@1 but reveals anisotropic generalization - compositional success but failure under topological shifts.

entry.title: AriadneMem: Threading the Maze of Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents

author.name: Wenhui Zhu, Xiwen Chen, Zhipeng Wang, Jingjing Wang, Xuanzhao Dong, Minzhou Huang, Rui Cai, Hejian Sang, Hao Wang, Peijie Qiu, Yueyue Deng, Prayag Tiwari, Brendan Hogan Rappazzo, Yalin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AriadneMem, a structured memory system for long-horizon LLM agents using entropy-aware gating and conflict-aware coarsening to handle disconnected evidence and state updates in long-term dialogue.

entry.title: From Conflict to Consensus: Boosting Medical Reasoning via Multi-Round Agentic RAG

author.name: Wenhao Wu, Zhentao Tang, Yafu Li, Shixiong Kai, Mingxuan Yuan, Zhenhong Sun, Chunlin Chen, Zhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MA-RAG, a multi-round agentic RAG framework for medical reasoning that iteratively evolves external evidence and internal reasoning history, transforming semantic conflicts among candidate responses into actionable refinement signals.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Derive New Knowledge? A Dynamic Benchmark for Biological Knowledge Discovery

author.name: Chaoqun Yang, Xinyu Lin, Shulin Li, Wenjie Wang, Ruihan Guo, Fuli Feng, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes DBench-Bio, a dynamic benchmark for evaluating AI biological knowledge discovery that automatically generates evaluation tasks to avoid data contamination and static benchmark obsolescence.

entry.title: PhyPrompt: RL-based Prompt Refinement for Physically Plausible Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Shang Wu, Chenwei Xu, Zhuofan Xia, Weijian Li, Lie Lu, Pranav Maneriker, Fan Du, Manling Li, Han Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PhyPrompt, an RL-based framework that automatically refines text-to-video prompts to produce physically plausible videos by incorporating physics constraints, using Chain-of-Thought fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization.

entry.title: The Controllability Trap: A Governance Framework for Military AI Agents

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo

entry.summary: Proposes the Agentic Military AI Governance Framework (AMAGF) addressing six governance failures specific to agentic AI in military settings, structured around preventive, detective, and corrective governance pillars with a measurable Control Quality Score.

entry.title: Image-based Prompt Injection: Hijacking Multimodal LLMs through Visually Embedded Adversarial Instructions

author.name: Neha Nagaraja, Lan Zhang, Zhilong Wang, Bo Zhang, Pawan Patil

entry.summary: Studies image-based prompt injection attacks on multimodal LLMs where adversarial instructions are visually embedded in natural images using segmentation-based region selection and adaptive rendering to override model behavior.

entry.title: Local Shapley: Model-Induced Locality and Optimal Reuse in Data Valuation

author.name: Xuan Yang, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen, Jian Pei

entry.summary: Introduces Local Shapley, which exploits model-induced locality (e.g., KNN neighbors, tree leaves) to efficiently compute Shapley values by projecting computation onto support sets, achieving exact or near-exact results much faster.

entry.title: Confidence-Calibrated Small-Large Language Model Collaboration for Cost-Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Chuang Zhang, Zizhen Zhu, Yihao Wei, Bing Tian, Junyi Liu, Henan Wang, Xavier Wang, Yaxiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes COREA, a system cascading small and large LMs for cost-efficient reasoning, where SLMs output confidence scores and defer uncertain questions to LLMs, trained with RL-based confidence calibration.

entry.title: Inference-Time Toxicity Mitigation in Protein Language Models

author.name: Manuel Fern\'andez Burda, Santiago Aranguri, Iv\'an Arcuschin Moreno, Enzo Ferrante

entry.summary: Shows that domain adaptation of protein language models to specific taxonomic groups can elicit toxic protein generation. Adapts Logit Diff Amplification as an inference-time control to reduce toxicity without retraining, preserving biological plausibility.

entry.title: Unbiased Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Group-Based Policy Optimization

author.name: Haodong Zhu, Yangyang Ren, Yanjing Li, Mingbao Lin, Linlin Yang, Xuhui Liu, Xiantong Zhen, Haiguang Liu, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DPPO (Dynamic Pruning Policy Optimization) for efficient GRPO training that prunes samples while maintaining unbiased gradient estimation through importance sampling correction. Accelerates LLM reasoning training without altering optimization objectives.

entry.title: What Does Flow Matching Bring To TD Learning?

author.name: Bhavya Agrawalla, Michal Nauman, Aviral Kumar

entry.summary: Analyzes why flow matching works for Q-value estimation in RL. Shows it's not about distributional RL but about test-time recovery via integration and dense velocity supervision providing better learning signals than standard regression.

entry.title: RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots

author.name: Soroush Nasiriany, Sepehr Nasiriany, Abhiram Maddukuri, Yuke Zhu

entry.summary: Presents RoboCasa365, a comprehensive benchmark with 365 household tasks across 2,500 kitchen environments with 2,200+ hours of demonstration data. One of the most diverse and large-scale benchmarks for generalist robot policy evaluation.

entry.title: Biased Generalization in Diffusion Models

author.name: Jerome Garnier-Brun, Luca Biggio, Davide Beltrame, Marc M\'ezard, Luca Saglietti

entry.summary: Identifies a phase of 'biased generalization' in diffusion models where test loss decreases but generated samples have anomalously high proximity to training data. Introduces quantitative metrics to detect this memorization-like behavior during training.

entry.title: MOOSE-Star: Unlocking Tractable Training for Scientific Discovery by Breaking the Complexity Barrier

author.name: Zonglin Yang, Lidong Bing

entry.summary: Addresses the intractability of directly training LLMs to model P(hypothesis|background) for scientific discovery. Introduces MOOSE-Star framework that reduces complexity from exponential to logarithmic through task decomposition.

entry.title: Prompt-Dependent Ranking of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Angel Rodrigo Avelar Menendez, Yufeng Liu, Xiaowu Dai

entry.summary: Develops a framework for prompt-dependent LLM rankings with statistical uncertainty quantification. Shows that point-estimate rankings can lead to misallocation when differences aren't statistically meaningful.

entry.title: The Theory behind UMAP?

author.name: David Wegmann

entry.summary: Provides a rigorous mathematical correction and self-contained derivation of the theoretical foundations underlying UMAP's metric realization functor, fixing errors in the original work and Spivak's unpublished draft.

entry.title: CONCUR: Benchmarking LLMs for Concurrent Code Generation

author.name: Jue Huang, Tarek Mahmud, Corina Pasareanu, Guowei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CONCUR, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on concurrent code generation, addressing the gap that existing benchmarks focus only on sequential code and miss concurrency bugs like deadlocks and race conditions.

entry.title: Stable and Steerable Sparse Autoencoders with Weight Regularization

author.name: Piotr Jedryszek, Oliver M. Crook

entry.summary: Shows that L2 weight regularization dramatically increases cross-seed feature consistency in sparse autoencoders for neural network interpretability, especially when combined with tied initialization and unit-norm constraints.

entry.title: Training-free Dropout Sampling for Semantic Token Acceptance in Speculative Decoding

author.name: Jeongtae Lee, Minjung Jo, Hyunjoon Jeong, Gunho Park, Sunghyeon Woo, Joonghoon Kim, Se Jung Kwon, Dongsoo Lee

entry.summary: Introduces DropMatch for speculative decoding that matches draft tokens to target model distribution via Monte Carlo dropout applied to the LM head only. This training-free approach enables sampling-based acceptance decisions for speculative decoding.

entry.title: FINEST: Improving LLM Responses to Sensitive Topics Through Fine-Grained Evaluation

author.name: Juhyun Oh, Nayeon Lee, Chani Jung, Jiho Jin, Junho Myung, Jongwon Lee, Taeui Song, Alice Oh

entry.summary: Introduces FINEST, a fine-grained evaluation taxonomy for LLM responses to sensitive topics that categorizes errors across Content, Logic, and Appropriateness. Demonstrates an improvement pipeline guided by this taxonomy on Korean sensitive questions.

entry.title: Traces of Social Competence in Large Language Models

author.name: Tom Kouwenhoven, Michiel van der Meer, Max van Duijn

entry.summary: Tests 17 open-weight LLMs on 192 False Belief Test variants using Bayesian logistic regression to assess Theory of Mind capabilities. Finds scaling benefits performance but not strictly, and propositional attitude explication fundamentally alters response patterns.

entry.title: PinCLIP: Large-scale Foundational Multimodal Representation at Pinterest

author.name: Josh Beal, Eric Kim, Jinfeng Rao, Rex Wu, Dmitry Kislyuk, Charles Rosenberg

entry.summary: Introduces PinCLIP, Pinterest's large-scale visual representation model using a hybrid Vision Transformer with VLM backbone for image-text alignment in recommendation and retrieval. Proposes neighbor-based training beyond standard contrastive objectives.

entry.title: LDP-Slicing: Local Differential Privacy for Images via Randomized Bit-Plane Slicing

author.name: Yuanming Cao, Chengqi Li, Wenbo He

entry.summary: Introduces LDP-Slicing, a training-free framework for applying Local Differential Privacy to images by decomposing pixel values into binary bit-planes, resolving the dimensionality problem that made LDP impractical for images.

entry.title: NOVA3R: Non-pixel-aligned Visual Transformer for Amodal 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Weirong Chen, Chuanxia Zheng, Ganlin Zhang, Andrea Vedaldi, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: Introduces NOVA3R, a method for non-pixel-aligned 3D reconstruction from unposed images that learns a global view-agnostic scene representation via scene tokens and a diffusion-based 3D decoder, recovering both visible and invisible geometry.

entry.title: Text Compression Can Help Secure Model Weights

author.name: Roy Rinberg

entry.summary: Proposes using text compression to increase the effective cost of model weight exfiltration, building on the observation that compressed text output is harder to distinguish from model weights, thereby strengthening egress-limit-based security against weight theft.

entry.title: Physics of RL: Toy scaling laws for the emergence of reward-seeking

author.name: AlexMeinke

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical toy model to study when RL training leads to reward-seeking reasoning versus behaviors that achieve high reward without explicitly optimizing for reward. Finds scaling-law-like relationships: more diverse RL environments increase likelihood of reward-seeking emergence.

entry.title: Controlling Chat Style in Language Models via Single-Direction Editing

author.name: Zhenyu Xu, Victor S. Sheng

entry.summary: Investigates controlling stylistic attributes in LLMs through representation engineering, providing evidence that styles are encoded as linear directions in activation space. Presents a training-free method for style control supporting linear composition.

entry.title: On the Learnability of Offline Model-Based Optimization: A Ranking Perspective

author.name: Shen-Huan Lyu, Rong-Xi Tan, Ke Xue, Yi-Xiao He, Yu Huang, Qingfu Zhang, Chao Qian

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that good regression accuracy implies good optimization performance in offline model-based optimization. Proposes a ranking-based risk framework and proves that ranking accuracy is both necessary and sufficient for optimization.

entry.title: Position: Vector Prompt Interfaces Should Be Exposed to Enable Customization of Large Language Models

author.name: Liangwei Yang, Shiyu Wang, Haolin Chen, Rithesh Murthy, Ming Zhu, Jielin Qiu, Zixiang Chen, Juntao Tan, Jianguo Zhang, Zhiwei Liu, Wenting Zhao, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Huan Wang, Shelby Heinecke

entry.summary: Argues that LLM providers should expose vector prompt inputs as a public interface for customization. Shows vector prompt tuning continues to improve with supervision while text-based optimization saturates early.

entry.title: EmbodiedSplat: Online Feed-Forward Semantic 3DGS for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Seungjun Lee, Zihan Wang, Yunsong Wang, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: Proposes EmbodiedSplat, an online feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method for open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming images, enabling simultaneous online reconstruction and semantic understanding without per-scene optimization.

entry.title: Specification-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Discrete-Event World Models via the DEVS Formalism

author.name: Zheyu Chen, Zhuohuan Li, Chuanhao Li

entry.summary: Presents a framework for generating and evaluating discrete-event world models using the DEVS formalism, seeking a middle ground between hand-engineered simulators and implicit neural models. Targets environments governed by ordering, timing, and causality of discrete events.

entry.title: $\tau$-Knowledge: Evaluating Conversational Agents over Unstructured Knowledge

author.name: Quan Shi, Alexandra Zytek, Pedram Razavi, Karthik Narasimhan, Victor Barres

entry.summary: Introduces τ-Knowledge, an extension of τ-Bench for evaluating agents in environments requiring coordination of external natural-language knowledge with tool outputs. New τ-Banking domain models realistic fintech scenarios.

entry.title: From Exact Hits to Close Enough: Semantic Caching for LLM Embeddings

author.name: Dvir David Biton, Roy Friedman

entry.summary: Explores offline and online policies for semantic caching of LLM embeddings. Proves that optimal offline semantic caching is NP-hard and proposes polynomial-time heuristics combining recency, frequency, and locality.

entry.title: Towards Self-Robust LLMs: Intrinsic Prompt Noise Resistance via CoIPO

author.name: Xin Yang, Letian Li, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Xuxin Cheng, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai, Wenyuan Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CoIPO for intrinsic prompt noise resistance in LLMs, addressing the problem that LLM performance degrades with imperfect prompts. Focuses on building robustness into the model itself rather than relying on external prompt preprocessing.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Decoding of Neural Activity

author.name: Yanchen Wang, Joy Hsu, Ehsan Adeli, Jiajun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes NEURONA, a neuro-symbolic framework for fMRI decoding that integrates symbolic reasoning and compositional execution with brain region grounding, showing that structural priors improve decoding and generalization.

entry.title: MemSifter: Offloading LLM Memory Retrieval via Outcome-Driven Proxy Reasoning

author.name: Jiejun Tan, Zhicheng Dou, Liancheng Zhang, Yuyang Hu, Yiruo Cheng, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes MemSifter, which offloads memory retrieval to a small proxy model that reasons about which memories are relevant, reducing computational burden on the primary working LLM.

entry.title: MMAI Gym for Science: Training Liquid Foundation Models for Drug Discovery

author.name: Maksim Kuznetsov, Zulfat Miftahutdinov, Rim Shayakhmetov, Mikolaj Mizera, Roman Schutski, Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Nikita Bondarev, Thomas MacDougall, Mathieu Reymond, Mihir Bafna, Kaeli Kaymak-Loveless, Eugene Babin, Maxim Malkov, Mathias Lechner, Ramin Hasani, Alexander Amini, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Alex Aliper, Alex Zhavoronkov

entry.summary: Introduces MMAI Gym for Science, a training framework for molecular foundation models in drug discovery, demonstrating that smaller purpose-trained Liquid Foundation Models can outperform larger general-purpose LLMs on drug discovery tasks.

entry.title: Order Is Not Layout: Order-to-Space Bias in Image Generation

author.name: Yongkang Zhang, Zonglin Zhao, Yuechen Zhang, Fei Ding, Pei Li, Wenxuan Wang

entry.summary: Identifies and studies Order-to-Space Bias in image generation models, where mention order of entities in text deterministically affects spatial layout and role binding. Introduces OTS-Bench for systematic evaluation.

entry.title: Agentic Peer-to-Peer Networks: From Content Distribution to Capability and Action Sharing

author.name: Taotao Wang, Lizhao You, Jingwen Tong, Chonghe Zhao, Shengli Zhang

entry.summary: Outlines the networking foundations for Agentic P2P Networks where local AI agents on edge devices share capabilities and actions directly, contrasting with traditional content-sharing P2P networks.

entry.title: T2S-Bench & Structure-of-Thought: Benchmarking and Prompting Comprehensive Text-to-Structure Reasoning

author.name: Qinsi Wang, Hancheng Ye, Jinhee Kim, Jinghan Ke, Yifei Wang, Martin Kuo, Zishan Shao, Dongting Li, Yueqian Lin, Ting Jiang, Chiyue Wei, Qi Qian, Wei Wen, Helen Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Structure of Thought (SoT), a prompting technique that guides LLMs to construct intermediate text structures, and T2S-Bench, a benchmark for text-to-structure capabilities across 6 scientific domains and 32 structural types.

entry.title: Spectral Surgery: Training-Free Refinement of LoRA via Gradient-Guided Singular Value Reweighting

author.name: Zailong Tian, Yanzhe Chen, Zhuoheng Han, Lizi Liao

entry.summary: Proposes Spectral Surgery, a training-free method to refine LoRA adapters by decomposing updates via SVD, estimating per-component sensitivity with gradients, and reweighting singular values. Shows consistent improvements across tasks and backbones.

entry.title: CodeTaste: Can LLMs Generate Human-Level Code Refactorings?

author.name: Alex Thillen, Niels M\"undler, Veselin Raychev, Martin Vechev

entry.summary: Introduces CodeTaste, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on code refactoring tasks mined from real open-source repositories. Tests whether agents can execute refactorings reliably and identify the refactorings human developers actually chose.

entry.title: Dissecting Quantization Error: A Concentration-Alignment Perspective

author.name: Marco Federici, Boris van Breugel, Paul Whatmough, Markus Nagel

entry.summary: Analyzes quantization error through signal-to-quantization-noise ratio, decomposing it into concentration (spread/outliers) and alignment (dominant variation directions). Shows alignment is as important as concentration, with implications for transform design.

entry.title: Believe Your Model: Distribution-Guided Confidence Calibration

author.name: Xizhong Yang, Haotian Zhang, Huiming Wang, Mofei Song

entry.summary: Proposes DistriVoting, a method that uses distributional priors of confidence scores alongside individual confidence for answer selection in Large Reasoning Models. Decomposes confidence distributions into positive/negative components to guide voting.

entry.title: PTOPOFL: Privacy-Preserving Personalised Federated Learning via Persistent Homology

author.name: Kelly L Vomo-Donfack, Adryel Hoszu, Gr\'egory Ginot, Ian Morilla

entry.summary: Introduces PTOPOFL, replacing gradient communication in federated learning with 48-dimensional persistent homology descriptors, making inversion provably ill-posed and enabling topology-guided personalized aggregation.

entry.title: Accurate and Efficient Hybrid-Ensemble Atmospheric Data Assimilation in Latent Space with Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Hang Fan, Juan Nathaniel, Yi Xiao, Ce Bian, Fenghua Ling, Ben Fei, Lei Bai, Pierre Gentine

entry.summary: Proposes HLOBA, a hybrid-ensemble data assimilation method operating in latent space for weather prediction. Maps forecasts and observations into shared latent space via autoencoder for efficient 3D assimilation with uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: SENTINEL: Stagewise Integrity Verification for Pipeline Parallel Decentralized Training

author.name: Hadi Mohaghegh Dolatabadi, Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan, Sameera Ramasinghe, Chamin P Hewa Koneputugodage, Gil Avraham, Yan Zuo, Violetta Shevchenko, Alexander Long

entry.summary: Proposes SENTINEL for verifying integrity in pipeline-parallel decentralized training using lightweight momentum-based monitoring with EMAs to detect corrupted inter-stage communication without computation duplication.

entry.title: Bayesian Adversarial Privacy

author.name: Cameron Bell, Timothy Johnston, Antoine Luciano, Christian P Robert

entry.summary: Introduces a new Bayesian decision-theoretic notion of privacy that is contextual and specific, arguing it provides more meaningful privacy guarantees than differential privacy. The framework has the data controller make disclosure decisions from the prior viewpoint rather than conditional on actual data.

entry.title: Benchmarking Motivational Interviewing Competence of Large Language Models

author.name: Aishwariya Jha, Prakrithi Shivaprakash, Lekhansh Shukla, Animesh Mukherjee, Prabhat Chand, Pratima Murthy

entry.summary: Benchmarks 10 LLMs (proprietary and open-source) on motivational interviewing competence using the MITI 4.2 framework, comparing to human therapists on both handcrafted and real-world clinical transcripts.

entry.title: Code Fingerprints: Disentangled Attribution of LLM-Generated Code

author.name: Jiaxun Guo, Ziyuan Yang, Mengyu Sun, Hui Wang, Jingfeng Lu, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Studies model-level code attribution to determine which LLM produced a given code snippet. Explores differences in training data and generation strategies that create distinguishable patterns.

entry.title: DAGE: Dual-Stream Architecture for Efficient and Fine-Grained Geometry Estimation

author.name: Tuan Duc Ngo, Jiahui Huang, Seoung Wug Oh, Kevin Blackburn-Matzen, Evangelos Kalogerakis, Chuang Gan, Joon-Young Lee

entry.summary: Presents DAGE, a dual-stream transformer disentangling global coherence from fine detail for multi-view geometry estimation. Low-res stream handles view consistency while high-res stream preserves sharp details.

entry.title: ProFound: A moderate-sized vision foundation model for multi-task prostate imaging

author.name: Yipei Wang, Yinsong Xu, Weixi Yi, Shaheer Ullah Saeed, Natasha Thorley, Alexander Ng, Yukun Zhou, Wen Yan, Dean Barratt, Shonit Punwani, Veeru Kasivisvanathan, Mark Emberton, Daniel C. Alexander, Yipeng Hu

entry.summary: Presents ProFound, a domain-specialized vision foundation model for volumetric prostate mpMRI, pre-trained on 5,000 patients (22,000+ 3D MRI volumes) using self-supervised approaches. Demonstrates strong performance across multiple prostate-related clinical tasks with limited labeled data.

entry.title: RIVER: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Video LLMs

author.name: Yansong Shi, Qingsong Zhao, Tianxiang Jiang, Xiangyu Zeng, Yi Wang, Limin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces RIVER Bench for evaluating real-time video interaction capabilities of multimodal LLMs, covering retrospective memory, live perception, and proactive anticipation tasks. Reveals significant gaps between offline and online video understanding capabilities.

entry.title: X-Loco: Towards Generalist Humanoid Locomotion Control via Synergetic Policy Distillation

author.name: Dewei Wang, Xinmiao Wang, Chenyun Zhang, Jiyuan Shi, Yingnan Zhao, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces X-Loco, a framework for training a vision-based generalist humanoid locomotion policy by distilling multiple specialist policies through a case-adaptive selection mechanism, mastering diverse skills like walking, fall recovery, and whole-body coordination.

entry.title: AI4S-SDS: A Neuro-Symbolic Solvent Design System via Sparse MCTS and Differentiable Physics Alignment

author.name: Jiangyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces AI4S-SDS, a neuro-symbolic framework combining multi-agent collaboration with Monte Carlo Tree Search for automated chemical solvent design. Proposes Sparse State Storage with Dynamic Path Reconstruction to overcome context window limitations during long-horizon reasoning.

entry.title: Towards Realistic Personalization: Evaluating Long-Horizon Preference Following in Personalized User-LLM Interactions

author.name: Qianyun Guo, Yibo Li, Yue Liu, Bryan Hooi

entry.summary: Proposes RealPref, a benchmark for evaluating realistic preference-following in long-horizon personalized user-LLM interactions, featuring 100 user profiles, 1300 preferences, four types of preference expression, and long-horizon interaction histories.

entry.title: DIALEVAL: Automated Type-Theoretic Evaluation of LLM Instruction Following

author.name: Nardine Basta, Dali Kaafar

entry.summary: Presents DIALEVAL, a type-theoretic framework using dual LLM agents to automate instruction decomposition into typed predicates with type-specific satisfaction semantics for evaluating instruction following.

entry.title: StructLens: A Structural Lens for Language Models via Maximum Spanning Trees

author.name: Haruki Sakajo, Frederikus Hudi, Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe

entry.summary: Introduces StructLens, an analytical framework that reveals internal structures in language models through maximum spanning trees based on semantic representations in residual streams, focusing on global inter-layer relationships.

entry.title: Certainty robustness: Evaluating LLM stability under self-challenging prompts

author.name: Mohammadreza Saadat, Steve Nemzer

entry.summary: Introduces the Certainty Robustness Benchmark, a two-turn evaluation measuring how LLMs balance stability and adaptability under self-challenging prompts like 'Are you sure?' and 'You are wrong!'

entry.title: Bridging the Reproducibility Divide: Open Source Software's Role in Standardizing Healthcare AI

author.name: John Wu, Zhenbang Wu, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Analyzes reproducibility in AI for healthcare publications, finding 74% still rely on private datasets or don't share code. Argues for open-source software to standardize healthcare AI.

entry.title: LiteVLA-Edge: Quantized On-Device Multimodal Control for Embedded Robotics

author.name: Justin Williams, Kishor Datta Gupta, Roy George, Mrinmoy Sarkar

entry.summary: Presents LiteVLA-Edge, a deployment-oriented Vision-Language-Action pipeline for fully on-device inference on Jetson Orin hardware, achieving 150.5ms latency through 4-bit GGUF quantization.

entry.title: SafeCRS: Personalized Safety Alignment for LLM-Based Conversational Recommender Systems

author.name: Haochang Hao, Yifan Xu, Xinzhuo Li, Yingqiang Ge, Lu Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces SafeCRS, a safety-aware training framework for LLM-based conversational recommender systems that respects personalized safety constraints like trauma triggers and phobias during recommendation.

entry.title: EvoPrune: Early-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient MLLMs

author.name: Yuhao Chen, Bin Shan, Xin Ye, Cheng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EvoPrune, an early-stage visual token pruning method for multimodal LLMs that prunes during visual encoding rather than after, using layer-wise similarity, diversity, and attention-based importance metrics.

entry.title: PROSPECT: Unified Streaming Vision-Language Navigation via Semantic--Spatial Fusion and Latent Predictive Representation

author.name: Zehua Fan, Wenqi Lyu, Wenxuan Song, Linge Zhao, Yifei Yang, Xi Wang, Junjie He, Lida Huang, Haiyan Liu, Bingchuan Sun, Guangjun Bao, Xuanyao Mao, Liang Xu, Yan Wang, Feng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes PROSPECT, a streaming VLN agent that couples a Vision-Language-Action policy with latent predictive representation learning, using CUT3R as a streaming 3D spatial encoder fused with SigLIP semantic features.

entry.title: On the Suitability of LLM-Driven Agents for Dark Pattern Audits

author.name: Chen Sun, Yash Vekaria, Rishab Nithyanand

entry.summary: Studies LLM-driven agents for auditing dark patterns in CCPA data rights request portals, testing whether agents can reliably detect manipulative interface designs that burden or discourage users from exercising data rights.

entry.title: Data-Aware Random Feature Kernel for Transformers

author.name: Amirhossein Farzam, Hossein Mobahi, Nolan Andrew Miller, Luke Sernau

entry.summary: Proposes data-aware random feature kernels for efficient Transformer attention, adapting importance sampling to the anisotropic distribution of queries/keys in pretrained models. Achieves better approximation than isotropic random features (Performers) without retraining.

entry.title: PlaneCycle: Training-Free 2D-to-3D Lifting of Foundation Models Without Adapters

author.name: Yinghong Yu, Guangyuan Li, Jiancheng Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PlaneCycle, a training-free, adapter-free method for lifting 2D foundation models to 3D by cyclically distributing spatial aggregation across orthogonal planes through network depth. No additional parameters needed.

entry.title: Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training: Robustifying Multimodal Web Agents Against Cross-Modal Attacks

author.name: Haoyu Liu, Dingcheng Li, Lukas Rutishauser, Zeyu Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes DMAST for robustifying multimodal web agents against cross-modal attacks. Shows visual-component attacks far outperform text-only injections and develops adversarial training formalized as a two-player zero-sum Markov game.

entry.title: A Stein Identity for q-Gaussians with Bounded Support

author.name: Sophia Sklaviadis, Thomas Moellenhoff, Andre F. T. Martins, Mario A. T. Figueiredo, Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan

entry.summary: Derives new Stein identity and Bonnet/Price-type theorems for bounded-support q-Gaussians, extending gradient estimation tools beyond standard Gaussians. Shows these can improve stochastic optimization with bounded distributions.

entry.title: Tuning Just Enough: Lightweight Backdoor Attacks on Multi-Encoder Diffusion Models

author.name: Ziyuan Chen, Yujin Jeong, Tobias Braun, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Studies backdoor attacks on Stable Diffusion 3's multi-encoder architecture, showing that selectively tuning a subset of text encoders can achieve efficient and effective attacks with fewer trainable parameters.

entry.title: LUMINA: Foundation Models for Topology Transferable ACOPF

author.name: Yijiang Li, Zeeshan Memon, Hongwei Jin, Stefano Fenu, Keunju Song, Sunash B Sharma, Parfait Gasana, Hongseok Kim, Liang Zhao, Kibaek Kim

entry.summary: Derives design principles for constrained scientific foundation models through systematic investigation of AC optimal power flow. Extracts three empirically grounded principles for building models that satisfy physical constraints.

entry.title: Scalable Contrastive Causal Discovery under Unknown Soft Interventions

author.name: Mingxuan Zhang, Khushi Desai, Sopho Kevlishvili, Elham Azizi

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable causal discovery model for paired observational and interventional settings that aggregates subset-level PDAGs with contrastive cross-regime orientation rules for globally consistent structure learning.

entry.title: stratum: A System Infrastructure for Massive Agent-Centric ML Workloads

author.name: Arnab Phani, Elias Strauss, Sebastian Schelter

entry.summary: Presents stratum, a system infrastructure for massive agent-centric ML workloads that addresses performance bottlenecks when LLM agents generate thousands of ML pipeline executions for data profiling and optimization.

entry.title: How Predicted Links Influence Network Evolution: Disentangling Choice and Algorithmic Feedback in Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Mathilde Perez, Rapha\"el Romero, Jefrey Lijffijt, Charlotte Laclau

entry.summary: Proposes a Hawkes process temporal framework to disentangle intrinsic homophily from algorithmic feedback effects in evolving networks where link prediction models are deployed.

entry.title: Training-Free Rate-Distortion-Perception Traversal With Diffusion

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Suzhi Bi, Ying-Jun Angela Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework using pretrained diffusion models to traverse the entire rate-distortion-perception surface for lossy compression, proving optimality of the diffusion decoder under AWGN observations.

entry.title: SELDON: Supernova Explosions Learned by Deep ODE Networks

author.name: Jiezhong Wu, Jack O'Brien, Jennifer Li, M. S. Krafczyk, Ved G. Shah, Amanda R. Wasserman, Daniel W. Apley, Gautham Narayan, Noelle I. Samia

entry.summary: Proposes SELDON, a continuous-time variational autoencoder for sparse, irregular astrophysical light curves using masked GRU-ODE encoder with latent neural ODE propagator. Designed for millisecond-scale inference to handle the 10M alerts/night from the Vera Rubin Observatory.

entry.title: The CompMath-MCQ Dataset: Are LLMs Ready for Higher-Level Math?

author.name: Bianca Raimondi, Francesco Pivi, Davide Evangelista, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Introduces CompMath-MCQ, a 1,500-question benchmark for evaluating LLMs on graduate-level computational mathematics including linear algebra, numerical optimization, and scientific computing. Questions are originally authored by professors to avoid data leakage.

entry.title: Proact-VL: A Proactive VideoLLM for Real-Time AI Companions

author.name: Weicai Yan, Yuhong Dai, Qi Ran, Haodong Li, Wang Lin, Hao Liao, Xing Xie, Tao Jin, Jianxun Lian

entry.summary: Introduces Proact-VL, a framework for proactive real-time AI companions in gaming scenarios that handles continuous streaming, autonomous response timing, and content quality/quantity control under real-time constraints.

entry.title: InfinityStory: Unlimited Video Generation with World Consistency and Character-Aware Shot Transitions

author.name: Mohamed Elmoghany, Liangbing Zhao, Xiaoqian Shen, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Yang Zhou, Gang Wu, Viet Dac Lai, Seunghyun Yoon, Ryan Rossi, Abdullah Rashwan, Puneet Mathur, Varun Manjunatha, Daksh Dangi, Chien Nguyen, Nedim Lipka, Trung Bui, Krishna Kumar Singh, Ruiyi Zhang, Xiaolei Huang, Jaemin Cho, Yu Wang, Namyong Park, Zhengzhong Tu, Hongjie Chen, Hoda Eldardiry, Nesreen Ahmed, Thien Nguyen, Dinesh Manocha, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Franck Dernoncourt

entry.summary: Presents InfinityStory for generating hour-long storytelling videos with background consistency, multi-subject shot transitions, and character identity preservation across scenes.

entry.title: Spatial Causal Prediction in Video

author.name: Yanguang Zhao, Jie Yang, Shengqiong Wu, Shutong Hu, Hongbo Qiu, Yu Wang, Guijia Zhang, Tan Kai Ze, Hao Fei, Chia-Wen Lin, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu

entry.summary: Introduces Spatial Causal Prediction (SCP), a new task requiring models to predict unseen past or future spatial states from video, with SCP-Bench containing 2,500 QA pairs across 1,181 videos. Evaluates existing models' ability to reason beyond visible spatio-temporal observations.

entry.title: TumorFlow: Physics-Guided Longitudinal MRI Synthesis of Glioblastoma Growth

author.name: Valentin Biller, Niklas Bubeck, Lucas Zimmer, Ayhan Can Erdur, Sandeep Nagar, Anke Meyer-Baese, Daniel R\"uckert, Benedikt Wiestler, Jonas Weidner

entry.summary: Presents TumorFlow, a physics-guided generative framework that synthesizes longitudinal 3D brain MRI of glioblastoma growth by combining a generative model with biophysical tumor-infiltration maps. Enables temporally consistent tumor growth trajectory simulation.

entry.title: DiverseDiT: Towards Diverse Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Mengping Yang, Zhiyu Tan, Binglei Li, Xiaomeng Yang, Hesen Chen, Hao Li

entry.summary: Investigates representation dynamics in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), finding that representation diversity across blocks is crucial for effective learning. Proposes DiverseDiT to promote diverse representations without external pretrained encoders.

entry.title: Structural Action Transformer for 3D Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Xiaohan Lei, Min Wang, Bohong Weng, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Structural Action Transformer (SAT) for 3D dexterous manipulation that reframes action chunks as unordered sequences of joint-wise trajectories rather than temporal sequences, enabling cross-embodiment skill transfer for high-DoF robotic hands.

entry.title: SkillVLA: Tackling Combinatorial Diversity in Dual-Arm Manipulation via Skill Reuse

author.name: Xuanran Zhai, Zekai Huang, Longyan Wu, Qianyou Zhao, Qiaojun Yu, Jieji Ren, Ce Hao, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Proposes SkillVLA for dual-arm manipulation that enables skill reuse by decoupling left and right arm skills in VLA models, allowing recombination of single-arm skills across novel pairings without learning every combination.

entry.title: Mass surveillance, red lines, and a crazy weekend

author.name: Boaz Barak

entry.summary: Boaz Barak (OpenAI employee) shares personal views on the OpenAI-Department of War deal, arguing that harm to democracy is an underappreciated AI risk and that the deal's surveillance provisions create an opportunity to establish tracking for mass surveillance risks alongside bio/cyber risks.

entry.title: RAGNav: A Retrieval-Augmented Topological Reasoning Framework for Multi-Goal Visual-Language Navigation

author.name: Ling Luo, Qiangian Bai

entry.summary: Proposes RAGNav, a framework for multi-goal vision-language navigation that bridges semantic reasoning and physical structure through a Dual-Basis Memory system integrating topological maps with semantic reasoning to address spatial hallucinations.

entry.title: TATRA: Training-Free Instance-Adaptive Prompting Through Rephrasing and Aggregation

author.name: Bartosz Dziuba, Kacper Kuchta, Pawe{\l} Batorski, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek, Paul Swoboda

entry.summary: Introduces TATRA, a training-free prompting method that constructs instance-specific few-shot prompts by synthesizing on-the-fly examples, requiring no labeled data or task-specific optimization.

entry.title: How does fine-tuning improve sensorimotor representations in large language models?

author.name: Minghua Wu, Javier Conde, Pedro Reviriego, Marc Brysbaert

entry.summary: Investigates whether fine-tuning can bridge the 'embodiment gap' in LLMs, showing internal representations can be steered toward more embodied patterns but improvements are sensitive to learning objectives and don't transfer across task formats.

entry.title: Inhibitory Cross-Talk Enables Functional Lateralization in Attention-Coupled Latent Memory

author.name: Hong Jeong

entry.summary: Presents a memory-augmented transformer with lateralized memory banks coupled through sign-controlled cross-talk, showing that inhibitory (not excitatory) cross-talk enables functional specialization without bank-dominance collapse.

entry.title: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis

author.name: Pei Yang, Wanyi Chen, Yuxi Zheng, Xueqian Li, Xiang Li, Haoqin Tu, Jie Xiao, Yifan Pang, Bill Shi, Lynn Ai, Eric Yang

entry.summary: Presents AOI, a trainable multi-agent framework for autonomous cloud operations that uses GRPO to distill expert-level knowledge from failed trajectories into locally deployed open-source models under security constraints.

entry.title: Zero-Knowledge Federated Learning with Lattice-Based Hybrid Encryption for Quantum-Resilient Medical AI

author.name: Edouard Lansiaux

entry.summary: Introduces ZKFL-PQ, a three-tiered cryptographic protocol for federated learning combining quantum-resistant key encapsulation, lattice-based zero-knowledge proofs, and post-quantum security for medical AI.

entry.title: InEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Intermediate Logical Pathways for Intelligent Image Editing Models

author.name: Zhiqiang Sheng, Xumeng Han, Zhiwei Zhang, Zenghui Xiong, Yifan Ding, Aoxiang Ping, Xiang Li, Tong Guo, Yao Mao

entry.summary: Introduces InEdit-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating image editing models on intermediate logical reasoning pathways—multi-step evolution from initial to final states requiring procedural and causal understanding.

entry.title: Large-Language-Model-Guided State Estimation for Partially Observable Task and Motion Planning

author.name: Yoonwoo Kim, Raghav Arora, Roberto Mart\'in-Mart\'in, Peter Stone, Ben Abbatematteo, Yoonchang Sung

entry.summary: Uses LLM common-sense reasoning to guide state estimation in partially observable robot planning, incorporating knowledge about object co-location and typical placement to improve task planning under uncertainty.

entry.title: Why Do Unlearnable Examples Work: A Novel Perspective of Mutual Information

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Yibo Miao, Yinpeng Dong, Xiao-Shan Gao

entry.summary: Analyzes unlearnable examples through the lens of mutual information reduction, showing that effective unlearnable examples always decrease mutual information between clean and poisoned features, and proposes improvements based on this theory.

entry.title: Learning Approximate Nash Equilibria in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Mean-Field Subsampling

author.name: Emile Anand, Ishani Karmarkar

entry.summary: Proposes ALTERNATING-MARL for cooperative Markov games with communication constraints, where a global agent performs subsampled mean-field Q-learning. Proves convergence to approximate Nash equilibria.

entry.title: When and Where to Reset Matters for Long-Term Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Taejun Lim, Joong-Won Hwang, Kibok Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive and Selective Reset (ASR) for continual test-time adaptation that dynamically determines when and where to reset model parameters, with importance-aware regularization to preserve useful knowledge.

entry.title: GIPO: Gaussian Importance Sampling Policy Optimization

author.name: Chengxuan Lu, Zhenquan Zhang, Shukuan Wang, Qunzhi Lin, Baigui Sun, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GIPO, a policy optimization method using Gaussian importance sampling instead of hard clipping (as in PPO), providing smoother trust region constraints with non-zero gradients. Targets improved data efficiency for multimodal RL agents. Includes theoretical analysis of update magnitude constraints.

entry.title: CubeComposer: Spatio-Temporal Autoregressive 4K 360{\deg} Video Generation from Perspective Video

author.name: Lingen Li, Guangzhi Wang, Xiaoyu Li, Zhaoyang Zhang, Qi Dou, Jinwei Gu, Tianfan Xue, Ying Shan

entry.summary: Introduces CubeComposer, a spatio-temporal autoregressive diffusion model that natively generates 4K 360° panoramic videos by decomposing into cubemap faces. Reduces memory demands while achieving high resolution for VR applications.

entry.title: Trade-offs in Ensembling, Merging and Routing Among Parameter-Efficient Experts

author.name: Sanae Lotfi, Lucas Caccia, Alessandro Sordoni, Jordan T. Ash, Miroslav Dudik

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates trade-offs between ensembling, merging, and routing strategies for combining parameter-efficient experts (LoRA adapters). Provides systematic comparison of design decisions across these fusion approaches.

entry.title: LEA: Label Enumeration Attack in Vertical Federated Learning

author.name: Wenhao Jiang, Shaojing Fu, Yuchuan Luo, Lin Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Label Enumeration Attack (LEA), a novel label inference attack on Vertical Federated Learning that works across multiple VFL scenarios without needing auxiliary data. Uses clustering-based enumeration to infer private labels.

entry.title: Lang2Str: Two-Stage Crystal Structure Generation with LLMs and Continuous Flow Models

author.name: Cong Liu, Chengyue Gong, Zhenyu Liu, Jiale Zhao, Yuxuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Lang2Str, a two-stage framework combining LLMs (for high-level crystal structure description) with flow-based models (for precise atomic coordinate generation) for materials discovery.

entry.title: Out-of-distribution transfer of PDE foundation models to material dynamics under extreme loading

author.name: Mahindra Rautela, Alexander Most, Siddharth Mansingh, Aleksandra Pachalieva, Bradley Love, Daniel O Malley, Alexander Scheinker, Kyle Hickmann, Diane Oyen, Nathan Debardeleben, Earl Lawrence, Ayan Biswas

entry.summary: Benchmarks PDE foundation models on out-of-distribution material dynamics with shocks, fractures, and discontinuities. Finds that models pretrained on fluid-centric benchmarks struggle with extreme-loading regimes.

entry.title: Surprisal-R\'enyi Free Energy

author.name: Shion Matsumoto, Raul Castillo, Benjamin Prada, Ankur Arjun Mali

entry.summary: Introduces Surprisal-Rényi Free Energy (SRFE), a new divergence measure that recovers forward and reverse KL as endpoint limits and reveals an explicit mean-variance tradeoff governing departures from KL-dominated regimes.

entry.title: Riemannian Langevin Dynamics: Strong Convergence of Geometric Euler-Maruyama Scheme

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhan, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Proves strong convergence of order 1/2 for a geometric Euler-Maruyama scheme for SDEs on Riemannian manifolds, providing theoretical foundations for manifold-valued diffusion models.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Generative Learning via Latent Space Distribution Matching

author.name: Kwong Yu Chong, Long Feng

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Space Distribution Matching (LSDM) for semi-supervised generative modeling that learns a latent space from paired and unpaired data, then performs distribution matching using Wasserstein distance. Provides theoretical error bounds and demonstrates benefits of unpaired data for geometric fidelity.

entry.title: ErrorLLM: Modeling SQL Errors for Text-to-SQL Refinement

author.name: Zijin Hong, Hao Chen, Zheng Yuan, Qinggang Zhang, Luyao Zhuang, Qing Liao, Feiran Huang, Yangqiu Song, Xiao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes ErrorLLM for SQL refinement that explicitly models syntactic and semantic errors grounded in schema and question context. Addresses limitations of self-debugging and self-correction approaches for text-to-SQL.

entry.title: The Company You Keep: How LLMs Respond to Dark Triad Traits

author.name: Zeyi Lu, Angelica Henestrosa, Pavel Chizhov, Ivan P. Yamshchikov

entry.summary: Examines how LLMs respond to user prompts expressing Dark Triad personality traits (Machiavellianism, Narcissism, Psychopathy). Finds models predominantly show corrective behavior but exhibit reinforcing output in certain cases.

entry.title: TaxonRL: Reinforcement Learning with Intermediate Rewards for Interpretable Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning

author.name: Maximilian von Klinski, Maximilian Schall

entry.summary: Introduces TaxonRL, using GRPO with intermediate rewards for hierarchical taxonomic visual reasoning. Achieves 91.7% accuracy on Birds-to-Words by incentivizing species/genus/family-level feature reasoning before final classification.

entry.title: CoRe-BT: A Multimodal Radiology-Pathology-Text Benchmark for Robust Brain Tumor Typing

author.name: Juampablo E. Heras Rivera, Daniel K. Low, Xavier Xiong, Jacob J. Ruzevick, Daniel D. Child, Wen-wai Yim, Mehmet Kurt, Asma Ben Abacha

entry.summary: Introduces CoRe-BT, a cross-modal radiology-pathology-text benchmark for brain tumor typing with 310 patients including MRI, pathology images, and reports, designed to study robust multimodal learning under missing modalities.

entry.title: WSI-INR: Implicit Neural Representations for Lesion Segmentation in Whole-Slide Images

author.name: Yunheng Wu, Wenqi Huang, Liangyi Wang, Masahiro Oda, Yuichiro Hayashi, Daniel Rueckert, Kensaku Mori

entry.summary: Proposes WSI-INR, a patch-free framework using Implicit Neural Representations for whole-slide image lesion segmentation, modeling the WSI as a continuous function mapping coordinates to tissue semantics.

entry.title: DISC: Dense Integrated Semantic Context for Large-Scale Open-Set Semantic Mapping

author.name: Felix Igelbrink, Lennart Niecksch, Martin Atzmueller, Joachim Hertzberg

entry.summary: Introduces DISC, a dense semantic mapping system that extracts CLIP embeddings directly from vision transformer intermediate layers in a single pass, avoiding expensive crop-based feature extraction. Built on GPU-accelerated architecture for large-scale open-set mapping.

entry.title: Real5-OmniDocBench: A Full-Scale Physical Reconstruction Benchmark for Robust Document Parsing in the Wild

author.name: Changda Zhou, Ziyue Gao, Xueqing Wang, Tingquan Gao, Cheng Cui, Jing Tang, Yi Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Real5-OmniDocBench, the first benchmark that physically reconstructs all 1,355 images of OmniDocBench across five real-world degradation scenarios (scanning, warping, screen photography, illumination, skew) to evaluate VLM document parsing robustness.

entry.title: Gaussian Wardrobe: Compositional 3D Gaussian Avatars for Free-Form Virtual Try-On

author.name: Zhiyi Chen, Hsuan-I Ho, Tianjian Jiang, Jie Song, Manuel Kaufmann, Chen Guo

entry.summary: Introduces Gaussian Wardrobe, a compositional 3D Gaussian avatar framework that decomposes humans into bodies and layers of shape-agnostic garments from multi-view video, enabling virtual try-on by recombining garments across different individuals.

entry.title: ArtHOI: Articulated Human-Object Interaction Synthesis by 4D Reconstruction from Video Priors

author.name: Zihao Huang, Tianqi Liu, Zhaoxi Chen, Shaocong Xu, Saining Zhang, Lixing Xiao, Zhiguo Cao, Wei Li, Hao Zhao, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Presents ArtHOI for synthesizing articulated human-object interactions by formulating it as 4D reconstruction from monocular video generated by diffusion models, recovering geometrically consistent scenes without 3D supervision.

entry.title: ManipulationNet: An Infrastructure for Benchmarking Real-World Robot Manipulation with Physical Skill Challenges and Embodied Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Yiting Chen, Kenneth Kimble, Edward H. Adelson, Tamim Asfour, Podshara Chanrungmaneekul, Sachin Chitta, Yash Chitambar, Ziyang Chen, Ken Goldberg, Danica Kragic, Hui Li, Xiang Li, Yunzhu Li, Aaron Prather, Nancy Pollard, Maximo A. Roa-Garzon, Robert Seney, Shuo Sha, Shihefeng Wang, Yu Xiang, Kaifeng Zhang, Yuke Zhu, Kaiyu Hang

entry.summary: Introduces ManipulationNet, a global infrastructure for benchmarking real-world robotic manipulation with standardized physical tasks and multimodal reasoning challenges, aiming to address the lack of reproducible benchmarks that has fragmented manipulation research.

entry.title: Understanding Sources of Demographic Predictability in Brain MRI via Disentangling Anatomy and Contrast

author.name: Mehmet Yigit Avci (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), Akshit Achara (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), Andrew King (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), Jorge Cardoso (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to disentangle anatomy vs. contrast as sources of demographic predictability in brain MRI, addressing bias concerns in clinical AI. Shows how anatomical variation and acquisition differences contribute differently to predicting age, sex, and race.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Interpreting Multivariate Physiological Time Series

author.name: Davide Gabrielli, Paola Velardi, Stefano Faralli, Bardh Prenkaj

entry.summary: Presents Vivaldi, a multi-agent LLM system for interpreting multivariate physiological time series in emergency care. Clinical evaluation reveals that agentic reasoning does not uniformly outperform zero-shot inference.

entry.title: Controllable Generative Sandbox for Causal Inference

author.name: Qi Zhang, Harsh Parikh, Ashley Naimi, Razieh Nabi, Christopher Kim, Timothy Lash

entry.summary: Introduces CausalMix, a variational generative framework for creating synthetic causal inference data with explicit controls over overlap, confounding, and treatment effect heterogeneity while maintaining distributional realism.

entry.title: Seeing as Experts Do: A Knowledge-Augmented Agent for Open-Set Fine-Grained Visual Understanding

author.name: Junhan Chen, Zilu Zhou, Yujun Tong, Dongliang Chang, Yitao Luo, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: Presents KFRA, a knowledge-augmented agent for open-set fine-grained visual understanding that operates through a three-stage reasoning loop combining open-vocabulary detection, web-scale retrieval, and discriminative region analysis.

entry.title: Real Eyes Realize Faster: Gaze Stability and Pupil Novelty for Efficient Egocentric Learning

author.name: Ajan Subramanian, Sumukh Bettadapura, Rohan Sathish

entry.summary: Proposes using eye-tracking signals (gaze stability and pupil response) from wearable devices as a training-free frame curation mechanism for egocentric video, selecting informative frames based on visual stability and arousal-linked novelty.

entry.title: Invariance-Based Dynamic Regret Minimization

author.name: Margherita Lazzaretto, Jonas Peters, Niklas Pfister

entry.summary: Proposes ISD-linUCB for non-stationary linear bandits that decomposes the reward model into stationary and non-stationary components, using historical data to learn invariances for improved online performance.

entry.title: Underrepresented in Foundation Model Pretraining Data? A One-Shot Probe

author.name: Chris Vorster, Mayug Maniparambil, Noel E. O'Connor, Noel Murphy, Derek Molloy

entry.summary: Proposes a data-efficient method to predict a vision-language foundation model's zero-shot accuracy on a target domain using only one labeled image per class, leveraging LLM-generated counterfactual descriptions to probe underrepresentation.

entry.title: Whole-Body Safe Control of Robotic Systems with Koopman Neural Dynamics

author.name: Sebin Jung, Abulikemu Abuduweili, Jiaxing Li, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes using Koopman operator theory to learn linear representations of nonlinear robot dynamics, integrated with Safe Set Algorithm to solve tracking and safety constraints in a single QP for real-time control of manipulators and quadrupeds.

entry.title: Agentics 2.0: Logical Transduction Algebra for Agentic Data Workflows

author.name: Alfio Massimiliano Gliozzo, Junkyu Lee, Nahuel Defosse

entry.summary: Presents Agentics 2.0, a Python-native framework formalizing LLM inference calls as typed semantic transformations (transducible functions) that compose via algebraically grounded operators for building reliable, explainable agentic data workflows.

entry.title: Knowledge Graph and Hypergraph Transformers with Repository-Attention and Journey-Based Role Transport

author.name: Mahesh Godavarti

entry.summary: Presents an architecture for joint training on sentences and structured data (knowledge graphs/hypergraphs) with separable representations, using a key-value repository with journey-based role transport for attention.

entry.title: Escaping the BLEU Trap: A Signal-Grounded Framework with Decoupled Semantic Guidance for EEG-to-Text Decoding

author.name: Yuchen Wang, Haonan Wang, Yu Guo, Honglong Yang, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes SemKey, a multi-stage framework for EEG-to-text decoding that addresses semantic bias, signal neglect, and artificially inflated BLEU scores by enforcing signal-grounded generation through four decoupled semantic objectives.

entry.title: Non-Invasive Reconstruction of Intracranial EEG Across the Deep Temporal Lobe from Scalp EEG based on Conditional Normalizing Flow

author.name: Dongyi He, Bin Jiang, Kecheng Feng, Luyin Zhang, Ling Liu, Yuxuan Li, Yun Zhao, He Yan

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroFlowNet, a cross-modal generative framework using conditional normalizing flows for the first reconstruction of intracranial EEG from scalp EEG signals across the deep temporal lobe.

entry.title: RAG-X: Systematic Diagnosis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering

author.name: Aswini Sivakumar, Vijayan Sugumaran, Yao Qiang

entry.summary: Proposes RAG-X, a diagnostic framework for medical RAG systems that independently evaluates retriever and generator components to pinpoint whether errors stem from faulty retrieval or flawed generation.

entry.title: Mathematicians in the age of AI

author.name: Jeremy Avigad

entry.summary: An essay by Jeremy Avigad urging mathematicians to engage with AI developments that can prove research-level theorems both formally and informally, and to consider how AI will disrupt mathematical practice.

entry.title: MPFlow: Multi-modal Posterior-Guided Flow Matching for Zero-Shot MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Seunghoi Kim, Chen Jin, Henry F. J. Tregidgo, Matteo Figini, Daniel C. Alexander

entry.summary: Proposes MPFlow, a zero-shot multi-modal MRI reconstruction framework using rectified flow that incorporates auxiliary MRI modalities at inference time without retraining, with a self-supervised cross-modal pretraining strategy.

entry.title: HALyPO: Heterogeneous-Agent Lyapunov Policy Optimization for Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Hao Zhang, Yaru Niu, Yikai Wang, Ding Zhao, H. Eric Tseng

entry.summary: Proposes HALyPO for human-robot collaboration, using Lyapunov stability theory in policy parameter space to address the rationality gap between heterogeneous human and robot agents in multi-agent RL.

entry.title: MACC: Multi-Agent Collaborative Competition for Scientific Exploration

author.name: Satoshi Oyama, Yuko Sakurai, Hisashi Kashima

entry.summary: Proposes MACC, a framework for multi-agent collaborative competition in scientific exploration using LLM-based agents, arguing that combining collaboration and competition produces more reliable scientific discoveries.

entry.title: Fairness Begins with State: Purifying Latent Preferences for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning in Interactive Recommendation

author.name: Yun Lu, Xiaoyu Shi, Hong Xie, Xiangyu Zhao, Mingsheng Shang

entry.summary: Proposes DSRM-HRL, reframing fairness-aware recommendation as a latent state purification problem, arguing that the accuracy-fairness conflict stems from state estimation failure due to popularity-driven noise and exposure bias.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Distributed Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning

author.name: Wang Jian, Shen Hong, Ke Wei, Liu Xue Hua

entry.summary: Proposes structure-aware distributed backdoor attacks for federated learning with metrics (SRS, SCC) measuring model sensitivity and compatibility with perturbations, showing architecture-specific attack optimization improves effectiveness.

entry.title: IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language

author.name: Markus Knauer, Samuel Bustamante, Thomas Eiband, Alin Albu-Sch\"affer, Freek Stulp, Jo\~ao Silv\'erio

entry.summary: Presents IROSA, a framework for open-vocabulary robot skill adaptation using pre-trained LLMs through a tool-based architecture that maintains a protective abstraction layer between language model and robot hardware.

entry.title: BD-Merging: Bias-Aware Dynamic Model Merging with Evidence-Guided Contrastive Learning

author.name: Yuhan Xie, Chen Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes BD-Merging, a bias-aware model merging framework that uses evidence-guided contrastive learning to handle distribution shift at test time, explicitly modeling uncertainty for adaptive reliability.

entry.title: Volumetric Directional Diffusion: Anchoring Uncertainty Quantification in Anatomical Consensus for Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Chao Wu, Kangxian Xie, Mingchen Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Volumetric Directional Diffusion (VDD) for ambiguous 3D medical image segmentation that anchors generative diffusion trajectories to a deterministic consensus prior, resolving the fidelity-diversity trade-off while avoiding anatomical hallucinations.

entry.title: When AI Fails, What Works? A Data-Driven Taxonomy of Real-World AI Risk Mitigation Strategies

author.name: Evgenija Popchanovska, Ana Gjorgjevikj, Maryan Rizinski, Lubomir Chitkushev, Irena Vodenska, Dimitar Trajanov

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven taxonomy of AI risk mitigation strategies derived from 9,705 media-reported AI incidents. Extends MIT's AI Risk Mitigation Taxonomy with empirically grounded classifications linking failure dynamics to interventions.

entry.title: Robustness of Agentic AI Systems via Adversarially-Aligned Jacobian Regularization

author.name: Furkan Mumcu, Yasin Yilmaz

entry.summary: Introduces Adversarially-Aligned Jacobian Regularization (AAJR) for multi-agent LLM systems, controlling sensitivity only along adversarial directions rather than globally. Proves AAJR yields a larger admissible policy class with smaller approximation gap.

entry.title: Minimax Optimal Strategy for Delayed Observations in Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Harin Lee, Kevin Jamieson

entry.summary: Proposes a minimax optimal algorithm for RL with delayed state observations, achieving regret of Õ(H√(D_max·SAK)) with a matching lower bound. Frames the problem as a special case of a broader MDP class.

entry.title: Orbital Transformers for Predicting Wavefunctions in Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory

author.name: Xuan Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Chengdong Wang, Jacob Helwig, Shuiwang Ji, Xiaofeng Qian

entry.summary: Proposes OrbEvo, an equivariant graph transformer for learning wavefunction evolution in time-dependent DFT. Predicts electronic wavefunction coefficients across time steps, dramatically accelerating TDDFT simulations.

entry.title: Extending Neural Operators: Robust Handling of Functions Beyond the Training Set

author.name: Blaine Quackenbush, Paul J. Atzberger

entry.summary: Develops a rigorous mathematical framework for extending neural operators to handle out-of-distribution input functions using RKHS theory. Provides theorems on reliable extension requirements and connects kernel choices to Sobolev spaces.

entry.title: Harmonic Dataset Distillation for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Seungha Hong, Sanghwan Jang, Wonbin Kweon, Suyeon Kim, Gyuseok Lee, Hwanjo Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Harmonic Dataset Distillation (HDT) for time series forecasting that decomposes data into sinusoidal basis via FFT and matches harmonic structure. Addresses architectural overfitting and scalability limitations of conventional dataset distillation.

entry.title: Dual-Solver: A Generalized ODE Solver for Diffusion Models with Dual Prediction

author.name: Soochul Park, Yeon Ju Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Dual-Solver for diffusion model sampling that generalizes multistep samplers through learnable parameters for interpolating prediction types, selecting integration domains, and adjusting residual terms.

entry.title: TAP: A Token-Adaptive Predictor Framework for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration

author.name: Haowei Zhu, Tingxuan Huang, Xing Wang, Tianyu Zhao, Jiexi Wang, Weifeng Chen, Xurui Peng, Fangmin Chen, Junhai Yong, Bin Wang

entry.summary: Presents TAP, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion model sampling that adaptively selects a predictor for each token at every step using a probe-based proxy loss evaluation.

entry.title: Learning Hip Exoskeleton Control Policy via Predictive Neuromusculoskeletal Simulation

author.name: Ilseung Park, Changseob Song, Inseung Kang

entry.summary: Presents a physics-based framework for training hip exoskeleton control policies entirely in simulation using neuromusculoskeletal models and muscle-synergy priors, demonstrating sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: Beyond Mixtures and Products for Ensemble Aggregation: A Likelihood Perspective on Generalized Means

author.name: Rapha\"el Razafindralambo, R\'emy Sun, Fr\'ed\'eric Precioso, Damien Garreau, Pierre-Alexandre Mattei

entry.summary: Studies density aggregation for deep ensembles through generalized means of order r, unifying linear pooling (probability averaging) and geometric pooling (logit averaging). Shows the regime r∈[0,1] is the only range ensuring systematic improvements over individual ensemble members.

entry.title: Assessing the Effectiveness of LLMs in Delivering Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

author.name: Navdeep Singh Bedi, Ana-Maria Bucur, Noriko Kando, Fabio Crestani

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to emulate CBT therapists using transcribed role-play sessions, comparing generation-only and RAG approaches. Tests both proprietary and open-source models on linguistic quality, semantic coherence, and therapeutic fidelity.

entry.title: AILS-NTUA at SemEval-2026 Task 12: Graph-Based Retrieval and Reflective Prompting for Abductive Event Reasoning

author.name: Nikolas Karafyllis, Maria Lymperaiou, Giorgos Filandrianos, Athanasios Voulodimos, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Presents a winning system for SemEval 2026 Task 12 (Abductive Event Reasoning) combining graph-based retrieval, reflective prompt evolution, and consistency enforcement. Ranks first with 0.95 accuracy and reveals systematic reasoning biases across 14 models.

entry.title: Pointer-CAD: Unifying B-Rep and Command Sequences via Pointer-based Edges & Faces Selection

author.name: Dacheng Qi, Chenyu Wang, Jingwei Xu, Tianzhe Chu, Zibo Zhao, Wen Liu, Wenrui Ding, Yi Ma, Shenghua Gao

entry.summary: Presents Pointer-CAD, an LLM-based CAD generation framework using pointer-based entity selection that enables complex editing operations like chamfer and fillet, overcoming limitations of pure command sequence representations.

entry.title: Hazard-Aware Traffic Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Yaoqi Huang, Julie Stephany Berrio, Mao Shan, Stewart Worrall

entry.summary: Introduces Traffic Scene Graph Generation that captures safety-relevant relations between prominent hazards and the ego vehicle, going beyond generic spatial predicates to assess safety relevance in driving scenarios.

entry.title: RAGTrack: Language-aware RGBT Tracking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Hao Li, Yuhao Wang, Wenning Hao, Pingping Zhang, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu

entry.summary: Introduces textual descriptions into RGBT tracking benchmarks using MLLMs for automatic annotation, then proposes RAGTrack leveraging retrieval-augmented generation for language-aware RGB-Thermal tracking.

entry.title: LiDAR Prompted Spatio-Temporal Multi-View Stereo for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Qihao Sun, Jiarun Liu, Ziqian Ni, Jianyun Xu, Tao Xie, Lijun Zhao, Ruifeng Li, Sheng Yang

entry.summary: Presents DriveMVS, a multi-view stereo framework for autonomous driving that uses sparse LiDAR observations as geometric prompts and a spatio-temporal decoder for cross-frame consistency.

entry.title: Universal Pansharpening Foundation Model

author.name: Hebaixu Wang, Jing Zhang, Haonan Guo, Di Wang, Jiayi Ma, Bo Du, Liangpei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents FoundPS, a universal pansharpening foundation model that works across heterogeneous satellites and varied scenes using a modality-interleaved transformer with reversible spectral affine bases.

entry.title: DeepScan: A Training-Free Framework for Visually Grounded Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yangfu Li, Hongjian Zhan, Jiawei Chen, Yuning Gong, Qi Liu, Yue Lu

entry.summary: Introduces DeepScan, a training-free framework for visually grounded reasoning in large vision-language models that uses hierarchical scanning, refocusing, and evidence-enhanced reasoning in a bottom-up manner. The approach mimics human visual evidence localization without requiring additional training.

entry.title: Any2Any: Unified Arbitrary Modality Translation for Remote Sensing

author.name: Haoyang Chen, Jing Zhang, Hebaixu Wang, Shiqin Wang, Pohsun Huang, Jiayuan Li, Haonan Guo, Di Wang, Zheng Wang, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes Any2Any, a unified latent diffusion framework for translating between arbitrary remote sensing modalities using a shared latent representation, addressing the quadratic complexity of pairwise translation approaches.

entry.title: Touch2Insert: Zero-Shot Peg Insertion by Touching Intersections of Peg and Hole

author.name: Masaru Yajima, Yuma Shin, Rei Kawakami, Asako Kanezaki, Kei Ota

entry.summary: Presents Touch2Insert, a tactile-based framework for zero-shot peg insertion that reconstructs cross-sectional geometry from tactile images to achieve sub-millimeter precision, generalizing across novel connector geometries.
