entry.title: ArthroCut: Autonomous Policy Learning for Robotic Bone Resection in Knee Arthroplasty

author.name: Xu Lu, Yiling Zhang, Wenquan Cheng, Longfei Ma, Fang Chen, Hongen Liao

entry.summary: Proposes ArthroCut, an autonomous policy learning framework for knee arthroplasty that fine-tunes a VL backbone on multimodal surgical data (CT/MR, tracking, RGB-D, robot state) for context-aware bone resection.

entry.title: Self-adapting Robotic Agents through Online Continual Reinforcement Learning with World Model Feedback

author.name: Fabian Domberg, Georg Schildbach

entry.summary: Presents a framework for online continual RL that enables robotic controllers to self-adapt during deployment. Built on DreamerV3, it uses world model prediction residuals to detect out-of-distribution events and trigger finetuning automatically.

entry.title: Hierarchical Inference and Closure Learning via Adaptive Surrogates for ODEs and PDEs

author.name: Pengyu Zhang, Arnaud Vadeboncoeur, Alex Glyn-Davies, Mark Girolami

entry.summary: Develops a hierarchical Bayesian framework for inverse problems that jointly learns individual system parameters and shared unknown dynamics from collections of related physical systems using adaptive surrogates.

entry.title: Principled Learning-to-Communicate with Quasi-Classical Information Structures

author.name: Xiangyu Liu, Haoyi You, Kaiqing Zhang

entry.summary: Formalizes learning-to-communicate in multi-agent RL through information structures from decentralized stochastic control, proving convergence for certain quasi-classical information structures.

entry.title: From Misclassifications to Outliers: Joint Reliability Assessment in Classification

author.name: Yang Li, Youyang Sha, Yinzhi Wang, Timothy Hospedales, Xi Shen, Shell Xu Hu, Xuanlong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified evaluation framework integrating OOD detection and failure prediction for classifiers, with new metrics (DS-F1 and DS-AURC) that use double scoring functions.

entry.title: Continuous Modal Logical Neural Networks: Modal Reasoning via Stochastic Accessibility

author.name: Antonin Sulc

entry.summary: Proposes Fluid Logic, embedding modal logical reasoning (temporal, epistemic, deontic) into continuous manifolds via Neural SDEs. Introduces Logic-Informed Neural Networks (LINNs) analogous to PINNs.

entry.title: Who Judges the Judge? Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge for French Medical open-ended QA

author.name: Ikram Belmadani, Oumaima El Khettari, Pac\^ome Constant dit Beaufils, Richard Dufour, Benoit Favre

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can serve as judges of semantic equivalence in French medical open-ended QA. Shows domain-adapted and large general-purpose models best align with expert annotations, and lightweight adaptation via SFT and GRPO substantially improves compact models.

entry.title: One-Step Face Restoration via Shortcut-Enhanced Coupling Flow

author.name: Xiaohui Sun, Hanlin Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SCFlowFR for one-step face restoration using shortcut-enhanced coupling flow that models LQ-HQ dependency directly, avoiding path crossovers and enabling single-step sampling.

entry.title: Scaling Dense Event-Stream Pretraining from Visual Foundation Models

author.name: Zhiwen Chen, Junhui Hou, Zhiyu Zhu, Jinjian Wu, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised pretraining method that distills visual foundation models into event stream representations at scale, addressing semantic collapse issues through novel distillation paradigms for irregular event data.

entry.title: ViterbiPlanNet: Injecting Procedural Knowledge via Differentiable Viterbi for Planning in Instructional Videos

author.name: Luigi Seminara, Davide Moltisanti, Antonino Furnari

entry.summary: Introduces ViterbiPlanNet, which integrates procedural knowledge graphs into planning through a differentiable Viterbi layer, enabling end-to-end learning for action sequence prediction in instructional videos with improved sample efficiency.

entry.title: Dual Diffusion Models for Multi-modal Guided 3D Avatar Generation

author.name: Hong Li, Yutang Feng, Minqi Meng, Yichen Yang, Xuhui Liu, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes dual diffusion models for multi-modal guided 3D avatar generation from text or image prompts, constructing a 100K+ pair dataset across four modalities (text, face images, UV maps, 3D meshes) to enable fast inference.

entry.title: Learning Surgical Robotic Manipulation with 3D Spatial Priors

author.name: Yu Sheng, Lidian Wang, Xiaomeng Chu, Jiajun Deng, Min Cheng, Yanyong Zhang, Bei Hua, Houqiang Li, Jianmin Ji

entry.summary: Introduces Spatial Surgical Transformer (SST), an end-to-end visuomotor policy for surgical robot manipulation that achieves 3D spatial awareness using only default stereo endoscopes without wrist-mounted cameras.

entry.title: Transport Clustering: Solving Low-Rank Optimal Transport via Clustering

author.name: Henri Schmidt, Peter Halmos, Ben Raphael

entry.summary: Introduces transport clustering, reducing low-rank optimal transport to a clustering problem. Provides an efficient algorithm for a problem that is generally NP-hard, connecting OT theory to co-clustering.

entry.title: From Local Matches to Global Masks: Novel Instance Detection in Open-World Scenes

author.name: Qifan Zhang, Sai Haneesh Allu, Jikai Wang, Yangxiao Lu, Yu Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes L2G-Det, a local-to-global instance detection framework that bypasses object proposals by using dense patch-level matching between templates and query images for novel instance detection in cluttered scenes.

entry.title: Vector-Quantized Soft Label Compression for Dataset Distillation

author.name: Ali Abbasi, Ashkan Shahbazi, Hamed Pirsiavash, Soheil Kolouri

entry.summary: Proposes vector quantization of soft labels in dataset distillation to address the storage overhead from multiple soft labels per sample and their augmentations.

entry.title: EgoPoseFormer v2: Accurate Egocentric Human Motion Estimation for AR/VR

author.name: Zhenyu Li, Sai Kumar Dwivedi, Filip Maric, Carlos Chacon, Nadine Bertsch, Filippo Arcadu, Tomas Hodan, Michael Ramamonjisoa, Peter Wonka, Amy Zhao, Robin Kips, Cem Keskin, Anastasia Tkach, Chenhongyi Yang

entry.summary: Presents EgoPoseFormer v2 for egocentric human motion estimation in AR/VR, featuring a transformer model with identity-conditioned queries and multi-view spatial refinement, plus an auto-labeling system enabling use of large unlabeled datasets.

entry.title: Build, Judge, Optimize: A Blueprint for Continuous Improvement of Multi-Agent Consumer Assistants

author.name: Alejandro Breen Herrera, Aayush Sheth, Steven G. Xu, Zhucheng Zhan, Charles Wright, Marcus Yearwood, Hongtai Wei, Sudeep Das

entry.summary: Presents a practical blueprint for evaluating and optimizing multi-agent conversational shopping assistants at production scale, with a multi-faceted evaluation rubric for grocery shopping. Addresses underexplored challenges of evaluating multi-turn interactions and optimizing tightly coupled multi-agent systems.

entry.title: Quantum-Inspired Self-Attention in a Large Language Model

author.name: Nikita Kuznetsov, Niyaz Ismagilov, Ernesto Campos

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum-inspired self-attention mechanism (QISA) integrated into GPT-1's full autoregressive pipeline. First integration of quantum self-attention into a complete language modeling pipeline.

entry.title: IntPro: A Proxy Agent for Context-Aware Intent Understanding via Retrieval-conditioned Inference

author.name: Guanming Liu, Meng Wu, Peng Zhang, Yu Zhang, Yubo Shu, Xianliang Huang, Kainan Tu, Ning Gu, Liuxin Zhang, Qianying Wang, Tun Lu

entry.summary: Proposes IntPro, a proxy agent for context-aware intent understanding that infers user intentions from situational environments and accumulated intent patterns using retrieval-conditioned inference.

entry.title: ACES: Accent Subspaces for Coupling, Explanations, and Stress-Testing in Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Swapnil Parekh

entry.summary: Introduces ACES, a representation-centric audit for ASR systems that extracts accent-discriminative subspaces and uses them to probe model fragility and performance disparities across accents.

entry.title: Raising Bars, Not Parameters: LilMoo Compact Language Model for Hindi

author.name: Shiza Fatimah, Aniket Sen, Sophia Falk, Florian Mai, Lucie Flek, Nicholas Kluge Corr\^ea

entry.summary: Introduces LilMoo, a 0.6B parameter Hindi language model trained from scratch with a fully transparent pipeline, including a high-quality Hindi corpus (GigaLekh) filtered through heuristic and LLM-as-a-judge methods.

entry.title: Graph Negative Feedback Bias Correction Framework for Adaptive Heterophily Modeling

author.name: Jiaqi Lv, Qingfeng Du, Yu Zhang, Yongqi Han, Sheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes GNFBC, a negative feedback mechanism to correct the homophily bias inherent in GNN message-passing, with metrics for analyzing how label autocorrelation introduces bias.

entry.title: JANUS: Structured Bidirectional Generation for Guaranteed Constraints and Analytical Uncertainty

author.name: Taha Racicot

entry.summary: Introduces JANUS, a framework for constrained synthetic data generation using a DAG of Bayesian Decision Trees, addressing the quadrilemma of fidelity, control, reliability, and efficiency simultaneously.

entry.title: Rethinking Role-Playing Evaluation: Anonymous Benchmarking and a Systematic Study of Personality Effects

author.name: Ji-Lun Peng, Yun-Nung Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an anonymous evaluation method for LLM role-playing agents and investigates personality augmentation under anonymization, finding that name exposure carries implicit information that inflates role-playing performance.

entry.title: When Visual Evidence is Ambiguous: Pareidolia as a Diagnostic Probe for Vision Models

author.name: Qianpu Chen, Derya Soydaner, Rob Saunders

entry.summary: Uses face pareidolia (seeing faces in non-face objects) as a diagnostic probe for vision models. Evaluates six models across four representational regimes, revealing distinct mechanisms for handling visual ambiguity including semantic overreach in VLMs and geometric bias in face detectors.

entry.title: Crab$^{+}$: A Scalable and Unified Audio-Visual Scene Understanding Model with Explicit Cooperation

author.name: Dongnuan Cai, Henghui Du, Chang Zhou, Xi Chen, Dan Guo, Hongyuan Zhang, Xuelong Li, Di Hu

entry.summary: Presents Crab+, a unified audio-visual scene understanding model addressing task heterogeneity through explicit cooperation. Identifies that ~55% of tasks degrade under conventional multi-task training and proposes scalable solutions.

entry.title: Online Learning for Multi-Layer Hierarchical Inference under Partial and Policy-Dependent Feedback

author.name: Haoran Zhang, Seohyeon Cha, Hasan Burhan Beytur, Kevin S Chan, Gustavo de Veciana, Haris Vikalo

entry.summary: Studies online routing for multi-layer hierarchical inference systems with terminal-only feedback and long-term resource constraints. Addresses the challenge of policy-dependent observability where feedback variance amplifies with depth.

entry.title: Towards Improved Sentence Representations using Token Graphs

author.name: Krishna Sri Ipsit Mantri, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb, Zorah L\"ahner, Moshe Eliasof

entry.summary: Introduces GLOT, a lightweight graph-based pooling module for LLM outputs that constructs token-similarity graphs and uses GNNs to refine representations before aggregation, improving over standard mean/max pooling for sentence-level tasks.

entry.title: Inverse Contextual Bandits without Rewards: Learning from a Non-Stationary Learner via Suffix Imitation

author.name: Yuqi Kong, Xiao Zhang, Weiran Shen

entry.summary: Studies inverse contextual bandits where an observer tries to recover problem parameters by watching a non-stationary learner's actions. Proposes Two-Phase Suffix Imitation that discards early exploration data and learns from later exploitation behavior.

entry.title: FedCova: Robust Federated Covariance Learning Against Noisy Labels

author.name: Xiangyu Zhong, Xiaojun Yuan, Ying-Jun Angela Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FedCova, a federated learning framework robust to noisy labels that uses feature covariance learning and mutual information maximization instead of relying on clean data selection or auxiliary datasets.

entry.title: Quantifying Ranking Instability Across Evaluation Protocol Axes in Gene Regulatory Network Benchmarking

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Presents a diagnostic framework for measuring ranking instability in gene regulatory network benchmarks across evaluation protocol axes. Finds high reversal rates (up to 32%) across reference network choices.

entry.title: Tracing Pharmacological Knowledge In Large Language Models

author.name: Basil Hasan Khwaja, Dylan Chen, Guntas Toor, Anastasiya Kuznetsova

entry.summary: Investigates how drug-group semantics are represented in Llama-based biomedical LLMs using activation patching and linear probes. Finds early layers play a key role in encoding drug-group knowledge.

entry.title: Confidence-aware Monocular Depth Estimation for Minimally Invasive Surgery

author.name: Muhammad Asad, Emanuele Colleoni, Pritesh Mehta, Nicolas Toussaint, Ricardo Sanchez-Matilla, Maria Robu, Faisal Bashir, Rahim Mohammadi, Imanol Luengo, Danail Stoyanov

entry.summary: Proposes a confidence-aware monocular depth estimation framework for minimally invasive surgery using ensemble-derived confidence targets and confidence-aware loss, addressing unreliable predictions in endoscopic video.

entry.title: Parallax to Align Them All: An OmniParallax Attention Mechanism for Distributed Multi-View Image Compression

author.name: Haotian Zhang, Feiyue Long, Yixin Yu, Jian Xue, Haocheng Tang, Tongda Xu, Zhenning Shi, Yan Wang, Siwei Ma, Jiaqi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes OmniParallax Attention Mechanism for distributed multi-view image compression that explicitly models correlations between arbitrary view pairs during decoding, addressing the limitation of treating all images equally.

entry.title: Bridging Human Evaluation to Infrared and Visible Image Fusion

author.name: Jinyuan Liu, Xingyuan Li, Qingyun Mei, Haoyuan Xu, Zhiying Jiang, Long Ma, Risheng Liu, Xin Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a feedback reinforcement framework for infrared-visible image fusion that bridges human evaluation preferences, introducing the first large-scale human feedback dataset for this task. Uses human preference data to align fusion outputs with perceptual quality.

entry.title: Rethinking the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Zilin Lu, Ruifeng Yuan, Weiwei Cao, Wanxing Chang, Zhongyu Wei, Sinuo Wang, Yong Xia, Ling Zhang, Jianpeng Zhang

entry.summary: Revisits reinforcement learning for radiology report generation, finding data quality matters more than quantity. Proposes diagnostic diversity-based sampling and distinguishes between critical diagnostic tokens vs. routine tokens for more efficient RL optimization.

entry.title: DeNuC: Decoupling Nuclei Detection and Classification in Histopathology

author.name: Zijiang Yang, Chen Kuang, Dongmei Fu

entry.summary: Reveals that jointly optimizing nuclei detection and classification degrades foundation model representations in histopathology, and proposes DeNuC which decouples the two tasks for improved performance with pathology foundation models.

entry.title: Spectrum Shortage for Radio Sensing? Leveraging Ambient 5G Signals for Human Activity Detection

author.name: Kunzhe Song, Maxime Zingraff, Huacheng Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces Ambient Radio Sensing (ARS) that repurposes existing 5G/WiFi signals for human activity detection without interfering with primary communication, addressing spectrum scarcity for radio sensing applications.

entry.title: Map-Agnostic And Interactive Safety-Critical Scenario Generation via Multi-Objective Tree Search

author.name: Wenyun Li, Zejian Deng, Chen Sun

entry.summary: Presents a multi-objective MCTS framework for generating safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios that produce diverse, realistic collision events while ensuring explicit interaction logic among traffic participants.

entry.title: OpenAI’s surveillance language has many potential loopholes and they can do better

author.name: Tom Smith

entry.summary: Analyzes the surveillance-related language in the OpenAI-Department of War agreement, arguing that the contract contains significant ambiguities and loopholes regarding mass surveillance restrictions that OpenAI should clarify.

entry.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Aces Benchmarks, I Suppose

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi reviews Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro release, noting strong benchmark performance (77.1% on ARC-AGI-2, 2x+ improvement over 3 Pro) while observing that practical experience still feels like 'a Gemini model' compared to alternatives.

entry.title: From We to Me: Theory Informed Narrative Shift with Abductive Reasoning

author.name: Jaikrishna Manojkumar Patil, Divyagna Bavikadi, Kaustuv Mukherji, Ashby Steward-Nolan, Peggy-Jean Allin, Tumininu Awonuga, Joshua Garland, Paulo Shakarian

entry.summary: Proposes a neurosymbolic approach for narrative shift that uses abductive reasoning grounded in social science theory to transform text to reflect different narrative frameworks while preserving core messages.

entry.title: PulseLM: A Foundation Dataset and Benchmark for PPG-Text Learning

author.name: Hung Manh Pham, Jinyang Wu, Xiao Ma, Yiming Zhang, Yixin Xu, Aaqib Saeed, Bin Zhu, Zhou Pan, Dong Ma

entry.summary: Introduces PulseLM, a large-scale PPG-text dataset bridging raw photoplethysmography waveforms and natural language through closed-ended QA formulation, aggregating from fifteen public sources.

entry.title: Cryo-SWAN: the Multi-Scale Wavelet-decomposition-inspired Autoencoder Network for molecular density representation of molecular volumes

author.name: Rui Li, Artsemi Yushkevich, Mikhail Kudryashev, Artur Yakimovich

entry.summary: Presents Cryo-SWAN, a voxel-based variational autoencoder inspired by multi-scale wavelet decomposition for representing 3D molecular density volumes from cryo-EM data.

entry.title: Graph Hopfield Networks: Energy-Based Node Classification with Associative Memory

author.name: Abinav Rao, Alex Wa, Rishi Athavale

entry.summary: Introduces Graph Hopfield Networks that combine associative memory retrieval with graph Laplacian smoothing for node classification. The energy-based approach shows improvements on sparse citation networks and robustness under feature masking.

entry.title: Tucano 2 Cool: Better Open Source LLMs for Portuguese

author.name: Nicholas Kluge Corr\^ea, Aniket Sen, Shiza Fatimah, Sophia Falk, Lennard Landgraf, Julia Kastner, Lucie Flek

entry.summary: Presents Tucano 2, a fully open suite of Portuguese LLMs (0.5-3.7B parameters) with extensive datasets including synthetic data, SFT, and preference data for domains like RAG, coding, and reasoning.

entry.title: Goal-Driven Risk Assessment for LLM-Powered Systems: A Healthcare Case Study

author.name: Neha Nagaraja, Hayretdin Bahsi

entry.summary: Proposes a goal-driven risk assessment framework for LLM-powered healthcare systems that addresses the combined attack surface of adversarial model attacks, prompt injection, and conventional cyber attacks.

entry.title: MIND: Unified Inquiry and Diagnosis RL with Criteria Grounded Clinical Supports for Psychiatric Consultation

author.name: Guoyi Li, Shihao Xu, Jiatong Ma, Yunyun Han, Jianhua Chen, Yafeng Deng

entry.summary: Proposes MIND, an RL-based psychiatric consultation system that uses criteria-grounded clinical supports for differential diagnosis and optimizes multi-turn questioning strategies to reduce inquiry drift.

entry.title: Cognition to Control - Multi-Agent Learning for Human-Humanoid Collaborative Transport

author.name: Hao Zhang, Ding Zhao, H. Eric Tseng

entry.summary: Proposes C2C, a three-layer hierarchy for human-humanoid collaborative transport that integrates System 2-style deliberation with reliable low-latency continuous control under contact and safety constraints.

entry.title: Separators in Enhancing Autoregressive Pretraining for Vision Mamba

author.name: Hanpeng Liu, Zidan Wang, Shuoxi Zhang, Kaiyuan Gao, Kun He

entry.summary: Introduces separator tokens for autoregressive pretraining of Vision Mamba models, substantially extending input sequence length by demarcating and differentiating between different image regions.

entry.title: Upholding Epistemic Agency: A Brouwerian Assertibility Constraint for Responsible AI

author.name: Michael J\"ulich

entry.summary: Proposes a Brouwer-inspired assertibility constraint for responsible AI: systems must provide publicly inspectable certificates of entitlement in high-stakes domains or return 'Undetermined'. Creates a three-status interface semantics (Asserted/Denied/Undetermined).

entry.title: Discriminative Perception via Anchored Description for Reasoning Segmentation

author.name: Tao Yang, Qing Zhou, Yanliang Li, Qi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DPA for reasoning segmentation that adds discriminative perception to RL-based reasoning chains in MLLMs. Addresses the problem of unfocused reasoning that fails to distinguish targets from context in complex scenes.

entry.title: Architectural Proprioception in State Space Models: Thermodynamic Training Induces Anticipatory Halt Detection

author.name: Jay Noon

entry.summary: Introduces the Probability Navigation Architecture (PNA) framework treating neural computation as navigation through a probability manifold. Discovers that thermodynamically-trained SSMs develop anticipatory halt detection with a reproducible 'Universal Stopping Signature'.

entry.title: IPD: Boosting Sequential Policy with Imaginary Planning Distillation in Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yihao Qin, Yuanfei Wang, Hang Zhou, Peiran Liu, Hao Dong, Yiding Ji

entry.summary: Proposes Imaginary Planning Distillation (IPD) for offline RL that uses a learned world model with uncertainty measures to generate imaginary planning data, boosting sequential policies beyond static dataset limitations.

entry.title: Low-Resource Guidance for Controllable Latent Audio Diffusion

author.name: Zachary Novack, Zack Zukowski, CJ Carr, Julian Parker, Zach Evans, Josiah Taylor, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Julian McAuley, Jordi Pons

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Control Heads (LatCHs) for efficient guidance-based control of latent audio diffusion models. Operates directly in latent space to avoid expensive decoder backpropagation, requiring only 7M parameters and ~4 hours training.

entry.title: [Re] FairDICE: A Gap Between Theory And Practice

author.name: Peter Adema, Karim Galliamov, Aleksey Evstratovskiy, Ross Geurts

entry.summary: Replication study of FairDICE, a multi-objective offline RL algorithm. Finds theoretical claims mostly hold but a code bug reduces FairDICE to standard behavior close to OptiDICE, undermining its practical contribution.

entry.title: Q-Measure-Learning for Continuous State RL: Efficient Implementation and Convergence

author.name: Shengbo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Measure-Learning for continuous-state RL that learns a signed empirical measure on visited state-action pairs, reconstructing Q-values via kernel integration. Achieves O(n) memory and computation with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Adaptive Sensing of Continuous Physical Systems for Machine Learning

author.name: Felix K\"oster, Atsushi Uchida

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for adaptive information extraction from physical dynamical systems using a trainable attention module that learns where to probe and how to combine measurements. Instantiated on spatiotemporal PDE fields.

entry.title: k-hop Fairness: Addressing Disparities in Graph Link Prediction Beyond First-Order Neighborhoods

author.name: Lilian Marey, Tiphaine Viard, Charlotte Laclau

entry.summary: Proposes k-hop fairness for graph link prediction that goes beyond first-order neighborhood fairness (dyadic fairness) to address disparities within sensitive groups at multiple hops.

entry.title: Beyond Edge Deletion: A Comprehensive Approach to Counterfactual Explanation in Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Matteo De Sanctis, Riccardo De Sanctis, Stefano Faralli, Paola Velardi, Bardh Prenkaj

entry.summary: Introduces XPlore, a counterfactual explanation technique for GNNs that performs gradient-guided perturbations to both adjacency and node feature matrices, broadening the search space beyond edge deletion.

entry.title: Beyond Cross-Validation: Adaptive Parameter Selection for Kernel-Based Gradient Descents

author.name: Xiaotong Liu, Yunwen Lei, Xiangyu Chang, Shao-Bo Lin

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive parameter selection strategy for kernel-based gradient descent using empirical effective dimension, achieving optimal generalization error bounds that adapt to different kernels and target functions.

entry.title: Non-Invasive Reconstruction of Cardiac Activation Dynamics Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Nathan Dermul, Hans Dierckx

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed neural network for reconstructing cardiac activation patterns and deformation from measurable data, integrating nonlinear anisotropic constitutive modeling with finite-element-based losses.

entry.title: Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements: A framework for quantum hypothesis testing and semidefinite optimization

author.name: Nana Liu, Mark M. Wilde

entry.summary: Draws a connection between quantum measurement operators and Fermi-Dirac statistics, reinterpreting quantum hypothesis testing objectives as energies of fermionic modes and using thermal relaxation for semidefinite optimization.

entry.title: Balancing Fidelity, Utility, and Privacy in Synthetic Cardiac MRI Generation: A Comparative Study

author.name: Madhura Edirisooriya, Dasuni Kawya, Ishan Kumarasinghe, Isuri Devindi, Mary M. Maleckar, Roshan Ragel, Isuru Nawinne, Vajira Thambawita

entry.summary: Benchmarks DDPM, Latent Diffusion Models, and Flow Matching for synthetic cardiac MRI generation, evaluating fidelity, utility, and privacy. DDPM provides the best balance while Flow Matching shows promising privacy characteristics.

entry.title: Semantic Bridging Domains: Pseudo-Source as Test-Time Connector

author.name: Xizhong Yang, Huiming Wang, Ning Xu, Mofei Song

entry.summary: Proposes Stepwise Semantic Alignment (SSA) for test-time domain adaptation that uses a pseudo-source domain as a semantic bridge rather than a direct substitute for the original source domain.

entry.title: Arapai: An Offline-First AI Chatbot Architecture for Low-Connectivity Educational Environments

author.name: Joseph Walusimbi, Ann Move Oguti, Joshua Benjamin Ssentongo, Keith Ainebyona

entry.summary: Presents Arapai, an offline-first AI chatbot for education that operates without internet on CPU-only devices using quantized language models with automatic hardware-aware model selection.

entry.title: Structure-aware Prompt Adaptation from Seen to Unseen for Open-Vocabulary Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Yihang Duan, Jiong Wang, Pengpeng Zeng, Ji Zhang, Lei Zhao, Chong Wang, Jingkuan Song, Lianli Gao

entry.summary: Proposes structure-aware prompt adaptation for open-vocabulary compositional zero-shot learning that generalizes to unseen attributes and objects through analogy with seen concepts.

entry.title: Fine-grained Image Aesthetic Assessment: Learning Discriminative Scores from Relative Ranks

author.name: Zhichao Yang, Jianjie Wang, Zhixianhe Zhang, Pangu Xie, Xiangfei Sheng, Pengfei Chen, Leida Li

entry.summary: Addresses fine-grained image aesthetic assessment by contributing FGAesthetics, a dataset of 32,217 images in 10,028 series with subtle aesthetic variations, and proposing a method to learn discriminative scores from relative ranks rather than absolute scores.

entry.title: Revisiting the Role of Foundation Models in Cell-Level Histopathological Image Analysis under Small-Patch Constraints -- Effects of Training Data Scale and Blur Perturbations on CNNs and Vision Transformers

author.name: Hiroki Kagiyama, Toru Nagasaka, Yukari Adachi, Takaaki Tachibana, Ryota Ito, Mitsugu Fujita, Kimihiro Yamashita, Yoshihiro Kakeji

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates CNNs, vision transformers, and foundation models for cell-level histopathological analysis using extremely small 40x40 pixel patches, finding that task-specific architectures can outperform foundation models under small-patch constraints.

entry.title: Mask-Guided Attention Regulation for Anatomically Consistent Counterfactual CXR Synthesis

author.name: Zichun Zhang, Weizhi Nie, Honglin Guo, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Presents an inference-time attention regulation framework for counterfactual chest X-ray synthesis that uses organ masks to gate attention, confining structural interactions to anatomical ROIs and preventing structural drift in diffusion-based editing.

entry.title: SSR: A Generic Framework for Text-Aided Map Compression for Localization

author.name: Mohammad Omama, Po-han Li, Harsh Goel, Minkyu Choi, Behdad Chalaki, Vaishnav Tadiparthi, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Sandeep P. Chinchali

entry.summary: Proposes SSR, a text-enhanced map compression framework that leverages text descriptions and small image feature vectors for efficient localization, using LLMs for lossless text compression to reduce memory and bandwidth costs.

entry.title: Hold-One-Shot-Out (HOSO) for Validation-Free Few-Shot CLIP Adapters

author.name: Chris Vorster, Mayug Maniparambil, Noel E. O'Connor, Noel Murphy, Derek Molloy

entry.summary: Presents Hold-One-Shot-Out (HOSO), a validation-free method for learning the blending ratio in CLIP adaptation without requiring test set ablation or additional validation sets, making few-shot CLIP adaptation truly few-shot.

entry.title: Overlapping Domain Decomposition for Distributed Pose Graph Optimization

author.name: Aneesa Sonawalla, Yulun Tian, Jonathan P. How

entry.summary: Presents ROBO, a distributed pose graph optimization approach using overlapping domain decomposition that offers a tunable trade-off between communication and convergence speed for multi-robot systems.

entry.title: Force-Aware Residual DAgger via Trajectory Editing for Precision Insertion with Impedance Control

author.name: Yiou Huang, Ma Ning, Weichu Zhao, Zinuo Liu, Jun Sun, Qiufeng Wang, Yaran Chen

entry.summary: Proposes TER-DAgger, a force-aware imitation learning framework for precision insertion that mitigates covariate shift through trajectory editing and includes a force-aware failure anticipation mechanism for triggering human intervention.

entry.title: Perception-Aware Time-Optimal Planning for Quadrotor Waypoint Flight

author.name: Chao Qin, Jiaxu Xing, Rudolf Reiter, Angel Romero, Yifan Lin, Hugh H. -T. Liu, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Introduces a time-optimal trajectory planning framework for vision-based quadrotors that jointly optimizes dynamics, actuation limits, aerodynamic effects, and perception constraints (camera FOV, visual quality) to prevent failures in closed-loop execution.

entry.title: LLM coherentization as an obvious low-hanging fruit to try?

author.name: Épiphanie Gédéon

entry.summary: Proposes 'LLM coherentization' as an alignment approach—making LLMs internally coherent by giving them consistent world models and self-models, arguing that current RL and persona-shaping creates fragmented, potentially misaligned behavior patterns.

entry.title: FocusGraph: Graph-Structured Frame Selection for Embodied Long Video Question Answering

author.name: Tatiana Zemskova, Solomon Andryushenko, Ilya Obrubov, Viktoriia Khoruzhaia, Ekaterina Eroshenko, Ekaterina Derevyanka, Dmitry Yudin

entry.summary: Develops FocusGraph, a graph-structured keyframe selection framework for embodied long video question answering that organizes video frames as graphs to help MLLMs process long videos more effectively.

entry.title: From Threat Intelligence to Firewall Rules: Semantic Relations in Hybrid AI Agent and Expert System Architectures

author.name: Chiara Bonfanti, Davide Colaiacomo, Luca Cagliero, Cataldo Basile

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic multi-agent system that leverages hypernym-hyponym semantic relations to extract information from cyber threat intelligence reports and automatically generate firewall rules via CLIPS expert systems.

entry.title: M-QUEST -- Meme Question-Understanding Evaluation on Semantics and Toxicity

author.name: Stefano De Giorgis, Ting-Chih Chen, Filip Ilievski

entry.summary: Presents M-QUEST, a framework for understanding meme meaning through multiple dimensions (textual, visual, emotional, toxic) to enable better toxicity detection. Addresses lack of unified architectures for meme interpretation.

entry.title: Ethical and Explainable AI in Reusable MLOps Pipelines

author.name: Rakib Hossain, Mahmood Menon Khan, Lisan Al Amin, Dhruv Parikh, Farhana Afroz, Bestoun S. Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces a unified MLOps framework enforcing fairness, explainability, and governance throughout the ML lifecycle, reducing demographic parity difference from 0.31 to 0.04 with automated deployment gates.

entry.title: Physics-constrained symbolic regression for discovering closed-form equations of multimodal water retention curves from experimental data

author.name: Yejin Kim, Hyoung Suk Suh

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-constrained machine learning framework using symbolic regression for automatic discovery of closed-form equations for multimodal water retention curves in porous materials.

entry.title: RADAR: Learning to Route with Asymmetry-aware DistAnce Representations

author.name: Hang Yi, Ziwei Huang, Yining Ma, Zhiguang Cao

entry.summary: Proposes RADAR, a scalable neural framework for vehicle routing problems with asymmetric distances, using SVD-based initialization for compact embeddings from asymmetric distance matrices.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Time Constants Improve Stability in Equilibrium Propagation

author.name: Yoshimasa Kubo, Suhani Pragnesh Modi, Smit Patel

entry.summary: Introduces heterogeneous time steps for equilibrium propagation by assigning neuron-specific time constants, showing improved training stability while maintaining task performance.

entry.title: Belief-Sim: Towards Belief-Driven Simulation of Demographic Misinformation Susceptibility

author.name: Angana Borah, Zohaib Khan, Rada Mihalcea, Ver\'onica P\'erez-Rosas

entry.summary: Introduces BeliefSim, a framework for simulating demographic-specific misinformation susceptibility using LLMs, constructing belief profiles from psychology-informed taxonomies and evaluating through susceptibility accuracy and counterfactual sensitivity.

entry.title: IntroductionDMD-augmented Unpaired Neural Schr\"odinger Bridge for Ultra-Low Field MRI Enhancement

author.name: Youngmin Kim, Jaeyun Shin, Jeongchan Kim, Taehoon Lee, Jaemin Kim, Peter Hsu, Jelle Veraart, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes an unpaired 64mT to 3T MRI translation framework using Unpaired Neural Schrödinger Bridge with DMD2-style diffusion-guided distribution matching and anatomical structure preservation.

entry.title: PatchDecomp: Interpretable Patch-Based Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Hiroki Tomioka, Genta Yoshimura

entry.summary: Proposes PatchDecomp, a neural network time series forecasting method that achieves both accuracy and interpretability by decomposing predictions into per-patch contributions including exogenous variables.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Mapping and Dual-Branch Reconstruction for 2D-3D Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Radia Daci, Vito Ren\`o, Cosimo Patruno, Angelo Cardellicchio, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Marco Leo, Cosimo Distante

entry.summary: Introduces CMDR-IAD, a lightweight framework for 2D+3D multimodal industrial anomaly detection combining bidirectional cross-modal mapping with dual-branch reconstruction, working in both multimodal and single-modality settings.

entry.title: GeoSeg: Training-Free Reasoning-Driven Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Lifan Jiang, Yuhang Pei, oxi Wu, Yan Zhao, Tianrun Wu, Shulong Yu, Lihui Zhang, Deng Cai

entry.summary: Presents GeoSeg, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven segmentation in remote sensing imagery using MLLMs. Features bias-aware coordinate refinement and dual-route prompting for zero-shot performance without domain-specific training data.

entry.title: SaFeR: Safety-Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving Test via Feasibility-Constrained Token Resampling

author.name: Jinlong Cui, Fenghua Liang, Guo Yang, Chengcheng Tang, Jianxun Cui

entry.summary: Proposes SaFeR for safety-critical autonomous driving scenario generation that balances adversarial criticality, physical feasibility, and behavioral realism using Transformer-based token prediction with feasibility-constrained resampling.

entry.title: Causality Elicitation from Large Language Models

author.name: Takashi Kameyama, Masahiro Kato, Yasuko Hio, Yasushi Takano, Naoto Minakawa

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline to elicit causal relationships from LLMs by sampling documents, extracting events, and applying causal discovery methods. Provides a framework for presenting causal hypotheses that LLMs can plausibly assume.

entry.title: SPRINT: Semi-supervised Prototypical Representation for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Tabular Learning

author.name: Umid Suleymanov, Murat Kantarcioglu, Kevin S Chan, Michael De Lucia, Kevin Hamlen, Latifur Khan, Sharad Mehrotra, Ananthram Swami, Bhavani Thuraisingham

entry.summary: Introduces SPRINT, the first few-shot class-incremental learning framework for tabular data, using semi-supervised prototypical representations with confidence-based pseudo-labeling to leverage abundant unlabeled data in streaming settings.

entry.title: SpotIt+: Verification-based Text-to-SQL Evaluation with Database Constraints

author.name: Rocky Klopfenstein, Yang He, Andrew Tremante, Yuepeng Wang, Nina Narodytska, Haoze Wu

entry.summary: Presents SpotIt+, an open-source tool for evaluating Text-to-SQL systems via bounded equivalence verification. Introduces constraint-mining with LLM validation to generate realistic differentiating database instances.

entry.title: Large-Margin Hyperdimensional Computing: A Learning-Theoretical Perspective

author.name: Nikita Zeulin, Olga Galinina, Ravikumar Balakrishnan, Nageen Himayat, Sergey Andreev

entry.summary: Proposes a maximum-margin hyperdimensional computing classifier by establishing a formal connection between HDC and SVMs. Shows significant improvements over baseline HDC methods on benchmarks.

entry.title: When to restart? Exploring escalating restarts on convergence

author.name: Ayush K. Varshney, \v{S}ar\=unas Girdzijauskas, Konstantinos Vandikas, Aneta Vulgarakis Feljan

entry.summary: Proposes SGD with Escalating Restarts (SGD-ER), an adaptive learning rate scheduler that monitors convergence and triggers restarts with linearly escalating learning rates to escape sharp minima.

entry.title: Nearest-Neighbor Density Estimation for Dependency Suppression

author.name: Kathleen Anderson, Thomas Martinetz

entry.summary: Proposes an encoder-based approach for removing unwanted dependencies from data using nearest-neighbor density estimation. Combines a specialized VAE with a non-parametric loss function for direct independence optimization.

entry.title: Machine Pareidolia: Protecting Facial Image with Emotional Editing

author.name: Binh M. Le, Simon S. Woo

entry.summary: Introduces MAP, a facial privacy protection method that uses emotion modifications to disguise identities in facial images by fine-tuning a score network for dual objectives of target identity and expression.

entry.title: Exploiting Subgradient Sparsity in Max-Plus Neural Networks

author.name: Ikhlas Enaieh (LTCI, S2A), Olivier Fercoq (S2A, LTCI)

entry.summary: Exploits the natural subgradient sparsity in Max-Plus neural networks (using max and sum instead of add and multiply) to develop more efficient training algorithms that avoid unnecessary computations.

entry.title: Turning Trust to Transactions: Tracking Affiliate Marketing and FTC Compliance in YouTube's Influencer Economy

author.name: Chen Sun, Yash Vekaria, Zubair Shafiq, Rishab Nithyanand

entry.summary: Introduces tools to examine affiliate marketing on YouTube at scale, analyzing 2 million videos over 10 years for FTC compliance. Uses NLP and web measurement techniques to track disclosure practices and consumer harm.

entry.title: A Neural Topic Method Using a Large-Language-Model-in-the-Loop for Business Research

author.name: Stephan Ludwig, Peter J. Danaher, Xiaohao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces LX Topic, a neural topic method that uses an LLM-in-the-loop to produce calibrated, interpretable topics for business research. Conceptualizes topics as latent linguistic constructs.

entry.title: Coupling Local Context and Global Semantic Prototypes via a Hierarchical Architecture for Rhetorical Roles Labeling

author.name: Anas Belfathi, Nicolas Hernandez, Laura Monceaux, Warren Bonnard, Mary Catherine Lavissiere, Christine Jacquin, Richard Dufour

entry.summary: Proposes prototype-based methods for Rhetorical Role Labeling that integrate local context with global corpus-level representations. Introduces SCOTUS-Law, the first RRL dataset from US Supreme Court opinions.

entry.title: An Effective Data Augmentation Method by Asking Questions about Scene Text Images

author.name: Xu Yao, Lei Kang

entry.summary: Proposes a VQA-inspired data augmentation framework for scene text and handwriting recognition, generating character-level questions about text attributes to encourage finer-grained visual reasoning during OCR training.

entry.title: All-in-One Image Restoration via Causal-Deconfounding Wavelet-Disentangled Prompt Network

author.name: Bingnan Wang, Bin Qin, Jiangmeng Li, Fanjiang Xu, Fuchun Sun, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes a wavelet-disentangled prompt network for all-in-one image restoration that uses causal analysis to address spurious correlations between semantic features and degradation patterns. The method disentangles frequency components via wavelets and applies causal deconfounding to improve generalization across degradation types.

entry.title: A Hypertoroidal Covering for Perfect Color Equivariance

author.name: Yulong Yang, Zhikun Xu, Yaojun Li, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Introduces a hypertoroidal covering approach for achieving truly perfect color equivariance in neural networks, addressing artifacts from previous approximations of saturation and luminance as 1D translations.

entry.title: A multi-center analysis of deep learning methods for video polyp detection and segmentation

author.name: Noha Ghatwary, Pedro Chavarias Solano, Mohamed Ramzy Ibrahim, Adrian Krenzer, Frank Puppe, Stefano Realdon, Renato Cannizzaro, Jiacheng Wang, Liansheng Wang, Thuy Nuong Tran, Lena Maier-Hein, Amine Yamlahi, Patrick Godau, Quan He, Qiming Wan, Mariia Kokshaikyna, Mariia Dobko, Haili Ye, Heng Li, Ragu B, Antony Raj, Hanaa Nagdy, Osama E Salem, James E. East, Dominique Lamarque, Thomas de Lange, Sharib Ali

entry.summary: Multi-center analysis benchmarking deep learning methods for video polyp detection and segmentation across diverse clinical datasets, evaluating generalization and practical deployment considerations.

entry.title: Deep Sketch-Based 3D Modeling: A Survey

author.name: Alberto Tono, Jiajun Wu, Gordon Wetzstein, Iro Armeni, Hariharan Subramonyam, James Landay, Martin Fischer

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of deep sketch-based 3D modeling (DS-3DM), introducing the MORPHEUS design space framework that categorizes methods along input types, model architectures, and 3D output representations.

entry.title: Impact of Localization Errors on Label Quality for Online HD Map Construction

author.name: Alexander Blumberg, Jonas Merkert, Richard Fehler, Fabian Immel, Frank Bieder, Jan-Hendrik Pauls, Christoph Stiller

entry.summary: Studies the impact of localization errors on training data quality for online HD map construction, introducing three noise models (Ramp, Gaussian, Perlin) and evaluating their effects on a state-of-the-art map construction model.

entry.title: Sampling-Based Motion Planning with Scene Graphs Under Perception Constraints

author.name: Qingxi Meng, Emiliano Flores, Thai Duong, Vaibhav Unhelkar, Lydia E. Kavraki

entry.summary: Addresses perception-aware motion planning for high-DoF robots using scene graphs to maintain multi-object monitoring constraints while navigating cluttered human environments.

entry.title: MistyPilot: An Agentic Fast-Slow Thinking LLM Framework for Misty Social Robots

author.name: Xiao Wang, Lu Dong, Jingchen Sun, Ifeoma Nwogu, Srirangaraj Setlur, Venu Govindaraju

entry.summary: Introduces MistyPilot, an agentic LLM framework for social robots combining a Physically Interactive Agent for sensor-driven tasks with a Socially Intelligent Agent for emotionally aligned dialogue, using fast-slow thinking principles.

entry.title: Lightweight Visual Reasoning for Socially-Aware Robots

author.name: Alessio Galatolo, Ronald Cumbal, Alexandros Rouchitsas, Katie Winkle, Didem G\"urd\"ur Broo, Ginevra Castellano

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight language-to-vision feedback module for VLMs that enables a second vision encoder pass with language-guided attention, improving social scene understanding for robots operating around humans.

entry.title: RoboLight: A Dataset with Linearly Composable Illumination for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Shutong Jin, Jin Yang, Muhammad Zahid, Florian T. Pokorny

entry.summary: Introduces RoboLight, the first robotic manipulation dataset with systematically varied lighting conditions using a calibrated LED setup, enabling study of how illumination affects manipulation policies. Includes HDR recordings and linearly composable lighting for data augmentation.

entry.title: Make Powerful Machines Verifiable

author.name: Naci Cankaya

entry.summary: Argues that powerful machines (AI systems, corporations, governments) should be subject to verification mechanisms that can check properties without revealing secrets, using zero-knowledge proof concepts. Proposes that refusal of such verification is itself evidence of wrongdoing.

entry.title: PRAM-R: A Perception-Reasoning-Action-Memory Framework with LLM-Guided Modality Routing for Adaptive Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yi Zhang, Xian Zhang, Saisi Zhao, Yinglei Song, Chengdong Wu, Nenad Petrovic, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Proposes PRAM-R, an autonomous driving framework with LLM-guided modality routing using an asynchronous dual-loop design. A fast reactive loop handles perception/control while a slow deliberative loop manages modality selection via an LLM router.

entry.title: VANGUARD: Vehicle-Anchored Ground Sample Distance Estimation for UAVs in GPS-Denied Environments

author.name: Yifei Chen, Xupeng Chen, Feng Wang, Niangang Jiao, Jiayin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes VANGUARD for estimating Ground Sample Distance from UAV imagery in GPS-denied environments using detected vehicles as reference objects. Shows state-of-the-art VLMs suffer >50% error in spatial scale estimation.

entry.title: Robust Unscented Kalman Filtering via Recurrent Meta-Adaptation of Sigma-Point Weights

author.name: Kenan Majewski, Micha{\l} Modzelewski, Marcin \.Zugaj, Piotr Lichota

entry.summary: Introduces Meta-Adaptive UKF that uses a recurrent context encoder to dynamically adapt sigma-point weights based on measurement innovation history, replacing static parameterization of the Unscented Transform.

entry.title: SimpliHuMoN: Simplifying Human Motion Prediction

author.name: Aadya Agrawal, Alexander Schwing

entry.summary: Proposes SimpliHuMoN, a simple transformer-based model for human motion prediction that handles pose-only, trajectory-only, and combined prediction with a single architecture using self-attention modules.

entry.title: UniSync: Towards Generalizable and High-Fidelity Lip Synchronization for Challenging Scenarios

author.name: Ruidi Fan, Yang Zhou, Siyuan Wang, Tian Yu, Yutong Jiang, Xusheng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces UniSync, a unified lip synchronization framework handling diverse real-world scenarios including stylized avatars, face occlusion, and extreme lighting. Uses mask-free pose-anchored training to avoid color artifacts while maintaining background consistency.

entry.title: Bielik-Q2-Sharp: A Comparative Study of Extreme 2-bit Quantization Methods for a Polish 11B Language Model

author.name: Jakub Prejzner

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates six extreme 2-bit quantization methods on a Polish 11B language model (Bielik). Best variant (QuIP# E8P12) achieves near-baseline performance at 3.26GB, representing the first academic study of extreme quantization for a Polish LLM.

entry.title: RANGER: Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Retrieval Re-ranking for Pathology Report Generation

author.name: Yixin Chen, Ziyu Su, Hikmat Khan, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Proposes RANGER, a sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Experts framework with adaptive retrieval re-ranking for pathology report generation from whole slide images. Addresses limitations of homogeneous decoders and static knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: Algorithmic Compliance and Regulatory Loss in Digital Assets

author.name: Khem Raj Bhatt, Krishna Sharma

entry.summary: Shows that static ML-based AML enforcement systems for cryptocurrency substantially overstate real-world effectiveness due to temporal nonstationarity. The failure arises from miscalibrated decision rules rather than declining accuracy.

entry.title: N-gram Injection into Transformers for Dynamic Language Model Adaptation in Handwritten Text Recognition

author.name: Florent Meyer, Laurent Guichard, Denis Coquenet, Guillaume Gravier, Yann Soullard, Bertrand Co\"uasnon

entry.summary: Proposes n-gram injection (NGI) for dynamically adapting transformer-based handwritten text recognition models at inference time when the target corpus has a different language distribution than training data. Avoids retraining by switching to an external n-gram language model.

entry.title: A Baseline Study and Benchmark for Few-Shot Open-Set Action Recognition with Feature Residual Discrimination

author.name: Stefano Berti, Giulia Pasquale, Lorenzo Natale

entry.summary: Proposes Feature-Residual Discriminator (FR-Disc) for few-shot open-set action recognition in video, extending previous skeletal-data approaches to the more complex video domain with benchmarks on five datasets.

entry.title: Radar-based Pose Optimization for HD Map Generation from Noisy Multi-Drive Vehicle Fleet Data

author.name: Alexander Blumberg, Jonas Merkert, Christoph Stiller

entry.summary: Proposes radar-based pose optimization for HD map generation using fleet vehicle data, aligning radar point clouds across drives via pose graph optimization to produce globally consistent maps.

entry.title: Generative AI in Managerial Decision-Making: Redefining Boundaries through Ambiguity Resolution and Sycophancy Analysis

author.name: Sule Ozturk Birim, Fabrizio Marozzo, Yigit Kazancoglu

entry.summary: Compares various LLMs on ambiguity detection in business contexts, evaluates how systematic resolution processes enhance response quality, and investigates sycophantic behavior when models are presented with flawed directives.

entry.title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic AI for WebGIS Development

author.name: Boyuan (Keven), Guan, Wencong Cui, Levente Juhasz

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-helix governance framework for reliable agentic AI in WebGIS development, reframing five common LLM limitations as structural governance problems. Implements a 3-track architecture with knowledge graph substrate.

entry.title: Token-Oriented Object Notation vs JSON: A Benchmark of Plain and Constrained Decoding Generation

author.name: Ivan Matveev

entry.summary: Benchmarks Token-Oriented Object Notation (TOON) against JSON for LLM generation, testing plain and constrained decoding approaches. Evaluates whether the reduced token usage of TOON offsets the prompt overhead of teaching the format.

entry.title: TopicENA: Enabling Epistemic Network Analysis at Scale through Automated Topic-Based Coding

author.name: Owen H. T. Lu, Tiffany T. Y. Hsu

entry.summary: Introduces TopicENA, a framework merging BERTopic with Epistemic Network Analysis to enable automated topic-based coding at scale, replacing manual expert coding while maintaining structural association modeling.

entry.title: GreenPhase: A Green Learning Approach for Earthquake Phase Picking

author.name: Yixing Wu, Shiou-Ya Wang, Dingyi Nie, Sanket Kumbhar, Yun-Tung Hsieh, Yun-Cheng Wang, Po-Chyi Su, C. -C. Jay Kuo

entry.summary: Proposes GreenPhase, a multi-resolution feed-forward model for earthquake phase picking based on Green Learning that eliminates backpropagation, enabling interpretable and energy-efficient seismic analysis.

entry.title: PRIVATEEDIT: A Privacy-Preserving Pipeline for Face-Centric Generative Image Editing

author.name: Dipesh Tamboli, Vineet Punyamoorty, Atharv Pawar, Vaneet Aggarwal

entry.summary: Proposes PRIVATEEDIT, a pipeline for face-centric image editing that preserves biometric privacy by separating identity-sensitive regions from editable context using on-device segmentation. The approach works with third-party generative models without modification.

entry.title: Social Norm Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models: An Evaluation

author.name: Oishik Chowdhury, Anushka Debnath, Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs on social norm reasoning tasks, assessing their ability to identify and reason about norms in complex social situations embodied in text and images for multi-agent systems.

entry.title: Understanding Parents' Desires in Moderating Children's Interactions with GenAI Chatbots through LLM-Generated Probes

author.name: John Driscoll, Yulin Chen, Viki Shi, Izak Vucharatavintara, Yaxing Yao, Haojian Jin

entry.summary: Studies how parents want to moderate children's interactions with GenAI chatbots, using LLM-generated synthetic scenarios validated by parents. Reveals parental concerns about emotional manipulation, inappropriate content, and desire for customizable controls.

entry.title: Not All Candidates are Created Equal: A Heterogeneity-Aware Approach to Pre-ranking in Recommender Systems

author.name: Pengfei Tong, Siyuan Chen, Chenwei Zhang, Bo Wang, Qi Pi, Pixun Li, Zuotao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a heterogeneity-aware pre-ranking approach for recommender systems that addresses gradient conflicts from mixing heterogeneous training samples by adaptively scaling model complexity per sample difficulty.

entry.title: Joint Hardware-Workload Co-Optimization for In-Memory Computing Accelerators

author.name: Olga Krestinskaya, Mohammed E. Fouda, Ahmed Eltawil, Khaled N. Salama

entry.summary: Presents a joint hardware-workload co-optimization framework for in-memory computing accelerators that supports multiple neural network workloads, using evolutionary algorithms to find generalized hardware designs.

entry.title: Selecting Offline Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for Stochastic Network Control

author.name: Nicolas Helson, Pegah Alizadeh, Anastasios Giovanidis

entry.summary: Evaluates offline RL algorithms (CQL, Decision Transformers, hybrid) in genuinely stochastic wireless network control, finding Conservative Q-Learning produces more robust policies under stochastic dynamics.

entry.title: RVN-Bench: A Benchmark for Reactive Visual Navigation

author.name: Jaewon Lee, Jaeseok Heo, Gunmin Lee, Howoong Jun, Jeongwoo Oh, Songhwai Oh

entry.summary: Introduces RVN-Bench, a collision-aware benchmark for indoor visual navigation using Habitat 2.0 and HM3D scenes. Agents must navigate to goals using only visual observations without prior maps while avoiding collisions. Fills a gap in indoor navigation benchmarking where collisions are often neglected.

entry.title: End-to-end event reconstruction for precision physics at future colliders

author.name: Dolores Garcia, Lena Herrmann, Gregor Krzmanc, Michele Selvaggi

entry.summary: Presents end-to-end event reconstruction for particle physics using geometric algebra transformers with object condensation-based clustering. Maps detector hits directly to particle-level objects for future collider experiments.

entry.title: GarmentPile++: Affordance-Driven Cluttered Garments Retrieval with Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Mingleyang Li, Yuran Wang, Yue Chen, Tianxing Chen, Jiaqi Liang, Zishun Shen, Haoran Lu, Ruihai Wu, Hao Dong

entry.summary: Proposes GarmentPile++ for retrieving individual garments from piles using vision-language reasoning and visual affordance perception. Integrates high-level LLM reasoning with low-level manipulation for safe single-garment retrieval.

entry.title: Noise-aware Client Selection for carbon-efficient Federated Learning via Gradient Norm Thresholding

author.name: Patrick Wilhelm, Inese Yilmaz, Odej Kao

entry.summary: Proposes noise-aware client selection for carbon-efficient federated learning using gradient norm thresholding. Addresses data quality challenges in privacy-preserving distributed training while optimizing for renewable energy usage.

entry.title: Hybrid Belief Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coordinated Spatial Exploration

author.name: Danish Rizvi, David Boyle

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid belief-reinforcement learning framework combining Log-Gaussian Cox Process spatial beliefs with deep RL for multi-agent spatial exploration. The two-phase approach first builds spatial beliefs via information-driven planning, then transitions to policy learning.

entry.title: mlx-vis: GPU-Accelerated Dimensionality Reduction and Visualization on Apple Silicon

author.name: Han Xiao

entry.summary: Implements six dimensionality reduction methods (UMAP, t-SNE, PaCMAP, etc.) entirely on Apple Silicon GPUs via MLX framework. Achieves 2-4 second embeddings for 70K points with GPU-accelerated rendering.

entry.title: InstMeter: An Instruction-Level Method to Predict Energy and Latency of DL Model Inference on MCUs

author.name: Hao Liu, Qing Wang, Marco Zuniga

entry.summary: Proposes InstMeter, a predictor using MCU clock cycles to accurately estimate energy and latency of DL model inference on microcontrollers, improving over coarse proxies like MACs.

entry.title: Geographically-Weighted Weakly Supervised Bayesian High-Resolution Transformer for 200m Resolution Pan-Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Mapping and Uncertainty Estimation using Sentinel-1, RCM, and AMSR2 Data

author.name: Mabel Heffring, Lincoln Linlin Xu

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian Transformer for 200m resolution pan-Arctic sea ice concentration mapping using multi-sensor satellite data, with geographically-weighted weak supervision and uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: FastWave: Optimized Diffusion Model for Audio Super-Resolution

author.name: Nikita Kuznetsov, Maksim Kaledin

entry.summary: Proposes FastWave, a lightweight diffusion model for audio super-resolution to 48kHz that leverages recent training advances to achieve comparable results to SOTA with lower computational costs.

entry.title: Scalable Evaluation of the Realism of Synthetic Environmental Augmentations in Images

author.name: Damian J. Ruck, Paul Vautravers, Oliver Chalkley, Jake Thomas

entry.summary: Presents a scalable framework for evaluating the realism of synthetic environmental augmentations (fog, rain, snow, nighttime) in images, comparing rule-based augmentation with generative AI editing models using human evaluation and automated metrics.

entry.title: A Constrained RL Approach for Cost-Efficient Delivery of Latency-Sensitive Applications

author.name: Ozan Ayg\"un, Vincenzo Norman Vitale, Antonia M. Tulino, Hao Feng, Elza Erkip, Jaime Llorca

entry.summary: Formulates minimum-cost delay-constrained network control as a constrained MDP and applies constrained deep RL to enforce strict per-packet delay requirements while minimizing resource costs for next-generation networks.

entry.title: Retcon -- a Prompt-Based Technique for Precise Control of LLMs in Conversations

author.name: David Kogan, Sam Nguyen, Masanori Suzuki, Feiyang Chen

entry.summary: Presents Retcon, a few-shot prompting technique for turn-level control over LLMs in multi-turn conversations, demonstrating significantly better performance than zero-shot and traditional few-shot prompting.

entry.title: Hindsight Quality Prediction Experiments in Multi-Candidate Human-Post-Edited Machine Translation

author.name: Malik Marmonier, Beno\^it Sagot, Rachel Bawden

entry.summary: Studies MT quality prediction through hindsight experiments on a multi-candidate dataset with 6,000+ segments and 9 translation hypotheses per segment, examining the impact of LLMs on quality estimation paradigms.

entry.title: mHC-HSI: Clustering-Guided Hyper-Connection Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Yimin Zhu, Zack Dewis, Quinn Ledingham, Saeid Taleghanidoozdoozan, Mabel Heffring, Zhengsen Xu, Motasem Alkayid, Megan Greenwood, Lincoln Linlin Xu

entry.summary: Applies DeepSeek's manifold-constrained hyper-connection approach to hyperspectral image classification with a clustering-guided Mamba module for enhanced spatial-spectral feature learning.

entry.title: Glass Segmentation with Fusion of Learned and General Visual Features

author.name: Risto Ojala, Tristan Ellison, Mo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-backbone architecture for glass segmentation using frozen DINOv3 for general features and trained Swin for task-specific features, fused via Squeeze-and-Excitation modules.

entry.title: QD-PCQA: Quality-Aware Domain Adaptation for Point Cloud Quality Assessment

author.name: Guohua Zhang, Jian Jin, Meiqin Liu, Chao Yao, Weisi Lin

entry.summary: Proposes QD-PCQA for no-reference point cloud quality assessment using unsupervised domain adaptation from labeled images, with quality-aware feature alignment and sensitivity to quality ranking.

entry.title: Yolo-Key-6D: Single Stage Monocular 6D Pose Estimation with Keypoint Enhancements

author.name: Kemal Alperen \c{C}etiner, Haz{\i}m Kemal Ekenel

entry.summary: Presents Yolo-Key-6D, a single-stage end-to-end framework for monocular 6D pose estimation built on YOLO architecture with auxiliary keypoint regression of 3D bounding box corners. Targets real-time applications in robotics and AR/VR.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Patch Annotation for Improved Screening of Diabetic Retinopathy

author.name: Shramana Dey, Abhirup Banerjee, B. Uma Shankar, Ramachandran Rajalakshmi, Sushmita Mitra

entry.summary: Introduces SAFE, a two-stage framework for weakly supervised lesion annotation in diabetic retinopathy screening that combines weak supervision, contrastive learning, and clustering to systematically annotate unlabeled lesion regions.

entry.title: TextBoost: Boosting Scene Text Fidelity in Ultra-low Bitrate Image Compression

author.name: Bingxin Wang, Yuan Lan, Zhaoyi Sun, Yang Xiang, Jie Sun

entry.summary: Introduces TextBoost for ultra-low bitrate image compression that preserves scene text by incorporating OCR-extracted textual information as decoder guidance, avoiding the quality trade-offs of ROI-based approaches.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Joint Detection of Lacunes and Enlarged Perivascular Spaces

author.name: Lucas He, Krinos Li, Hanyuan Zhang, Runlong He, Silvia Ingala, Luigi Lorenzini, Marleen de Bruijne, Frederik Barkhof, Rhodri Davies, Carole Sudre

entry.summary: Proposes a morphology-decoupled framework for joint detection of lacunes and enlarged perivascular spaces in brain MRI, using gated cross-task attention and mixed supervision to handle their radiological similarity and extreme class imbalance.

entry.title: Stringology-Based Motif Discovery from EEG Signals: an ADHD Case Study

author.name: Anat Dahan, Samah Ghazawi

entry.summary: Proposes a stringology-based framework for analyzing EEG time series using order-preserving and Cartesian tree matching to detect temporal motifs, demonstrated as a proof-of-concept for ADHD classification.

entry.title: TreeLoc++: Robust 6-DoF LiDAR Localization in Forests with a Compact Digital Forest Inventory

author.name: Minwoo Jung, Dongjae Lee, Nived Chebrolu, Haedam Oh, Maurice Fallon, Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TreeLoc++, a global localization framework for forests operating directly on compact Digital Forest Inventories rather than raw point clouds, dramatically reducing storage requirements while improving localization reliability.

entry.title: HE-VPR: Height Estimation Enabled Aerial Visual Place Recognition Against Scale Variance

author.name: Mengfan He, Xingyu Shao, Chunyu Li, Chao Chen, Liangzheng Sun, Ziyang Meng, Yuanqing Wu

entry.summary: Proposes HE-VPR, a visual place recognition framework for aerial imagery that incorporates height estimation to partition the search database, using lightweight adapters on a frozen DINOv2 backbone to handle scale variance.

entry.title: AMP2026: A Multi-Platform Marine Robotics Dataset for Tracking and Mapping

author.name: Edwin Meriaux, Shuo Wen, David Widhalm, Zhizun Wang, Junming Shi, Mariana Sosa Guzm\'an, Kalvik Jakkala, Bennett Carley, Elias Sokolova, Yogesh Girdhar, Monika Roznere, Jason O'Kane, Junaed Sattar, Gregory Dudek

entry.summary: Introduces AMP2026, a multi-platform marine robotics dataset with synchronized data from aerial drones, boat-mounted cameras, and submerged robots for tracking and mapping research in challenging marine environments.

entry.title: A summary of Condensation and its relation to Natural Latents

author.name: Jeremy Gillen

entry.summary: Summarizes Sam Eisenstat's 'Condensation' theory of concepts and relates it to the Natural Latents framework, exploring when concepts can be objective across different agents and how latent variable models can capture this.

entry.title: Degradation-based augmented training for robust individual animal re-identification

author.name: Thanos Polychronou, Luk\'a\v{s} Adam, Viktor Penchev, Kostas Papafitsoros

entry.summary: Shows that degradation-aware data augmentation during training significantly improves robustness of wildlife re-identification models, which typically fail when discriminative features are obscured by real-world image degradations.

entry.title: Right in Time: Reactive Reasoning in Regulated Traffic Spaces

author.name: Simon Kohaut, Benedict Flade, Julian Eggert, Kristian Kersting, Devendra Singh Dhami

entry.summary: Proposes a reactive mission design framework combining probabilistic first-order logic with reactive circuits for online, exact probabilistic inference in autonomous traffic regulation. Enables real-time reasoning about uncertain environments and traffic rules.

entry.title: DQE-CIR: Distinctive Query Embeddings through Learnable Attribute Weights and Target Relative Negative Sampling in Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Geon Park, Ji-Hoon Park, Seong-Whan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes DQE-CIR for composed image retrieval that addresses relevance suppression and semantic confusion in contrastive learning through learnable attribute weights and target-relative negative sampling.

entry.title: CAM-LDS: Cyber Attack Manifestations for Automatic Interpretation of System Logs and Security Alerts

author.name: Max Landauer, Wolfgang Hotwagner, Thorina Boenke, Florian Skopik, Markus Wurzenberger

entry.summary: Introduces CAM-LDS, using LLMs for domain-agnostic interpretation of system logs and security alerts for intrusion detection. Addresses the limitation of conventional methods requiring expert-defined rules and manual configuration.

entry.title: Activation Outliers in Transformer Quantization: Reproduction, Statistical Analysis, and Deployment Tradeoffs

author.name: Pranav Kumar Kaliaperumal

entry.summary: Provides a reproducible empirical study of activation outliers in BERT quantization, showing validation accuracy drops from 89.66% to 54.33% with W8A8 quantization. Analyzes heavy-tailed activation distributions and proposes deployment tradeoffs.

entry.title: LeafInst - Unified Instance Segmentation Network for Fine-Grained Forestry Leaf Phenotype Analysis: A New UAV based Benchmark

author.name: Taige Luo, Junru Xie, Chenyang Fan, Bingrong Liu, Ruisheng Wang, Yang Shao, Sheng Xu, Lin Cao

entry.summary: Introduces LeafInst for forestry leaf instance segmentation from UAV imagery, with the Poplar-leaf dataset of 19,876 annotated leaf instances - the first such dataset for forestry leaves in open-field conditions.

entry.title: Small Object Detection in Complex Backgrounds with Multi-Scale Attention and Global Relation Modeling

author.name: Wenguang Tao, Xiaotian Wang, Tian Yan, Yi Wang, Jie Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-level feature enhancement framework for small object detection using Residual Haar Wavelet Downsampling to preserve fine-grained details and global relation modeling.

entry.title: UniRain: Unified Image Deraining with RAG-based Dataset Distillation and Multi-objective Reweighted Optimization

author.name: Qianfeng Yang, Qiyuan Guan, Xiang Chen, Jiyu Jin, Guiyue Jin, Jiangxin Dong

entry.summary: Proposes UniRain, a unified image deraining framework using RAG-based dataset distillation to select high-quality training samples and multi-objective reweighted optimization. Handles rain streaks and raindrops under both daytime and nighttime conditions.

entry.title: Motion Manipulation via Unsupervised Keypoint Positioning in Face Animation

author.name: Hong Li, Boyu Liu, Xuhui Liu, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Presents MMFA for controllable face animation via unsupervised keypoint positioning, using self-supervised representation learning to decouple identity, rotation, translation, and expression in the latent space.

entry.title: Empirical Evaluation of No Free Lunch Violations in Permutation-Based Optimization

author.name: Grzegorz Sroka

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates No Free Lunch theorem violations in permutation-based optimization, constructing benchmarks that reveal when NFL averaging fails to reflect actual algorithm performance rankings.

entry.title: Lyapunov Stability of Stochastic Vector Optimization: Theory and Numerical Implementation

author.name: Thiago Santos, Sebastiao Xavier

entry.summary: Provides Lyapunov stability analysis for a drift-diffusion model used in multi-objective optimization, proving global existence, pathwise uniqueness, and positive recurrence, with an Euler-Maruyama implementation.

entry.title: Navigating in Uncertain Environments with Heterogeneous Visibility

author.name: Jongann Lee, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Proposes a navigation algorithm for uncertain environments with heterogeneous visibility, balancing traversal cost against information gain from visiting high-visibility vantage points to resolve map ambiguities.

entry.title: Gaussian Mixture-Based Inverse Perception Contract for Uncertainty-Aware Robot Navigation

author.name: Bingyao Du, Joonkyung Kim, Yiwei Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes GM-IPC, a Gaussian Mixture-based Inverse Perception Contract that maps perception uncertainty into multi-modal sets for safer robot navigation, overcoming limitations of single-ellipsoid uncertainty representations that lead to over-conservative behavior.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Conversational AI for Agricultural Advisory

author.name: Sanyam Singh, Naga Ganesh, Vineet Singh, Lakshmi Pedapudi, Ritesh Kumar, SSP Jyothi, Archana Karanam, C. Yashoda, Mettu Vijaya Rekha Reddy, Shesha Phani Debbesa, Chandan Dash

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid LLM architecture for agricultural advisory that decouples factual retrieval from conversational delivery, using LoRA fine-tuning on expert-curated atomic agricultural knowledge units.

entry.title: A benchmark for joint dialogue satisfaction, emotion recognition, and emotion state transition prediction

author.name: Jing Bian, Haoxiang Su, Liting Jiang, Di Wu, Ruiyu Fang, Xiaomeng Huang, Yanbing Li, Shuangyong Song, Hao Huang

entry.summary: Constructs a multi-task, multi-label Chinese dialogue dataset supporting satisfaction recognition, emotion recognition, and emotional state transition prediction across multi-turn dialogues.

entry.title: Role-Aware Conditional Inference for Spatiotemporal Ecosystem Carbon Flux Prediction

author.name: Yiming Sun, Runlong Yu, Rongchao Dong, Shuo Chen, Licheng Liu, Youmi Oh, Qianlai Zhuang, Yiqun Xie, Xiaowei Jia

entry.summary: Proposes RACI, a process-informed learning framework for carbon flux prediction that separates slowly-varying regime conditions from high-frequency dynamic forcings, improving generalization across heterogeneous ecosystems.

entry.title: Interaction-Aware Whole-Body Control for Compliant Object Transport

author.name: Hao Zhang, Yves Tseng, Ding Zhao, H. Eric Tseng

entry.summary: Proposes interaction-oriented whole-body control for assistive humanoids performing cooperative object transport, separating upper-body interaction from lower-body support control.

entry.title: DisenReason: Behavior Disentanglement and Latent Reasoning for Shared-Account Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Jiawei Cheng, Min Gao, Zongwei Wang, Xiaofei Zhu, Zhiyi Liu, Wentao Li, Wei Li, Huan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DisenReason for shared-account sequential recommendation that disentangles behaviors from multiple users sharing one account using latent reasoning to infer the number and preferences of underlying users.

entry.title: TFWaveFormer: Temporal-Frequency Collaborative Multi-level Wavelet Transformer for Dynamic Link Prediction

author.name: Hantong Feng, Yonggang Wu, Duxin Chen, Wenwu Yu

entry.summary: Introduces TFWaveFormer, a Transformer architecture combining temporal-frequency analysis with wavelet decomposition for dynamic link prediction in temporal graphs. Aims to capture multi-scale temporal dynamics in social networks, communication, and finance.

entry.title: Sim2Sea: Sim-to-Real Policy Transfer for Maritime Vessel Navigation in Congested Waters

author.name: Xinyu Cui, Xuanfa Jin, Xue Yan, Yongcheng Zeng, Luoyang Sun, Siying Wei, Ruizhi Zhang, Jian Zhao, Haifeng Zhang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Sim2Sea, a framework for sim-to-real transfer of autonomous maritime vessel navigation in congested waters, including a GPU-accelerated simulator and domain adaptation strategies.

entry.title: ZeSTA: Zero-Shot TTS Augmentation with Domain-Conditioned Training for Data-Efficient Personalized Speech Synthesis

author.name: Youngwon Choi, Jinwoo Oh, Hwayeon Kim, Hyeonyu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ZeSTA, a domain-conditioned training framework for low-resource personalized speech synthesis that distinguishes real vs synthetic speech via lightweight domain embeddings, combined with real-data oversampling.

entry.title: CRESTomics: Analyzing Carotid Plaques in the CREST-2 Trial with a New Additive Classification Model

author.name: Pranav Kulkarni, Brajesh K. Lal, Georges Jreij, Sai Vallamchetla, Langford Green, Jenifer Voeks, John Huston, Lloyd Edwards, George Howard, Bradley A. Maron, Thomas G. Brott, James F. Meschia, Florence X. Doo, Heng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CRESTomics, a kernel-based additive classification model for carotid plaque characterization from B-mode ultrasound in the CREST-2 clinical trial. Combines coherence loss with group-sparse regularization for interpretable risk assessment.

entry.title: Fixed-Budget Constrained Best Arm Identification in Grouped Bandits

author.name: Raunak Mukherjee (Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay), Sharayu Moharir (Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay)

entry.summary: Studies fixed-budget best-arm identification in grouped bandits with feasibility constraints. Proposes FCSR algorithm that identifies the best feasible arm while maintaining optimal dependence on problem parameters.

entry.title: Linguistically Informed Graph Model and Semantic Contrastive Learning for Korean Short Text Classification

author.name: JaeGeon Yoo, Byoungwook Kim, Yeongwook Yang, Hong-Jun Jang

entry.summary: Proposes LIGRAM, a hierarchical heterogeneous graph model for Korean short-text classification that incorporates morpheme, POS, and named-entity sub-graphs tailored to Korean's agglutinative structure.

entry.title: DM-CFO: A Diffusion Model for Compositional 3D Tooth Generation with Collision-Free Optimization

author.name: Yan Tian, Pengcheng Xue, Weiping Ding, Mahmoud Hassaballah, Karen Egiazarian, Aura Conci, Abdulkadir Sengur, Leszek Rutkowski

entry.summary: Proposes DM-CFO for compositional 3D tooth generation using diffusion models with collision-free optimization, addressing layout and shape optimization for missing teeth in dental digitization.

entry.title: Architecture and evaluation protocol for transformer-based visual object tracking in UAV applications

author.name: Augustin Borne (ISL, Hochschule Karlsruhe -- Technik und Wirtschaft Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences, IRIMAS), Pierre Notin (ISL), Christophe Hennequin (ISL), Sebastien Changey (ISL), Stephane Bazeille (IRIMAS), Christophe Cudel (IRIMAS), Franz Quint

entry.summary: Proposes MATA, a modular tracking architecture for UAVs combining transformer-based tracking with Extended Kalman Filter and ego-motion compensation. Introduces a new metric (NT2F) for evaluating tracker sustainability on embedded platforms.

entry.title: Polyp Segmentation Using Wavelet-Based Cross-Band Integration for Enhanced Boundary Representation

author.name: Haesung Oh, Jaesung Lee

entry.summary: Proposes wavelet-based cross-band integration for polyp segmentation, showing that grayscale wavelet representations preserve higher boundary contrast than RGB, improving boundary delineation for colorectal cancer detection.

entry.title: An Adaptive KKT-Based Indicator for Convergence Assessment in Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Thiago Santos, Sebastiao Xavier

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive KKT-based convergence indicator for multi-objective optimization that uses quantile-based reformulation to assess convergence without relying on known Pareto fronts.

entry.title: OmniPlanner: Universal Exploration and Inspection Path Planning across Robot Morphologies

author.name: Angelos Zacharia, Mihir Dharmadhikari, Mohit Singh, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Presents OmniPlanner, a unified path planning framework that works across aerial, ground, and underwater robots for exploration and inspection tasks, using a platform abstraction layer to handle morphology-specific constraints.

entry.title: Statistical Inference for Score Decompositions

author.name: Timo Dimitriadis, Marius Puke

entry.summary: Introduces inference methods for score decompositions that partition predictive scoring functions into miscalibration, discrimination, and uncertainty components, connecting to Mincer-Zarnowitz regression and enabling formal tests for equal forecast quality.

entry.title: The Influence of Iconicity in Transfer Learning for Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Keren Artiaga, Conor Lynch, Haithem Afli, Mohammed Hasanuzzaman
