entry.summary: Examines transfer learning for sign language recognition by comparing iconic sign similarity effects across different sign language pairs, using MediaPipe features with MLP and GRU architectures.

entry.title: Learning Order Forest for Qualitative-Attribute Data Clustering

author.name: Mingjie Zhao, Sen Feng, Yiqun Zhang, Mengke Li, Yang Lu, Yiu-ming Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes a tree-like distance structure for clustering qualitative attribute data, capturing order relationships among nominal values via a joint learning mechanism.

entry.title: Baseline Performance of AI Tools in Classifying Cognitive Demand of Mathematical Tasks

author.name: Danielle S. Fox, Brenda L. Robles, Elizabeth DiPietro Brovey, Christian D. Schunn

entry.summary: Evaluates 11 AI tools (general-purpose and education-specific) on classifying the cognitive demand level of mathematical tasks. Tests how well current LLMs can support teachers in curriculum adaptation.

entry.title: mlx-snn: Spiking Neural Networks on Apple Silicon via MLX

author.name: Jiahao Qin

entry.summary: Introduces mlx-snn, the first spiking neural network library built natively on Apple's MLX framework, providing neuron models, surrogate gradients, spike encoding, and BPTT training for Apple Silicon.

entry.title: Towards Effective Orchestration of AI x DB Workloads

author.name: Naili Xing, Haotian Gao, Zhanhao Zhao, Shaofeng Cai, Zhaojing Luo, Yuncheng Wu, Zhongle Xie, Meihui Zhang, Beng Chin Ooi

entry.summary: Discusses challenges of integrating AI workloads directly into database engines, addressing joint query processing, model execution optimization, resource coordination, and security in multi-tenant systems.

entry.title: Towards Generalized Multimodal Homography Estimation

author.name: Jinkun You, Jiaxin Cheng, Jie Zhang, Yicong Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a training data synthesis method for generalized multimodal homography estimation that generates unaligned image pairs from single images. Achieves cross-modality generalization without needing modality-specific training data.

entry.title: A Multi-Dimensional Quality Scoring Framework for Decentralized LLM Inference with Proof of Quality

author.name: Arther Tian, Alex Ding, Frank Chen, Simon Wu, Aaron Chan

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional quality scoring framework for decentralized LLM inference networks, decomposing output quality into modular dimensions including structure, semantics, alignment, and agreement. Extends Proof of Quality mechanisms for incentive-compatible quality assessment.

entry.title: Efficient Point Cloud Processing with High-Dimensional Positional Encoding and Non-Local MLPs

author.name: Yanmei Zou, Hongshan Yu, Yaonan Wang, Zhengeng Yang, Xieyuanli Chen, Kailun Yang, Naveed Akhtar

entry.summary: Proposes efficient point cloud processing using high-dimensional positional encoding and non-local MLPs. Develops a two-stage abstraction-refinement view for modular feature extraction that clarifies the evolution of point cloud architectures.

entry.title: When Small Variations Become Big Failures: Reliability Challenges in Compute-in-Memory Neural Accelerators

author.name: Yifan Qin, Jiahao Zheng, Zheyu Yan, Wujie Wen, Xiaobo Sharon Hu, Yiyu Shi

entry.summary: Examines reliability challenges in compute-in-memory neural accelerators, showing small device variations can cause disproportionate failures. Presents techniques bridging device physics, architecture, and learning algorithms.

entry.title: Logit-Level Uncertainty Quantification in Vision-Language Models for Histopathology Image Analysis

author.name: Betul Yurdem, Ferhat Ozgur Catak, Murat Kuzlu, Mehmet Kemal Gullu

entry.summary: Proposes a logit-level uncertainty quantification framework for VLMs in histopathology, using temperature-controlled output logits to separate model confidence from uncertainty.

entry.title: Freezing of Gait Prediction using Proactive Agent that Learns from Selected Experience and DDQN Algorithm

author.name: Septian Enggar Sukmana (Kyushu Institute of Technology), Sang Won Bae (Stevens Institute of Technology), Tomohiro Shibata (Kyushu Institute of Technology)

entry.summary: Applies Double Deep Q-Network with Prioritized Experience Replay to predict Freezing of Gait episodes in Parkinson's Disease patients. Aims to extend the prediction horizon for proactive assistive interventions.

entry.title: Multi-Stage Music Source Restoration with BandSplit-RoFormer Separation and HiFi++ GAN

author.name: Tobias Morocutti, Emmanouil Karystinaios, Jonathan Greif, Gerhard Widmer

entry.summary: Presents a multi-stage music source restoration system using BandSplit-RoFormer separation with curriculum training and instrument-specific HiFi++ GAN restorers for the MSR ICASSP Challenge.

entry.title: Enhancing Authorship Attribution with Synthetic Paintings

author.name: Clarissa Loures, Caio Hosken, Luan Oliveira, Gianlucca Zuin, Adriano Veloso

entry.summary: Investigates whether synthetic images generated via DreamBooth fine-tuning of Stable Diffusion can improve painting authorship attribution models. A hybrid real+synthetic approach achieves higher accuracy than real-only training.

entry.title: Adaptive Enhancement and Dual-Pooling Sequential Attention for Lightweight Underwater Object Detection with YOLOv10

author.name: Md. Mushibur Rahman, Umme Fawzia Rahim, Enam Ahmed Taufik

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight underwater object detection framework based on YOLOv10 with adaptive enhancement, dual-pooling attention, and focal generalized IoU objectness for handling challenging underwater conditions.

entry.title: Long-Term Visual Localization in Dynamic Benthic Environments: A Dataset, Footprint-Based Ground Truth, and Visual Place Recognition Benchmark

author.name: Martin Kvisvik Larsen, Oscar Pizarro

entry.summary: Presents a curated dataset and novel ground-truthing method for long-term visual localization in underwater benthic environments using AUV imagery, addressing the lack of benchmarks for this domain.

entry.title: CLIP-Guided Multi-Task Regression for Multi-View Plant Phenotyping

author.name: Simon Warmers, Muhammad Zawish, Fayaz Ali Dharejo, Steven Davy, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: Proposes a CLIP-based multi-task framework for multi-view plant phenotyping that jointly predicts plant age and leaf count, achieving substantial improvements over baselines on the GroMo25 benchmark.

entry.title: LISTA-Transformer Model Based on Sparse Coding and Attention Mechanism and Its Application in Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Shuang Liu, Lina Zhao, Tian Wang, Huaqing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes LISTA-Transformer combining sparse coding (LISTA) with attention mechanisms for joint local feature modeling and global dependency capture, applied to image classification and industrial fault diagnosis.

entry.title: HBRB-BoW: A Retrained Bag-of-Words Vocabulary for ORB-SLAM via Hierarchical BRB-KMeans

author.name: Minjae Lee, Sang-Min Choi, Gun-Woo Kim, Suwon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes HBRB-BoW, a refined hierarchical binary vocabulary for ORB-SLAM that addresses precision loss in conventional binary clustering by converting to real-valued space for clustering and back to binary.

entry.title: Passive Phase-Oriented Impedance Shaping for Rapid Acceleration in Soft Robotic Swimmers

author.name: Qimin Feng, Orion A. Roberts, Qiang Zhong

entry.summary: Investigates constrained-layer damping as a passive mechanism for frequency-selective impedance shaping in soft robotic swimmers, showing how it enhances thrust and phase relationships for rapid acceleration.

entry.title: Swimming Under Constraints: A Safe Reinforcement Learning Framework for Quadrupedal Bio-Inspired Propulsion

author.name: Xinyu Cui, Fei Han, Hang Xu, Yongcheng Zeng, Luoyang Sun, Ruizhi Zhang, Jian Zhao, Haifeng Zhang, Weikun Li, Hao Chen, Jun Wang, Dixia Fan

entry.summary: Proposes ACPPO-PID, a safe reinforcement learning framework for quadrupedal swimming robots that maximizes thrust while constraining destabilizing forces in 6-DoF fluid environments. Uses PID-regulated Lagrange multipliers and imitation learning initialization for stable policy training.

entry.title: Compliant In-hand Rolling Manipulation Using Tactile Sensing

author.name: Huan Weng, Yifei Chen, Kevin M. Lynch

entry.summary: Investigates in-hand rolling manipulation using compliant multifingered hands with tactile sensing, deriving equations of motion for quasistatic rolling and formulating a multi-finger controller to achieve desired object motion.

entry.title: A Soft Robotic Demonstration in the Stratospher

author.name: Codrin Tugui, Tirth Thakar, Anatol Gogoj, Alexander White, Ang Leo Li, Alexander Yin, Edward Pomianek, Mihai Duduta

entry.summary: Demonstrates soft robotic actuators operating in stratospheric conditions using a novel UV-crosslinked silicone elastomer with platinum catalyst, showing dielectric elastomer actuators can function in extreme pressure and temperature environments.

entry.title: Direct Bayesian Additive Regression Trees for Conditional Average Treatment Effects in Regression Discontinuity Designs

author.name: Daisuke Kondo, Shonosuke Sugasawa

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian nonparametric approach using BART (Bayesian Additive Regression Trees) for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in regression discontinuity designs, using a pseudo-model with local linear loss functions.

entry.title: Sacred values of future AIs

author.name: Cleo Nardo

entry.summary: Applies Hanson's theory of sacred values to future AI coordination, predicting that AIs under coordination pressure will sacralize values like helpfulness/harmlessness/honesty, which could lead to systematic decision-making failures around those sacred topics.

entry.title: Multi-Agent-Based Simulation of Archaeological Mobility in Uneven Landscapes

author.name: Chairi Kiourt, Vassilis Evangelidis, Dimitris Grigoropoulos

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent framework for simulating archaeological mobility in uneven landscapes, combining global path planning with local dynamic adaptation through reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Influence Diagrams to Hybrid Threat Modeling

author.name: Maarten C. Vonk, Anna V. Kononova, Thomas B\"ack, Tim Sweijs

entry.summary: Applies multi-agent influence diagrams to model hybrid threats (below conventional military threshold) and evaluate countermeasures, running 1000 semi-synthetic variants of a real-world scenario.

entry.title: UrbanHuRo: A Two-Layer Human-Robot Collaboration Framework for the Joint Optimization of Heterogeneous Urban Services

author.name: Tonmoy Dey, Lin Jiang, Zheng Dong, Guang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UrbanHuRo, a two-layer framework for jointly optimizing heterogeneous urban services (delivery, sensing) through human-robot collaboration, addressing conflicting objectives across service types.

entry.title: CzechTopic: A Benchmark for Zero-Shot Topic Localization in Historical Czech Documents

author.name: Martin Kosteln\'ik, Michal Hradi\v{s}, Martin Do\v{c}ekal

entry.summary: Introduces CzechTopic, a human-annotated benchmark for zero-shot topic localization in historical Czech documents, evaluating LLMs and BERT-based models against human agreement.

entry.title: MOO: A Multi-view Oriented Observations Dataset for Viewpoint Analysis in Cattle Re-Identification

author.name: William Grolleau, Achraf Chaouch, Astrid Sabourin, Guillaume Lapouge, Catherine Achard

entry.summary: Introduces MOO, a large-scale synthetic dataset of 1,000 cattle individuals from 128 viewpoints (128K images) for studying viewpoint effects in aerial-ground animal re-identification. Identifies critical elevation thresholds for cross-view generalization.

entry.title: Two-Stage Photovoltaic Forecasting: Separating Weather Prediction from Plant-Characteristics

author.name: Philipp Danner, Hermann de Meer

entry.summary: Decomposes photovoltaic forecasting into weather prediction and plant characteristic models, using satellite observations as an intermediate layer. Analyzes error distributions for stochastic optimization.

entry.title: Combating data scarcity in recommendation services: Integrating cognitive types of VARK and neural network technologies (LLM)

author.name: Nikita Zmanovskii

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid recommendation framework combining LLMs for content analysis with VARK cognitive profiling to address cold-start problems. Uses LLMs to enrich item descriptions and generate user profiles from minimal data.

entry.title: Slice-wise quality assessment of high b-value breast DWI via deep learning-based artifact detection

author.name: Ameya Markale, Luise Brock, Ihor Horishnyi, Dominika Skwierawska, Tri-Thien Nguyen, Hannes Schreiter, Shirin Heidarikahkesh, Lorenz A. Kapsner, Michael Uder, Sabine Ohlmeyer, Frederik B Laun, Andrzej Liebert, Sebastian Bickelhaupt

entry.summary: Applies deep learning for slice-wise artifact detection in high b-value breast diffusion-weighted MRI, comparing binary and multiclass classification approaches on a clinical dataset of 11,806 slices.

entry.title: Modeling and Control of a Pneumatic Soft Robotic Catheter Using Neural Koopman Operators

author.name: Yiyao Yue, Noah Barnes, Lingyun Di, Olivia Young, Ryan D. Sochol, Jeremy D. Brown, Axel Krieger

entry.summary: Presents a neural network-enhanced Koopman operator framework for modeling and controlling soft robotic catheters, replacing manually chosen basis functions with learned representations for better predictive control of nonlinear catheter dynamics.

entry.title: Testing Full Mediation of Treatment Effects and the Identifiability of Causal Mechanisms

author.name: Martin Huber, Kevin Kloiber, Luk\'a\v{s} Laff\'ers

entry.summary: Proposes a test for full mediation of treatment effects and identifiability of causal mechanisms, showing that under both conditions, treatment is conditionally independent of outcome given mediators and covariates.

entry.title: Tendon Force Modeling for Sim2Real Transfer of Reinforcement Learning Policies for Tendon-Driven Robots

author.name: Valentin Yuryev, Josie Hughes

entry.summary: Proposes a tendon force modeling approach to improve sim-to-real transfer of RL policies for tendon-driven robots, specifically addressing the actuator dynamics gap that causes poor policy transfer.

entry.title: Optimal trajectory-guided stochastic co-optimization for e-fuel system design and real-time operation

author.name: Jeongdong Kim, Minsu Kim, Jonggeol Na, Junghwan Kim

entry.summary: Presents MasCOR, a machine-learning-assisted co-optimization framework for e-fuel production systems that learns from operational trajectories to generalize across diverse configurations under renewable energy uncertainty.

entry.title: Bridging Pedagogy and Play: Introducing a Language Mapping Interface for Human-AI Co-Creation in Educational Game Design

author.name: Daijin Yang, Erica Kleinman, Casper Harteveld

entry.summary: Designs a controlled natural language framework-based web tool for LLM-assisted educational game design, positioning language as the primary interface for mapping pedagogy to gameplay.

entry.title: FeedAIde: Guiding App Users to Submit Rich Feedback Reports by Asking Context-Aware Follow-Up Questions

author.name: Ali Ebrahimi Pourasad, Meyssam Saghiri, Walid Maalej

entry.summary: Proposes FeedAIde, using MLLM reasoning to generate context-aware follow-up questions that help app users submit richer, more detailed feedback reports during the reporting process.

entry.title: LikeThis! Empowering App Users to Submit UI Improvement Suggestions Instead of Complaints

author.name: Jialiang Wei, Ali Ebrahimi Pourasad, Walid Maalej

entry.summary: Proposes LikeThis!, a GenAI approach that takes user comments with screenshots and generates multiple UI improvement alternatives, empowering users to submit constructive feedback with concrete suggestions.

entry.title: A Short Note on a Variant of the Squint Algorithm

author.name: Haipeng Luo

entry.summary: Describes a simple variant of the Squint algorithm for the classic expert problem, proving a regret bound resembling recent results by Freund et al. through an equally simple proof modification.

entry.title: Reducing hyperparameter sensitivity in measurement-feedback based Ising machines

author.name: Toon Sevenants, Guy Van der Sande, Guy Verschaffelt

entry.summary: Analyzes why measurement-feedback Ising machines have a narrower effective hyperparameter range than their continuous-time counterparts, and proposes a method to reduce this sensitivity.

entry.title: Automated Measurement of Geniohyoid Muscle Thickness During Speech Using Deep Learning and Ultrasound

author.name: Alisher Myrgyyassov, Bruce Xiao Wang, Yu Sun, Shuming Huang, Zhen Song, Min Ney Wong, Yongping Zheng

entry.summary: Presents SMMA, an automated framework combining deep learning segmentation with skeleton-based thickness quantification for analyzing geniohyoid muscle dynamics during speech via ultrasound.

entry.title: The Logovista English-Japanese Machine Translation System

author.name: Barton D. Wright

entry.summary: Documents the architecture and development of the Logovista English-Japanese rule-based machine translation system, commercially active from early 1990s through 2012, preserving historical knowledge about a large-scale RBMT system.

entry.title: Detection and Identification of Penguins Using Appearance and Motion Features

author.name: Kasumi Seko, Hiroki Kinoshita, Raj Rajeshwar Malinda, Hiroaki Kawashima

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for penguin detection and identification that integrates appearance and motion features, adapting YOLO11 for consecutive frame processing to overcome visual homogeneity challenges.

entry.title: Tracking Feral Horses in Aerial Video Using Oriented Bounding Boxes

author.name: Saeko Takizawa, Tamao Maeda, Shinya Yamamoto, Hiroaki Kawashima

entry.summary: Employs oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) for tracking feral horses in aerial video, addressing limitations of axis-aligned bounding boxes for top-view footage with varying body orientations.

entry.title: Characterization and Correlation of Robotic Snake Scale Friction and Locomotion Speed

author.name: Umit Sen, Andri Mahegan, Gina Olson

entry.summary: Characterizes frictional anisotropy in robotic snake scales including lateral friction, and correlates these measurements with locomotion speed and direction across different surfaces.

entry.title: GSeg3D: A High-Precision Grid-Based Algorithm for Safety-Critical Ground Segmentation in LiDAR Point Clouds

author.name: Muhammad Haider Khan Lodhi, Christoph Hertzberg

entry.summary: Introduces GSeg3D, a grid-based algorithm for ground segmentation in LiDAR point clouds designed for safety-critical autonomous driving applications, emphasizing high precision to reduce false detections.

entry.title: Maybe there's a pattern here?

author.name: dynomight

entry.summary: A historical essay tracing a recurring pattern where technologies invented to reduce harm (Gatling gun, rockets, nuclear energy, drones, AI) end up being repurposed for military or harmful applications, implicitly warning about AI following the same trajectory.

entry.title: Developing an AI Assistant for Knowledge Management and Workforce Training in State DOTs

author.name: Divija Amaram, Lu Gao, Gowtham Reddy Gudla, Tejaswini Sanjay Katale

entry.summary: Develops an AI assistant for knowledge management and workforce training in state transportation agencies, addressing fragmented knowledge transfer and information retrieval challenges in large technical document collections.

entry.title: A novel network for classification of cuneiform tablet metadata

author.name: Frederik Hagelskj{\ae}r

entry.summary: Develops a convolution-inspired point cloud architecture for classifying cuneiform tablet metadata, addressing limited annotated datasets for archaeological analysis.

entry.title: BLOCK: An Open-Source Bi-Stage MLLM Character-to-Skin Pipeline for Minecraft

author.name: Hengquan Guo

entry.summary: Presents BLOCK, an open-source pipeline using multimodal LLMs and fine-tuned FLUX.2 to generate pixel-perfect Minecraft skins from character concepts. Introduces EvolveLoRA, a progressive LoRA curriculum for multi-stage image generation.

entry.title: The Empty Quadrant: AI Teammates for Embodied Field Learning

author.name: Hyein Kim, Sung Park

entry.summary: Identifies an underexplored intersection in AIED research: AI as an epistemic teammate during unstructured field learning. Proposes Field Atlas, a concept where AI serves as a partner during place-bound inquiry rather than just an information delivery tool.

entry.title: LabelBuddy: An Open Source Music and Audio Language Annotation Tagging Tool Using AI Assistance

author.name: Ioannis Prokopiou, Ioannis Sina, Agisilaos Kounelis, Pantelis Vikatos, Themos Stafylakis

entry.summary: Introduces LabelBuddy, an open-source collaborative auto-tagging audio annotation tool that decouples interface from inference via containerized backends, allowing custom model plug-ins for AI-assisted pre-annotation in music information retrieval.

entry.title: REDNET-ML: A Multi-Sensor Machine Learning Pipeline for Harmful Algal Bloom Risk Detection Along the Omani Coast

author.name: Ameer Alhashemi

entry.summary: Develops REDNET-ML, a machine learning pipeline for harmful algal bloom detection along the Omani coast using multi-sensor satellite data fusion with CatBoost decision model.

entry.title: Real-time loosely coupled GNSS and IMU integration via Factor Graph Optimization

author.name: Radu-Andrei Cioaca, Cristian Rusu, Paul Irofti, Gianluca Caparra, Andrei-Alexandru Marinache, Florin Stoican

entry.summary: Proposes a real-time loosely coupled GNSS-IMU integration architecture using Factor Graph Optimization, focusing on computational feasibility for real-time deployment.

entry.title: Real-time tightly coupled GNSS and IMU integration via Factor Graph Optimization

author.name: Radu-Andrei Cioaca, Paul Irofti, Cristian Rusu, Gianluca Caparra, Andrei-Alexandru Marinache, Florin Stoican

entry.summary: Presents a real-time tightly coupled GNSS-IMU factor graph optimization method with fixed-lag marginalization, evaluated on the UrbanNav dataset for GPS-degraded urban environments.

entry.title: VietNormalizer: An Open-Source, Dependency-Free Python Library for Vietnamese Text Normalization in TTS and NLP Applications

author.name: Hung Vu Nguyen, Loan Do, Thanh Ngoc Nguyen, Ushik Shrestha Khwakhali, Thanh Pham, Vinh Do, Charlotte Nguyen, Hien Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents VietNormalizer, an open-source, zero-dependency Python library for Vietnamese text normalization targeting TTS and NLP applications, handling numbers, dates, currencies, acronyms, and other non-standard words.

entry.title: Soft Semi-active Back Support Device with Adaptive Force Profiles using Variable-elastic Actuation and Weight Feedback

author.name: Rohan Khatavkar, The Bach Nguyen, Inseung Kang, Hyunglae Lee, Jiefeng Sun

entry.summary: Presents a soft, lightweight back support device combining variable-stiffness passive and active artificial muscle elements in parallel, providing weight-adaptive assistance for lifting and lowering tasks.

entry.title: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) Authentication for Offline CBDC Payment System Using IoT Devices

author.name: Santanu Mondal, T. Chithralekha

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-knowledge proof authentication system for offline CBDC payments using IoT devices, enabling secure transactions without network connectivity while maintaining AML/CFT compliance.

entry.title: Unsupervised Surrogate-Assisted Synthesis of Free-Form Planar Antenna Topologies for IoT Applications

author.name: Khadijeh Askaripour, Adrian Bekasiewicz, Slawomir Koziel

entry.summary: Proposes unsupervised surrogate-assisted synthesis of free-form planar antenna topologies for IoT. Uses surrogate models to accelerate antenna topology optimization.

entry.title: A Bi-Stage Framework for Automatic Development of Pixel-Based Planar Antenna Structures

author.name: Khadijeh Askaripour, Adrian Bekasiewicz, Slawomir Koziel

entry.summary: Presents a bi-stage framework for automatic pixel-based antenna topology generation using global optimization of pixel connections followed by surrogate-assisted local search.

entry.title: LoRA-MME: Multi-Model Ensemble of LoRA-Tuned Encoders for Code Comment Classification

author.name: Md Akib Haider, Ahsan Bulbul, Nafis Fuad Shahid, Aimaan Ahmed, Mohammad Ishrak Abedin

entry.summary: Presents LoRA-MME, a multi-model ensemble of LoRA-tuned code encoders for code comment classification in the NLBSE'26 competition.

entry.title: A theoretical model of dynamical grammatical gender shifting based on set-valued set function

author.name: Mohamed El Idrissi

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical model for grammatical gender shifting in language using set-valued set functions, formally representing template-item pairing for morphological generation.

entry.title: Gen Z and AI: Education, Well-being, and the Labour Market

author.name: Jason Hung

entry.summary: Synthesizes research on how Generation Z is experiencing the AI transition across education, social life/well-being, and labour markets, arguing that AI adoption has outpaced institutional preparation with compounding effects on mental health and job prospects.

entry.title: Field imaging framework for morphological characterization of aggregates with computer vision: Algorithms and applications

author.name: Haohang Huang

entry.summary: Develops a field imaging framework for morphological characterization of construction aggregates using computer vision, addressing challenges of segmentation and volume estimation in field conditions.

entry.title: STEM Faculty Perspectives on Generative AI in Higher Education

author.name: Akila de Silva, Isabel Hyo Jung Song, Hui Yang, Shah Rukh Humayoun

entry.summary: Presents findings from focus groups with 29 STEM faculty about GenAI adoption in higher education, covering concerns about academic integrity, assessment validity, and pedagogical strategies.

entry.title: Lambdas at the Far Edge: a Tale of Flying Lambdas and Lambdas on Wheels

author.name: Giorgio Audrito (Department of Computer Science), Daniele Bortoluzzi (Department of Computer Science), Ferruccio Damiani (Department of Computer Science), Giordano Scarso (Department of Computer Science), Gianluca Torta (Department of Computer Science), Andrea Basso (MITO Technology, Milan, Italy), Monica Cochi (Torino Airport), Lorenzo Gusman (Torino Airport), Lorenzo Comba (Department of Agricultural, Forest, Food Sciences), Paolo Gay (Department of Agricultural, Forest, Food Sciences), Paola Dal Zovo (Concept Engineering Reply, Turin, Italy), Giada Galati (Eurix, Turin, Italy), Francesco Gallo (Eurix, Turin, Italy), Alja\v{z} Grdadolnik (Faculty of Computer, Information Science University of Ljubljana, Ljubljana, Slovenia), Massimo Pescarollo (Department of Economics, Statistics Cognetti de Martiis, University of Turin, Turin, Italy), Paola Pisano (Department of Economics, Statistics, Cognetti de Martiis, University of Turin, Turin, Italy)

entry.summary: Describes the eXchange Calculus (XC) and its C++ implementation FCPP for programming collective behavior of distributed devices at the network edge, with applications to drones and mobile robots.

entry.title: Is GDP a Kind of Factory?

author.name: Benquo

entry.summary: Critiques the use of GDP as a measure of economic convergence, arguing that the Solow growth model's predictions don't match how convergence is actually measured, and that the apparent convergence was a mirage driven by the Chinese commodities boom.

entry.title: Lie To Me, But At Least Don't Bullshit

author.name: Czynski

entry.summary: A philosophical exploration distinguishing between lies (deliberate deception), falsehoods (saying untrue things), and bullshit (speech without regard for truth), arguing that bullshit is more corrosive than lying because it erodes the shared commitment to truth.

entry.title: How a Pinky Promise once stopped a war in the Middle East.

author.name: positivesum

entry.summary: A historical narrative about King Hussein of Jordan's diplomatic role during the Gulf Crisis, involving trust-based diplomacy between Middle Eastern leaders. Not related to AI.
